0x305031712b03616f_0x3b87301fb4b7b770.text: An Absolute Must-Do — Top 10 Life Experience for Our Family I don't say this lightly: visiting Elephant Jungle Sanctuary in Phuket was one of the top 10 experiences of my entire life, and my family felt the same way. If you're on the fence about booking this, stop hesitating and just do it. From the moment we arrived, the entire experience was thoughtfully organized and deeply meaningful. We got to feed and touch the elephants up close — something that instantly melted every heart in our group. Then came the mud bath, which was as hilarious as it was unforgettable, followed by splashing around with the elephants in a pool. Pure joy doesn't even begin to cover it. What really set this apart was how much we *learned*. The team took time to introduce each elephant individually — their personalities, their backstories, their quirks. You leave not just with incredible memories and photos, but with a genuine connection to these magnificent animals and a real appreciation for the sanctuary's mission. We also got to make traditional Thai food, which was a wonderful bonus and gave us even more cultural depth to an already packed and incredible day. Now — I have to talk about our guide Minty. She was, without question, the MVP of the entire experience. Smart, funny, warm, and incredibly engaging, she had our whole group laughing and participating from start to finish. She made sure no one was left out and brought so much energy and genuine passion to everything she did. Minty is the kind of guide who elevates a great experience into an unforgettable one. Hannah was also lovely and kind throughout the day as well. If you're visiting Phuket with family, this is a non-negotiable. Book it. You won't regret a single minute.
0x305031712b03616f_0x3b87301fb4b7b770.author: John Daniels

0x305031712b03616f_0x3b87301fb4b7b770.text: We traveled all the way from the Philippines and honestly, 1000% worth it. 🐘💚 Our tour guide Michael was AMAZING. You can instantly tell how passionate he is about elephants. Not the “memorized script” kind of passionate, but the “this man could talk about elephants for 10 business days straight” kind. 😂 He made the whole tour fun, informative, and super engaging. We learned so much from him and he explained everything so well during the orientation, from the dos and don’ts to why the sanctuary cares for the elephants the way they do. What we loved most is how much they genuinely care about the elephants. They’re free to roam around, well taken care of, and the whole experience felt very respectful and educational. You can really see that the elephants’ welfare comes first here, which made the experience even more special. The mahouts were also very friendly! They guided us while feeding the elephants and made us feel comfortable and not scared at all. You can tell they really care both about the elephants and the visitors, especially for first-timers like us. 🐘✨ Also, shoutout to the reception team for being so warm and friendly! They asked where we were from and then started playing Filipino songs at the reception. Instant happiness for us Filipinos abroad. 😂 Special thanks to Ana, Max, Mr. Shao, and Smiley for making our visit even more memorable! If you’re thinking of visiting, do it. Come for the elephants, stay for Michael’s elite elephant TED Talk. 🐘✨
0x305031712b03616f_0x3b87301fb4b7b770.author: Mai Pagkalinawan

0x305031712b03616f_0x3b87301fb4b7b770.text: We found this place by accident while driving round in our rental car. WOW! We really loved getting up close with the elephants and learning about them. I almost walked off when I found out it was 2000baht/person for the elephant bath and feeding but after going for it I’m so glad I did. It was absolutely amazing. The elephant bath was great fun and it was amazing to be up close and personal with the elephants. The staff at the place are such helpful, friendly and nice people. We wondered off with the wrong group and instead of losing out - the guy noticed we were missing from the right group and came and got us. Thankyou! We got to make a food ball using a giant mortar and pestle with rice, banana and salt and feed this and bamboo to the elephants. All the staff were taking our phones of us to take pictures of us with the elephants. It was a really great experience and I’m so glad being tight didn’t make us miss out on it. We would love to come back here on our next holiday to Phuket 😍🐘
0x305031712b03616f_0x3b87301fb4b7b770.author: Alexander Galley

0x305031712b03616f_0x3b87301fb4b7b770.text: Staff were very well informed about the elephants and gave a large background before we were even able to see the elephants, which was appreciated as you really understood where the elephants were coming from. Only thing I would say that personally should’ve been prewarned, we were told that we could touch the elephants if they are feeding I.e. feed them a bit of watermelon and you can touch the trunk. However, it was not noted that some elephants were aggressive and not to be touched, I seen many people going to feed a certain elephant then going to touch it’s face or trunk and being scolded by one of the people working with the elephants. Appreciate the worker telling people not to touch as they could be injured if the elephant is aggressive, however to stop him from repeating himself this really should’ve been revealed in the briefing.
0x305031712b03616f_0x3b87301fb4b7b770.author: Aimee Higgins

0x305031712b03616f_0x3b87301fb4b7b770.text: Absolutely incredible experience from start to finish. The sanctuary is doing such important work rescuing and caring for elephants, and you can genuinely feel the love and dedication from everyone there. I learnt so much about elephants, their behaviour, their history, and the heartbreaking situations many of them were saved from. A massive thank you to our guide K, who was outstanding all day. So knowledgeable, passionate, and engaging you could tell how much they truly care about the elephants and their wellbeing. Hearing the rescue stories and learning about each elephant’s journey made the whole experience even more meaningful. Such a wholesome, eye-opening and unforgettable day. If you’re visiting Phuket, this is an absolute must-do experience. Thank you to everyone at Elephant Jungle Sanctuary for the amazing work you do! 🐘❤️
0x305031712b03616f_0x3b87301fb4b7b770.author: Daniel Bent (DB)

0x305031712b03616f_0x3b87301fb4b7b770.text: I booked the half-day tour. It was my first time experiencing elephants up close. The elephants are very well cared for here and seemed peaceful. At the beginning, the tour itinerary was explained. Sky, who explained everything at the start, was a really friendly and humorous person. Afterwards, we were allowed to feed the elephants watermelons, then prepare food and take mud baths with the elephants, followed by bathing with them in clean water. The elephants were very peaceful and let us stroke them without any problems. I had the impression that they really enjoyed it and the staff treated the animals with great sensitivity. Afterwards, there was a cooking class on how to prepare Pad Thai. I really recommend it and it was a wonderful morning.
0x305031712b03616f_0x3b87301fb4b7b770.author: Sven

0x305031712b03616f_0x3b87301fb4b7b770.text: A must do experience!!! What can I say, such a well designed informative tour and experience with these majestic animals. The organisation has a few other sanctuaries across Thailand. The elephants are rescued from the timber logging industry, entertainment (rides and circus tricks) are brought here to live from the mainland. Phuket has no wild elephants. We did the half day experience witj elephant feeding (watermelon amd sugarcane) making elephant rice balls (and feeding them), mud spa session amd elephant bathing ( you scrub them), shower off time and a lovely lunch. Bonus extra are the free high res photographs taken by their professional photographer you can download from a QR code link after the session.

0x305031712b03616f_0x3b87301fb4b7b770.text: What a fantastic and rewarding experience! They are clearly well cared for by their assigned caretakers. There are excellent gift shops, and I would urge you to spend generously as you are supporting what is a hugely worthwhile sanctuary. Thank you Nancy for your guidance and information, we look forward to returning in the very near future.

0x30e29effb3b50a71_0xd689537a44928c37.text: Sura Korean BBQ Bangkok — Sura’s owner and chef learnt cooking from a Buddhist nun, Soenjae, the master of temple food, and value the harmony of nature’s diverse ingredients. We did not try Sura’s traditional chicken soup which has been awarded the Blue Ribbon Survey, Korea’s Michelin for 4 years in a row 2014-2017. Food wise, nothing to scream about but if you are looking for a quick affordable meal in the Sukhumvit area, this would be the place. It’s Korean no doubt but not the best quality Korean. Unexpectedly the notable dish was the cold buckwheat noodles (199B). We ordered the Friends Set (999B++) ideal for 3 persons -- Pork Belly (200g) Pork Blade Shoulder (200g), Kimchi Stew, Steam Egg Hotpot with Cheese. The vegetables were fresh and succulent. The popular boneless beef short ribs (730B 150g) was sold out when we came at about 2pm. We had the Premium Kkotgalbisal, highly marbled boneless beef short rib (870B 150g), but quality wise, it was on the low-end. The restaurant is cosy yet not cramped, having nice defined space for diners. March 7, 2024
0x30e29effb3b50a71_0xd689537a44928c37.author: Onestonebooks

0x30e29effb3b50a71_0xd689537a44928c37.text: Chance upon this place purely by accident as we were walking out towards Sukhumvit after taking our pre flight ART. Prices looked very affordable so decided to give it a try. It's a little joint that filled up quickly so make a reservation for weekends if you're coming. There was a queue when we left at about 7pm. From autographs on the walls, it seems that several local and Korean celebrities have graced this restaurant. The meats and soup were good but not great but the presentation was very instagramable. Service was surprisingly good and the side dishes were never allowed to be empty at any point. Beer was served in ice cold mugs with 2 pieces of rock ice to keep it cold all the time. Lastly, something of a novelty to me but i thought it was brilliant - you'll be provided also with a shower cap if you have longer hair so that you don't smell like BBQ when you leave.

0x30e29effb3b50a71_0xd689537a44928c37.text: Sura Korean BBQ & Tofu House is a cozy, unpretentious spot that delivers authentic Korean flavors with a focus on hearty tofu soups, flavorful grilled meats, and a variety of vegan-friendly options. The portions are generous, the banchan is satisfying, and the service is welcoming, making it a great choice for both casual dinners and group outings. While the space is modest and it can get busy during peak hours, the food more than makes up for it, offering comforting, well-seasoned dishes that appeal to meat-eaters and vegetarians alike. Overall, it’s a reliable, delicious destination for anyone craving authentic Korean comfort food outside the hustle of Koreatown

0x30e29edecba1a1dd_0x1063bee26f916ded.text: This place teaches you a different mindset about how you should take care of your health. I think the easiest way to describe the BDMS Wellness Clinic experience is that they help you understand your health baseline through data, and then identify areas where you can improve. Thank you to Dr. Tae for giving such a clear and thorough explanation of all my results, and to Khun Waew for making all the scheduling run smoothly. She knows her clients well and is always able to make helpful suggestions based on what you actually need. Most importantly, Dr. Mod, my nutritionist, gave me a different perspective on how I should approach my diet. I already know most of the basics of what I should and shouldn’t eat, so simply being told what to do doesn’t help me much. She took the time to really listen and understand my habits and what makes change difficult for me. It felt almost like talking to a psychologist, and she helped me find an approach that actually feels realistic and achievable.

0x30e29ed23dcfbdf5_0xbacf077cc7c09b29.text: I visited The Smile Bar for a same-day whitening package, which included three back-to-back whitening treatments, as well as a teeth cleaning. Overall, the treatment itself was good. I also received a protective treatment to help prevent tooth sensitivity for up to 30 days; however, this was not complimentary and was charged separately, as everything was an additional cost. While the results were satisfactory, several aspects of the experience were disappointing. The staff member assisting me appeared disengaged and was frequently on her phone, which felt unprofessional during a dental procedure. There was also a hygiene concern. There was only one sink available for all patients to rinse their mouths. During the two hours I was there, I did not see the sink area cleaned even once between patients. When I went to rinse, there was visible residue from previous patients, including saliva and debris, which was unpleasant and raised concerns about cleanliness. Pricing transparency was another issue. The charges for the teeth cleaning were not clearly explained beforehand, and I was also charged an additional 300 THB service fee that was never mentioned in advance. One additional point for future customers: I noticed that some five-star reviews appear to be incentivized. Customers are offered a free wooden toothbrush in exchange for leaving a five-star review. For this reason, I would recommend doing your own research and not relying solely on the ratings. There are other dental clinics available, such as All About Teeth, that offer whitening services and, in my experience, can provide even whiter results. I suggest comparing options before deciding. Overall, while the treatment itself was acceptable, improvements in staff professionalism, hygiene practices, and transparency around pricing would greatly improve the experience.
0x30e29ed23dcfbdf5_0xbacf077cc7c09b29.author: Shaz Alidina

0x30e29ed23dcfbdf5_0xbacf077cc7c09b29.text: I had a great experience from start to finish. The staff were very professional and friendly, and they took the time to explain the entire whitening process before we began. One thing I really appreciated was that they first did a shade comparison of my teeth, so I could clearly see my starting color and track the results afterward. It made the treatment feel much more personalized and transparent. They offer three different whitening packages depending on your goals and budget, which I thought was great because there wasn’t any pressure to choose the most expensive option. The staff patiently explained the differences between each service and helped me select the one that suited me best. The clinic itself was clean, comfortable, and welcoming. The treatment was straightforward, and the staff checked in regularly to make sure I was comfortable throughout the session. I noticed a visible improvement in the brightness of my teeth afterward, and seeing the before-and-after shade comparison was very satisfying. Overall, the experience exceeded my expectations. The combination of professional service, clear explanations, comfortable environment, and noticeable results made it well worth it. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone considering teeth whitening, whether it’s your first time or you’ve had whitening treatments before. I’ll definitely be coming back again in the future! 😊✨

0x30e299e13ca0eda5_0x9a81af58f887abb3.text: This market redefines the word "market" by being open all day, without the need to wait for closing time like typical markets. It's a market where the owners are considerate of the users and the users are also considerate. Therefore, if any problems arise, the owners will quickly resolve them, which I personally appreciate. I usually drive from Sathorn to have lunch and dinner here every day. I'm very impressed with this market. They have everything from savory dishes and desserts to fruits and fresh produce. There are also several bubble tea vendors; I personally like Bear House. There's plenty of parking, but it can get congested on weekends due to traffic. People tend to slow down and wait for spaces. If you have to circle around to find parking inside, you might need to be understanding of the situation. Overall, it's a great market, earning it 5 stars.

0x310295925648ac67_0x429d8cfbf7e0e5af.text: This dental clinic is a relatively new establishment, and its exterior design does not immediately resemble a conventional clinic. Instead, it embraces a minimalist, clean aesthetic that deliberately departs from the typical clinical environment. From the moment one steps inside, the atmosphere feels more akin to a music conservatory or an art gallery, calm, refined, and thoughtfully curated. The soothing ambiance, complemented by gentle background music, effectively alleviates the usual anxiety associated with dental visits, allowing patients to feel at ease almost instantly. At reception, I was initially surprised to be greeted by a very young staff member, likely in his early teens. However, from the moment he began explaining procedures and asking relevant questions, it became clear that he was well trained and capable. If this is part of a structured training initiative during school holidays, it is certainly a commendable approach to developing responsibility and confidence at a young age. The attending dentist, a young female practitioner with extensive experience, was both professional and approachable. Her demeanor was warm and reassuring, and her team of assistants maintained the same level of attentiveness and gentleness throughout the visit. Overall, the clinic offers a highly relaxed and patient friendly environment. Hygiene standards are excellent, with even the restroom maintained in pristine condition. Given that the clinic is newly established, the facilities are in near perfect condition. The only minor observation would be that some of the decorative plants in the corners appeared slightly wilted, which could be improved to better match the otherwise polished environment. The treatment experience itself was smooth and comfortable, and the appointment process was efficient and well-organized. In summary, this is a highly recommended dental clinic that successfully redefines the patient experience through thoughtful design, professionalism, and attention to detail.
0x310295925648ac67_0x429d8cfbf7e0e5af.author: Happitel Apartment

0x30e29e8d0c705d9f_0x5448833050277340.text: The Lotus group in Thailand was once a branch of Tesco UK so visitors from the UK will understand that Lotus is a one stop shop. Also on the upper level is a branch of DIY, a hardware store that sells: hand and power tools, screws and fasteners, electrical accessories, plastic products, kitchen and bathroom accessories etc, etc. all at very reasonable prices.

0x30e29e8d0c705d9f_0x5448833050277340.text: I recently had the pleasure of visiting Lotus’s shopping mall in Bangkok, and I couldn’t be more impressed! One of my favorite parts was the food court—it's a foodie paradise! You’ll find delicious Thai dishes alongside tasty international options, all at great prices. Plus, the staff are super friendly and ready to help, which made my visit even better. Getting there is easy, too, with convenient parking and good access to public transport. Whether you’re hunting for trendy fashion, cool electronics, or even just some groceries, Lotus’s has something for everyone. I definitely recommend checking this place out if you’re in Bangkok—it’s a must-visit!

0x30e28299ff1149af_0x2929331072f42f58.text: Ying Charoen Market, or "Saphan Mai Market" as it's more commonly known, is one of the oldest and most important large-scale retail and wholesale fresh markets in the Bang Khen area. Overall reviews from actual customers indicate that it's a market with a complete range of ingredients, convenient transportation, and is open 24 hours a day. It's suitable for both vendors buying supplies for their businesses and the general public looking for fresh ingredients at reasonable prices. Atmosphere and Facilities Cleanliness and Management: The market has been renovated to be indoors and is well-organized into zones for selling goods, such as fresh produce (meat/seafood), fruits and vegetables, dried food, and prepared food, making it easy to browse. Even though it's a large market, it's well-maintained with good cleanliness and ventilation. Parking: There is ample parking space both around the market and in the parking garage. However, during peak hours, such as early mornings or evenings, finding parking may be difficult, and traffic around the market may be heavy. Accessibility: This is a major advantage as it's located next to Phahonyothin Road and is close to the BTS Sai Yud station, making it very convenient to travel to without worrying about traffic or parking. Products and Prices Variety: The market offers a wide range of products, from fresh ingredients such as pork, chicken, frozen and fresh seafood, local vegetables, temperate vegetables, and seasonal fruits, to groceries and various seasonings. Price: Known for its affordable prices, as it is a large wholesale market. Buying in bulk results in significantly lower prices. Many fresh produce items are of good quality at reasonable prices. Ready-to-Eat Food Zone (Yingcharoen Food Plaza): This food court brings together many delicious restaurants and ready-to-eat savory and sweet dishes, perfect for those who want to find something tasty to eat throughout the day.
0x30e28299ff1149af_0x2929331072f42f58.author: ธนัญชัย ควรพินิจ

0x30e28299ff1149af_0x2929331072f42f58.text: 🌟 This is a really enjoyable market to stroll through. There's a wide variety of food and goods to choose from, all in one place. The atmosphere is lively but not overly crowded, the air circulation is good, and overall, the area is well-organized. 👍 Things I liked: • Wide variety of food and goods, fun to browse. • Generally reasonable prices. • Plenty of parking and convenient access. • Clean and organized; well-maintained compared to other markets of the same caliber. 💡 Suggestions: • During peak hours, managing parking flow and having staff to guide visitors to available parking spaces would significantly reduce waiting times. • Adding a market map or signs indicating shop zones would make navigation easier for first-time visitors. ⭐ My personal rating: • Accessibility: 9/10 • Cleanliness: 7.5/10 • Variety of goods and food: 9/10 • Area management: 8.5/10 • Value for money: 9/10 Summary: Another market worth visiting. 0x30e28fd99860fe0f_0x9505188fa96a6987.text: When buying things, the price tag says it's on sale, but we need to check what's on sale, the color, the scent, and the barcode. Sometimes it's the same type of product but with different scents. Check the barcode to make sure the discount matches the item you picked up. I once saw an item on sale but didn't check the color and barcode, and when I went to pay, the discount wasn't applied. They said I picked the wrong item. It has to be the specific item that's discounted. Instead of buying the discounted item, you might end up paying the regular price. Focus on checking the barcode of the item that's on sale.

0x30e29f47ede318f7_0x20198be3316332fe.text: Honest review: The Good: They are super professional, everything from start to finish the service was fantastic. I cannot fault it at all, and the technology they have with scanning your teeth and getting a full 3D colour image of everything is really great. They bring everything up on screen and can zoom in, showing you everything and talking through recommendations together. I've never experienced that at any other dentist in my life (in UK, Europe, Mexico, Colombia) The bad: I only really went in for a cleaning/scaling/polishing - however you want to call it, which typically would cost around 800-1200 THB in most other places I've been in my life. They told me the staining was only possible to be removed with their Airflow system - which I don't think is quite right because other dentists I've been to have always managed to do it and none have had Airflow. The cost then went from what they had quoted me previously as 1400-2000 THB, to 2,568 THB. I accepted even though it was more than I was expecting. Then at the end, they added another 250 THB on, for the 'consulation fee', which I don't think is really fair as they never mentioned that one. So in summary, the service is really good, and they do a great job, but they really lay it on thick with the cost. It's more than triple what I paid the last dentist I went to (in Greece) for a scale & polish. The end result is more or less the same.

0x30e29f47ede318f7_0x20198be3316332fe.text: Great dental clinic! Easy to message on what’s app and make an appointment. When the top retainer didn’t fit, they immediately took another mold and got me a good retainer the same day. Super thankful. Only warning is they definitely try to upgrade your cleaning and we just had to be firm that we only wanted a standard cleaning. 0x30503990fb35ab1f_0xcecf67b3c95ea51f.text: We visited Catch Beach Club for brunch and ended up staying for dinner as well. For brunch, we booked a sunbed for 5,000 baht, which can be used as a deposit for food and drinks. The atmosphere was great, lively and relaxed, with a lounge DJ playing during the day and evening. There was also a small fire performance with artists walking around, although there was no big fire show during dinner. It is a nice place to spend the whole day: enjoy the beach, pool, shower, relax, and then stay for dinner. For brunch, we tried the gazpacho. The presentation was beautiful, served with shrimp, but the taste itself felt a little flat. The scallop ceviche with shrimp was excellent and I definitely recommend it. The mashed potatoes with truffle were also delicious. I almost licked the plate twice. The blue crab salad has been on the menu for a long time, but as always, it was tasty. For dinner, the pad thai was amazing, juicy, flavorful, and very well made. We also tried the octopus, but for me it was too spicy, so keep in mind that it is above medium spice level. The coffee was good. Beer selection could be better, especially on tap. Most options were bottled, and I think a place like this would benefit from a few draft beer choices. I also wanted fresh juice by the glass, but they only had large 1.5 liter fresh juice options, while the rest were from cartons. They now have two pools around the beach club area, which is a nice upgrade. Overall, it is a very good place to spend the whole day when the weather is sunny.
0x30503990fb35ab1f_0xcecf67b3c95ea51f.author: Nora Vale

0x30503990fb35ab1f_0xcecf67b3c95ea51f.text: Catch Beach Club honestly feels like the ultimate place to be here. The atmosphere is absolutely stunning — directly by the ocean with the sound of the waves just a few meters away, beautiful lighting everywhere, and an overall vibe that instantly makes you feel relaxed and comfortable. The staff was extremely friendly and attentive, and the entire place gives you exactly what you would hope for from a high-end beach club experience. Yes, it is definitely on the more expensive side, but you are clearly paying for the incredible ambiance and location, and in that sense it feels worth it. The music was perfect for the setting: relaxed, stylish, and never too much. It’s exactly the kind of place where you genuinely enjoy spending hours without wanting to leave. The only small downside — and honestly not really the club’s fault — was that it deserved a few more people. At times it felt a little empty, but that was probably because we visited during the week rather than on a weekend. Overall, a beautiful beach club with an amazing atmosphere, great service, and one of the best seaside vibes we’ve experienced in Phuket.

0x30e29e821a625123_0xf81a0d515151159d.text: GHuai Khwang Market is an extremely vibrant and authentic local market in Bangkok, offering a true taste of local Thai nightlife, street food, and fresh produce shopping. 🍉 Core Highlight: Fresh Produce & Tropical Fruits The true heart of this market is its massive fresh produce section! As a major supply hub for local residents and restaurant owners, it offers a huge selection of super affordable tropical fruits (such as mangosteen, rambutan, durian, mangoes, and longan), along with fresh vegetables, meat, and seafood. Compared to touristy night markets or supermarkets, the prices here are dirt cheap, quantities are generous, and everything is fresh from the farm. 🍲 Food & Local Street Eats: Beyond the fresh market section, it is famous for its wide array of local Thai street eats. You can find authentic Isan cuisine (like spicy papaya salad and grilled meats), boat noodles, traditional Thai desserts, and various seafood stalls that cater heavily to late-night diners. 🛍️ Everyday Shopping & Local Vibe: The market also features stalls selling cheap clothing, daily necessities, cosmetics, household items, and fresh flowers. Unlike polished, tourist-centric night markets, this place feels raw, energetic, and deeply rooted in everyday local life. ⏰ Best Time to Visit & Transport: * Operating Hours: The fresh fruit, vegetable, and produce market operates 24/7. The street food stalls and night market vendors are at their peak from around 7:00 PM until late into the night. * Access: Easily accessible via MRT Huai Khwang Station (Exit 3 or 4), followed by a short walk down Pracha Songkhro Road. 🚗 Summary: If you want to buy cheap, fresh tropical fruits late at night, explore a truly authentic Thai wet market, or grab a late-night bite alongside locals, Huai Khwang Market is a top choice.
0x30e29e821a625123_0xf81a0d515151159d.author: Sanj

0x30e29e821a625123_0xf81a0d515151159d.text: I bought a durian from a street vendor. They were selling it for 180-200 baht per kilogram. Previously, I'd bought pre-cut durians for 90-130 baht, but it wasn't enough, so today I bought a whole, small durian. I bought it for 270 baht from a stall that usually sells durians for 180 baht per kilogram. It came out as three pieces: one approximately 10cm in diameter and 20cm long, one approximately 4cm in diameter and 15cm long, and one approximately 3cm in diameter and 3cm long. It was the perfect amount for one person. I recommend ordering a whole durian and having them cut it up on the spot, rather than buying a pre-cut one with the price displayed. I revisited in September 2026. This time, the going rate was 130-200 baht per kilogram. There were fewer pickup trucks selling durians on the street than last time. I bought one durian (about 3 kg) every day from a fruit shop for 130 baht/kg during my one-week stay, and I was able to eat a delicious durian 90% of the time, so I'm very satisfied. I will definitely buy it again the next time I visit Bangkok!

0x30e2a00acea3865f_0xded68b894c75cfcd.text: Dadfa Lasalle is a popular local Thai restaurant located in the Lasalle area of Bangkok. The restaurant is well known for its authentic Thai street food and flavorful dishes that attract both local residents and visitors. At Dadfa Lasalle, customers can enjoy a variety of Thai dishes such as spicy salads, stir-fried seafood, grilled meats, and traditional Thai soups. The food is known for its rich taste, fresh ingredients, and generous portions. The restaurant has a casual and friendly atmosphere, making it a great place for families and friends to enjoy a meal together. Because of its delicious food and reasonable prices, Dadfa Lasalle is a favorite dining spot for people who want to experience authentic Thai flavors in Bangkok.

0x3054f3b52e4a8e4d_0x2f5df5703a343206.text: We stumbled across this beautiful sanctuary by accident & wow what a place…. The staff were so welcoming & accommodating (we just turned up with no reservation) we were given 3 different packages to choose from, we chose package 3 . We were given a quick debrief on the do’s & dont’s whilst in the sanctuary then we was introduced to the baby elephants & was able to feed them… we were given a educational guide on the difference of the Asian & African elephants we then made protein balls & prepared food for the adult elephants… everything was so well organised & very relaxed we were allowed to interact with the elephants & true as many photos as we wished. We were then taken through a short jungle walk to meet another adult elephant who we fed then showered , after this we showered the babies which were very mischievous & playful. We were then given some fruit & were shown a video that was taken of our whole experience along with many photos taken by our guides. This whole experience was so much more than we had ever imagined & really made our holiday bring do close to these beautiful creatures who are so well looked after now since being rescued from lives of torture & trekking to now living a life if freedom in a lovely jungle enclosure to roam freely and safely whilst being shown respect & love from their handlers …. If you choose one place to see the elephants 100% choose this place as it runs entirely on donations & all money raised goes back into the upkeep , rescue & medical costs for not just these elephants but for all the elephants on Koh Samui …. Thank you to all the staff who welcomed us today & for making my dream of meeting & feeding these beautiful animals come true 🙏
0x3054f3b52e4a8e4d_0x2f5df5703a343206.author: Caron Gould

0x3054f3b52e4a8e4d_0x2f5df5703a343206.text: This sanctuary is truly an amazing place. The elephants are well cared for, and it's clear they are happy and comfortable in their environment. One of the standout aspects is that the elephants aren't caged or restrained, allowing them to roam freely, which creates a more natural and respectful setting. A highlight of the visit was getting the opportunity to make food for the elephants and feed them directly, which was an incredible hands-on experience that made us feel even more connected to these gentle giants. We visited as part of a large group of around 40 people, so there was a lot going on, and at times it felt a bit chaotic. If you're someone who prefers smaller groups or wants a more intimate experience, I would definitely recommend spending a little extra for a private or smaller group tour to ensure a more personalized encounter with the elephants. What’s really great about this place is that it’s a true sanctuary, meaning the elephants are not mistreated or exploited. They live in a stress-free environment, and unlike some other places, this sanctuary does not offer elephant rides, which can be harmful to the animals. Instead, the focus is on their well-being and allowing visitors to learn about them in a responsible and ethical way. I highly recommend doing thorough research to find a sanctuary like this one, where the elephants are treated with the respect and dignity they deserve. Make sure to support places that prioritize the health and happiness of the animals and avoid those that allow elephant rides or other forms of exploitation. Visiting a sanctuary like this can be a rewarding and unforgettable experience, both for you and the elephants!
0x3054f3b52e4a8e4d_0x2f5df5703a343206.author: GEE

0x3054f3b52e4a8e4d_0x2f5df5703a343206.text: We have visited this amazing place on 06/09/2020 and it totally exceed our expectations! First of all, 2 beautiful elephants Yo Yo and Champagne are happy, well treated, looking healthy and active. They are moving all around the territory all the time! Not standing at one place. No chains! They are free! Second, you can touch and feed elephants with bamboo and bananas. Third, you can wash elephants from hose and even take a bath with them in a Lake. Fourth, it’s a child friendly activity. In our visit there were guests with children and they absolutely loved communication with elephants! Fifth, you can have chilled drinks in the cafe while feeding elephants or just observing them. Sixth, all the staff are super friendly and helpful. Momay, Pookkie and guys told us interesting facts about elephants, took photos of us, so we didn’t have to interrupt our communication with elephants and send them on our phones. Seventh, the place location is very convenient - just behind the famous Mumified Monk temple. Eight, there is no entrance fee, and no other fees, just a donation. Ninth, elephants were rescued from the hard work and now finally start to live a happy life! Tenth, activity is cool and suitable for couples, individuals, families, kids, groups - for everyone. That’s true! Eleventh, guys are doing a great mission so please come and support them! I guarantee that you and your kids would have an unforgettable amazing activity and good memories! I’ve been in the big famous elephant sanctuary in Chiang Mai, the experience there was good, but believe me - here it feels even more unique and exotic! Super highly recommended!
0x3054f3b52e4a8e4d_0x2f5df5703a343206.author: Viktoriya Kronos

0x3054f3b52e4a8e4d_0x2f5df5703a343206.text: This is such a amazing sanctuary, the staff are incredible & the story of the sanctuary is amazing too, they explain everything how ethical they are and how they rescue and help other elephants, they have a vet who is the only vet on the island and she travels to help other elephants on the island, they are only donation based and they let their elephants roam freely - there is no gate or fence around. They have 2 new baby elephants rescued from the circus who are underweight and are being monitored, treated and fed at the moment as they are newly rescued. So beautiful to see a true ethical sanctuary, this one is a must see if you want to see a place that really is caring for the elephants! They have 1 hourly packages and you get to make a vitamin cake for the elephants and feed them, shower them with water and you get a video at the end and a lovely keyring. The elephants just roam around you and they are not told to do anything / pose for photos or do tricks, it is really beautiful & it seems they are very free! A very educational and wholesome day ! Staff are really amazing : great laugh with them and they are so good at explaining everything and educating on the sanctuary and also just elephants!
0x3054f3b52e4a8e4d_0x2f5df5703a343206.author: Natalka

0x3054f3b52e4a8e4d_0x2f5df5703a343206.text: A visit to see the elephants was a must for our Southern Thailand trip, and finding the most ethical elephant sanctuary was of utmost importance. After a bit of research, I'm so glad that we decided to go to I Love Elephant Samui, a wonderful home for previously abused elephants. The staff and management so clearly adore and take excellent care of these beloved gentle giants. The elephants are very happy, playful, and free to roam around the property as they please. We had the most special morning preparing a cake for the elephants that we then fed to them, along with lots of watermelon and bananas! The elephants were so comfortable with us! We spent time with a more elderly "Grandma" elephant as well as with a Mom and her sweet baby elephant 🥹We loved playing with them in the water and even gave them a bit of a scrub after they rolled around in the mud. It was truly an unforgettable experience. If you're planning a trip to Koh Samui, make sure you spend time at this amazing sanctuary to help them continue their incredible work. See you next time! ❤️ 🐘
0x3054f3b52e4a8e4d_0x2f5df5703a343206.author: Anna Loumbrozo

0x3054f3b52e4a8e4d_0x2f5df5703a343206.text: This elephant rescue site left us awe-inspired. The staff's warmth and passion for their work created trust and confidence that the animals are not forced to do anything. Of course you're a friend for the elephants when you bring them fruit and other food but I think that's generally the same with all animals. The staff ensured our comfort and safety during the visit, sharing impressive facts about the animals. The serene tropical location blended seamlessly with well-maintained facilities. But what really speaks for the team and their work is that they seem to limit the visits that can be done per day. When we returned from our tour the elephants clearly wanted to be alone and walked away from the facilities. When we returned we heard that the team just sent another group of tourists away and asked them to come another day because the animals got enough visits for today. So we can clearly recommend the visit for those seeking an enriching and respectful experience surrounded by a genuinely friendly team.
0x3054f3b52e4a8e4d_0x2f5df5703a343206.author: Max Urbitsch

0x3054f3b52e4a8e4d_0x2f5df5703a343206.text: We absolutely loved I love Elephant Samui. I was a bit worried because it is not one of the first to come up when searching, but I am glad we decided to go for it. The place is small but other than the time you spend preparing the elephants food, the rest of the time you are pretty much surrounded by elephants. We fed them multiple times, bathed them multiple times and had plenty of one on one time with them. My entire family absolutely loved it. The tour is supposed to be an hour but we were there for over 1.5 hours. Everyone there is extremely friendly and welcoming, we really could not have asked for a better tour. The place was opened by the only Elephant doctor on Samui to care for orphaned elephants, and they are truly roaming around, there was no forcing the elephants to do anything as they seemed extremely content following the food! I HIGHLY recommend this experience as it was a highlight of our trip!
0x3054f3b52e4a8e4d_0x2f5df5703a343206.author: Susana Arispe

0x3054f3b52e4a8e4d_0x2f5df5703a343206.text: AMAZING DAY! Staff so friendly and so educational getting to learn all about the elephants and the amazing work they are doing! 0x30e29f258aba6d0f_0x41e5d338f0fbc4dc.text: 👀 Review of my ReLEx SMILE Pro vision correction experience at TRSC On June 4th, I decided to “invest in my eyes and quality of life” by having ReLEx SMILE Pro surgery at TRSC with Dr. Sukanda Sawasdibutr 🩺 Before the surgery, I must say that the examination here was very thorough. From measuring my eyesight and examining the corneal structure to consulting me on the most suitable method for my eye condition, everything was meticulously prepared. I was examined by Dr. Ornicha Sriwanich and had Earn as my personal consultant, answering questions, managing appointments, and providing close care throughout the process 💕 📌 Surgery Day Upon arrival at the center, the staff helped me, prepared me, and provided complete information. Honestly, I was very nervous 😅 At first, I chose to hug a ball to relieve my anxiety, but when the time came… I changed my mind and held the nurse's hand instead 🫶 The doctor talked to me, reassured me, and then started the countdown: 8…7…6… (It reminded me of tricking kids into getting their teeth done! 555) In a few seconds, everything was done ✨ At that moment, I could see! But it was like a thin fog was covering my vision. After the surgery, they covered my eyes to prevent me from rubbing them, and prescribed anxiety and pain medication. The first night was painless, just a feeling of tightness and irritation, similar to wearing contact lenses. 🌅 The next morning: My usual instinct was to reach for my glasses, but wait… I just had eye surgery! I tried opening my eyes through the small gap in the eye shield… Wow! I could see them! 😍 It was a strange and amazing feeling. I went back to the center. They removed the eye shield, checked my eyesight again, and taught me how to clean and apply the eye drops. Ern was there to take care of me closely, as always. ⏳ Recovery & Follow-up Appointment • 1 day after surgery: Vision is gradually getting clearer, no pain. • 3 days after surgery: Able to work normally, just wear glasses to protect against wind and droplets, avoid makeup around the eyes. • 1 week: Responsible for daily life. Still experiencing glare at night. • 1 month: Nighttime glare has improved significantly. • 3 months: Vision is stable, life is very comfortable, no bothersome problems. What I really liked was the follow-up appointments at 1 day / 1 week / 1 month / 3 months / 1 year, with no extra charge. 💡My feelings: Before the procedure, I was extremely worried about pain and glare, but in reality, it was much less painful than I expected. Just taking paracetamol was enough. The next day, I practically forgot I ever wore glasses 👓 Now, 3 months later, life is very comfortable. I don't have to worry about glasses or contact lenses anymore. ✨ Personally, I think ReLEx SMILE Pro at TRSC is the most worthwhile investment I've ever made. I'm so glad I decided to do it! 💙

0x30da307b04fd282d_0xd3f8f83320d1e37d.text: I needed to have a new crown and major filling done, so found them online, had good reviews etc etc. Was only going to be in Thailand for 2 weeks so emailed a month ahead, carefully listing what needed to be done, set up the initial visit and all sounded fine. But when I arrived, they had no idea what was going on, the dentist was not available, had to do xrays, which was fine, then said I would have to come back in 2 weeks for the visit with the dentist. Not good to say the least especially when I specifically listed my time frame in the initial emails back and forth. So after a bit of arguing, they finally found an appt with the dentist 10 days or so later, calling it very close considering they had to make the crown and then if there was an issue, I was out of luck. So went back on a Thursday and that visit was fine, the Dentist was excellent and the facilities were nothing short of amazing. He did the filling and put on the temp crown and set me up for the next Monday for the final work. Showed up Monday and they seemed confused and mixed me up with another patient, saying I need an insert and a few other things. Huh? After a bit of discussion again, got that straightened out, met with the Dentist and all was good. Overall they did a very good job, one of if not the best major dental experiences I have ever had, but the office support staff is iffy at best and do not speak any English which may have contributed to the issues. So I do recommend them, but with a few caveats. Be sure to double and triple check appts, get confirmation on treatment plans and be firm about time frames. Oh, the cost was about 1/3 of what it was for the same work in the US and possibly better quality too.
0x30da307b04fd282d_0xd3f8f83320d1e37d.author: David

0x30da307b04fd282d_0xd3f8f83320d1e37d.text: I had a mostly good experience there. I had a bridge done and an emergency extraction and implant with a bone graft and also a cleaning and some cavities filled. The guy who did the implant seemed extremely competent and professional and just very efficient. I was very grateful they could fit me in on such short notice. But the fillings were some of the worst of my life. Honestly, it seemed like the dentist who did it just barely graduated dental school. They were much more concerned with me being not being in pain than they were with doing what they actually needed to do. This resulted in having to come back for a second appointment to do the same cavities over again, and the second time I was there for 2 and a half hours of frustration and pain where they did the cavities another time without Novocain and then when that was still too painful, they put so much Novocain that I couldn’t eat or drink for six hours after. So basically, they had to do the same cavities three times in order to fill them. They were not deep cavities and I just don’t understand why they were so inept.

0x30e290a7be0dc75b_0x4848e9a161a5317f.text: Krung Non Market is a fairly large market. The outdoor area sells new and second-hand clothing, shoes, bed sheets, 10-baht household items, and second-hand goods displayed on sheets for customers to browse. The central area features outdoor food stalls where vendors set up their own tents, which is quite lively with many people buying food. This zone also has a ball pit for children to play in (coupons available). Inside the covered area, you'll find mobile phone shops, vegetable stalls, bakeries, and flower garland vendors. These are permanently located shops that operate daily. Most customers are residents of the Taling Chan area and migrant workers from neighboring countries, who come to shop in large numbers. Parking is available on the sides and behind the market, with designated parking areas, and it's free. There's a mobile sound system from Wat Phra Bat Nam Phu promoting the temple's products under the brand name "Jai Fah," including fabric softener, laundry detergent, dishwashing liquid, inhalers, balm, riceberry rice, and more. The money will go towards taking care of underprivileged or orphaned children who are currently under the care of the temple. So, my mother took the opportunity to buy Jai Fah products because it's a buy-one-get-two deal: she gets the product to use and also does good deeds at the same time. My mother said that if she lived around here, she would come to the market every day because she could buy everything she needed in one place.

She made sure everything was done the right way (much as I hated the root canals 😆) and managed to save the tooth that looked destined to be replaced by an implant. 0x305031e53d641c2b_0xd501c53a8feb874a.text: Very good clinic. I had a dental abscess, and it was extremely painful, so I decided to visit this clinic based on reviews, especially because of how they treat foreigners. During my first visit, I filled out forms where I could indicate my language level. Even though my English is quite poor and I only speak Russian, everything went smoothly. After completing the paperwork and entering the office, I was welcomed by the dentist and the assistant. Before the treatment, the doctor explained the entire process to me, including treatment options and costs. The procedure itself was very comfortable and stress-free — I’m actually very afraid of dentists, haha. They warned me before the anesthesia and even apologized for small things, which was very sweet. Thank you for your care and professionalism. Considering my condition and my preferences, the total cost came to 15,000 baht, which I think is very reasonable for a private clinic, especially given the high level of professionalism. The reception staff were also very kind and understanding. If I didn’t understand something, they always tried to explain it or translate it into Russian. Thank you so much!

0x305031e53d641c2b_0xd501c53a8feb874a.text: I’m an Australian currently living in Switzerland and did a lot of research before choosing a dentist in Phuket. Rang Hill consistently came up as one of the best and safest clinics, so I decided to go with them. Really impressed overall. The clinic is modern, very clean, and runs professionally....... you can tell they have high standards and very skilled doctors! Dr. Apinya Jariyasoontorn was excellent. She was thorough, explained everything clearly, and took real care with the work. I had cleaning, X-rays and multiple fillings done, and the level of detail really stood out. ( Some complex fillings were very close to the root with zero pain throughout the treatment and after) You can also tell by the way the clinic is run that pricing is fair and consistent, it doesn’t feel like one of those places that inflates prices for tourists. Everything was transparent from the start. Would definitely recommend if you’re looking for quality dental care in Phuket (possibly better then Australian clinics that have grsds doing your work) Also shout out to all the team members at the clinic, whole process was extremely smooth and well run :)

0x305031e53d641c2b_0xd501c53a8feb874a.text: I had a consultation at Rang Hill Dental Clinic and was genuinely impressed by the professionalism and honesty of the team. The clinic was very clean, modern, and well organized, and all the staff were polite, calm, and welcoming from the moment I arrived. I was seen by Dr Amonrat, and what I appreciated most was the Dr’s ethical and conservative approach. Instead of trying to sell me expensive cosmetic procedures, she carefully reviewed my X-rays, explained my bite and dental condition clearly, and recommended only the treatments that were genuinely appropriate for my situation. She was honest about the limitations and risks of cosmetic bonding in my case, which gave me a lot of confidence and trust. I really respected that the focus was on long-term dental health and the patient’s best interest, not unnecessary superficial treatment. Highly recommended for anyone looking for honest, professional dental care in Phuket.

0x30519541c1b0b233_0x70871ac2a5203418.text: My bf and I booked a "try scuba diving" experience, and it was a lot of fun. There were one other couple and another girl on the boat that day. The couple is doing a PADI course, the girl has done this for like 50 times already so she is super experienced. This was our first time diving, so it was also super cool to talk with them about their experiences. 3 coaches went with us that day: Ame, Big and Ohm. Ame is obviously the patient, wise teacher type. He is fluent in English, and is very expressive and responsible. He makes sure all details are clear. Big is the funny one. He is so energetic and happy all the time and can jump around on the boat even when it's super bumpy. It's almost like a super power. And this is a special shout out to Ohm, our life guard in the ocean. He is friendly, patient, and kind. He takes super good pictures under the water for us and carried us around the whole time. I just have 2 advice for people who want to try this for the first time: 1. Take motion sickness pills one day before or at least 1 hour before!! If you don't know if you will get seasick, think if you get carsick and if you do, you'll get seasick for sure. I didn't take pills so I threw up three times. It was embarrassing and painful... You should also google how to throw up while scuba diving btw, because it could be dangerous. 2. Take some clothes for changing because your clothes could get wet and it will be cold after the dives if you don't have dry clothes. Take an extra towel as well if you can. Otherwise have fun!!! And sorry Ohm that i threw up on you in the sea...🙈🙈🙈
0x30519541c1b0b233_0x70871ac2a5203418.author: Nicole Wu

0x30519541c1b0b233_0x70871ac2a5203418.text: We saw google reviews and went for enquiry about scuba dive for 1day which is near to our booked resort in Krabi with several companies. We found this one is wonderful with budget friendly and safety. Initially me nd my husband were scared to take scuba since we are not expert swimmers in ocean. But they were very friendly and the lady answered all of our questions and showed so many videos and photos who went scuba dive without knowing swimming. Then we booked immediately and given the location of resort. They have arranged Pick up and drop for hotel. Pick up was exactly at 8:30 am.They took only 6 people including us to local islands for 2 dive spots. For the first dive, initially I was scared to go inside but Amon (Scuba master) was very helpful he calm down my tension and taken inside exactly more than 8m depth. We were vey happy with our first dive. Only thing we should control our ear pressure difference inside of the deepest water. Plenty of snacks, fruits and water arranged for us. We were confident and went for second dive with 9.5m with 38min timing. Amon is having the scuba timer so he was very cautious that how much depth he has to take us as beginners. Along with Amon one more person will be available for take us to back to the boat. All Scuba expert team is so supportive and friendly. Special thanks to Amon 🙏 for these wonderful experience. These are all permanent memories in our hearts♥️
0x30519541c1b0b233_0x70871ac2a5203418.author: Shamili

0x30519541c1b0b233_0x70871ac2a5203418.text: We have been staying in Ao Nang for few days and after looking around for a decent scuba diving company who offered a good quality/price ratio and expert instructors, when we came across Scuba Expert (Krabi). We were a group of 6 people and we had a wonderful day! They offered pick up from our hotel and lunch/snacks. The diving experience was amazing, we saw a lot of fishes, corals and so on! The best we was were stingrays, turtles and moraines. Both instructors (Amon and Ohm) were amazing.. very patient and expert divers! With their initial teaching, they managed to break the ice with funny jokes and positive attitude, which made us feel safer (especially for beginners like us). The food provided was local and was amazing! We did plenty of boat tours that offered food on board but nothing like this company. They also included soft drinks, fruit and vegetarian/vegan options (to be asked in advance). We would definely recommended it! :)

0x30e29919601934c9_0xf3255dacb5718e8a.text: During our trip to Bangkok's China Town, we decided to visit the Royal India Restaurant to satisfy our craving for Indian cuisine in Thailand. Despite initial apprehensions due to its unassuming exterior, the positive Google Maps reviews spurred us to give it a chance. Our hopes wavered as we approached, but once we tasted the food, they were immediately reignited. The dining experience at Royal India Restaurant turned out to be a delightful surprise. The moment we took our first bites, any doubts were dispelled. The flavors of the Indian dishes were simply exquisite, exceeding our expectations in every way. From aromatic curries to perfectly cooked rotis, every dish was a testament to their culinary prowess. Though the restaurant's appearance might not be as inviting, the true gem lies within its kitchen. For any Indian missing the familiar tastes of home while in Thailand, this establishment comes highly recommended. The journey from uncertainty to culinary satisfaction was a memorable one, reminding us not to judge a book by its cover.
0x30e29919601934c9_0xf3255dacb5718e8a.author: Rithu Maria Jose

0x30e29919601934c9_0xf3255dacb5718e8a.text: THE LEGACY of Indian Cuisine & Sweets A legend is someone or something which survives the onslaught of time and yet commands the same respect and awe as when it started. Royal India Indian Food Restaurant is the only place I know which deserves the title iof a legend as I have frequented this place, at the same location for almost half a century! Food has always been good, and while traditional recipes are the norm, the new generation of proprietors have ensured that the cuisine is up to modern standards while mating the simplicity and sophistication which marks this place. Every dish has been good, and if have to state something exceptional, then it is their dessert RASMALAI, which I have found to still be the undisputed champion, the best available in Thailand! The restaurant may loom small, but it is cozy, and the ambience is charming and yet does not distract you away from concentrating on having a delicious, sumptuous meal! Bon Appetite! ✍️
0x30e29919601934c9_0xf3255dacb5718e8a.author: Sukan Sethi

0x30e29919601934c9_0xf3255dacb5718e8a.text: This place has a signage on the main road. The eatery itself is in the lane. The raita (seasoned yoghurt) with cucumber & potatoes was well seasoned, it was nice by itself as well as with roti. The Aloo Paratha was well made & seasoned. It was soft & nice on its own! The tandoori roti was also good. The Dal Makhani was perfect with the roti. The Vegetable Jalfrazi could have been seasoned better. The flavour was not right. Ended the meal with masala chai, perfect after an Indian meal. The mithai / sweetmeats were also good. The chum chum was mildly sweet & the center's thickened cream balanced the flavour. The rasmalai was white instead of the usual saffron infused yellow. The cream could have been a little thicker! The waitress serving us was good. She knew the menu & was friendly.
0x30e29919601934c9_0xf3255dacb5718e8a.author: Kiran Seth

0x30e29919601934c9_0xf3255dacb5718e8a.text: We visited Royal Indian in Pahurat, also known as Bangkok’s Little India, and ordered vegetable samosas along with masala chai. The restaurant’s interior was clean, and the waiter was attentive, which made the experience pleasant. Having last visited in 2018, I was really excited to return. The samosas were well-cooked, though they lacked the bold masala flavors I was expecting. As for the chai, it could have used more ginger for a stronger, more authentic taste. Despite these minor tweaks, it was still a great experience to revisit after so many years. Outside the restaurant, there were stalls selling Indian sweets, adding to the vibrant atmosphere of the area. Definitely worth a stop if you’re in the neighborhood and craving Indian food!

0x30e29f003ac34685_0x7c2797469d26839a.text: I had Ultraformer treatment at Talisa Clinic, Siam Square One branch, at the beginning of last month. I had 800 shots done, focusing on my cheeks and jawline because I felt my face was starting to sag and my jawline wasn't as defined. Before the treatment, the doctor thoroughly checked my face, examining both sides and advising on which areas needed attention. During the procedure, they carefully worked on each point, constantly asking if I was in pain or if I was comfortable. It was better than I expected. After the treatment, looking in the mirror, I could immediately see that my face was lifted, especially my cheeks and jawline. My jawline looked more defined, and my face looked firmer and more contoured, but still natural – not stiff or unnatural. Now, almost a month later, I like the results even more than the first day. My cheeks, which used to sag, are noticeably lifted, my jawline is much sharper, and my face looks smaller without having to find the perfect angle for photos! Especially in side photos, the lift in my cheeks and jawline is very noticeable. Comparing before and after photos, the difference is quite significant. This exceeded my expectations. The service was also good; the staff were attentive and didn't push me to buy additional treatments or packages, which I appreciated because I don't like being pressured into buying things at clinics. Overall, after about a month of waiting, I'm very happy with the results. The results were great immediately after the procedure, but after a month, the facial contours became even more defined, especially the cheeks and jawline. I feel like I made the right choice with 800 shots this time.
0x30e29f003ac34685_0x7c2797469d26839a.author: Khingkha ̈

0x30e29f003ac34685_0x7c2797469d26839a.text: I came for a facial consultation because I was concerned about sagging cheeks, although I don't have much cheek fat. The doctor recommended Ultraformer MPT, so I wanted to share my experience in case it's helpful for those researching Ultraformer MPT. Before deciding, as I mentioned, I wanted to address my sagging cheeks, which was a big problem for me. I read a lot of reviews before deciding on Talisa Clinic, Siam Square One branch. There was no hard selling at all. After the consultation, they took me to see the doctor. She explained everything in detail, discussing the treatment areas, the number of shots, the specifications of the machine, and the best locations on my face for the treatment. On the day of the treatment, I booked an appointment as usual and got my slot on time, which I was very happy with. The clinic atmosphere was clean and the air conditioning was cool, although it wasn't very large. During the procedure, I felt some pain, but it was minimal (2/10). The doctor was lovely and kept asking me how I felt throughout the process. Immediately after the procedure, I felt my face was slightly lifted and tightened. This was a month after the treatment, and I love how my face looks now. The results are much better than the first time. My facial contours are more defined, and we had 600 shots done. Overall, our experience at Talisa Clinic, Siam branch, this time exceeded our expectations! We were extremely impressed and really liked the Ultraformer mpt treatment.

0x3051c00f44e1f345_0x32bedca5a1df150b.text: I honestly cannot recommend Aonang Medical Clinic highly enough. During our stay in Krabi, my partner unfortunately became seriously unwell with food poisoning, and after reading the clinic’s outstanding reviews, I decided to take him there — and every one of those reviews proved to be fully deserved. From the moment we arrived, the team demonstrated exceptional professionalism, efficiency, and compassion. The nursing staff welcomed us warmly, triaged my partner promptly and appropriately, and ensured he was comfortable resting in a ward while waiting for the doctor. Dr. Suphakris Tanmuk arrived within the hour, and as a doctor myself, I can confidently say that the standard of clinical expertise and patient care we experienced was truly excellent. The appropriate diagnostic tests were performed immediately, treatment was started without delay, and my partner was admitted that same morning to a private room where I was also able to stay with him. Having that level of comfort and reassurance while abroad meant so much to us. Throughout his stay, the nurses were attentive, kind, and incredibly diligent — regularly monitoring his observations, administering medication, and making sure he was comfortable at all times. Dr. Suphakris personally reviewed him again later that afternoon and the following day prior to discharge, and every aspect of the care was impeccable. I would also like to give special thanks to the administrative staff, who liaised directly with our insurance company throughout the process, allowing me to focus entirely on supporting my partner during his recovery. I genuinely don’t think I have ever seen someone recover from a fever and bacterial gastroenteritis so quickly. Upon discharge, the clinic also provided all of the necessary medications clearly labelled, and the nurse took the time to carefully explain how and when each medication should be taken, which we greatly appreciated. They even kindly arranged transportation back to our hotel, another thoughtful gesture during what could have been a stressful experience. Thank you to everyone at Aonang Medical Clinic for turning what could have been a frightening experience abroad into one that felt calm, safe, and genuinely caring. We will always be incredibly grateful for the outstanding care you provided.
0x3051c00f44e1f345_0x32bedca5a1df150b.author: Lily Fletcher

0x30e29f9c9a01c193_0x1fc177af344b11bf.text: I was looking for a place near my accommodation to get teeth whitening and found this clinic with great reviews. I also asked my host for a recommendation and, coincidentally, he genuinely suggested the same place, so I figured it would be a great choice. Before going, I cleared up several doubts over WhatsApp. I asked if it was possible to do only the whitening, and they said yes — they would still do a free dental check-up (as shown in the photo). I also asked if I could choose the Single package, which included a cleaning and a shorter whitening session (15 min), and, if I felt it was necessary, upgrade to the Double package, which had a longer whitening time (30 min) and didn’t include cleaning (both were the same price, only the inclusions differed). The answer was yes, and that in that case I’d just need to pay for the extra cleaning (as also shown in the photo). So we booked the Single whitening for me and my husband. Everyone treated us very well — I have no complaints about that. However, when we were leaving, the receptionist gave us a bill that included the Double whitening and the Basic check-up package, which we never requested. When we questioned the amount, she issued a new bill, this time correct: Double + cleaning + sterilization, exactly as explained earlier on WhatsApp. Even so, she said she was giving us a “discount,” when in fact that was just the proper price. The whitening was indeed done for 30 minutes (Double), but we didn’t like that no one asked beforehand if we wanted to upgrade. As for the results, mine was satisfactory, but my husband’s was a bit below expectations — although we understand that can vary from person to person. Overall, the service was good, but we really didn’t like how the billing part was handled.
0x30e29f9c9a01c193_0x1fc177af344b11bf.author: Lu

0x3102be134a595be9_0x17c776058e554ea.text: To all the people who do not speak Thai. The procedure is as follows You go to a self BP & oxygen testing machine. You test yourself and take the test results to triage, the nurse initially ask for your symptoms and give you a sheet with details of which department to go and a token no for registration. You go to registration counter and wait for your token to be called,make sure to bring passport and write your current address and phone no on a piece of paper. The registration counter gives you a registration card and a paper with QR CODE. You need to take this into the OPD department and give it to the nurse. The nurse takes the paper and call you name when your turn comes. Depending on your diagnoses you need to blood test and other stuff. I only paid for blood test and pills. I guess the doctor consultation is free. It was quick, the only place where it took time is the injection department and collecting the pills. The doctor and nurses speak English and can guide you well. Most of the signs are in Thai. The behavior of the staff is good. Saw couple of foreigners taking treatment.

If I have any problems or questions, I can contact them via LINE, which made me feel very reassured. The treatment process wasn't as scary or painful as I thought. After the anesthetic wore off, there was some tightness, but nothing very painful. After treatment, I could clean the wound at home, so I didn't need to come to the clinic frequently. The doctor scheduled follow-up appointments regularly, which was very convenient. If you have chronic ingrown toenails that keep coming back after multiple treatments, I highly recommend trying treatment here. The doctor treats the problem directly, doesn't prolong the treatment unnecessarily, the prices are reasonable, and both the doctor and staff are very attentive and provide excellent service. 0x30da3b478853c31b_0x224b043e90666b6e.text: Chiang Mai is a luxurious massage spot located near the Ping River near Pak Daeng Restaurant in Chiang Mai! This was my first time visiting a professional spa massage brand during my second trip to Chiang Mai. The building itself is impressively spacious, with the entire ground floor serving as a lobby, the first and second floors dedicated to massages, and the basement floor a space for relaxation, tea, and rejuvenation. The overall atmosphere feels like a five-star hotel, and the ample lobby space for resting and waiting was truly wonderful. Lying down on a cushion on the sofa was heavenly! Free Wi-Fi is also available. The holiday atmosphere, with Christmas just around the corner, is a bonus! While it's a bit pricier than other local Chiang Mai massage parlors, it's worth it. The massage rooms are all private, not just curtained off. Each room is based on a double occupancy, making it a truly comfortable experience for solo travelers, groups, couples, and families alike. Moreover, her skills were truly excellent, and the two-hour Thai massage was incredibly refreshing and completely free of fatigue. She focused on my lower body, and I felt like all the fatigue from the day had disappeared, leaving me feeling refreshed and refreshed! The massage room for two is equipped with a massage bed, personal clothing, a mirror, a TV, a clock, and hangers. Please note that this is for reference only. The massage was incredibly satisfying, and the cup of tea provided afterward was so delicious I almost wanted to ask for another. The bathroom was also incredibly clean and well-maintained! If I ever visit Chiang Mai again, Health Land was a place I'll definitely return to for another satisfying experience. By the way, we each gave a 100 baht tip.

0x3054f5aa874b3b71_0xb893f37164c6bdde.text: I spent two weeks volunteering at this shelter and I cannot recommend it enough! Doesn’t matter if it’s just for a day or up to a few months, this is the place for animal lovers. I was very close to canceling my travel plans and going home. The work here gave me purpose to work through it! It’s located in the more secluded/jungly side of Koh Samui, so the scenery is beautiful! The daily schedule was very similar from day to day: we started with cleaning the puppy area (and of course lots of cuddles) and went on to prepare and give extra food to the sicker/skinnier dogs in the morning. We always grabbed lunch with the volunteering staff, so there’s a nice sense of community. In the afternoon we helped cleaning the cat compartments as well as cleaning their ears/eyes if needed and went on a walk with different dogs every day (so everyone gets out) and went to the beach! On some days we took the truck with the older/disabled dogs, so they could enjoy moving in the ocean! Altogether, you could tell the dogs and cats were being taken good care of. There’s lots of different compartments with so many beautiful souls, that you’ll absolutely fall in love with. I was very sad to leave, especially without being able to adopt a furry friend, but I’ll for sure (!!!) come back to volunteer again and next time, I won’t be going home alone!
0x3054f5aa874b3b71_0xb893f37164c6bdde.author: Aitana Schmid

0x3054f5aa874b3b71_0xb893f37164c6bdde.text: Another great place. Go and walk the dogs there and donate a little. They look after 500 animals across 2 sites so they need all the help they can get. I believe they are looking for volunteers to help out, a Scottish couple were there whilst i was there and she said they had been working there for naearly 2 weeks. Also i think they are desperate for people to adopt some of the animals. They have cats and kittens there too, its not just for dogs. Its fantastic to see someone care for all these stray animals. Koh Samui is full of dogs, most i saw were well fed but obviously some wont be and dogs on the island wander around the dark streets at night, i even saw some lying in the main road when it was pitch black so plenty must get injured and i believe the owner of this place said they help with vets and care and recovery- all this must cost a small fortune to run on a daily level so i can only imagine how much it costs to see to all these animals. One of the dogs i walked had injured back legs so i assume it had been hit by a car at some point. Beware though that some of the dogs werent that approachable with me, its not their fault, they could have been mistreated. One did try to bite me so be careful if you go to stroke some of them
0x3054f5aa874b3b71_0xb893f37164c6bdde.author: Garry Webster

0x3054f5aa874b3b71_0xb893f37164c6bdde.text: I wasn’t sure what to expect when I decided to visit the Dog and Cat Sanctuary, but the experience completely exceeded anything I imagined. I had the chance to walk a beautiful dog named Jimmie on the beach with other dogs and travelers . Such a joyful, peaceful way to spend time. The dogs were incredibly sweet and friendly, and it was obvious how much love and care they receive. Even the other individuals visiting were a delight to meet . The volunteers are truly the heart of this place. Kind, dedicated, and clearly passionate about animal welfare, they make the sanctuary feel more like a community than a shelter. Everything is well-organized and thoughtfully run. I initially felt a bit apprehensive about visiting a shelter with so many animals, but I was quickly reassured. The dogs are happy, healthy, and clearly well looked after. The whole visit left me feeling uplifted and inspired. Special thanks Hasse, David and Marcus I was so moved by the experience that I now sponsor four dogs. It’s a small way to give back to a place that gives so much. Highly recommend for anyone who wants to make a difference or simply connect with some amazing animals and people.
0x3054f5aa874b3b71_0xb893f37164c6bdde.author: Khedjia Nottingham

0x3054f5aa874b3b71_0xb893f37164c6bdde.text: I was incredibly fortunate to learn about the work of Dog & Cat Rescue Samui – and I'm deeply impressed. Since its founding in 1999, they have been tirelessly helping street dogs and cats on Koh Samui. The team works with unbelievable passion, dedication, and professionalism. It's especially touching to see how lovingly the animals are cared for, given medical treatment, and prepared for a better life. Many of them have been through difficult times – here they get a real second chance. The organization is committed not only to rescue and care but also to sustainable solutions such as spay/neuter programs and education. This demonstrates their long-term thinking and approach. Anyone who loves animals should definitely support this organization – whether through donations, volunteering, or simply by recommending their important work. Dog & Cat Rescue Samui is a shining example of how much good people can achieve. Highly recommended! 🐾
0x3054f5aa874b3b71_0xb893f37164c6bdde.author: Simon Landthaler

0x3054f5aa874b3b71_0xb893f37164c6bdde.text: Whilst staying nearby, we decided to spend the afternoon playing with and walking some of the islands rescue dogs. The Dog and Cat Rescue foundation are doing an amazing job looking after all the animals. Although there are a lot of dogs and cats, they have large areas which are separated to ensure they dogs get along. They seem to be happy and looked after being fed large meals of rice and veg and donations from the public. If you decide to visit, please bring large bags of food and anything else you can spare as they can always do with more for the animals. 2pm ish you can also take the dogs to the beach for a walk and play. Unfortunately some dogs have some life long injuries , so may just want to sit and be stroked, but it’s great to give them the interaction Please also make sure you take the time to walk all the way to the back as the place is huge and it’s likely that the dogs in the rear do not get as much interaction
0x3054f5aa874b3b71_0xb893f37164c6bdde.author: D B

0x3054f5aa874b3b71_0xb893f37164c6bdde.text: I have volunteered at Dog and Cat Rescue Koh Samui for some time, and I continue to be amazed by the incredible work they do every day. Caring for more than 400 dogs and over 100 cats is a huge undertaking, yet the staff and volunteers provide outstanding care, dedication, and compassion to every animal. What impressed me most is how much they achieve with the donations they receive. Every contribution is clearly put to good use, helping improve the lives of hundreds of animals who otherwise would have very few options. The atmosphere is welcoming, the team is passionate, and the impact they make on Koh Samui is truly remarkable. I highly recommend visiting the shelter, volunteering, or simply taking one of the dogs for a walk. It’s a wonderful experience and a great way to support an organization that is making a real difference every single day.
