0x30e29f0291f3842b_0x736e3264da6a2f84.text: From the moment I walked into KCC Clinic in Siam Paragon, I felt immediately welcome- many of the lovely staff were in the reception area and greeted me with genuinely happy smiles and a large welcome. I was offered water by my delightful consultant Champagne, and asked to sit in a very comfortable lounge area for a complete assessment. Champagne never pushed me, suggested anything unnecessary, was most concerned with my comfort and the outcomes I desired. After my initial consultation and assessment, the amazing Dr. Karn came to me and explained all the treatments I was going to have, the effects, and what the end result would be. I was delighted to have Dr. Karn, as she is the co-founder of the clinic, and not only is she very practical about what can be achieved for each individual, but also has many years experience. During the entire process, the gorgeous Champagne was by my side at every step; helping me, explaining every process, ensuring my comfort and giving exceptional service- all very comforting, as she has a bubbly disposition and a great sense of humor! The entire staff are patient, kind, friendly and professional, and the clinic is very clean but also inviting rather than being simply clinical (which I tend not to enjoy, as it makes me feel quite uncomfortable- as if I am in a laboratory). The results of your treatment(s) are shown to you in real time, so you can see what effect they are having immediately. If you have any treatment which might involve some discomfort, you are provided the appropriate topical treatments without question, which only adds to the serene feeling of your experience. After my treatments were performed with an experienced eye, and gentle touch by the kind Dr. Karn, Champagne was waiting to happily greet me again. Both Dr. Karn and Champagne explained aftercare thoroughly and arranged for a follow-up visit, during which the progress of the treatment will be assessed and monitored. I am EXTREMELY impressed with the result, and I am told it will only improve! Champagne followed up immediately with reminders and asking how I was feeling, which was followed by messages the following day to ask if I was well, which I very much appreciated. I highly recommend KCC Clinic (Siam Paragon) for all your health and wellness advice and treatments! 🙏🏽
0x30e29f0291f3842b_0x736e3264da6a2f84.author: Cherry Blossom

0x30e29f0291f3842b_0x736e3264da6a2f84.text: This is my second time at KKC, and I’ve had another great experience. The whole team is very kind and attentive. I especially want to mention Kwang and Pui, who made the whole experience very easy and comfortable. They listen carefully to what you would like to improve, explain the different options, coordinate with the doctor, take the before-and-after photos, explain the pricing, and follow up with you after the treatment. They check how you are feeling, ask if you have had any discomfort, and send you the aftercare recommendations. I really appreciate this personalized follow-up. The doctor then evaluates your face and skin and recommends the most appropriate options, whether devices, injectables, or other treatments, based on what she actually sees. I particularly liked the doctor who treated me this time. She was very kind and seemed experienced, and I appreciated that she shared recommendations based on treatments she has personally tried and found effective. They are also very clear about expectations and explain what results you can expect immediately, after a week, after a month, and when the treatment should reach its full effect. They also explain when and how often they recommend coming back. Overall, I’m very happy with my experience and with the treatments I chose. I really like the personalized attention and follow-up, and I definitely recommend KKC.

0x30e2994bdab79247_0x183f4a0091149b43.text: Title: My Favorite Spa Stop in Thailand! Let’s Relax Spa lived up to its reputation as one of the best massage chains in Thailand, and my experience here was absolutely wonderful. From the moment I walked in, the calm, minimalist decor and soft lighting immediately put me at ease. The reception staff were warm and efficient, checking me in quickly and explaining the process clearly. My therapist was incredibly professional—she asked about my tension areas and adjusted the pressure throughout the session, working out all the knots in my shoulders and back. The entire facility was spotless, and the private treatment room felt peaceful and private. After the massage, the signature mango sticky rice and warm herbal tea were the perfect way to end the experience. No pushy sales, no awkward moments—just pure relaxation. If you’re looking for a reliable, high-quality spa in Thailand, this is a must-visit. 10/10, would absolutely recommend to friends!

0x305031fa4c6fc08b_0x75b26a807ff2b0fd.text: Wow how should I begin. Honestly, I wasn't planning in advance to do any facial treatment. I was searching on Google and came across this place. It had a lot of positive reviews so I saved it and I saw that it's very close to my place. So after lunch I thought to pop in and ask them if they have free slots for that day by any chance or next day and ask to see what they can recommend for me. When I arrived I was greeted by the lovely receptionists and suddenly I got the manager talking to me asking me what I'd like to get and looked at my face and gave me her recomandation, even got the doctor coming out and also got her recomandation. They were super nice and patient with me got me some tea and amazingly delicious pumpkin desert 🤤. It took me forever to decide what I wanted because I wasn't planning on it and normally I also do deep research before doing or buying anything. In the end I chose a treatment and straight away they got me to the room and we did the treatment with the bubble gen 9 in 1 machine which is a non invasive treatment rejuvenates, cleanses and lifts the skin. It was a very pleasant experience, I've never done anything like this. They treated me like a princess from the moment I entered until the end, they are very polite and I could feel how genuine they were. They didn't try to push anything on me. I even got hand a foot massage. My skin felt hydrated straight after. It's been 3 weeks now and my skin looks better. I think I saw a difference after 1 week and more after 2 weeks. I also started using Korean sunscreen and pyto retinol after so I am not sure if those helped too. But I definitely think this was a good restart for my skin. After that I really started taking care of my skin and looking after it. So for me it was like a good restart for a better care. I highly recommend this place, they are very professional.

0x305039d75e30be09_0xf1837d86152c5211.text: I recently visited My Physio by Kanitta Clinic in Phuket and was absolutely impressed from start to finish. From the very first moment, the entire team welcomed me with genuine warmth and kindness. The clinic atmosphere is calm, clean, and professional, creating immediate trust and comfort. Kanitta and her staff took the time to explain every step of the treatment process clearly and in detail. They carefully analyzed my condition, identified the root causes, and demonstrated each exercise and therapy technique in a way that was easy to understand and follow. I really appreciated how they combined modern physiotherapy knowledge with traditional Thai and Chinese medical understanding, making the treatment both effective and holistic. During my sessions, I never felt rushed. Every question was answered patiently, and every exercise was checked to make sure I was doing it correctly. The technology and equipment used are up‑to‑date, and the staff’s professionalism stands out in every aspect. Whether you’re a traveler in Phuket needing quick recovery from pain or an expat or local looking for long‑term care, I can wholeheartedly recommend this clinic. They truly care about each patient’s well‑being, not just the symptoms. Everything—from the friendly reception to the detailed explanations—was simply perfect. Without a doubt, this was one of the best physiotherapy experiences I’ve ever had. I confidently give them 5 out of 5 stars and will definitely return whenever I need professional physiotherapy in Phuket.

0x305039d75e30be09_0xf1837d86152c5211.text: I’m really happy with the treatment I received at this physiotherapy clinic in Phuket! After struggling with office syndrome for around 4 years, I finally found relief after 5 sessions here. I can barely move my neck before coming to the clinic. My therapist, Mo, was amazing. She’s very skilled, caring, and explained everything really well. My treatment plan included ultrasound therapy followed by therapeutic massage, plus shockwave therapy and dry needling based on Mo’s recommendations. Each technique was explained clearly and tailored to my condition, which made me feel confident in the process. Mo also recommended stretching exercises suitable to my condition and lifestyle changes to help maintain the results long term. The clinic is super clean and the whole environment feels professional yet welcoming. A lot of nice coffee shops around too. Nothing better than sipping drip coffee after therapy session. Highly recommend it to anyone needing physiotherapy in Phuket!

0x305039d75e30be09_0xf1837d86152c5211.text: I was traveling in Phuket when I suddenly injured my lower back, and it put a serious damper on my trip. Thankfully, I found My Physio By Kanitta Clinic, and it turned out to be the best decision I could have made. From the moment I walked in, the team was welcoming, professional, and incredibly knowledgeable. I want to give huge credit to the doctor and to the amazing physiotherapist, Tuk, who worked absolute wonders. Tuk immediately understood the issue, explained everything clearly, and treated my back with such skill and care that I felt improvement after just the first session. By the third session, my back was completely healed — pain-free, mobile, and feeling better than I ever expected in such a short time. Thanks to them, I was able to enjoy the rest of my stay in Phuket without any discomfort. I can’t recommend My Physio By Kanitta Clinic highly enough. If you’re in Phuket and need physiotherapy, this is the place to go!

0x305039d75e30be09_0xf1837d86152c5211.text: I came to Phuket with shoulder pain that actually got worse after a bad massage, and it was starting to ruin my trip. The therapist really took the time to understand what happened instead of just jumping into treatment. The session itself was very targeted and gentle (not painful at all), focusing on releasing the surrounding muscles rather than forcing the sore area. I felt a clear difference right after, and the improvement continued over the next couple of days. What I appreciated most is that they don’t take a “no pain no gain” approach — they actually know what they’re doing and treat the root cause. If you have any muscle pain, especially after a bad massage, I highly recommend this place. It genuinely saved my trip.

0x30da3b68e1e0578d_0x1cca820b29cd365a.text: During my visit to Chiang Mai, I had the opportunity to explore OT Dispensary, a standout establishment in the city’s burgeoning cannabis scene. Located conveniently in the heart of Chiang Mai, this dispensary offers a curated experience that blends professionalism with a relaxed, welcoming vibe. The first thing that struck me was the atmosphere. The interior design is sleek yet approachable, creating a space that feels both modern and cozy. The staff were knowledgeable, approachable, and passionate about their offerings, which made the experience educational and enjoyable for someone like me who appreciates understanding product quality and benefits. OT Dispensary boasts an impressive selection of cannabis strains and products, from high-quality flowers to oils and edibles. Their dedication to quality is evident in the carefully curated menu, which caters to both beginners and seasoned enthusiasts. I particularly appreciated the clear labeling and detailed descriptions, which helped me make an informed choice. Beyond the products, OT Dispensary goes the extra mile with its commitment to customer care. The staff took the time to listen to my preferences and provided thoughtful recommendations tailored to my needs. This personalized approach set OT Dispensary apart from other shops I’ve visited. Additionally, the dispensary prioritizes education and responsible use, which is a reassuring touch for both locals and travelers. Whether you’re looking for a relaxing strain to wind down after a day exploring Chiang Mai or something to spark creativity, OT Dispensary delivers with professionalism and care. In summary, OT Dispensary is a must-visit for anyone exploring the cannabis culture in Chiang Mai. With its excellent selection, knowledgeable staff, and welcoming atmosphere, it’s more than just a dispensary—it’s an experience.
0x30da3b68e1e0578d_0x1cca820b29cd365a.author: Dre P

0x30da3b68e1e0578d_0x1cca820b29cd365a.text: The atmosphere in this lounge is wonderfully laid-back and welcoming. The comfortable seating arrangements and relaxed vibe create the perfect spot to unwind. The team members are friendly without being overbearing, and their genuine approach to customer service stands out. 0x30da3becf3885829_0x6dee724f34430d1d.text: TLDR - Book the tattoo! From the second we walked in, Patrick and the rest of the team (Minnie, Ploy, Katie + Terry) welcomed us warmly, treated us with kindness, professionalism and respect, were patient with answering all of our questions, happily worked with us on our designs, made sure we were all on the same page regarding pricing before we walked out the door with quotes and provided the reassurance I was looking for when booking a new studio we had never been to before. The studio itself is absolutely immaculate. You know it’s clean the second you walk in because your nose feels as though it’s been transported to a hospital back in Australia. There’s not a speck of dust in the whole place and this goes for all floors and areas, not just the main reception. Every single floor is clean, comfortable, private and well equipped. Toilet on every floor for convenience. Snacks and drinks are well stocked and you’re constantly checked on throughout. My entire family all got tattoos and the calibre of work is beyond anything I could have imagined. I had tattoos from both Terry and Katie. Katie was the artist for my lion fish and coral, Terry for my bigger leg piece. The whole process was seamless and crazy to say, almost painless. Both artists as well as the shop owners (Pat + Minnie) constantly checking on me throughout from making sure I was happy with the stencil placement, comfortable in the chair, checking if I needed a break, drink, snack, air turned up or down, different music or a show on the tv. I couldn’t have been better looked after. The after care was also exceptional. Thorough details on how and when to remove second skin as well as aftercare cream actually being provided in a beautifully presented envelope. The team has also sent photos and checked in on us since leaving. 2 days later and we can’t feel our tattoo’s at all. If we couldn’t see them we would not know they were there. I cannot rate Artisan ink high enough, 5 stars is nowhere near a good enough rating! The service, the cleanliness, the calibre of work is extraordinary, the price is extremely reasonable, the friendliest team we have ever had the please of meeting. We walked in wary of going to a new studio, we walked out knowing we will never go anywhere else, sorry guys, you’re stuck with us now 🫶🏽 Do yourself a favour and go in for a chat, there’s zero pressure to actually book a tattoo but I guarantee you will!

We ended up asking the hotel to call a doctor to our hotel room at 4am. Dr Mon and her assistant arrived at our hotel room within 30 mins and stayed for almost 1.5 hours conducting a thorough assessment, providing medication, and clearly explaining the next steps. It turned out our baby had contracted COVID Less than 12 hours after Dr Mon’s visit, our baby needed to be admitted to hospital. As soon as we let her know we were heading in, she promptly forwarded all the relevant paperwork to the hospital so our baby could be checked in quickly before we even arrived. Dr Mon was incredibly diligent, kind, and supportive, and helped us navigate the Thai hospital system during an already stressful time. Her regular check-ins via WhatsApp were so reassuring, and we especially appreciated her helping communicate in Thai with our Grab driver on the way to the hospital and the hospital staff. Now that we’re back home, our baby has made a full recovery. We sincerely thank Dr Mon and her team for their outstanding care and support. We are genuinely grateful and wish them all the very best.

0x30503bb0d1604473_0x10fe98eea79a4626.text: I cannot recommend Dr. Mon at Doctor Patong Clinic highly enough. I arrived at the clinic suffering from severe gastro symptoms and was unable to keep anything down. I was quickly assessed, connected to an IV drip, and given a clear explanation of what was happening and why. Dr. Mon explained every procedure with confidence and clarity, making me feel completely at ease during what was a very unpleasant experience. What impressed me most was not only her obvious medical expertise, but also her genuine kindness and care. After my visit, she followed up several times to check on my condition and see if there was anything else she could do to help. She even arranged for medication to be delivered to me free of charge, which went far beyond what I would ever expect from a doctor. Dr. Mon’s professionalism, compassion, and dedication to her patients are truly exceptional. I only wish she were my family doctor back in Australia. If you are in Phuket and need medical care, I would recommend Dr. Mon and Doctor Patong Clinic a thousand times over. Thank you, Dr. Mon, for taking such wonderful care of me.

0x3102be55ed3ed2bb_0x641326246a1ecab6.text: About three weeks before the end of my two-month trip, I developed a severe toothache that gradually spread to my jaw, cheek, ear, and sinus area. I was hoping to manage the pain until I could return home and see my trusted dentist, as I am always cautious about unnecessary extractions of important permanent teeth. When the pain became unbearable, I researched dental clinics in Pattaya and chose Dental Smile Pattaya. Looking back, it was absolutely the right decision. From the moment I arrived, I was impressed by the professionalism and friendliness of the entire team. After a thorough examination and multiple X-rays, the dentist carefully explained that the real source of my pain was not the tooth I suspected, but a severely damaged wisdom tooth with decay reaching the nerve. He even used a dental model to help me fully understand the diagnosis and treatment options. I have had dental anxiety since childhood and previously experienced a very traumatic wisdom tooth extraction. Because of that, I was extremely nervous. However, the dentist and his assistants were exceptional. Throughout the procedure, they continuously reassured me, helped manage my stress, and made me feel safe and comfortable. Their kindness, patience, and professionalism played a huge role in building my trust and helping me stay calm. The extraction itself was smooth, efficient, and far less traumatic than my previous experience. The dentist's skill and confidence were evident throughout the entire treatment. Today, I am very grateful that I chose Dental Smile Pattaya. They not only solved a serious problem during my travels, but also restored my confidence in dental treatment. To the dentist and the entire team: thank you for your professionalism, compassion, patience, and genuine care. I would confidently recommend Dental Smile Pattaya to anyone, especially travelers and patients who may feel nervous or uncertain about seeking dental care away from home. And finally, I apologize for the length of this review. I simply wanted to make sure I properly acknowledged the outstanding care I received and gave credit where it was truly deserved. Thank you again for everything.

They explained everything clearly and kept me updated through WhatsApp with appointment confirmations and reminders, which made the whole process very easy. The prices are also very competitive. I did extensive research before choosing a dentist, and after reading reviews and comparing clinics, I decided on Dr Aoy. From the moment I walked through the door, I had a positive feeling about the clinic, and I wasn't wrong. The professionalism, attention to detail, quality of work, and genuine care from the entire team were outstanding. Travelling from Australia was absolutely worth it, and I would happily do it again. Thank you, Dr Aoy and the entire team for providing such exceptional dental care. I would highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for world-class treatment and a genuinely caring dental team.

0x30da313f784c4d83_0xe608c0b48832a14a.text: Narat and his assistant are amazing. I went there to see Narat two days in a row as I had pretty severe back and hip pain making it hard to walk. I messaged him through LINE to see if he would take me right when he opened. He took time to explain a few things and to understand my concerns. As I was in so much pain, I booked an appointment right when he opened at 9am. When I went to see him he took the time to understand my concerns and understand my body. He pointed out a lot of different issues and how he would try to fix it. Unfortunately he said it wasn’t a quick fix which is why I had to go twice. On the first day he was able to do a small adjustment which gave me a lot of relief, but it still was painful. His assistant gave me a massage down my back with care for my spine as he said that it was very tight and they don’t move well at all. He did a small back adjustment and a neck adjustment that I really needed to loosen up the tension and tightness. So on the first day it felt better but was still sore. On the second day I went back my hips and back were looser but still felt tight and painful. When I went to see him his assistant did a good massage of the back to loosen it up a bit, then he said he would try a new technique to loosen up the spine. He went to town on my spine and it felt great. After, he did a small adjustment to my neck, which hurt because of how tight it is. He was able to relieve the pain by doing some scraping and a certain pen technique which was really amazing. After, he said that my posture looks very hunched over, so he recommended cupping. I’ve had cupping before, but it has never been so incredibly effective. It really pulled out those sore muscles and gave it space. Once he finished the cupping, almost all my hip and back pain disappeared. He also cupped my neck and shoulders in a way I’ve never had before which made it feel a lot looser. I wish I could stay one more day to see what he’d do tomorrow, but I can say that he knows what he’s doing and really goes that extra mile to ensure he tries to get to the root of the problem. I’ve gone to many chiropractors in Canada over the years and none were this effective. He did not do a 5 minute crack and make you leave. His pricing is very reasonable too. 900 Baht first day 900 Baht for chiropractic treatment second day 500 Baht for cupping on the second day. Overall 2,300 Baht. This is not money wasted and was very well spent. When I left the store a group of 5 adults walked in after me. I think that sets the tone for how good he is as well. I highly recommend Narat. Thank you for your help.

0x3102973cdcb5a237_0xcbb1adfc97150064.text: I recently visited JMC Clinic for my allergy rash concerns, and the experience exceeded all my expectations. From the moment I walked in, I was struck by how immaculately clean the entire clinic was—every surface felt fresh and sanitized, creating a reassuring, safe environment that’s so important for medical care. The staff, from the front desk team to the nurses, were incredibly professional and attentive. They greeted me warmly, handled my appointment efficiently, and took the time to address all my questions with patience. Most impressively, the doctors demonstrated exceptional expertise: they listened carefully to my symptoms, thoroughly explained my condition and treatment options, and crafted a targeted plan that addressed my ongoing rash issues. Their professionalism never felt cold—instead, it was paired with genuine care that made me feel seen and supported throughout the visit. JMC Clinic checks all the boxes for quality healthcare: a spotless facility, a team of dedicated professionals, and personalized care that delivers results. I can’t recommend this clinic highly enough to anyone in need of reliable, compassionate medical support—they’ve earned my trust and will be my go-to for future healthcare needs.
0x3102973cdcb5a237_0xcbb1adfc97150064.author: Hassan

0x3102973cdcb5a237_0xcbb1adfc97150064.text: I went to the clinic after not being able to stop coughing for 5 days. From the moment I walked into the clinic the amount of care and concern was evident. There was not much waiting at all. After examining me and getting an X-ray it was determined that I had a lung infection. They gave me an antibiotic drip and a hydration drip. they also gave me oxygen. The nursing staff was very kind and caring. I actually started to feel a bit better after the antibiotic drip. They gave me medicine to take home. They also gave me the paperwork because they wanted me to go to the hospital if I wasn’t feeling better the next day. The total cost for treatment 6,364.00 thb. Approximately $284.00 cdn. I was there for 2 1/2 hours.By the time I got home my coughing stopped 90%. The next day I was feeling a lot better and had an appetite again. I cannot express my gratitude for the very professional care. They really made me feel cared for. They all spoke English.
0x3102973cdcb5a237_0xcbb1adfc97150064.author: Cardkleener (Cardkleener)

I through whay not pay them a visit and see what happens. as I arrived i waited for few minutes, the lovely receptionists took my details and checked my blood pressure amd nicely asked me to wait few minutes to see a doctor. After few minutes she directed me to a lady doctor that in the clinic. what a wonderful lady. she asked all relevant questions, explained to me where to go and how to get there and what time i need to be there. 0x30e2a1e190777de3_0x3e84ed7b10185cb0.text: The new building has cleaning staff, and the elevators have a floor-locking system, allowing access only to the intended floor. There are about 10 restaurants, a 7-Eleven, an Amazon cafe, a gym, and a buffet restaurant. The building is decorated for holidays; for example, Christmas has a Christmas tree and Santa Claus handing out candy. However, the motorcycle parking needs improvement as it's insufficient and the back entrance is locked, forcing riders to walk around to the front, exposed to sun and rain. Those carrying documents must be careful not to get wet as there's no shelter. Running requires caution due to the slippery, smooth surface. Motorcycles are double-parked, and some security guards refuse to move them. The car parking lot has about 11 floors with two-way access. After 8:30 AM, parking is usually only available on the 5th or 6th floor. Tenants should be aware of air conditioning issues; the air conditioning ducts near the windows may not reach all areas, and turning the AC centrally can make it too cold.
0x30e2a1e190777de3_0x3e84ed7b10185cb0.author: Jaturong jarungjirakiet

0x30e2a1e190777de3_0x3e84ed7b10185cb0.text: Office for rent with a Japanese restaurant and a Chinese tour bus. Parking is ridiculously expensive. Free for 15 minutes, but the 16th minute is a full 40 baht. The parking spaces are narrow, making it inconvenient to get in and out of the steps. Many times, people have to pass each other, so you have to back up as far as you can. Be careful when getting in and out. The design doesn't take safety into account. The restaurant inside the canteen is a must-try. Personally, I don't like it much because it's not delicious, just edible.

0x30e2a1e190777de3_0x3e84ed7b10185cb0.text: This building houses the Revenue Department, located on the corner of Rama III Road, near the Supalai Head Office. On the 3rd, 4th, and 5th floors, you'll be greeted with a warm welcome and fast service. Hot and cold coffee and Ovaltine are served. High security measures are in place, and many companies are located. Separate elevators are available, with staff on hand to provide information. The ground floor hall features an indoor market selling clothing, food, and miscellaneous goods. The food court offers ample parking.

For exiting, insert your visitor card to open the doors and walk out. If you are here to submit additional documents to the Revenue Department, please go to the 4th floor.

0x30fdaba73d7a553f_0xc1832ef1ae173309.text: I'm 72 years old, and I thought that at my age, there were very few benefits to be gained from the science of chiropractic before being treated at Spine Clinic by Dr. David, chiropractor. For over 40 years, after a false move in judo, I regularly experienced numbness in my left thigh muscle, which made my daily life uncomfortable for walking activities. Recently, due to sciatica, I could no longer put one foot in front of the other to walk unaided. I had to hold myself to walk 10 meters. I was completely bent over with pain that started in my lower back and went down my left thigh and leg. I noticed immediate improvements after the first session, was amazed and surprised by the difference a single session could make. I felt reassured and full of hope. In just six treatment sessions with Dr. David, and with the help of his team of highly skilled masseuses, following the instructions to regularly perform the exercises and stretches at home recommended by Dr. David, I am amazed to have regained normal mobility in my left leg while improving my overall well-being in a safe and natural way. Dr. David took the time to listen to my concerns, understand my pain and its history, clearly explained what he was going to do, and devoted all his energy to achieving the best possible results. I am delighted with the Spine Clinic; the team is very professional and passionate, and they always make us feel welcome upon our arrival. The progress I have seen encourages me to continue using their services. Congratulations and a big thank you.
0x30fdaba73d7a553f_0xc1832ef1ae173309.author: Bernard Verrier

0x30fdaba73d7a553f_0xc1832ef1ae173309.text: As a health & wellness practicioner of more than 15 years myself, I have sought the help of numerous physical therapists over the years for various pain & stiffness within my body. Henrik went straight to the source of the problem & unlike some treatments I have had in the past he was very controlled & reassuring in his methods. There was no pain or fear of broken bones like has been the case for me in the past. The release is instant & I always experienced noticeable improvement after Henrik’s treatments. Definitely the highest level of manual therapy available in Thailand, If you are in pain and need help I highly recommend the spine clinic. Thank you Henrik for all your amazing work. Justin

0x30e29ece000c3855_0xb9b976312e9a04d3.text: I would like to record my appreciation for Pacific Prime. They assisted me in iteratively comparing, applying for, and securing my (worldwide) health insurance. I want to make special mention of Kei, Daniel and Emalyn in the Bangkok Office, who made the entire process smooth and stress-free. I sent an initial meeting request to the Company over email and Kei responded in a timely manner, asking all the relevant questions to prepare for the scheduled meeting (with her and Daniel). The office itself was an oasis of calm, with everybody working, holding client meetings, and doing post-sales support in quietly and efficiently. I appreciated the work Kei put in for preparing the presentation, which made it easy for me to narrow down the insurance provider I wanted, and pinpoint the plan which suited my needs. Daniel, being more senior, provided several crucial insights which aided me in making my final choice. Finally, Emalyn did much of the post-application heavy lifting and liaisoning between the chosen provider and me, and handled both my requests for information and the insurer's requests comprehensively and with due speed. I hope I never need to use my insurance cover, but I take comfort in knowing that Pacific Prime will be around to assist me if there is ever such a situation. If you are serious about your insurance needs, and not simply checking off a list box requirement, I would recommend using the services of an insurance broker, and my vote is with Pacific Prime. Much thanks again to Kei, Daniel and Emalyn.
0x30e29ece000c3855_0xb9b976312e9a04d3.author: Ashish Kaul

0x30e29ece000c3855_0xb9b976312e9a04d3.text: If getting the right international health insurance seems daunting, this is the place to go. It is so reassuring not having to deal with the insurers themselves with their aggressive approaches in their sales process. My consultant Wouter was peaceful and trustworthy, very organized, knowledgeable, not pushy at all and took all the time to explain different options. When at first I was not accepted because of a very recent road accident he immediately came up with very decent temporary solutions which covered me until I was accepted by the Insurer with the policy I had initially chosen. I always had the feeling I had a guy in my corner. And God knows how rare that is where and when insurance is concerned. I am looking forward to a long and fruitful relationship with these brokers and I truly, truly can recommend them. I will not hesitate to get other kinds of insurance through them

0x30da3abd69eada57_0xfc6f6bbeb9b63237.text: I booked in advance via Facebook message, choosing Option B: a 90-minute facial massage + Thai massage for 1350 baht. I found it incredibly relaxing. After the massage, I chatted with the owner for a long time. She was super nice and my favorite person on this entire Chiang Mai trip! She said the facial massage technique was something she developed herself. She diligently researched various facial muscles and acupoints, and shared tips on which areas to massage for health benefits. She even created her own set of facial massage techniques – very impressive! The environment was quite simple and small, like a private studio. I felt revitalized after the massage – highly recommended! However, I suggest that women who wear makeup come before bed, as they apply some products to the face during the massage, so they will essentially remove your makeup first. You might want to consider going makeup-free for the rest of your trip! A minor drawback is that some movements during the massage involve lying face down, but their pillows are regular pillows, so you need to alternate between left and right sides. Lying face down for a while can cause neck pain.
0x30da3abd69eada57_0xfc6f6bbeb9b63237.author: Rui Lin

0x30da3abd69eada57_0xfc6f6bbeb9b63237.text: I found Orn while seeking out a Thai massage, and I am so happy I did. I expected a Thai massage, but received so much more. Not only is the shop full of good loving energy and true healing hands, but Orn really goes above and beyond in so many ways. She feels like a long lost family member, who has such love in her heart. She made me feel so beautiful inside and out. The Thai massage was amazing and tailored specifically to what I needed. She even gave me extra time in certain areas as my body really needed it. But the most incredible part was the face massage. She offers this as a stand alone service, as well as an add on to the thai massage. I never realized how much tension I held in my face, and how it is all connected to the neck and the shoulder. I had clicking in my jaw that was treated in just one session. I feel my jawline is more defined, my scalp is somehow looser and more relaxed, and I left feeling so happy in my heart as well. I highly recommend Orn, you will be so lucky to meet her and she is a real gift to the world. Thank you so much Orn 🙏❤️
0x30da3abd69eada57_0xfc6f6bbeb9b63237.author: Kelly Vaughn

0x30da3abd69eada57_0xfc6f6bbeb9b63237.text: This is not one of those typical walk-in massage places you find on every main street. It’s a small, cozy salon run by a lovely lady who truly cares about her clients. From the very beginning, you can feel it’s not a mass-service business – everything is done with attention, warmth, and real skill. The massage itself was excellent. I could literally feel the muscle tension melting away. It wasn’t just random pressure, but a thoughtful and professional treatment. Before starting, the therapist asked if it was my first Thai massage – such a nice and caring touch. After the session, we had a short, friendly chat, which made the whole experience even more personal. The place is not located on a main street, but it’s absolutely worth the short walk. I’ll definitely be going back and already recommend it to my friends. So far, it’s the best massage I’ve had in Thailand. Also, an important plus – the lady speaks very good English, so communication is easy and comfortable.

0x30da3abd69eada57_0xfc6f6bbeb9b63237.text: If you're looking for HARD Thai massages that leaves you feeling light and floaty afterwards, then Orn Healing Hands is for you! After trying a few massage places in Chiang Mai, we were frustrated by the lack of hard massages offered. Most of them were rubs leaving us feeling the same as we walked in. Do not be fooled by the simple decor and higher prices of Orn Healing Hands, because its worth every penny. They really know the pressure points of the body and work hard to relief the tightness in our bodies. There was pleasure and pain all at the same time! The atmosphere is very clean and simple with light music playing in the background. They start out washing our feet with lime and a scrub. Then we changed into the massage clothes. After the massage, they even gave us ginger tea and a biscuit. I would recommend making a reservation. I'm super happy to have found this place and I'm recommending to all my friends and family visiting Chiang Mai!

0x30da3abd69eada57_0xfc6f6bbeb9b63237.text: I've gone there 3 times during my time in Chiang Mai. The deep tissue face massage was fantastic! 0x3102bf599ee43c15_0x871d87f9f4739dee.text: Seoul Clinic Thailand in Pattaya delivered a great experience with their oxygen treatment. The procedure itself was professionally handled and the results were impressive. The staff was knowledgeable and took the time to explain everything properly before and during the treatment, making sure we felt comfortable and well informed throughout the entire process. The clinic is clean, modern, and well equipped, creating a professional environment that inspires confidence. The treatment itself was thorough and well executed, showing that the team knows exactly what they are doing. You could tell this is a clinic that takes its services seriously and invests in both the equipment and the expertise needed to deliver quality results. The overall experience from booking to walking out the door was smooth and well organized. The one issue that holds this place back from a full five stars is the 3% surcharge for card payments. In this day and age, charging customers extra for paying by card feels outdated and unnecessarily penalizing. Card payment has become the standard method of transaction for most people, especially international visitors who may not always carry large amounts of cash. Adding a surcharge on top of the treatment price leaves a sour taste and feels like a hidden extra cost that should either be absorbed into the pricing or eliminated entirely. It is a shame because everything else about the experience was excellent. The treatment, the staff, the facilities, all top notch. But when you finish a great treatment feeling positive and then get hit with an unexpected surcharge at the payment counter, it takes some of that goodwill away. Four stars because the clinic delivers quality treatments in a professional setting with a great team. Drop the card surcharge and this would be an easy five. In 2026 customers should not be penalized for choosing to pay by card.

Like many other reviews mention, this is a very bodybuilding-oriented gym with a huge amount of machines, which is great if you train seriously. You can tell a lot of people here are passionate about fitness and bodybuilding. There are many experienced lifters and bodybuilders training here, and the atmosphere feels focused and motivating. There are also a lot of foreigners and tourists, but that’s normal for Koh Samui. Even during the mornings the gym can get quite busy, which shows how popular the place is. I came in low season and I never saw the gym empty. The staff are also excellent — very friendly, smiling, professional, and constantly re-racking weights and keeping the gym clean and organized. For me, that makes a huge difference in the overall experience. The price is a little expensive honestly, but considering this is Koh Samui, I still think the pricing remains fair for the quality of the gym and equipment. I’ve been living in Bangkok for years, and honestly, even in Bangkok it is extremely rare to find a gym with this level of equipment and overall quality for this kind of price. I can count them on one hand. That’s something they should absolutely keep because it’s one of the gym’s biggest strengths. Overall, a very serious gym with excellent bodybuilding machines, a good atmosphere, and probably one of the best training environments on the island.
0x3054ef00357f128f_0x680984e6ecf16298.author: Mathieu Chaumont

0x3054ef00357f128f_0x680984e6ecf16298.text: I have been a member of Legacy Gym since it opened 16 months ago and from Day 1 it’s been nothing but the best decision I could have made ! I love the place ! I’m made to feel like I’m the most special person in the gym every time I go ! The place itself is a world class five star facility with the best selection of equipment that is maintained hourly and daily. The entire facility is immaculately cleaned all day long every day by the best staff imaginable! In other words, you could eat off the floor ! But what separates Legacy Gym from all others is the staff! They are kind , hospitable, always helpful, always attentive to your needs and genuinely interested in you having the best environment to have a great workout! You will be greeted with by a smiling face at the entrance and thruout your time there ! I have even experienced a staff member greeting me at my car with an umbrella when it’s raining , and also have had my helmet taken off my bike when it begins to rain before leaving ! There is such a team effort I just have to say all this ! It’s family there for me and everyone else that goes there ! I’m joining for another year next week!
0x3054ef00357f128f_0x680984e6ecf16298.author: Lynn

0x3054ef00357f128f_0x680984e6ecf16298.text: I can confidently say that Legacy Gym is the best gym on the island. It’s huge — two full floors with a massive variety of equipment, and many machines are duplicated. Even during peak hours, you never have to wait because there’s plenty of space and enough equipment for everyone. The group classes are absolutely amazing. I personally train with Ben, and I love it. It’s honestly like a cult — you try it once and you can’t stop. A special thank you to the cleaning team — the gym is always spotless. All the equipment is clean, well-maintained, and feels new. The gym smells fresh, and with air conditioning and fans running, it’s always comfortable at any time of day. And a big thank you to the reception team — Terry and Wai-Wai. They are always so friendly. Every time I walk in, I’m greeted with a smile and asked how I’m doing. It really makes a difference. I always leave the gym smiling too, thanks to them. Huge appreciation to the owner for creating such an incredible place. Koh Samui truly needed a professional gym like this. Highly recommended!
0x3054ef00357f128f_0x680984e6ecf16298.author: Kingdom Samui

0x3054ef00357f128f_0x680984e6ecf16298.text: Hands down the best gym on Koh Samui. The space is huge, spotless, and fully air-conditioned — high ceilings, tons of room, and you never have to wait for a machine. The equipment is next-level: it’s kitted out with high-end Bench Fitness gear (the Australian brand), including plate-loaded machines and custom pieces you genuinely won’t find anywhere else in Thailand. Everything is new and maintained constantly. It’s so much more than a gym, too — there’s a proper podcast and photo studio, group classes (Power Pump, spin, BODYCOMBAT, yoga) led by great coaches, and a spa for recovery. Open 6 AM to 11 PM daily, which makes it easy to fit in around anything. But the thing that really sets Legacy apart is the staff. Genuinely warm, attentive, and welcoming — you’re treated like family every single time MAKE THE BEST PROTEIN SHAKE ON THE ISLAND 🏝️ The crowd is a healthy mix of beginners and serious lifters, so it’s motivating without ever feeling intimidating. If you’re on Samui and you actually want to train, this is the place. Highly recommend!
0x3054ef00357f128f_0x680984e6ecf16298.author: Ben Urquhart

0x3054ef00357f128f_0x680984e6ecf16298.text: I’ve trained in a few places in the past, and Legacy Muscle Universe is the best gym here on Koh Samui in my opinion. On day one, it was Payton who showed me around, and everything is new and very clean. The equipment is good quality. I have been coming for almost a year and visit 2 or 3 times every week. Everything is still good quality and the premier facilities are as good or better than ever, with the sauna and spa excellent additions. So I enjoy the good value. The classes are a fun way to work out. The reception staff are very friendly, and Payton is helpful as ever. As a local, or for tourists, I would definitely recommend Legacy Muscle Universe!
0x3054ef00357f128f_0x680984e6ecf16298.author: Loupart jean-charles

0x3054ef00357f128f_0x680984e6ecf16298.text: 5 star gym easily. 400 baht for a day pass which we agree to be reasonable. Lots of high end machines, lots of dumbbells plenty of weight in here. Upstairs is full of cardio machines & more machines. Multiple studios including a posing room upstairs as well. Very clean & maintained facility, did not check out the spa but looked quite nice from afar. Staff were friendly, this place did not have a snobby feel whatsoever but very welcoming. Spoke with a few of the members who were training at the time we went very friendly people. This gym is a must & well worth the price every time. Lots of vehicle & or scooter parking available.
0x3054ef00357f128f_0x680984e6ecf16298.author: M

0x3054ef00357f128f_0x680984e6ecf16298.text: The gym LEGACY is just incredible! Huge, beautifully designed with multiple training areas and top of the line equipment. But the real highlight is definitely the group classes. A super varied schedule with high quality coaches. Special mention to Linda, the best coach of all time, her Cardio Boxing class is number one and her Booty Circuit and Circuit Training sessions are amazing as well. The Yoga classes with Kru are also truly excellent and Elijah’s sessions with his relaxation practice are absolutely exceptional. Spin classes with Ben are also very good ! And all of this for a price that beats any other gym on Koh Samui !
0x3054ef00357f128f_0x680984e6ecf16298.author: Camille De la Taille Gadret

0x3054ef00357f128f_0x680984e6ecf16298.text: Fantastic gym. The selection of equipment is great — modern, well-maintained, and offers great variety for every type of workout. The staff are incredibly friendly, supportive, and always ready to help, which creates a truly welcoming atmosphere. The overall vibe in the gym is motivating and positive, making every training session enjoyable. The classes are excellent as well, led by professional instructors who keep things fun and challenging. Without a doubt the best gym on the island. Highly recommended!
0x3054ef00357f128f_0x680984e6ecf16298.author: Sabina

0x30dbd39c9e0ac059_0xa104fc9cf7005f07.text: I came to see Dr. Pui on October 22, 2025, after a friend who had been treated there and recovered, recommended her. I came to ask Dr. Pui for treatment of pain in my upper arm. It prevented me from lying face down and placing my hand on top of my arm, and reaching to the side or behind me caused sharp pain. I had to stop yoga for over a year. An MRI revealed a partial tendon tear. I had been receiving injections, medication, and shockwave therapy for over a year at several places, but the pain only subsided without a complete cure. After one acupuncture session with Dr. Pui, I felt my arm strength improve. Dr. Pui also prescribed physical exercises in the morning and before bed. After 3-5 acupuncture sessions, the pain disappeared completely and hasn't returned. I also discussed with Dr. Pui about a kidney cyst that I've had for almost 10 years. The cyst is 2-4 cm in size. In mid-2025, I had a severe infection with a high fever and had to be hospitalized for the first time in my life. Dr. Pui advised that if I continued to get infections due to the kidney cyst, it would be necessary to remove the kidney because the cyst is large, located in the center like the yolk of an egg, and there's no cure. I was very stressed and afraid of further infections and the need for removal. Dr. Pui suggested I try acupuncture and Chinese medicine, along with dietary control and stress reduction from work. The doctor confidently explained the treatment plan, giving the patient a great deal of hope and peace of mind. I received acupuncture treatments continuously from the end of October 2025 until now, April 2026, completing 20 sessions, including the initial sessions which caused shoulder and arm pain. I also took self-prepared Chinese herbal medicine for about 50 days, stopping in early March 2026 and remaining with acupuncture until mid-April 2026. The doctor then suggested a follow-up ultrasound to check the size of the cyst. The doctor who performed the previous ultrasound during my hospitalization was puzzled, asking where the cyst had gone, which side it was on, and why it was gone. They asked what I had done. I was so happy and accidentally mentioned that I had been receiving acupuncture (I didn't intend to tell them). Upon receiving the results, I immediately sent them to Dr. Pui, overjoyed and amazed by this Traditional Chinese Medicine treatment. I would like to express my deepest gratitude to Dr. Pui for providing a more comfortable alternative to waiting for infection and kidney removal. I wish Dr. Pui continued good health. I hope this shared information will be useful to others. May everyone find the best health options for themselves as well.
0x30dbd39c9e0ac059_0xa104fc9cf7005f07.author: hatairat Poonlarptawee

0x30dbd39c9e0ac059_0xa104fc9cf7005f07.text: Today I want to share my personal experience receiving treatment from this doctor. Two or three years ago, I was diagnosed with uterine cysts. I received treatment at private hospitals in Chiang Mai. The fibroids shrunk, but didn't disappear completely. When I had the opportunity to accompany my boyfriend to the clinic, I consulted with the doctor about the fibroids. The doctor gave excellent advice and is incredibly skilled. I used to experience monthly abdominal pain. After receiving treatment from the doctor using acupuncture and herbal medicine, the most impressive thing is that the abdominal pain disappeared completely – not even a little bit! And the uterine cysts shrunk entirely. After less than two months of treatment with the doctor, my latest checkup at the hospital informed me that the nearly 3cm cyst was completely gone. For anyone looking for a Chinese medicine doctor, I highly recommend this clinic. You won't be disappointed. From a patient's heart. (The doctor might be a little strict, haha, but it's worth it for the effective treatment!)
0x30dbd39c9e0ac059_0xa104fc9cf7005f07.author: ชนันท์ธิดา มาซิว

0x30dbd39c9e0ac059_0xa104fc9cf7005f07.text: I've had an allergic rash for a very long time, caused by COVID-19. I've tried many treatments, both modern and traditional Thai medicine, but the itchy rash wouldn't completely go away; it would reappear and become itchy again. So I searched for a Chinese medicine clinic on Google and found Songklod Traditional Chinese Medicine Clinic in Chiang Mai (luckily, the doctor had recently moved the clinic to Chiang Mai, making it very easy to visit). The doctor is very kind and attentive to patients. She examines the tongue, pulse, and analyzes the symptoms before starting the treatment. She also gives advice on exercise and overall health. The itchy rash significantly decreased within a month and a half, and no new rashes appeared. I'm very happy. If anyone has an allergic rash and is looking for a Chinese medicine treatment option, I highly recommend talking to Dr. Pui at Songklod Traditional Chinese Medicine Clinic in Chiang Mai.
0x30dbd39c9e0ac059_0xa104fc9cf7005f07.author: Theranath Luddapun

0x30dbd39c9e0ac059_0xa104fc9cf7005f07.text: My period was absent for 4 months, and before that it was irregular due to accumulated stress from moving and changing jobs. I was already interested in Traditional Chinese Medicine, so I searched for clinics on Google and found this one. It's not far from my house either. I came for the first time yesterday, January 20th, 2026. I was very lucky that the doctor was free for a short time, so I was able to have acupuncture. The doctor checked my pulse, examined my tongue, inserted acupuncture needles, and gave me herbal medicine to boil and take. I took the medicine for two doses. This afternoon (January 21st, 2026), my period came! I'm so happy! Thank you so much, Dr. Pui. Thank you truly. I will take care of my health, sleep well, eat well, and follow your advice. I'm so lucky to have found this clinic. It's a light and a great source of encouragement in my life. I hope you will stay in Chiang Mai for a long time. 💗
0x30dbd39c9e0ac059_0xa104fc9cf7005f07.author: Bow Suwannarat

0x30dbd39c9e0ac059_0xa104fc9cf7005f07.text: I had abdominal pain and was diagnosed with sand-like gallstones. I wanted to try Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) first, so I searched for a TCM practitioner in Chiang Mai and found Songklom Clinic through a Google search and reading reviews. I decided to consult them about my gallstones before considering surgery. The doctor prescribed acupuncture and herbal medicine. Initially, I experienced abdominal pain after eating, but after continuing to take the herbal medicine, I no longer have any pain and can live a normal life. I also no longer have jaundice (yellowing of the skin and eyes). It's been 5 months without any symptoms, so I've cancelled the gallstone surgery. Besides the doctor's treatment, we also need to manage our diet and lifestyle as advised. I haven't had surgery to remove the gallstones yet, and I have no symptoms; I'm living normally. I highly recommend this clinic; it's excellent!
0x30dbd39c9e0ac059_0xa104fc9cf7005f07.author: Kesorn KK

0x30dbd39c9e0ac059_0xa104fc9cf7005f07.text: I spotted this place from France and was able to visit during my time in Chiang Mai few weeks ago. I absolutely do NOT regret my choice. The doctor takes the time to explain everything, finds very accurate problems (i also am helped by others TCM practitioners here in France) that concurs with what we already knew and goes even deeper in my opinion. i had very painful legs for months prior to visit and in 2 sessions, the pain was gone. it was my main reason to visit this clinic but the doctor found my other problems and recommended me some tips to feel better. i also dragged my friend there for constipation problems and shoulder pain and her problems were also gone after the 2 sessions we did together. i HIGHLY recommend this place and, i almost want to come back to Chiang Mai JUST to be able to be treated here. Thanks a lot for everything!
0x30dbd39c9e0ac059_0xa104fc9cf7005f07.author: Faranah N.

0x30dbd39c9e0ac059_0xa104fc9cf7005f07.text: As a patient myself I have to admit that the medicine given was really effective. I used to be someone that did not believe in traditional medicine. However, my experience in Moonbow completely transformed my belief. Growing up I had really bad tic symptoms. I went to many hospitals and they gave me medicines. However as long as I don’t take the pills anymore my symptoms came back immediately if not worse than before. My family and I decided to try traditional medicines instead so we visited this clinic. I took herbal medicines and did acupuncture for around 2 months now my symptoms became around 50% better. During the treatments not just my tics got better but also my acne. If you are having illness right now I truly recommend you to come to Moonbow and give traditional medicine a try.
0x30dbd39c9e0ac059_0xa104fc9cf7005f07.author: Ethan Yi

0x30dbd39c9e0ac059_0xa104fc9cf7005f07.text: I've suffered from gastritis for many years and was so discouraged that I started looking into alternative medicine. I initially searched for many clinics until I found this one. It's as good as everyone says! The doctor is kind but strict. If I could give 10 stars, I would! They use a holistic approach to treatment, which takes time and patience. But when your symptoms improve, it's a holistic improvement, not just a localized problem. Recently, I was diagnosed with gallstones, but I didn't want surgery, so I consulted with a doctor and decided to seek treatment here first. If it didn't improve, I would consider surgery. But after just over two months, the gallstones are gone!!! I'm so happy that I was able to preserve my gallbladder.
0x30dbd39c9e0ac059_0xa104fc9cf7005f07.author: Arunee_Oom

0x305037cbd917b293_0x88b6acae9a308d84.text: I had an incredible experience at DOPA, truly one of the best wellness spaces I’ve ever visited. From the moment you walk in, the atmosphere feels calm, welcoming, and beautifully designed, with a very serene, almost retreat-like vibe that instantly helps you switch off. The food was outstanding, fresh, wholesome, and thoughtfully curated. We especially loved the immunity booster and the other wellness shots, which were both delicious and felt genuinely energising. It’s easy to see why so many people talk about their clean, nourishing menu and great coffee options too. The wellness facilities were just as impressive. The sauna and steam rooms were perfectly maintained and incredibly relaxing, and the entire space felt very clean and well organised something a lot of visitors appreciate. We also tried the massages and they were fantastic, easily among the most relaxing treatments we’ve had. The therapists were skilled and the experience felt very personalised and unhurried. What really stands out and something I’ve heard others mention as well is the overall energy of the place. It feels like a community space where you can slow down, recharge, and spend a few peaceful hours. The staff were warm and attentive, and everything from the facilities to the service felt premium yet comfortable. We genuinely had the best time here and I would absolutely recommend it to anyone visiting Phuket who wants a mix of great food, wellness, and a truly relaxing experience.
0x305037cbd917b293_0x88b6acae9a308d84.author: Pratha Agrawal

0x305037cbd917b293_0x88b6acae9a308d84.text: DOPA Sauna & Wellness Club Located conveniently on the outskirts of Bangtao, DOPA Sauna & Wellness Club is a hidden gem that offers an impressive array of wellness facilities, including a Banya, sauna, steam room, pool, jacuzzi, three different cold plunge options, massage rooms, a small workout area, and a menu of healthy, clean food. My overall experience was phenomenal. From the moment I arrived, the staff greeted me with warm smiles, creating an inviting atmosphere. The color scheme is visually pleasing, and the natural vibe truly makes you feel at ease. It’s a sanctuary where you can leave all your worries behind and immerse yourself in a vacation-like experience. What stood out to me was the friendly demeanor of both the staff and fellow visitors, contributing to a welcoming community feel. I also appreciated the owner, Boris, who is actively involved in maintaining the facility. His attention to detail is evident; he consistently ensures that the space is clean and presentable. As a leader, he sets a strong example for his staff with a “lead by example” approach. I highly recommend DOPA Sauna & Wellness Club for anyone seeking a relaxing retreat that prioritizes wellness and community.
0x305037cbd917b293_0x88b6acae9a308d84.author: Mark G

0x305037cbd917b293_0x88b6acae9a308d84.text: We got a recommendation to visit this place, and the moment we arrived we understood why, it’s truly one of the best wellness centers in the world. We’ve been to many wellness places before, but this one is on a whole different level. The attention to detail is insane: from the design, to the atmosphere, to the quality of the saunas and facilities. Everything feels natural, clean, and organic. Even the restaurant here, honestly, it’s the best food we’ve had in Phuket. Dopa has saunas, a steam room, hot and cold onsen pools, fire place, and beautiful spaces that feel like a sanctuary for your body and mind. The experience here is incredible, and even the people who come here are all so beautiful. This is the place I recommend the most in Phuket for anyone who loves wellness and health. Whether you’re coming for the amazing food or for a top-level sauna and spa experience, this is the spot. We even learned that the water they use inside the sauna is completely purified. Highly, highly recommended.
0x305037cbd917b293_0x88b6acae9a308d84.author: daniel alon

0x305037cbd917b293_0x88b6acae9a308d84.text: Absolutely amazing experience! From the moment we arrived, the staff made us feel incredibly welcome, especially Katty, who was exceptionally friendly, attentive, and professional. The entire place is beautifully designed: stylish, cozy, and very relaxing. The food was delicious, with a great selection and high quality dishes. The sauna area is outstanding, everything you could possibly need for a perfect spa and bath experience is there. The banya itself was excellent, and the pool is spacious enough to fully enjoy and relax. One of the highlights for me was the ice plunge pools with different temperatures, such a refreshing and unique touch! You can really tell that every detail was carefully thought out. This is the kind of place you genuinely want to come back to again and again. Highly recommended!
0x305037cbd917b293_0x88b6acae9a308d84.author: Artemii Besedin

0x305037cbd917b293_0x88b6acae9a308d84.text: As someone who pays attention to details, what I appreciate about Dopa is that it offers more than just a sauna experience. From the moment you enter, you can sense that the place was created by someone deeply passionate about holistic well-being. Every corner reflects thought and intention. From the textures and design choices to the calming atmosphere. I’ve been to many saunas before, but this one stands out for how it fosters a sense of independent wellness and community rather than just providing a service. Photos can’t quite capture how amazing this place truly feels once you’re there. The wonderful thing is, you’ll discover that for yourself. The textures, the atmosphere, and the overall experience come together beautifully. 🏅🏆
0x305037cbd917b293_0x88b6acae9a308d84.author: Janerika Guevara

0x305037cbd917b293_0x88b6acae9a308d84.text: What stood out for me here was the food quality, especially the salads and fresh fruits. Everything tasted really fresh and clean, like you can tell the ingredients are well-selected. It didn’t feel like typical spa food that looks nice but tastes bland. The menu feels thoughtfully designed for wellness and recovery. You don’t leave feeling heavy or sleepy. I also like that the dishes feel nice serving and intentional, super professional 👏👏👏. It feels like the chef really understands nutrition and how food affects the body. You can sense that there’s knowledge and skill behind the menu. I left feeling light, satisfied, and not bloated. If you care about what you put into your body, this place makes sense.
0x305037cbd917b293_0x88b6acae9a308d84.author: Jennie N

0x305037cbd917b293_0x88b6acae9a308d84.text: I had a wonderful experience at this sauna in Thailand and was extremely satisfied overall. The location is beautiful, peaceful, and perfectly suited for relaxation. From the moment I arrived, I felt very comfortable and welcomed. The service was outstanding — the staff were friendly, professional, and always attentive without being intrusive. Everything was well organized and very clean, which made the experience even more enjoyable. I truly appreciated the calm atmosphere and the high level of care provided. This place is ideal for anyone looking to relax, unwind, and enjoy a high-quality sauna experience. I would definitely come back and highly recommend it to others visiting the area.
0x305037cbd917b293_0x88b6acae9a308d84.author: Mr Yes

0x305037cbd917b293_0x88b6acae9a308d84.text: I came to DOPA on a day when my body felt tired and overloaded. I didn’t expect much, but I left feeling lighter. The food was honestly better than I thought — balanced, nourishing, and not heavy. The pizza crust was healthy and super crunchy, and I still finished it even though I was already full. That says a lot. The menu feels intentional, like it’s designed for recovery, not just for taste. The sauna and steam rooms were clean and well-managed. The herbal sauna session with the master was very hot but incredibly relaxing. The place itself looks modern and calm, not flashy. Staff were friendly and easygoing. Overall, it felt like a real wellness break, not just a club spa visit.
0x305037cbd917b293_0x88b6acae9a308d84.author: Thao Nguyen

0x30da3b2eb63ce545_0xf0420e6568c90fe2.text: 10 out 5 stars! Great clinic, excellent staff, superb doctor-will definitely be back! Received above and beyond care, excellent results!! - thread lift (nose and cheeks) and botox. What i appreciate most - how professional everything was, from sign-in to explaining the treatment options, did not felt like i am being sold something, but was presented with options in response to my skin concerns- they listened, and explained options, the processes involved, what they professionally would recommend, the cost it involves. I was not rushed when explaining my concerns, and was given a thorough explanation of the recommended treatments. There was no push to buy services at all-more of information so i can make a decision. The clinic was very well kept, clean, and trustworthy. The Doctor who did the procedure explained everything-the procedure, what to expect during procedure and the expected results even way before I have committed to the procedure. I felt like I was the only patient as she spent time making sure I know and understand the process. Big thank you doc! Aftercare was TOP NOTCH. Had to travel the next day to another city, but the clinic was in constant follow-up using whatsapp. 5 day, 7 day, 10 day and even 1 month follow-up ensuring everything was healing perfectly and as intended. This were proactive messages asking how the healing is progressing and if I had any other concerns. I had nose and cheek thread lift done and botox injections done - excellent results! No adverse effects whatsoever ever just normal healing soreness, very minor not noticeable yellow bruising. Whats great is I had an open line communication anytime with the clinic about concerns i had and they’ve proactively contacted me to make sure healing is as expected and if I had any other concerns even if I was already in another city and eventually another country. I highly recommend Mi-A if you are ever in Chiang Mai and thinking about skin treatments. If undecided, book a consult and talk to the team. They’re not pushy, or will not try to sell you something on the spot but will go through treatments options so you can make an informed decision just like I did. Thank You Mi-A team!!!
0x30da3b2eb63ce545_0xf0420e6568c90fe2.author: Bruce B

0x30da3b2eb63ce545_0xf0420e6568c90fe2.text: Came in looking for Pico Sure and Rejuran HB+ for the first time for hyperpigmentation. I’m from the US and finding a clinic in Asia & doing these services were nerve wracking. But what I loved about this experience was 1. Very responsive on Line & FB. I talked to them for a few days back and forth before the procedure & they were really patient with all of my questions which made me trust them. Other clinics didn’t have as much patience. 2. Prices were affordable 3. Doctor was knowledgeable and has done Pico & Rejuran before. The front staff were all so warm. They knew what they were talking about when it came to skin care 4. Spoke great English and answered all my questions 5. They gave me the option to try Pico, and then half way decide if I wanted to do Rejuran HB+. That was great because I felt less pressure & could make the right decision for myself if I wanted to stop. (I ended up doing both) they even showed me the box so I could validate it was legit! 6. They msg’d me with a list of after care instructions, checked in a week after via msg, and continued to answer my offline questions on Line. 7. Also scheduled a follow up appointment where they showed me the before & after photos. They got rid of my melasma and my skin looks a lot clearer! 8. When I showed them skin products I bought at a different pharmacy and the doctor was knowledgeable at advising if/when I should use them. Overall I feel very cared for. They focus not only about the onetime procedure but making sure all of my questions were answered and amazing service. Really happy with the experience :)
0x30da3b2eb63ce545_0xf0420e6568c90fe2.author: Jane Dracy

0x30da3b2eb63ce545_0xf0420e6568c90fe2.text: I've been living in Chiang Mai on and off for a few months here and there and have always had skin issues which really escalated during the hotter period here in April along with my stress with work. I know Thailand has the reputation for skin clinics and quick treatments, but I never know which ones are reputable enough as my skin is very sensitive from past damage from aesthetic clinic back home and I am wary. Anyway, reading up and checking out reviews carefully I decided to call Mi-A clinic for a consult. Today 8 months later, my skin (i'm in my early 40s) is much better. Doctor treated my pigmentation with laser, and I tried 2 types of injections (MADE and one other) for tackling my acne breakout. Both resolved my issues tremendously and my skin is much clearer now. Doctor King is extremely patient to listen, along with clinic assistant Opal, they both speak and understand English well and could address my concerns. The other clinic assistants were all very nice, gentle and patient. Never once was there any hardsell of their services or pressure to do anything I wasn't comfortable with. Extremely professional and the clinic is big and clean, with reasonable prices. They are my go-to clinic now as and when I am back to the city. My skin may not be super model perfect now, but it's a long long way better than before. I guess for those who battle skin problems, will understand the feeling.
0x30da3b2eb63ce545_0xf0420e6568c90fe2.author: G C

0x30da3b2eb63ce545_0xf0420e6568c90fe2.text: I recently visited Mi-A Clinic for Botox and CO2 laser treatment, and honestly I could not be happier with the experience and results. From the moment I arrived, everyone made me feel genuinely comfortable and welcome. The clinic itself is beautiful, calm, clean and relaxing, which immediately helped me feel at ease. What stood out most to me was how much time and care the doctor gave during the consultation. Everything was explained in detail, including the procedure itself, what to expect during recovery, and the realistic results.
