0x30502517668aeda9_0xdcfd75cdfa6f8bb4.text: Kata hiking trail to big Buddha This trail became really popular back the at the beginning of Covid when they closed all the beaches and people still wanted to get out and do some exercise. Theres been a lot of modifications to the trail since then, making it a bit safer for everyone to use. The trail from the beginning to the big buddha road is about 20 minutes non stop walking or 30-40 minutes with a few breaks and another 10-15 minutes to reach the big buddha statue. The trail through the jungle is actually only about 1km, it just has a been incline the whole way up. The best time to go is in the morning or late afternoon, as its generally a bit cooler than. Once you reach the road theres a few sea view cafes which is definitely a great place to catch your breath and indulge in a fresh cold coconut. The best time to spot the monkeys is late afternoon around 4-5pm, just be careful to not get to close as these are wild monkeys, If you do come across them on the route, just keep walking and view from a safe distance. I walk up here quite regularly with my dog and he loves the trail, great way to tire him out haha. What to bring? Bring closed in footwear as the trail can be slippy with quite a few loose rocks. Mosquito spray is needed in the wetter months, as you get a lot once you enter the jungle. Bring some water to keep refreshed. You cannot drive this trail on a motorbike... i have seen people try , your bike will get stuck. Doing the climb with young kids is possible, I would highly recommend not doing it with a pushchair though, as you will need free hands to be able to climb up. Enjoy the trek!
0x30502517668aeda9_0xdcfd75cdfa6f8bb4.author: Mojos travels

0x30502517668aeda9_0xdcfd75cdfa6f8bb4.text: There were mixed reviews on the difficulty of this trail. So we took the gamble and went as it was right by our Airbnb. We went at high sun because we wanted a "slow day" and got up late. Mistake #1, no slow days in Thailand get up with the sun it's too damn hot. We thought 600ml each of water would be enough, mistake #2. We wore long clothing to protect from bugs, mistakish #3, you will be completely soaked by the time you get up, use bug spray and you will be fine. There were times I wanted to die. I begged my husband to leave my body for the scorpions. I fell a few times on the way back down but I am quiet clumsy. It is steep, there are ropes, use them up and down. As fit-ish late 20s year olds we had a hard time going up. There is a restaurant at the top called big Buddha art cafe. Absolutely delicious. There was trash everywhere, please respect Thailand and pack out your trash ☺️
0x30502517668aeda9_0xdcfd75cdfa6f8bb4.author: Kizzi Reda

0x30502517668aeda9_0xdcfd75cdfa6f8bb4.text: I feel I need to share an honest review as some others on here are definitely a bit dramatic. So overall it’s a good little “trail”. Mostly walking up through the trees. If you’re lucky you’ll see some nature. From spiders to monkeys. Now this is where the negative reviews come in… the trail is and isn’t a trail. I get some may have this image of a nice mud path that goes up hill, which is the case for 1/2 of it. Other bits are a little sketchy perhaps but nothing that you can’t get around. There are some ropes to assist in areas. I’d suggest a decent shoe. But as I said, don’t go into this thinking it’s a stroll up a path. Fairly easy for someone who walks/ hikes a lot. Others may find it a little challenging. Roughly 20 minutes or so for the trail itself. Some cafes at the top of the trail, followed by a 10 - 15 minute walk to the Buddha.
0x30502517668aeda9_0xdcfd75cdfa6f8bb4.author: Alex Kilkenny

0x30502517668aeda9_0xdcfd75cdfa6f8bb4.text: This is a difficult climb, which consists of a continuous up hill climb with no real flat areas until you reach the top. It took me approximately 1 hour from kata town to the top, I used google maps and it took me through the forest. Lots of uneven ground, although there is ropes in places it still is difficult. I would consider myself to have a good level of fitness and I did have to stop a few times. I met many people who were struggling, or even had turned around. If your in to hiking and like a challenge, then definitely give this a go. I stupidly climbed with no water, massive mistake! Once you get back onto the road there is restaurants/ cafes where you can get a drink and enjoy a view over kata / karon beach. The buddah was free entry but be sure to cover your knees and shoulders. There was lots of monkeys at the top during my visit!
0x30502517668aeda9_0xdcfd75cdfa6f8bb4.author: Charlie

0x30502517668aeda9_0xdcfd75cdfa6f8bb4.text: It is NOT a casual stroll in the park, rather an all terrain assault course that really the SAS should use for training. Beautiful views. I am relatively fit but gave up half way up. Clint Eastwood said "A man's gotta know his limitations", so rather than risk a broken limb or heart attack my continuing overall trip around Asia was worth more to me than the treacherous (at times) climb. I walked with walking shoes, but coming down saw people with sandals, crocks and flip flops..... insanity. If you can do it, and want to take lots and lots of water and a towel. I took a change of shirt because the one worn going up was sodden with sweat. Go luck to you if you attempt it, but please go prepared and take it gently and with care
0x30502517668aeda9_0xdcfd75cdfa6f8bb4.author: Richard

0x30502517668aeda9_0xdcfd75cdfa6f8bb4.text: I took the Big Buddha Hiking Trail and found it challenging but rewarding. The round trip from Karon Beach to Big Buddha and back was just under 90min, check opening hours first if you want to go in. I arrived at 7am and it opened at 9am - I was more interested in the challenge of the walk than visiting the Big Buddha. The trail itself was well signposted and required some dexterity to navigate, but was ok. It was a good workout on the trail and a little easier when hitting the road section up to the Big Buddha. Coming down was much quicker and aided by ropes in places. Even leaving early it was warm, so take plenty of water during the day. Disappointing to see some rubbish on the trail, please pick up after yourself.
0x30502517668aeda9_0xdcfd75cdfa6f8bb4.author: M.

0x30502517668aeda9_0xdcfd75cdfa6f8bb4.text: Nice and steep, ropes were available in the steepest sections. A lot of rain erosion on the dirt sections of the trail. Closer to the top, you walk through a paved Road between a rubber tree plantation. If you're coming from Karon or Katang Beach, you can hike up about as quickly as a drive to the top of the Big Buddha because the roads take you all the way to the east side of the island before wrapping back around. If you're coming from the Western beaches, this hiking trail goes straight up the hill and right to the Big Buddha. It took my wife and I 45 minutes to hike up the trail, and it took us 45 minutes in a cab to get back!
0x30502517668aeda9_0xdcfd75cdfa6f8bb4.author: Dave Nuerge

0x30502517668aeda9_0xdcfd75cdfa6f8bb4.text: The trail itself isn't too long but it' steep in some areas with some rope that can be used.I actually saw some people working on the very beginning of the trail. It took me about 30 minutes to get to the top of the trail and another 10 minutes all the way to Big Bhudda. I did the ascent in the middle of the day and it got quite hot, so be prepared and bring some water. Did the descend just before sunset and that was a bit easier and quite a bit faster. Its slippery though. Like other people mentioned, use decent shoes. Also there are some electrical wires which you should probably avoid. All in all, nice little adventure.
0x30502517668aeda9_0xdcfd75cdfa6f8bb4.author: Randy

0x30e283cc1c1fbb99_0xb85f4a96393e994c.text: Good Up Specialty Coffee is a specialty coffee shop located in the Songprapa-Don Mueang area. It boasts a warm, two-story design in a simple, mid-century modern style. They offer a selection of high-quality house blend coffee beans in three roasts (light, medium, and dark), along with filter coffee, non-coffee options, and homemade bakery items. Location: JE Urban (Jw Urban) Project, Songprapa Road, Don Mueang (Closed Tuesdays) Atmosphere: Mid-century modern decor with a focus on wood tones and curved walls. The quiet atmosphere is ideal for working or relaxing, with background jazz music. Recommended Menu Items: Coffee: House Blend (3 choices), Drip Coffee (Filter), Coffee Tonic with fruit toppings such as yuzu, pineapple, and passion fruit. Non-Coffee/Bakery: Rich Matcha, Matcha Brownie (less sweet).

0x30e283cc1c1fbb99_0xb85f4a96393e994c.text: Wow, amazing! Such a wide variety of coffee beans to choose from; there's bound to be something you like. 0x30da3b7201a31ab9_0x5a1fb891f45453c5.text: I had the most amazing experience at Chiang Mai Wellness Clinic and cannot say enough wonderful things about the care I received from Dr. Nicha (Dr. Tan) and the entire team. From the moment my partner and I arrived, we were made to feel completely comfortable and at ease. The consultation process was thoughtful, thorough, and truly patient-centred, with zero pressure at any point. Dr. Tan took the time to explain everything clearly and made sure I felt confident and relaxed before proceeding with my treatment. A very special thank you to Bubbib, who gently applied the numbing cream and made me feel so well cared for, and to Fon, who applied the soothing jelly mask, followed by Pipo, who removed it with such care and kindness. Every step of the process felt calm, professional, and genuinely warm. I had the Ultraformer III procedure, and the results are honestly incredible — some of the best I’ve seen in all my years of facial rejuvenation treatments. The lifting, tightening, and overall improvement are remarkable, and the experience itself was smooth and far more comfortable than I expected. The pricing was also extremely reasonable for the level of expertise, technology, and care provided. It’s rare to find a clinic that combines medical professionalism, kindness, transparency, and outstanding results so seamlessly. I highly recommend Dr. Tan and the entire Chiang Mai Wellness Clinic team to anyone looking for safe, high-quality aesthetic treatments in Chiang Mai. This clinic is truly a gem.

0x30e29987e47b0889_0x3c596bb4a49d2f09.text: I’ve been treated for ADD a long time. Traveling all the time I see how healthcare systems remain fantastically expensive, inefficient, bewildering, and inequitable. Not just in America, but nation to nation, culture to culture, around the globe. I’d run out of medications, just as I arrived in Thailand to work as a freelance journalist. I cannot praise Pantamone Pharmacy enough for the navigational map they drew that Saturday evening on my behalf. Not as a farang but as a member of a global community of compassionate human beings. Expertly, the gracious pharmacist evaluated the documents from my hospital at Yale University, confirming with clarity just how to best maintain my American-prescribed schedule living in the kingdom. All travelers fall victim to their own ignorance and worse. Pantamone Pharmacy provides wonderful service that goes far beyond a simple refill. Here you find refuge in the knowledge and practice of dhamma.
0x30e29987e47b0889_0x3c596bb4a49d2f09.author: Robert Goethals

0x30e29987e47b0889_0x3c596bb4a49d2f09.text: Okay...let's be concise...the most incredible pharmacy in 40 years of travel! Kind, welcoming, courteous, respectful, friendly—that says it all. A professional discussion, certainly, but also an exchange of love and compassion that one unfortunately doesn't often encounter. Usually, business comes first and goodbye, but here, 20 minutes of conversation as if we'd known each other forever. Ah! Perhaps that's the case...in our inner lives. Jokingly, I showed her a photo from my phone...my heavenly mother, I said (the Virgin Mary), and she showed me one from hers...my heavenly father, she replied (Buddha)...a nice comparison without dogma! Long Live the Pharmacist! Sincerely, Pascal

0x30e29f5865e4cce9_0xf9b7feb3e02efc52.text: Finally! An acupuncturist for cynics and skeptics like me. I have always been skeptical of massages and TCM but that changed with a recent issue while vacationing in Bangkok. The day before an 18 hour flight I woke up with intense neck pain that was shooting down my arm and started to cry with panic because not only is it extremely uncomfortable but the idea of having to sit on a plane like this was really scary. I didn't want to go to a clinic where they tell me to just do stretches and I didn't want a tourist massage because I thought they'd make it worse. The pain was so bad that acupuncture sounded perfect because if they couldn't fix me then maybe they could just stab me to death with needles because I wasn't getting on a plane with this pain. This doctor is FANTASTIC because she is kind and professional but very direct which I appreciated because I'm sure than skeptics like me don't make her job easy but she knew just how to deal with me. She took my pulse and just looked at me and told me that I am eating too much spicy food, coffee, and this is causing anxiety. How did she know this! I confessed to her about all of the touristy foods I had been over indulging on like mango smoothies, iced coffees, and spicy pad thai everyday and she looked at me with this look of "lady, are you serious?". In the USA the doctors are so worried about making money and not getting sued so they coddle there patients too much. I wish we had more doctors like this one who are more direct with their patients. I told her about my lifestyle, job, diet, and medical history before moving on to treatment. She asked me what I needed help with and I told her about my neck pain. She said "OK, I will also help prepare you for jet lag, how about hair loss and weight loss too?" sure, why not! I got the electronic acupuncture and cupping which took about 45 minutes. As soon as I got up I felt better and I couldn't believe it. I told the doctor that I was better and she did not even look surprised because she knows the process works even for cynics and non believers like me. Three days later and I have no neck pain, no hip pain, and feel the best I ever have after a long flight. It is magical. I honestly cannot believe how great this was and I am telling everyone about it. I am a believer now! Even if you don't have pain, you should see her to prepare your body for a long flight or bus ride because I cannot believe how great I feel. Thank you so much and I hope to come back here again!
0x30e29f5865e4cce9_0xf9b7feb3e02efc52.author: Linda Houliston

0x30e29f5865e4cce9_0xf9b7feb3e02efc52.text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ At 60 years old, I have seen many doctors and wellness practitioners throughout my life, and it is rare to come across someone who combines knowledge with such genuine kindness and compassion. Dr. Nam is young enough to be my daughter, yet from the moment I met her, I felt completely safe and cared for. She took her time, listened carefully, and went through every one of my concerns with patience and sincerity. I never felt rushed. I truly felt I was in good hands, and I found myself trusting her completely because her care comes from a place that feels deeply genuine. What touched me most was not only her skill as a Traditional Chinese Medicine doctor and acupuncturist, but the love and passion she puts into everything she does. She creates beautiful herbal oils and products, and you can feel how much she believes in them and how much heart she pours into her work. That energy is contagious. There are practitioners who treat symptoms, and there are those rare souls who make you feel seen, heard, and genuinely cared for. Dr. Nam is one of those people. I left feeling grateful and with the comforting feeling that I had found someone I could trust with my health and well-being. Highly recommended, especially for anyone looking for a doctor who treats not just the body, but the person in front of her. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
0x30e29f5865e4cce9_0xf9b7feb3e02efc52.author: Patricia Dash

0x30e29f5865e4cce9_0xf9b7feb3e02efc52.text: Dr Nam herself was excellent. She was able to tell me a great deal about my lifestyle and diet simply from reading my pulse, which was genuinely impressive. I had acupuncture and cupping for an hour, and I noticed an immediate improvement in my bloating as well as the tightness in my right shoulder. The treatments themselves are effective, and I would recommend visiting — but I would strongly suggest insisting on being treated directly by Dr Nam. Unfortunately, my experience was let down by her team. While I was lying face down with needles inserted, staff members entered the room and spoke amongst themselves while cleaning the cups that had just been removed from my body. They did not explain what they were doing. It felt unprofessional and disruptive during what should have been a calm, restorative treatment. The treatment room also felt quite cluttered. Most concerning, the staff member responsible for removing my needles (while Dr Nam attended to other patients) left three needles in me — one on my hip, one on my face, and another in my hair. She had checked me over, but when I sat up, the remaining needles were still there. She apologised briefly and left the room. This was disappointing and made me question the level of care and attention from the supporting staff.

0x30e29f5865e4cce9_0xf9b7feb3e02efc52.text: It's been a while since I visited and it keeps nagging me in the back of my head that I should write a review, as Dr. Nam is definitely worthy of a 5 star detailed review! 0x30e29f5865e4cce9_0xf9b7feb3e02efc52.text: Dr. Nam at TCM ChingLian Clinic is the best acupuncturist my friend has ever visited. At just 30 years old, he was living like a disabled person — frequently bed-bound for weeks and unable to walk or even speak for more than five minutes at a time. Before coming to her clinic, he went to another clinic in Bangkok but did not see any significant and sustainable progress for two months. What Dr. Nam has achieved feels nothing short of a miracle. Through her treatment, his condition has improved significantly, and he is now even considering returning to work. This clinic offers real hope for people struggling with chronic conditions that Western medicine does not offer a cure for.

0x30da36c6d44469d7_0xd70ff6b58587819f.text: Hello, I'd like to share my review of WVS. There are many stray dogs in my neighborhood, and because they're mostly free-roaming, the number of stray puppies is constantly increasing. I'm one of the people who feeds and waters them. Recently, one of my dogs was hit by a car. Someone took him to the side of the road, but he kept trying to crawl back to my house where I usually feed him. However, I noticed something was wrong; he wasn't as cheerful as usual and wouldn't come begging for food. I asked the elderly woman who usually hangs him at a restaurant, and learned that he'd been hit by a car and couldn't stand. The driver didn't even stop to check on him. He was in pain, couldn't defecate, and his stomach was very swollen. I took him to the hospital, but they only did X-rays and blood tests, which were quite expensive. The vet said further treatment would start at 60,000 baht, but they couldn't guarantee it. So I consulted with WVS. They read my message and called immediately, recommending that I bring my dog ​​to them for treatment. The treatment took almost a month, and now he's completely recovered. There were no treatment costs at all. I want to express my deepest gratitude for helping these stray dogs regain their happiness.
0x30da36c6d44469d7_0xd70ff6b58587819f.author: Thamonwan Surapaph

0x30da36c6d44469d7_0xd70ff6b58587819f.text: WVS is a wonderful place. It's clean and safe. My mother called the staff to help pick up our dog, who was seriously ill, with a rope around her neck causing a foul odor and almost severing her throat. WVS staff took the dog in for treatment until she recovered completely and returned her to my mother. Her name is Thua Ngok (meaning "sprout"), and she is now very healthy. Another dog, Zebra, had uterine cancer, and WVS staff took her in for treatment. Zebra has also recovered and is under my mother's care. On August 15th, 2023, my mother had the dogs spayed and took them home. All three dogs—Thua Ngok, Zebra, and Bear—are now under my mother's care. We would like to express our deepest gratitude to the WVS staff. May you all have continued happiness and prosperity. 🙏

Update: Old Medicine Hospital – reflections and recommendations for future students I attended several courses at Old Medicine Hospital, drawn by its historical significance and its role in the preservation and dissemination of traditional Thai medicine. The school has a special atmosphere and a warm environment, and it’s clear that students from all over the world come with curiosity and an open mind. That said, I’d like to share a few observations that may be helpful for future students: In one of the courses, we were issued a Tok Sen toolset – a traditional instrument with deep roots in Thai therapeutic practice. I was surprised that the teacher brought in to lead the class neither used nor acknowledged the standard toolset provided by the school – which ultimately holds responsibility for the course content. She openly stated that she was unfamiliar with the tools, which also raises concerns about her familiarity with the school’s curriculum. Instead, she offered to sell her own set for 1,500 baht, even though a similar set could be purchased outside the school for around 450–550 baht. I don’t mind paying a bit more for good equipment, but it becomes problematic when you join a course where the instructor doesn’t know the tools provided and simultaneously promotes her own for sale. It felt like an unfortunate blend of teaching and personal business. It is also noteworthy that Tok Sen is one of the few subjects at the school without any kind of examination or formal assessment, unlike other programs. Given Old Medicine Hospital’s status as a cultural institution and authority within traditional Thai medicine, it seems particularly odd that this valuable heritage practice is treated with such minimal emphasis. Examinations in the other subjects are oral, and students are allowed to use their notes, which is appreciated. However, I experienced some inconsistency in how the use of materials was evaluated. In one course, using the textbook was not an issue; in another, it was considered a negative – even though I approached both in the same way. Teaching is generally structured around students practicing on each other, which can be a great learning method. Instructors are present, but their supervision tends to focus on what the techniques look like, rather than how they feel to the receiver. This means that important sensory aspects of the work can easily be missed. If you’re considering taking multiple courses in Thai bodywork, I strongly recommend spreading them across different schools. Each school offers a unique approach, and some provide the opportunity to practice on teachers or models who are familiar with the techniques – which makes a big difference in understanding what the methods should truly feel like. All in all, Old Medicine Hospital offers a historical setting and can be a valuable starting point – especially if you come with curiosity and a willingness to take responsibility for your own learning. By asking specific questions before enrolling – such as about the use of materials, exam structure, and the level of supervision – you can make the most of your experience.
0x30da3161fba33749_0x301c53b8a12a0bcb.author: Suzanne Olsen

0x30da3161fba33749_0x301c53b8a12a0bcb.text: While there are tons of massage parlors in town, I decided to try a treatment at a long-established school. It was so relaxing that I ended up booking another one the following week. A 90-minute herbal compress for 600 baht. The massage uses large steamed herbal balls to massage my entire body. The treatment is performed by a teacher from the school, so I'm sure they're skilled. After changing into my treatment attire, I lie face down, and the teacher, holding the herbal ball, says a prayer before starting. The heat from the herbal ball gently spreads down my back, feeling so good I can't help but let out the same sigh I get when I enter a hot spring. The herbal ball is applied directly to my skin or over my treatment attire, and as the temperature drops, I change out for a new warm herbal ball as I massage. The relaxing herbal scent, the warm heat, the medicinal properties of the herbs, and the therapist's skilled technique combine to melt away the fatigue of travel. The stomach massage was especially pleasant, as my stomach and intestines, tired from all the food I'd had on my trip, were gently kneaded and soothed. It reminded me of the happy feeling of my mother gently washing my body in a warm bath. I can't get this experience in Japan, so it makes me want to go back to Chiang Mai. There's also a herbal steam sauna next door. Please note: When using the herbal compress, your shorts will be stained with the yellow turmeric, so make sure you wear shorts that you don't mind getting stained. Your body will also turn a little yellow.

0x30e29f3832aca343_0xa63290a7c12d2d00.text: For the record, a single Pico Fraxel combination treatment session cost a minimum total of 33,260 baht, inclusive of medication and two types of post-treatment creams. I found it rather expensive and comparable to prices in Singapore and ChatGPT agrees with me. That said, the service was good. After approximately 40 minutes of numbing cream application, I was able to undergo the treatment within 10–15 minutes, followed by about 20 minutes of light therapy. I would recommend setting aside at least two hours for the entire process and ensuring you have sufficient funds available to avoid any delays. However, the signing of forms and payment could have been managed more efficiently before the face-numbing process began. Instead, these were handled while I was lying on the treatment bed with the numbing cream already applied, which made reading the information, signing the documents, and making payment rather inconvenient. Nevertheless, Dr. Bree was professional and clearly explained what needed to be done. She also pointed out other issues, such as some skin tags I have, but we both agreed it would be better to proceed step by step and assess the results of this treatment before considering any additional procedures. I have yet to see the final results from this first session, which may or may not influence my decision to undergo further treatments. On the positive side, the recovery has been promising so far, with very little downtime as the procedure is non-ablative. I was able to go home immediately after the treatment without needing to cover my face with a mask, as it looked quite natural—similar to a mild sunburn or tan. By the second day, my face felt less tight and red. However, my face felt very hot and had a burning sensation immediately after the procedure, and I think it would be beneficial for the clinic to offer a cooling facial mask treatment afterward rather than relying on patients to use a handheld rechargeable fan. I will continue to update this review with the results of my first treatment in about two weeks’ time to determine whether it is worth continuing with further sessions. Thank you for reading my review.

0x30da3100554edebf_0xe26533a53bdafc8d.text: I recently brought my cat to Thonglor Pet Hospital for her first full veterinary checkup, vaccinations, and parasite prevention, and I am genuinely impressed with the overall experience from start to finish. From the moment I arrived, the hospital environment felt clean, organized, and very professional. The reception staff were polite, calm, and efficient, and the check-in process was smooth even though the hospital was busy. I appreciated how clearly everything was explained, including waiting times and the sequence of procedures. The veterinary team was outstanding. The veterinarian took time to carefully examine my cat and explained each step in a way that was easy to understand, even for a first-time cat owner. I never felt rushed or pressured. Instead, I felt that the team truly cared about my pet’s health and comfort. My cat was nervous at first, but the staff handled her gently and patiently, which made a huge difference. What impressed me the most was how thorough the medical planning was. The vaccination schedule, parasite prevention, and deworming plan were clearly laid out, and I was able to see all upcoming appointments through the online system. Having access to digital medical records and reminders gives me a lot of confidence that I won’t miss important follow-ups in the future. I also appreciated that the staff took time to answer my questions, including general care advice, food recommendations, and long-term health planning. As a new pet owner, this guidance was extremely valuable and reassuring. Overall, Thonglor Pet Hospital provides a very high standard of veterinary care. The combination of experienced veterinarians, modern facilities, clear communication, and a well-organized system makes it a place I trust with my pet’s health. While the hospital is busy, it’s clear that this is because many pet owners rely on their quality of care. I would confidently recommend Thonglor Pet Hospital to anyone looking for professional, reliable, and compassionate veterinary services for their pets.
0x30da3100554edebf_0xe26533a53bdafc8d.author: athen gaming

0x30da3100554edebf_0xe26533a53bdafc8d.text: I use their services regularly for bathing, vaccinations, and boarding. Grooming services - You can tell the staff what you want done. Baths here leave your cat smelling amazing, like baby powder. The scent lasts for 3-4 days! I especially like that they trim nails, brush teeth, and scrub away black stains under the chin and on the testicles. The black stains turn pink afterwards! Vaccination services - You can inform the vet about your preferred vaccination schedule, such as monthly or every three months. Annual vaccinations will be scheduled according to your appointment date. Boarding services - I really like this branch's service. They provide updates on your cat's condition, including photos and videos, twice a day (morning and evening) at a time convenient for the staff. I always use their boarding services when I travel. A deposit and basic health check are required before boarding. A great feature is that the boarding area is clearly divided into zones for dogs and cats. Every day, they take the cats out for walks, letting them jump, climb, and enjoy the natural scenery, and they even pet their necks to keep them comfortable. For boarding services, you must bring your own cat litter and food. Alternatively, you can purchase care packages from the hospital as well. However, it's a shame there are no cameras to view the footage, and the rooms might be a bit small if they are small. Service: The staff provides excellent service and is polite. The doctors are skilled, kind, and attentive. For example, after vaccinations, when we come to pick them up, the doctor will come down to talk to us and update us on their condition in person. Updates are also available via LINE. Having used services at several branches, I like this one the most. The childcare service includes two updates, morning and evening, with lots of photos and videos. It's great for seeing how adorable they are and helps us miss them less.

Not a bad problem to have! After five nights, the kitten we picked up was undoubtedly healthier and happier than the one we dropped off. The price was very reasonable too. A wonderful pet hospital.

0x30da3b7bdd27a2eb_0x3b7ef05e2913f90c.text: Truly life changing. I have suffered from debilitating Chronic Pain for over five years due to an injury from working on Oil Rigs that ended my labor career and basically my life. I had visited many doctors in Chiang Mai during those five years across many different disciplines. Basically I had tried everything with no results. But literally after my first session with Dr. Noon I felt a change. She used the Y-strap technique to adjust my neck and 80% of my pain disappeared over night. I continued treatment for a few months and am down to about 5% of my original pain level now, after 6 months without any further treatment. I have even be able to return to pursuing and achieving my goal of becoming a diving instructor. Thank you again to Dr. Noon and the Nawapohn clinic, you truly changed my life. Also their receptionist, Bank, had met me while he was working at a previous clinic years ago and he remembered me and my problem when I started at Nawapohn. He is also a very friendly and helpful guy. I just went in for a follow up while visiting Chiang Mai this week and they remembered me and were very sweet. The quality of English is also very good at the clinic and the doctor has even been able to get into deeper conversations with me about specific muscles and nerves that affected my issue. I definitely recommend this clinic for you. A full 10 out of 10.

0x30da3b7bdd27a2eb_0x3b7ef05e2913f90c.text: Unfortunately, I underwent a subpectoral bicep tenodesis surgery that completely changed the course of my life. I could no longer bodybuild, and my once dominant right arm - the one that felt superhuman - became atrophied. I lost most function in my tricep and spent years traveling the world in search of someone who could truly help. Dr. Noon has been the most effective of them all. After years of atrophy, my tricep is finally beginning to fire again. The extreme tension in my neck, back, and the dense adhesions in my forearm are being released. For the first time in a long time, I feel harmony returning to my body. I was losing hope - but she’s shown me that a comeback is possible. And I’m starting to live it. Dr. Noon is modest, but without a doubt, she’s a true healer - a unique combination of incredible skill and deep heartfelt compassion. I’ve said it before and I’ll say it again… I appreciate you SO much.

She explained everything very well. And she was very gentle. Alpaca Dental Clinic has two branches: Bang Sue and Kray. ***Parking at the Bang Sue branch: If you're driving or riding a motorcycle, park in the parking lot in Soi Phatthana. The soi is just before the clinic, right next to it. It's Soi Phatthana/ a bubble tea supply shop/ and the clinic. It's a single-lane soi. When turning into the soi, drive slowly and be careful of oncoming traffic. In front of the clinic is a motorcycle taxi stand + a bus stop. **(Important) Do not park in front of the clinic as it will encroach on the motorcycle taxi area. There's an elderly gentleman watching the parking lot. Tell him you're here for dental treatment, and you'll get free parking. For those going to the Khaerai branch: Park your car at Lotus Khaerai. I'd like to say that I was personally impressed with the care at Alpaca Clinic. The staff provided excellent after-service. They called to inquire about my condition after the dental treatment. And they also called to remind me of my appointment the day before. You can also inquire about the treatment costs; the staff were happy to answer all questions.

0x30e29fe59b4186cf_0xf8dcf7b7924458e9.text: 🌸 My Heartfelt Review for Dr. Pak & Netty 🌸 I don’t even know where to begin, because words will never be enough to describe the love, care, and support I received from Dr. Pak and his wonderful assistant Netty ♥️. From the very first day, Netty welcomed me with such warmth that I instantly felt like part of their family. She guided me through everything from how to prepare for surgery, what to eat, and every little detail to make sure I felt calm and ready. Her kindness and patience touched my heart deeply. When it was time for surgery, I was nervous because mine was a very complicated case. For seven years I had been living in a nightmare my nose was crooked and swaying to the side, and it stole so much of my confidence. I was even scared to take pictures, and I never felt truly at peace with myself. I thought no one could fix it. But after meeting Dr. Pak, I felt a special energy, trust, and comfort. That’s when I knew I was in the right hands. During the surgery, even though I was by myself, I never once felt alone. Both Dr. Pak and Netty cared for me with so much love, just like family members. They were always by my side, making sure I was comfortable and safe. The atmosphere was full of kindness, and that gave me peace in my heart. The result was beyond my imagination. Dr. Pak truly worked magic he corrected what I thought was impossible. And the best part? I felt almost no pain at all. The recovery was so smooth, and instead of fear, I felt peace of mind. For the first time in years, I looked in the mirror and felt happy. He didn’t just fix my nose; he gave me back my confidence, my smile, and my life. Now, I will never be scared of photos again, and I feel free from the nightmare I carried for seven years. This journey has been so special not only because of the surgery itself, but because I met two people who treated me with so much care, respect, and love. Dr. Pak and Netty ♥️ are people I will remember, respect, and cherish for the rest of my life. Every time I come back to Bangkok, I will surely visit them not just as my doctor and nurse, but as family in my heart. Thank you, Dr. Pak and Netty ♥️, for everything you have done for me. You made me feel safe, loved, and confident again. This experience will stay in my heart forever. Love you guys lots 🌷✨

I parked my motorbike in the space next to the clinic, but when I returned after treatment, I found my bike locked. A man and a woman, who appeared to be the landowners, told me it was private property and demanded 1,000 THB to unlock it. There were no visible signs indicating it was prohibited to park, and when I questioned them about it, they responded with insulting remarks. Eventually, after I explained the situation to the clinic, they intervened and resolved the matter by paying 200 THB on my behalf. Later, when I checked with Thai staff, I was told that the red sign actually says, “This is the clinic’s parking area.” This raises serious concerns: it could be a scheme to extort money from foreigners, or possibly even some kind of collusion with the clinic. While the medical staff’s service was excellent, the lack of proper parking management and clear signage is a major issue. I strongly urge immediate improvements.

0x311d7dd43c81c09d_0xd06ee88e8b142744.text: This was my first time getting diode laser hair removal and fat injections. The place was clean, and the staff were friendly. They offered a welcome drink of collagen water. Before the procedure, I filled out a form, signed a consent form, and a statement confirming the services and results of the procedure, including any concerns arising from the clinic's procedures. The staff provided excellent service, calling everyone to me, making me feel embarrassed. Before the procedure, the staff recommended and sold me additional courses. This is typical of clinics today where salespeople try to sell additional courses. They don't hard-sell, but they consistently and consistently sell. With their strong salesmanship, if a customer refuses or asks to think about it, the salesperson isn't annoying or bothersome. The laser hair removal wasn't painful, just a slight tingling sensation. The staff applied cooling gel to my skin and constantly checked to make sure I was okay, whether it was burning or feeling okay. They were thorough and didn't rush me. Regarding the fat injections, Natty, the salesperson, gave excellent recommendations. She offered me a recommendation and helped me achieve the results I wanted. During the fat injections, the doctor prescribed medication. I opened the bottle and drew the medication in front of me. It was pure fat, nothing else. Since it was my first injection, everyone was there to support me. When the medication was injected into my face, it was painful, but I was relentless. The doctor encouraged me, constantly asking if I was okay. The staff were also there to take care of me, even applying cold compresses. The service was excellent, and I was very impressed. They chatted with each other, the doctor, the patient, and the staff, making the injections a relaxed atmosphere. There wasn't much pressure during the injections. The downside is the limited parking space. There might be a bit too little seating upstairs. If you come on a Saturday or Sunday, the parking lot in front is full, so you might have to park on the street instead. They're good at selling, but if you don't buy anything, it's not a problem. Overall, I was impressed.

0x311d7dd43c81c09d_0xd06ee88e8b142744.text: This was my first time using their service. I bought a package deal from Facebook. The staff were attentive, but the wait time was much longer than other clinics. I had a 2 PM appointment, and it took about half an hour to register before a sales representative called me in. 0x30e299c4591a25b1_0x8f38db0968a38246.text: I recently completed a hair transplant with Dr. Top and his team, and they did an amazing job! I had suffered with a high forehead for decades, and The Skin Clinic restored my confidence. They understood my hair texture as an African American and truly listened to my needs. Several doctors had reached out to me, but I am so happy that I chose The Skin Clinic in Bangkok. It was absolutely the best decision. The care and attention started immediately. When I was inquiring and booking through WhatsApp, the agent was very responsive and helpful. She even responded late in the evening at times to answer my questions. When I arrived at the clinic, the entire staff was warm and welcoming, and the facility itself was beautiful, modern, and very clean. Prior to my surgery, Dr. Top met with me personally and answered all of my questions. He spoke English, which made communication very easy for me. After completing all of the required tests (blood work, HIV test, EKG, etc.), we were ready for surgery. The nurse carefully washed and dried my hair with such tenderness and care. During the surgery, everything went better than I expected. The extractions and implantations were uncomfortable at times, but they were not nearly as painful as I had heard online. There was a very kind nurse who held my hand throughout the procedure. At the time, I didn’t know who she was because my eyes were covered, but her kindness made me feel very safe and supported. I know this review is a little long, but I want people to understand how wonderful Dr. Top and his staff truly are. They care for you from the very beginning all the way through the recovery process. After the surgery, I returned to the clinic three times for hair washing and treatments. The lady who washed my hair was incredibly gentle and kind, always making sure that she did not hurt me. When I finished my final visit, I went to thank her. At that moment, she showed me a photo of herself holding my hand during the surgery. It was the same nurse who comforted me during the procedure—Ms. Yui. I immediately gave her the biggest hug. Thank you, Dr. Top and your amazing staff! There were so many wonderful people who helped me that I cannot remember everyone’s name. I do remember one lady wearing tan (light brown) scrubs who helped me throughout the entire process. I’m so sorry that I don’t know your name, but I want to thank you as well. I truly appreciated your kindness. If you are considering a hair transplant in Bangkok, I highly recommend Dr. Top and The Skin Clinic. The care, professionalism, and kindness of the entire team made this a wonderful experience for me.
0x30e299c4591a25b1_0x8f38db0968a38246.author: heart0422

0x30e299c4591a25b1_0x8f38db0968a38246.text: Dr. Top and his amazing team fixed my botched transplant from Turkey and restored both my looks and my confidence 🥰 After a failed transplant in Istanbul (with a too-low, pluggy, unnatural hairline, mainly multi-grafts even in my eyebrows, and poor density), I came to Dr. Top with a complex case. Despite his full schedule, Dr. Top video-called me several times and we discussed everything in detail. He took me seriously, consulted with his colleagues beforehand, and they created a personalized treatment plan tailored to my needs. I had a full redesign of my hairline and eyebrows — all done as a long-hair transplant without shaving a single hair. Only Dr. Top and his doctors worked directly on me. Their work was incredibly precise, clean, and gentle — every graft was carefully selected and placed. Thick grafts were moved further back, single ones placed at the front, and my brows were beautifully restored. There was absolutely no pain during or after the procedure. Even better: no scary bloody appearance, no thick crusts, and no cobblestoning like I had experienced in Turkey. Back then, the transplant was obvious even months later. This time, barely anything was visible right after the procedure — and all traces disappeared within days. I didn’t have to hide under basecaps as I did after my previous experience. I felt completely taken care of. The daily saline washes in the morning and evening gave me so much peace of mind. The transplant looked clean from day one, and my family — who had seen my last recovery, couldn’t believe the difference. I encourage anyone to come here. The clinic is trusted by locals and foreigners alike. Everyone I saw and spoke to seemed genuinely satisfied. Dr. Top really understood how sensitive I was after what I’d been through, yet he and his team took me in and corrected everything with kindness and professionalism. They didn’t let me down like the other clinic did. Everyone — from the doctors to the nurses and assistants — worked incredibly hard and with such care. I'm deeply grateful to the whole team. They exceeded every expectation, and I can confidently say they would never let a patient leave with anything less than excellent results. I genuinely recommend this clinic from the bottom of my heart. I only wish I had come here first. Thank you, all the way from Europe💛

0x30e29904489391a5_0x50a933ae0ed61b51.text: I unexpectedly discovered a new interest during my travels, and this time I specifically visited Watpo & Chetawan Massage School in Bangkok to learn oil massage. Over five days, under the careful guidance of three instructors, I went from being clumsy at the beginning to being able to independently and smoothly complete a full 1.5-hour massage. Each massage session felt like entering a flow state, focusing on the present moment, forgetting all irrelevant external worries, and enjoying a wonderful time. The students were all very friendly, encouraging each other, taking turns being both client and masseuse, and enjoying two free full-body oil massages every day. My full-time job isn't as a masseuse, and I might quickly forget all the techniques after returning to Hong Kong, but those wonderful memories will remain forever.

0x30e29904489391a5_0x50a933ae0ed61b51.text: What an amazing rest stop for the weary traveler. After a long day of touring Grand Palace and Wat Pho, we needed a place to kill time before dinner. On a whim we googled foot massage and this place was close. We walked in, fully anticipating to be turned away, unsure of if this was a school or what. But we were met with 8-10 very friendly masseuses in the lobby who were ready and waiting for walk-ins. We pointed to “30 minute foot massage” on a menu of options, and 680 baht and 30 seconds later, my husband and I were on cots in the massage room. We experienced intense but very relaxing massages. They gave us mulberry tea at the end of it. Many monks in the sitting room there, so you know the massages are good!
0x30e29904489391a5_0x50a933ae0ed61b51.author: Lisa Haggerty

0x30e29904489391a5_0x50a933ae0ed61b51.text: I had seven massages in five days in Phuket, and I've been coming to Thailand since 1999. I've had them in Pattaya, Chiang Mai, Koh Samui, and Hua Hin. Now I understand what they call traditional and authentic Thai massage. I paid 1,080 baht for two hours, and I'll probably remember it for a long time. Things I realized: 1. Starting with a prone position isn't traditional Thai massage. 2. Massage varies from person to person. 3. A good masseuse always uses open strokes. 4. If they use a lot of elbows, you shouldn't expect much. I'm coming here next July to take the full course. PS) If you just want a massage, you don't need to go to Wat Pho.
0x30e29904489391a5_0x50a933ae0ed61b51.author: james moon

0x3054f36d2d61595b_0xe3361175a37ab0f3.text: This is my 2nd time visiting this place for a good detox. Never failed me, always good result. The last time I came with 2 friends. This round, we have a total of 7 of us! I didn’t advertise at all but due to the excellent result I had, and sharing great outcomes on my first visit, my friends interested to go with me for a detox. A lot of people afraid of this program due to no actual food is being provided. But so far none of us complaining of being hungry. I believe when one in the right environment, everything is possible 👍🤩 Everyone of us have different results, different outcomes. But the most amazing part is how the teacher be able to diagnose our issues by looking just at our buckets. You have to be here at least once to understand what I meant, those that have make it here, most will make another trip to come back for sure because we know how great this detox would be and how much this detox can help us to understand our bodies 😀🙏😱 A lot of my friends initially think the price for detox is expensive, however, after the 8 days, they all decided to bring their families and friends on the next trip!! Tanya Samui is a place not for regular detox, it’s a place for “HEALING”. Why I said it’s healing? Because you will meet a lot of people with varieties of diseases and sickness across the world❗️yes world❗️there are people with cancer, people with liver issue, diabetes, cholesterol, blood pressure issues, even a stiff arm. I’ve seen one where the teacher told him he has prostate cancer, he was so surprised that he didn’t even tell anyone including his wife that came with him. Despite it’s not something happy to know, but at least he was informed by teacher it’s curable. Not all cases are so lucky though. I’ve met one that came from Vietnam with his 2 daughters looking for help; however, teacher told them she can’t do anything as it’s too late. Therefore, I learned from every diagnosis that prevent is better than cure, go for it before it’s too late. Let me share with you an uncle I met 4 years ago. He is from Penang and he was diagnosed with a 4th stage of cancer. He visited a lot of doctors in Malaysia and Singapore and no one can help. At most he can live 4-6 months. He didn’t give up and he came to Tanya Samui after a friend told him about this. It might be his last resources, but he did came and that was how I met him 4 years ago. He is now still healthy, looking great and be able to still drive and eat as he wishes. 4 years of good life, eventhough he still have cancer cells within him, but this place give you a 4 years bonus and I think he will have many more years to be around 🤩👍🙏❗️amazing right? If you don’t believe, give yourself 8 days of detox and let’s see who and what you see. Thank you teacher for providing this amazing place for us. FYI, there are lots of upgrades and renovation that have been done these past 4 years. Comparing to where I had been, this place has turn to be a 5 star 🌟 resort. There are aerobics every afternoon and evening. A full equipped gym facilities, huge swimming pool with sun decks, bicycles, lotus garden, walking tracks, cafeteria - entitled for graduate students 😄. If you also want to pamper yourself during this time, there are massage center, 1 hour starting from Tbh400, hair salon, pedicure & manicure services as well. Nearby the resort, just a short walking distant right outside the entrance, you can find a convenient shop, 3 massage and spa parlors, all price starting from TBh300/hour. If you want to pamper yourself and have a short healthy breakaway, do consider this place. You won’t regret for sure 👍 Thank you for all the people that work there, without them, it won’t make this detox resort the best place on earth. Now I know this could be my 2nd home if I want to detox myself from digital and gain a healthier body.
0x3054f36d2d61595b_0xe3361175a37ab0f3.author: Daphane Thong

0x3054f36d2d61595b_0xe3361175a37ab0f3.text: Wonderful place to do oil fasting detox. Although guest relations and program management could improve. There are 6, 8, 11 days detox program, if necessary you can stay even longer, for weeks as well. Once at registration you have been given an orientation about schedule, some pills and a 1.5 litre of water bottle, there is no more guidance afterwards. No one checks on you either. You just do your own thing and collect drinks at designated time. There is a clinic on site that is separate from the program, although being within the retreat centre the doctor knows of the program, one can see the doctor if you feel sick or have medical concern. Consultation is covered by the program but not medication or additional services. Ultimately they are separate business. This is common throughout the centre, the cafe is separate from centre reception, the retail shop is also separate as you have to pay for respective services individually and payment fees and methods are different too. Sometimes there are volunteers who will come to centre who speaks multiple Asian languages and English. They are knowledgeable and are great help. The Thai staff level of English comprehension varies, usually receptionist has the best English. Program activities start as early as 5am and finishes at 530pm. House keeping everyday, but it is pretty bare inside the room. Kettle, 2 glasses, hairdryer, a safety box, a fridge, a fan and a TV (only thai channels working, no streaming app). Of course there are beds and air con. No iron or iron board, no slippers, There are towels but no face towel, no other toiletries. You can book to come anyday of the year (as long as there are rooms). It is common for participants to feel sick or dizziness and often sodium tablets is prescribed at the clinic, Alternatively one can add salt (this is not supplied by centre so either go buy it yourself or bring some along). The teacher inspects your poo (which you will poo in a bucket and carried to inspection area towards the last few days of your program, it varies depending on how many days). It is best to bring mask with you as it can get smelly. The center offers airport transport for a fee, book in advance. One can share the ride with someone to reduce the cost. Usually the teacher will recommend maintenance program end of your retreat, therefore best to bring suitcase with space as well as luggage allowance. Average 5-10kg of additional goods purchase for thr maintenance program. Within walking distance from centre there are two convenient store that sells from food to toiletries. It is also possible to walk to nearby beach to see sunrise (as it faces East). There are various massage and treatment just like any resort centre, mostly for detox purposes. Tokens treatment is a Northern Thailand hammering treatment, the therapist on duty the day I received it was in a bad mood that rough handled me, argued with me about the room temperature when I politely requested to lower the aircon speed, and listened and watched YouTube video throughout the session, with his phone next to my head. He moved the phone when I turned to signal him about the noise disturbing me. One would expect this kind of behavior at many massage places outside, cheaper places unfortunately but I didnt expect it inside a resort. Overall it was good, I suggest check out different massage options in the area as well, and ask other long term frequent visiting guests for guidance, they might give better or faster advise than the Thai staff.
0x3054f36d2d61595b_0xe3361175a37ab0f3.author: T.T M

0x3054f36d2d61595b_0xe3361175a37ab0f3.text: We were on a program of internal body cleansing (or we often refer it to detox) at Tanya Samui. Located on the Ko Samui, Thailand, Tanya Samui proclaims itself as a holistic health retreat center. Many foreigners who had come and gain health advantage from the program would happily share their experience by word-of-mouth and their own social media. Therefore, more and people were interested to also have the advantage, including my wife and me. For the accomodation, we chose the new building which rooms are spacious for 2 person occupancy and are equipped with smart TV, balcony and private bathroom. The rooms were cleaned every day. Initiated and directly managed by Mrs. Tunyarat Petchprom (or also known as “Teacher” Khun Kob), the program requires us to not consume any solid food troughout our retreat, while we are free to do any other positive activity e.g.: meditating, doing yoga, socializing with other guests at the common area, exercising in the inhouse gym, swimming, hiking, going to beach, or even exploring the island. The only restriction is not to consume any other food or beverages other than provided by the program schedule. For our consumption, there is a designated schedule to drink different types of liquids depending the time of day. The liquids includes herbal tea, herbal solutions, clear soup, enzyme, fruit juice, and the star is techers’s proprietary “Tanya Oil”. Should the fasting been done alone in our normal setting, I think it would be really hard to do as the body craving more and more for food. But in this retreat, we are encircled with the supportive environment, i.e: tranquil and beatiful gardens set with Buddhist theme helps us to relax and enjoy the present moment, socializing with other guests from different nations doing the same program made us feel strengthen, and the time that we had meeting with teacher Khun Kob made us inspired. In those meetings, she shares stories about her success journey developing the program in response for her health issue years ago, her gift of interpreting health issues in others, and her virtuous purpose in the world. For the two of us, it had been a memorable journey; the restrictions of food and the oil consumption was very challenging, but after all, we together learned a very important lesson about taking care of our own body by adopting a better mindset. We understand that graduating from 8 days program from Tanya Samui was not the end of the challenge, but rather, a new guerila to maintain the better attitude towards life. We sincerely pray that the Teacher and her staffs to be always resourceful in spreading the love, knowledge and spirit broader to the world. Kha pun khap.
0x3054f36d2d61595b_0xe3361175a37ab0f3.author: Marcel Wijaya

0x30e2999e0cd1cf99_0x8ffdd6b096ccdfc6.text: I can’t say enough positive things about this clinic. I had a hair transplant back in 2019 in Hong Kong and the results were underwhelming to say the least with a 30% survival rate. My rationale at the time was that medical quality was better in HK than Thailand. How wrong I was. I undertook a far bigger transplant with 3M and the results are astounding. My hair is back to the way it was 20 years ago. I was told the target survival ratio was 90% and I personally felt it was even higher than that for me. The after care was incredible and likely a key factor in the high survival rate as was the PRP injections they recommended. The core differentiation versus my experience in Hong Kong was 1) the sheer volume of staff; hair transplants are labour and time sensitive meaning more staff equals better results (and was why they were able to do 5000 grafts which most clinics will refuse to do), 2) the extreme level and quality of aftercare. I think this may be because 3M is listed on the Bangkok Exchange and hence very risk adverse to a single patient ending up with a head full of infected follicles and 3) the ancillary optional services such as medication issuance and stem cell injections. All in all I am incredibly grateful for the amazing job they did. They completely restored my hair. If I had one extremely minor criticism it would be that they use someone with actual training to cut your hair short when you first come in (or recommend patients to go to a proper barber beforehand). The haircut I was given (and had to live with for a month) looked pretty awful to say the least.

0x30e2999e0cd1cf99_0x8ffdd6b096ccdfc6.text: I’m so incredibly happy I came here… Choosing Masterpiece Hospital in Bangkok was absolutely the right decision. I even got to meet the owner of the hospital—she’s stunning and beautiful woman! All the nurses and staffs are incredibly kind and very professional — they walked me through the steps with care and details. Not a single one was rude, and no one tried to sell me anything unnecessary. They were just genuinely kind and caring. Truly amazing service! At first, I only planned to get an eyebrow transplant, but after seeing other people’s hair transplant results, I was inspired to do mine too—and I ended up doing it! The results are beautiful, and there was absolutely no pain at all. Truly amazing—zero pain. So impressive! Post surgery, they ensure I get all the care I need by providing a communication group and they answer promptly for any questions I may have. At first I was hesitant about the language barrier, but turns out they have a dedicated translator for all languages. On top of the translator, the medical staffs actually speak fluent English. If you’re thinking of improving your appearance, dealing with hair loss, or just want to boost your confidence, you have to come here and rest assured they will deliver with satisfying results.

0x3050259b6a3e0d45_0x29233e29cdb1912a.text: Before going to this doctor, I looked at some reviews and information beforehand and then deliberately chose this practice. The first impression on site confirmed this: everything seemed very neat, clean (really top-notch by Thai standards), well-organized, and professional. Important to know: Just seeing the doctor costs 1,500 baht – without any treatment. We were there with our young son, who had been suffering from severe diarrhea for four days and hadn't been feeling well for about ten days in total. They approached the situation very thoroughly. A treatment plan came relatively quickly, including blood tests, virus and bacteria tests, IV fluids, and medication (including antibiotics). In the end, the estimate came to around 18,000 baht, which is quite a shock at first. We then consciously decided against the virus test, since you can't treat a virus specifically anyway, and opted for the blood test and IV fluids. The treatment itself was very professional, the staff extremely friendly and caring – especially in their interactions with our child. He received an IV and electrolytes; everything was explained calmly and carried out meticulously. What I really want to emphasize is that the practice completes all the necessary paperwork correctly and thoroughly for international health insurance. This significantly increases the chances of successfully submitting the costs for reimbursement in Germany later. This provides at least some peace of mind given the high prices. Yes, it's expensive – no question about it. There are considerably cheaper doctors in Thailand. But you can definitely see the difference in the facilities, cleanliness, and organization. Here, you get Western standards, expertise, and a sense of security, especially when it comes to children. In short: Not cheap, but in my opinion, absolutely recommendable. If you value clean, structured, and competent treatment and want to feel well cared for, this is the place for you.
0x3050259b6a3e0d45_0x29233e29cdb1912a.author: Serti Demi

0x3050259b6a3e0d45_0x29233e29cdb1912a.text: Absolutely top-quality medical service. On January 1st at noon! Less than an hour after the call, a team of doctors and nurses knocked on the door of the hotel room where I was staying with my 13-year-old daughter, who was suffering from fever and diarrhea. After examining her, the doctor suggested both immediate antibiotic treatment, in case of a bacterial infection, and a blood test to determine the type of infection. He assured her that the results would be available within an hour and would be communicated via email. In the case of a viral infection, antibiotics would have been unnecessary. Having opted for the blood test, she was simultaneously given an infusion of substances to treat her symptoms (diarrhea and spasms). The doctor, using a simultaneous translation app, explained everything to me in detail and left me the medications for treatment. An hour later, I received the blood test results, which indicated the need for antibiotic treatment. As an Italian who has lived in France for twenty years, I was amazed at the efficiency of the timely blood test results. Something I doubt can be found in the two countries I know well. The service comes at a cost, justified by the level of service provided.
0x3050259b6a3e0d45_0x29233e29cdb1912a.author: Leo Agosti

0x3050259b6a3e0d45_0x29233e29cdb1912a.text: We cannot thank the team at this clinic enough for the incredible care and support they provided to our 2-year-old son while we were staying at Club Med Phuket. When our son became seriously unwell with gastro, the medical team attended our room promptly, carried out a thorough assessment, provided clear medical guidance, administered an IV drip and supplied the necessary supporting medication — all with incredible professionalism, compassion and care. What stood out most was the genuine kindness of the team. They took the time to explain everything clearly, reassured us throughout a stressful situation, and have continued to follow up via WhatsApp to check on his recovery. They also provided all documentation and correspondence required for our travel insurance, making the entire process seamless. Beautiful people doing wonderful things. It has been said that "there is no universally accepted definition for the terms 'strain', 'variant', and 'isolate' in the virology community, and most virologists simply copy the usage of terms from others". A strain is a genetic variant or subtype of a microorganism (e.g., a virus, bacterium or fungus). For example, a "flu strain" is a certain biological form of the influenza or "flu" virus. These flu strains are characterized by their differing isoforms of surface proteins. New viral strains can be created due to mutation or swapping of genetic components when two or more viruses infect the same cell in nature.[3] These phenomena are known respectively as antigenic drift and antigenic shift. Microbial strains can also be differentiated by their genetic makeup using metagenomic methods to maximize resolution within species.[4] This has become a valuable tool to analyze the microbiome. Artificial constructs Scientists have modified strains of viruses in order to study their behavior, as in the case of the H5N1 influenza virus. 0x3054f1ab6d82cc2d_0x2b0297d7ccbc0b49.text: I've got stomach flu on my 4th day of my trip. Worrying I might be too weak to travel back home on the 5th day, I decided to engage Doctor Samui through whatsapp. They responded quickly and asked about my symptoms and the hotel I am staying. They were at my doorstep in less than an hour. 1 doctor and 2 other staff came. They spoke good English. They gave me IV drip, took my blood, administer antibiotics and other medications on the spot. The 2 staff stayed until my IV drip finished and gave me clear instructions on the oral medications for the next few days. I felt assured that someone came and took care of me and gave me proper medication (Before engaging them, I did buy some off the shelf medication but didn't work). They whatsapp me the doctor's memo and receipt (in English) and couple of hours later, they sent me the blood test results. This whole service is really expensive but luckily I bought travel insurance. All in all, I think their service is really good and gave me reassurance. Highly recommend anyone out there who need a doctor to see you urgently. To Doctor Samui team: Thank you for coming to Holiday Inn Bophut to "rescue" me on 23 Dec 2024. I was too sick to remember your names otherwise I will list them all here.

0x3054f1ab6d82cc2d_0x2b0297d7ccbc0b49.text: I came here with a really bad ear infection right after arriving in Koh Samui and received excellent care. They performed an ear flush, cleaned everything carefully then injected steroids and showed me each step along the way. After just one day I already feel much better and I’m continuing the treatment feeling very reassured. I even shared the doctor’s report with my own doctor back home, a renowned and very critical specialist, and she confirmed that everything was done correctly, that “I was in good hands” which gave me even more peace of mind. Lastly, the medical report they provided is very detailed and will be excellent for my insurance claim. Overall, I’m extremely happy with the experience and highly recommend this clinic.

0x310293f9b14ca899_0xcb0b55964decaff5.text: Animal Army Hospital โรงพยาบาลสัตว์ แอนิมัล อาร์มี่ in Pattaya is a truly remarkable organization that deserves all the recognition it can get. What makes this place so special is that it operates as a non-profit, dedicating its resources and efforts to helping animals in the community rather than focusing on profit margins. In a world where veterinary care can be expensive and inaccessible for many, having an organization like Animal Army stepping up and filling that gap is incredibly valuable and admirable. The team behind this operation is genuinely wonderful. Every person I interacted with was friendly, passionate, and clearly driven by a real love for animals. You could tell immediately that the people working here are not just doing a job but following a calling. That kind of dedication and heart is visible in everything they do and it creates an atmosphere of genuine care and compassion that both animals and their owners can feel. The work they do for the animal community in Pattaya cannot be overstated. Organizations like this are the backbone of animal welfare in areas where stray and neglected animals would otherwise have nowhere to turn. The fact that they provide professional veterinary care while operating on a non-profit basis shows an incredible commitment to their mission and the community they serve. Supporting places like Animal Army Hospital is supporting something that truly matters. Every visit, every donation, and every bit of awareness helps them continue the important work they do for animals that need it most. Five stars for an organization that combines professional veterinary care with genuine compassion and a non-profit mission that makes a real difference in Pattaya. If you are looking for a way to support animal welfare in the area, Animal Army Hospital is worthy of every bit of support it receives.

0x310293f9b14ca899_0xcb0b55964decaff5.text: I can highly recommend Animal Army in Pattaya. They are not only a dog rescue and animal welfare organization, but also operate a fully licensed veterinary clinic in Pattaya (Najomtien) that treats both rescue animals and privately owned pets. The veterinary team is incredibly friendly, professional, and experienced. The prices are very affordable compared to many other vets in Pattaya, while the quality of care is outstanding. Whether you need routine treatment, emergency care, surgery, or help with an injured animal, they genuinely care about every case. What makes Animal Army special is that they actively rescue injured and abandoned street dogs and provide life-saving medical treatment. If you find a sick or injured stray dog in Pattaya, they are one of the first places you should contact. They also help with adoptions, including international adoptions for people who want to give Thai rescue dogs a forever home abroad. I also find some of the negative reviews a little unfair. Animal Army is a charity organization that relies heavily on donations, volunteers, and a limited number of staff. Expecting a rescue organization to have unlimited resources, be available 24/7, or instantly respond to every situation is simply unrealistic. They are doing an incredible amount of work with the resources they have. So please be nice! TL;DR An amazing organization, a fantastic veterinary clinic, and a team that truly makes a difference for animals, pets, and street dogs in Thailand.

0x3054f0537078d511_0x3848612e18539770.text: After suffering a severe comminuted fracture of my elbow, I can wholeheartedly recommend Thal International Hospital on Koh Samui. My elbow was so badly injured that it required complex surgery to reconstruct it with plates and screws. The entire medical team, and especially the surgeons, performed an extraordinary feat. The reconstruction of such a badly damaged elbow could hardly have been done better. Their expertise, precision, and professionalism were impressive. I would also like to highlight the excellent initial care I received at the Thal International Hospital on Koh Tao. From the initial treatment to the perfectly organized transfer to Koh Samui, everything was quick, professional, and seamless. Special thanks also go to all the nurses, caregivers, and staff. The entire team was always friendly, attentive, helpful, and highly dedicated. As a patient, you feel completely at ease from the very first moment and receive outstanding medical and personal care. The food was also excellent. It was varied, delicious, and of a quality you would expect from a fine restaurant. You really can't ask for more from a hospital. Many thanks to the entire team for the outstanding treatment and excellent care. Thanks to you, I have the best possible chance of regaining full use of my arm. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Absolutely top-notch service and highly recommended!
0x3054f0537078d511_0x3848612e18539770.author: Pitt Pitt

0x3054f0537078d511_0x3848612e18539770.text: I mean, it's a hospital. What is there to say? Went there with high fever and gastro intestinal issues at about 5.30 pm. Personal medical anamnesis was done within 10 minutes of arrival. Full diagnosis later that evening. Due to my symptoms a COVID test had to be done as well. The results for this took the longest time of all procedures done. Nurses and doctors were very friendly and proficient in English. Staff was also helpful in processing everything with and for the travel health insurance. Did not have to pay a single baht when leaving as the hospital dealt with the insurance for the most part. Got a room for myself with an extra bed for my girlfriend. TV, fridge, microwave and water kettle in the room. Small snacks and water are included. Had to stay 3 nights. Nurses available round the clock. Checking on you every few hours. Doctor's visit twice per day. Meals were ok but you can order outside food. All in all: a better experience than I ever had in Germany.

0x3054f0537078d511_0x3848612e18539770.text: I feel from a scoter at low speed. Don’t apply sun screen before driving one. Or at least clean it off your palms so they aren’t greasy. EMT cleaned my foot and got me to hospital. Doctor examined me, every one was very professional and everything was clean. They told me the cost upfront, around 8000 B which is close to 250 €. I got my wounds cleaned and Tetanus shot. I got travel insurance and no worries, even if I didn’t get insurance, it wasn’t end of the world as I got savings. But it was still cheaper as I paid 20€ for insurance. Travel insurance is really cheap this days so don’t be cheap towards yourself and buy insurance when you travel. You spend more money in 7-eleven.

0x30da3b24686c98e9_0x3a87277961d543cf.text: TL;DR: very, very highly recommended. The service and the prices are so good I will come back here from Europe for any major procedures. Long version: I am a regular customer. Came here the first time because I live next door, keep coming back for everything tooth-related because they have amazing, professional doctors for very reasonable prices. Calm, professional, explain what they plan to do and why, never push you to some expensive procedure if there is a cheaper and less invasive way to solve the problem. There is a good reason this place has practically only five-star reviews, and it is mainly their doctors. Example: I just came back from getting 5 necessary fillings there. As a completely extra side-effect, every tooth the Doctor had to touch now looks like new. Literally better than any other tooth in my mouth that hasn't been treated here. Because the doc happens to be a restoration specialist, and it feels like he just can't help it but to make it look good. Painless procedure, despite us agreeing on no anasthetics for today. With complicated problems, the doctor thinks about them and tells you later (sometimes next visit two weeks later!) "oh, I thought about this tooth and, what I said earlier might not be necessary, I can do it this-and-that way". Or, sometimes, "I think we should leave it alone, because nothing I can do with this tooth will make it structurally better, and you have no problems right now." I think that is simply an amazing service, for many reasons. Unfortunately, I have to move back to Europe soon, but given the difference in price, service, and outcome, for anything complicated I will probably literally come back here, despite the travel costs and duration. I might not save much due to the flight, hotel, etc, but at least I know that I will get a better job done here than practically anywhere else I have ever been before (and my sample size is, unfortunately, quite staggering due to how bad my teeth are, and how often I change cities and countries).
0x30da3b24686c98e9_0x3a87277961d543cf.author: Yaroslav Tal
