0x3054f16d347b0e53_0x7082244f321eca49.text: I had an accident that caused a laceration on my right eyebrow with significant bleeding and pain, and I went to Samui Home Clinic, Chaweng, one of the most well-known clinics on the island. From the moment I arrived, the reception staff, nurse aides, and nursing team immediately rushed to assist me with genuine kindness, empathy, and professionalism, which made me feel safe and well cared for. Dr. Aratchaporn Kunasol (Dr. Pleng) attended to me promptly and compassionately 🙏🏻🥰. She administered local anesthesia very gently and painlessly before suturing. During the procedure, her technique was exceptionally delicate and highly professional, and she closed the wound beautifully. The entire team—including the nurses (Registered Nurse Bam), nurse aide Pin, and the reception staff (Khun Lady Ford)—was consistently kind, professional, attentive, and empathetic. Their warmth and sincerity truly stood out. They provide excellent care for patients from all over the world, with outstanding attention to detail throughout pre-treatment, treatment, and post-treatment. I am extremely appreciative of Dr. Pleng and her team. The clinic genuinely prioritizes patient care with remarkable kindness and empathy. The staff communicate in excellent English, the clinic is very clean, and they provide thorough and clear advice on wound care and follow-up until suture removal. Despite the high standard of specialist care, the pricing is very reasonable compared with other medical centers. I highly recommend this clinic not only for emergency care, but also for general medical care, family medicine, preventive care, and dermatologic conditions. 🙏🏻❤️

0x3054f16d347b0e53_0x7082244f321eca49.text: Excellent efficient clinic in Chaweng. My daughter was very poorly with an infection & fever. We checked the clinic website which you can book online an appointment but we didn’t want to wait so we called and were able to come immediately. My daughter was seen in just a few minutes, had blood test, urine test, IV & antibiotics all very promptly. The doctor communicated what was wrong and we decided that our daughter would come daily for observation & tests & treatment.. We felt she was in very professional hands and we recommend the Clinic as it’s very clean & efficient. The price for initial consultation, tests and medicine & nearly 4 hours in a bed it was less than £100. The follow up consultation & IV/ antibiotic treatment was approx £12.50 per day in this day and age of poor medical facilities this clinic provided exceptional care for an exceptional price.

0x3054f16d347b0e53_0x7082244f321eca49.text: The staff here are worth their weight in gold. I have never been more grateful to the staff who sent a car to my hotel because I was unable to walk to the clinic, took care of me and arranged for me to get back to the hotel that night. They also worked 3 hours over their shift to make sure I was okay to leave. Their prices are incredibly reasonable and their ability to communicate in English was also really helpful and reassuring. I wouldn’t hesitate on recommending them for medical treatment, and would also recommend going sooner than you think you need, because I felt better almost instantly. They also arranged further tests and treatment on the days after to ensure I was fighting fit. Highly recommend.

He gave me an injection; a quick sting is better than waking up in excruciating pain every night when I just turn over. He prescribed medication and said the pain should be gone by tomorrow. 0x30e29dc2510079ef_0xf3f3ad917538d04a.text: This is an honest review. I went in because of a toothache, but I didn't know what it was, so I asked for an examination first. It turned out I had a wisdom tooth that had penetrated my molar, reaching the nerve. So I needed to either have the tooth extracted or get a dental implant. But I didn't have that much money, so I chose to have two teeth extracted. It cost me 3500 baht. I think the price was very worthwhile. Because 1) I had an examination, 2) an X-ray, and 3) I had two teeth extracted, one of which was embedded in the gum, only slightly protruding. If I went to a government clinic (I checked the waiting list), I would have to wait another two months, which is a very long time. So I chose this clinic. After the extraction, I received medication and ice packs. Overall, I was very satisfied. The service was excellent, and the doctor explained everything well. For those wondering if tooth extraction hurts: The doctor injects local anesthetic. It's not painful, but there's a slight tingling sensation because it's like a nerve is being hit. But the doctor did a good job. I highly recommend this clinic for anyone considering treatment.

0x3102960cdb1cd041_0xd9ab684afe8c21ac.text: Had a really interesting training with Mr. Na and first time experience training with his Pilates Reformer, and TRX... I'm 29 years-old, by the time I write this, I suffer from hips misalignment, knocked knees, and flat feet for as long as I know myself... I also broke two of my legs in diffrent occasion, and has a surgery during childhood... so I already knew all of it before, I wasnt seeking for diagnosis... Mr. Na's Pilates Reformer machines really guides you toward proper technique, fixing muscular imbalances etc, while the sholuder brace keeps your shoulders down, and pretty much square and even.. it's a good method to strengthen you glutes and core muscles without twisting your hips (if youre prone to compensate that way), and loading too much on your joints... I was surprised how hard my muscles worked in my last therapy session, yet my knee joint didnt get warm, tense, or burining as it usually does... Likewise Mr Na is honest, very friendly, and seems to have higher attention to details, (making sure a little more thoroughly you're using the right muscles) than most physiotherapist I've met, duing his supervisions... Other physiotherapists I've met didnt pay high regard, or were going out of their way to make sure I understand how important and how exactly should I use and work out my full body, and core muscles and all of that jazz... But i was noticed Mr. Na. Being remarkably diffrent, and has an hollistic approch.. (That being said, I must admit that I had most of my life an extremely low (real) posture understanding, and muscle awareness up untill I lost weight in early 20's, or more significantly was up untill I tried a diffrent non-conventional group therapy approch in the last 6 monthes prior coming to Pattaya, those time had really educated me about my how my body should move - I think it doesnt come intuitivly for everone...and we all should be curious and SELF INVOLVED about it, the process, and our diagnosis - to fully heal... even before of trying diffrent approches and practitioners... not just rely on other to notice that... and not just rely on western doctors which often time discourage and give you no hope to do something about it, with faking their certainty, and just tell you to use custom orthotics.... yet, despite everything I was still curious about using Pilates reformer, and to strengthen up my muscles foundation in a controlled manner, more tailored to my own pace and difficulty level, and I was pleasently surprised... I'm curious how fast my progress would go that way... Highly recommend you guys giving Mr. Na's clinic a try..

0x3102960cdb1cd041_0xd9ab684afe8c21ac.text: Amazing specialist! After 20 years of lower back pain, I feel relief! Over the years, I visited about 15 different specialists—masseurs, chiropractors, physiotherapists—with varying results. This physiotherapist in Pattaya was the first one who genuinely helped me. After just a few visits and simple, 15-minute home exercises, the pain was reduced by 60% in only two months! The pelvic massage and activation of muscles that had long stopped functioning proved revolutionary, immediately improving my posture and gait. The doctor has incredible knowledge and approaches the patient holistically—he even advised me on how to carry my bag so that it aligned with my new movement habits. I was also convinced by his open approach to taboo subjects (such as sexual activity), which demonstrates great professionalism and trustworthiness. I sincerely recommend dedicating 3–5 weeks (visiting twice a week) and following the recommendations. It is worth it! Every visit brings not only relief but a real improvement in the quality of life. Thank you kindly, and I will definitely be back!

0x30e2947666364c5f_0x8ce4643415fd922f.text: I've brought my child here for treatment several times. I only recently found out that the treatment is free because she's studying engineering here. Tuition averages over 200,000 baht per year because it's an international program. Today, I came for emergency treatment for a serious gynecological issue, something I only experience a few times a year. This is only the second time. The previous time, even though we were delayed in entering the treatment room, I was more impressed with the speed of treatment compared to this time. However, it seemed less professional, which I understand because the staff isn't the same as before; individual qualities vary. The positive aspect is that this crisis allowed me to turn it into an opportunity to teach my child that graduating from here means having a professional spirit befitting the educational institution that provided them with knowledge and saved their life. Wherever we work, the quality of our work reflects on the institution we attended. The most commendable thing here is the interpreter and patient reception staff. Upon arrival, the receptionist made me feel relieved that my child was saved; their demeanor and communication were excellent. If it weren't for the quality of service, I would have immediately gone to a private clinic and would have been furious on social media. I understand now why my wife kept complaining all the way home – the problem was the lack of service, specifically that the service provider wasn't the same person. When paying for medication, they didn't have the student identification documents, and it took a lot of effort to get them. Last time, the paperwork was handled from the start, but it was such a hassle to get home. As a student, my ID card wasn't enough; I needed all sorts of other certifications. And for students paying hundreds of thousands of baht in tuition annually, it's no wonder my wife was so upset. She said next time we'd go to a private institution. I told her it's just a matter of individual service quality. Even in private institutions, you can't escape it; there are always people with lower quality workmanship everywhere. Every organization has its share of people who got their jobs through connections. Today was just bad luck to encounter someone like that. That's all. What needs fixing, but isn't easy to solve today, is the lack of parking spaces. The chaos is evident. The problem is that our country has too many private car owners; they're like an unwanted burden on society. For me, I don't want to demand too much. Considering everything they've done so far, this place has passed with flying colors. Even with such complex services, it's still impressive.
0x30e2947666364c5f_0x8ce4643415fd922f.author: New Note

0x30e2947666364c5f_0x8ce4643415fd922f.text: Today (March 2026), I had the opportunity to visit the Kanchanapisek Medical Center for dental care. If I remember correctly, my first visit was about 8 years ago, and I've returned periodically since then. Time has passed, and it seems the place is constantly developing. This time, I noticed a new building under construction in front of the center 🏥. It seems the area is expanding. One thing that remains the same is that the place is quite spacious, well-organized, and clean. There's also plenty of parking space 🛻🛵🚙🚗🏍️. If you park far from the building, there's a shuttle service to take you back to the parking lot, making it convenient for those who need to use the services. After finishing my errands, I had a little time, so I walked around the ground floor. That's when I noticed there are many restaurants and cafes. I enjoyed browsing so much that I almost lost track of time. There was one shop that made me laugh at myself a little. At first glance, I mistook the sign for a gold shop, Hua Seng Heng, but upon closer inspection, I realized it was Hua Seng Hong, a Chinese restaurant selling dim sum and steamed buns, as the red sign is very similar. There are also snack shops like Auntie Anne's and several other restaurants, making the downstairs area quite lively. Browsing around was quite enjoyable and helped pass the waiting time. 🌽🍌🍋🍐🍊🥝🥑🍝🥙🌯🍛🥗🍡🍧🍨🍭🧁☕🧋🍯🍎🍒🍓🍉 Overall, I felt this medical center was spacious, well-organized, and offered many amenities, including parking, shuttle service, and restaurants, making the visit less stressful. I look so much younger. Dr. B is an adorable beautiful woman and her assistants are lovely. The clinic is immaculately clean and well run with the newest equipment. My husband was impressed with the work and offered to get me one more thing done. I got threading and German Botox for my saggy turkey neck. It was a 2 hour process. 0x30da3a63ba5115bf_0x1ede952ea899a909.text: I needed to have my glasses repaired: one of the arms had come off due to the loss of the hinge screw. And this morning I searched the internet for an optical shop here in Chiang Mai. I found “The Vision Optic” in the neighborhood called “Nimman”. Upon arrival I was immediately impressed. The premises that house this sales center, preparation and repair of glasses and sunglasses, as well as the related activity of measuring eyesight, are large and luxurious. The assortment of frames is vast, and extends to almost all the most important brands in the world. I think anyone can find glasses to their taste. To be honest, the elegance of the environment intimidated me a little. But the kindness, simplicity and courtesy of the two young ladies who welcomed me immediately made me feel at ease. After a few minutes my glasses were returned to me repaired to perfection, and not without an accompanying smile from the gentleman who had done the work. When I asked how much I should pay for the repair, I was told nothing. I thanked him and left feeling grateful and satisfied. I don't think I need to add anything else.
0x30da3a63ba5115bf_0x1ede952ea899a909.author: alfonso salvato

0x30da3a63ba5115bf_0x1ede952ea899a909.text: This is the best shop in Chiang Mai. The people there are always helpful and welcoming. Last night I accidentally smashed the frame of my glasses into a twisted, broken mess. This morning I went there and asked if they could salvage the lenses and sell me another frame. The man helping me asked me to wait a few minutes and took the broken remains with him. When he returned ten minutes later he had restored the broken mess and handed me what looked like a brand new pair of glasses. Then he refused any payment. People like these should be appreciated. I urge you, if ever you need glasses, or an eye exam, please bring your business to The Vision Optic. Great people...
0x30da3a63ba5115bf_0x1ede952ea899a909.author: Rob Mason

0x30da3a63ba5115bf_0x1ede952ea899a909.text: I'm very grateful to this optical store. My daily contact lens broke and needed to be checked urgently for inflammation or broken pieces. All the clinics were closed on Sunday afternoon, but Vision Optic said they had the necessary equipment and could check it. They also honestly advised me to go to the hospital first and said that for serious cases, it's better to go to the clinic. It turned out everything was fine and there was no need to worry. The receptionist also spoke good English, and the store itself is also large and has a good selection of frames. If I need to get new glasses, I'll consider them first. Thank you for your business.
0x30da3a63ba5115bf_0x1ede952ea899a909.author: Milana Prikhodko

0x30da3a63ba5115bf_0x1ede952ea899a909.text: Exceptionally high-quality service. This place feels very much like a privately owned establishment, and so the staff are extremely friendly. attentive and professional. They were very helpful finding me the right glasses frames for my needs, and were able to make good suggestions on the range of lens options. Upon first walking in, I was immediately able to get a sight test, and within a handful of days I had a fantastic new pair of glasses which, weeks on I'm very happy with. I would recommend here as a first choice for opticians in Chiang Mai.
0x30da3a63ba5115bf_0x1ede952ea899a909.author: Edward Woodcock

0x30da3a63ba5115bf_0x1ede952ea899a909.text: Amazing staff and service! The owner and optometrist were incredibly accommodating, helpful, and genually interested in chatting and providing the best service possible. There's a sweet little dog inside and it's easy to feel comfortable right away. They helped me look at all the frames and kept taking my feedback and bringing me more to try on. I had a prescription already but they tested me again for free, right in the back room. Chose my frame and had my glasses within 30 minutes. Highly recommend this spot if to need glasses!
0x30da3a63ba5115bf_0x1ede952ea899a909.author: Sean Dalton

0x30da3a63ba5115bf_0x1ede952ea899a909.text: Great service! My glasses got under the wheels of a car just before my flight from Bangkok to Chiang Mai. I arrived at the shop about an hour before closing time. Turns out, while the frame was bent, the lenses were still intact and could be reused. Within minutes the very friendly and competent staff found a frame that fit my lenses without modification. Ten minutes later I walked out after paying a very reasonable price for the new frame. The next time I need glasses, I will definitely come back here.

0x30da3a63ba5115bf_0x1ede952ea899a909.text: My girlfriend has creatoconus. The doctors in Switzerland told her that she can't wear glasses anymore. That's why we went to Vision Optic. And it was fantastic. The employees were incredibly professional and had a lot of experience. They took a lot of time and looked for a solution although the device could not measure one eye because of the creatukonus. Now she got new glasses and she sees much better and doesn't always need her lenses anymore. Thank you very much. Her work is very valuable.

0x30da3a63ba5115bf_0x1ede952ea899a909.text: At 25 years old, I've never worn glasses. I could tell my vision was getting worse, though, and I was having more frequent headaches. The wonderful people here helped me through the whole process, from the prescription to choosing frames (I had no idea where to start!) to choosing lenses. The glasses were ready for me to take home in 30 minutes. Prices are what I would expect back in the US, but I felt very confident in the staff here (and they have an adorable dog!)

0x30e297d163683efd_0xd13cddbeb419b81e.text: I'm usually terrified of dentists and only go to clinics for necessary procedures. Today, my front filling came out, and the dentist gave excellent advice. The dentist was very kind, providing guidance and explaining the filling process, including specific brushing techniques and areas that needed improvement. I was very impressed. The dentist even complimented me on my good oral hygiene practices. The assistant also did a great job. The reception upon entering the clinic was excellent. The service, care, and attention were great. The clinic is beautiful, the equipment is modern and clean, and they even accept social security benefits (900 baht/year), so I only pay the difference. Overall, I had a great experience here and was very impressed.

0x30e29f2cc0adc309_0xcdd5f207dc04647c.text: Came here a couple months back for a double chin lipo procedure. Online consultation was alright and the surgeon answered all my queries. Administrative staff were okay, most were sweet but got the date of my surgery wrong (I texted in the chat to reschedule it to a day earlier than initially communicated, months before surgery was scheduled) but a minor inconvenience. They arranged for me to have a meal after surgery according to my dietary restrictions and were very clear about information regarding the procedure, after-care and what to expect. Day of the surgery, I was nervous and the surgeon was late. There was no consultation with the surgeon before the surgery, not sure if this is standard practice but it was a minor inconvenience as well. Had local anesthetic put in and as someone with a fear of needles, it freaked me out but the nursing staff were very sweet and were tapping my leg to distract me from the pain. The actual surgery was okay, just a lot of vibration and moving around in my neck. The surgeon communicated whenever he was doing something new, throughout the surgery, which I really appreciated. After the surgery, the surgeon left (and that was the last I saw of him) and the nursing team cleaned me up really well. Hygiene in the operating theatre was also world class and they were very particular about following proper SOPs to ensure sanitation. Follow-up appointments to remove stitches with the nursing staff, and red light therapy was extremely pleasant. Nursing staff were incredibly sweet and welcoming and I had the best time with them. Overall, I do see a difference but be sure to prepare for realistic results. The nursing staff were the highlight of my visit.
0x30e29f2cc0adc309_0xcdd5f207dc04647c.author: Amy F

0x30e29f2cc0adc309_0xcdd5f207dc04647c.text: I had fat grafting, as well as BodyTite-assisted liposuction, at Rattinan Clinic with Dr. Hui as my surgeon, and I’m beyond happy with the results. A very special thank you to Ezra, who was amazing throughout the entire journey. Ezra was there for me before the procedures, afterwards, and during the aftercare, always caring, attentive, and easy to reach. 0x30e29f2cc0adc309_0xcdd5f207dc04647c.text: I had my arm liposuction done at Rattinan Clinic and had a really positive experience overall. The team was professional, warm, and genuinely caring, which meant a lot to me since I was travelling alone. They made me feel well taken care of throughout the process, and my recovery went smoothly. Post 1 month, my swelling around the arms went down and revealed my tone arm. I’ve been maintaining my results by gradually returning to the gym. For the quality of service and care I received, I felt that the price point was amazing and definitely worth it. For anyone considering the procedure, I think the most important thing is to be mentally prepared and do your own research beforehand, especially on possible side effects and what you’ll need during recovery. One practical tip is to prepare extra bedding, towels, or padding for the treated area, as some leakage during the first few days can happen and can be quite messy. Please know that recovery and results can vary from person to person, so I would definitely recommend following your doctor’s instructions and listening to your body. Knowing what to expect made the recovery process much less stressful for me. Above all, keep a healthy mind! Overall, I’m very happy with my experience at Rattinan Clinic and would definitely recommend them to anyone considering arm liposuction.

Open from morning to evening; you can visit a doctor before or after work. My first visit was on the 5th floor. I had a sore throat, and the clinic had me get a COVID test first, but I had to do it myself in the restroom – a strip test. Then I waited for the doctor. I went in the evening; there were patients coming in steadily, but no waiting in line. The nurses were friendly, helpful, and cheerful. Free drinking water was provided. Payment can be made via QR code, cash, and credit card. Medication prices are the same as Siriraj Hospital; only the doctor's service fee is higher. Internal medicine doctors are available for general illnesses, but specialists require appointments. The doctors here are also from Siriraj Hospital. From what I've gathered, they're currently accepting cases until 7:30 or 8:00 PM, but the clinic itself is open until 10:00 PM. Since it's newly opened, everything looks clean, new, modern, and fully equipped, just like a private hospital. For elderly people or those in wheelchairs, it might be a bit difficult. From the parking lot to the elevator, you need to park in the correct zone and on the correct floor; otherwise, you'll have to go up and down the stairs. After your doctor's appointment, you can stop by for a meal and go shopping at ICS or Icon Siam, which are across the street. Getting there is relatively convenient with the BTS Skytrain nearby, and parking is not too difficult if you drive.
0x30e29904148b43d7_0x8824142a95019562.author: GiZMo

0x30e29904148b43d7_0x8824142a95019562.text: The location is okay, not crowded, and easy to get to. There's no parking fee (don't forget to get your parking ticket stamped!). You can claim benefits from the Government Savings Bank, just like at the main Siriraj Hospital branch. (However, Social Security benefits are not accepted; you have to pay yourself.) The service can be a bit bumpy at times, such as when many people arrive at the same time without an appointment, making it feel like they can't attend to everyone. Waiting times for patient files were very long, and people who arrived later were called first, which was a bit confusing. But I understand and can forgive that. Yesterday, I had a minor issue, but after sharing it with a staff member (I think her name was Coke), she listened, understood my concerns, and provided excellent assistance. She took me to consult with the medical records team (her name was Sai), who was also lovely, asked questions attentively, and helped me find the fastest available appointment. It was surprisingly fast – I got an appointment for the next day! This might have been a lucky coincidence that the doctor was on duty and there was an available slot. (This kind of luck doesn't happen every time!) Anyway, I want to thank all the staff and nurses involved. From the reception and screening process to the appointment scheduling team, everyone was attentive, understanding of the problem, and genuinely committed to helping us solve it. Today, I finally met with the doctor. He was very kind, thoroughly examined me, and gave excellent advice, which greatly relieved my and my family's worries. The doctor's assistant nurse was also incredibly lovely and attentive to detail. She promptly arranged for X-rays and other necessary tests, and the waiting times were minimal. Overall, it was a wonderful and very impressive experience! :)
0x30e29904148b43d7_0x8824142a95019562.author: Nitcha

0x30e29904148b43d7_0x8824142a95019562.text: Wow! I am so glad I went here for my respiratory issue. As an American I was a little skeptical because sometimes clinics can be all about selling services. Not here. I was met with a very friendly and professional staff. Very easy and clear process for in-take. Dr. Piapawn was outstanding. She took time to make sure that I understood the diagnosis and treatment. This was especially helpful seeing as I do not speak Thai. One of the best experiences I have had with a doctor anywhere. (I've been to over 60 countries. This ranks high.) Also, even though it is common in Thailand, I was still so impressed by the efficiency of having my prescriptions available for check-out, and all on the same bill. (This does not happen in the U.S.) It was very affordable for: nasal swab tests, chest x-ray, doctor consultation, and meds. On top of that, I did not have an appointment when I walked in. And still they managed to provide all of that in less than 2 hours. Plus, they handed me a CD with my x-ray results when I left. My God, I love Thai health care. On the mend now. Knowing this place is up the road from me gives me peace of mind. Thank you to all the very friendly and helpful staff at Siriraj H. Kawp Kun Kap.

0x30da3b590ba0a30b_0xc6b6679da5704041.text: Previously, I struggled with severe acne, including clogged pores, inflamed pimples, and persistent acne scars, especially on my cheeks and chin. I tried many methods, including using skincare products based on reviews, changing face washes, taking vitamins, and reducing oily and sugary foods, but the acne kept recurring. Sometimes it improved, sometimes it worsened, causing me to lose confidence in public. Finally, I decided to seek serious acne treatment at Cleo. Initially, I was a little worried about the price, safety, and the possibility of damaging my skin. But after trying it, I can honestly say it was the right decision. From the moment I stepped into the clinic, the staff were incredibly helpful, polite, and provided clear information. The doctor took a very detailed history, covering my lifestyle, sleep, diet, skincare routine, and any previous allergies. They didn't push any treatments; instead, they assessed my skin problems first and explained the cause of my acne and the appropriate treatment. Overall, I was very impressed with the doctor, the staff, and the results. My acne genuinely improved, not just temporarily disappeared. If you've had acne for a long time and haven't found a solution with self-treatment, I highly recommend trying Cleo. At least you'll understand the root cause of your skin problem and receive proper care. My confidence has increased significantly. Highly recommended from a satisfied user.

Initially, I was a little apprehensive, but after actually visiting, I was very impressed. Cleo Clinic analyzes your skin condition first, revealing the true cause of your acne. The doctor and staff at Cleo give very detailed advice, explaining how to care for your skin, cleansing routine, skincare products, and how to prevent recurrence. The acne extraction is very clean and gentle; there's minimal swelling and redness afterward, unlike at other places I've been to. After consistent treatment and follow-up, I feel my skin has improved significantly. Inflamed acne has noticeably decreased, fewer new breakouts, smoother skin, and acne scars are fading. This has boosted my confidence considerably. I want to thank the doctor and staff at the clinic so much for their excellent care and guidance. They not only treated my acne but also taught me the correct way to care for my skin. If you're struggling with acne, I highly recommend consulting Cleo Clinic. It's totally worth it! 0x30da3b590ba0a30b_0xc6b6679da5704041.text: For anyone struggling with severe acne, I want to share my personal experience getting treatment at Cleo Clinic. Before treatment, I had a lot of inflamed acne, including small bumps and clogged pores, and it left red marks all over my face, making me extremely self-conscious. But after the consultation, the doctor gave very detailed advice and analyzed my skin condition accurately. They didn't push unnecessary treatments, so I decided to give it a try. The treatment process involved very clean acne extraction (leaving almost no scars) followed by an anti-inflammatory treatment. After the treatment, I noticed that the acne dried up faster. This included face washing, medication application, and adjusting my daily routine to prevent new acne breakouts, so the acne wouldn't easily return. I've been receiving treatment for about 6 sessions now, and my skin has improved so much that people around me have noticed. Before, I used to have to wear thick makeup to cover it up, but now I have significantly less acne and my skin is much better.

0x6ec1dd08bd45e84f_0xa339efd2ddb8dd45.text: We tried their free 8-item health checkup service plus one special item, an ultrasound, but only received the ultrasound. Dental, gum, heart, and skin health checks, as mentioned in the post, were not included. We might have misinterpreted the information as "8+1 items free." The doctor explained and diagnosed our concerns well, especially regarding kidney, kidney stones, and liver problems, as we had many questions. The doctor clarified things, eased our anxieties, and provided guidance on pet care and estimated costs. The place was bright, airy, and beautifully decorated. However, there was one minor issue: the hospital's dogs (or perhaps not) were allowed to roam freely. While everyone loves animals, it doesn't mean everyone likes dogs. Some people are afraid of dogs, and some types of animals brought for treatment don't get along with them. We brought our cat for a checkup, and the dog sniffed and showed curiosity, as is natural for them. Our cat was quite stressed and scared, hissing incessantly. We felt uncomfortable with this. We think limiting the dogs' roaming would be better for their health and safety. Fights or disease transmission between animals would be unacceptable. The dogs also tend to lie on the weighing scale, leaving saliva on the floor, especially with people constantly wearing shoes in and out. Even though they were hospital shoes, I wouldn't feel comfortable weighing my cat there, so I didn't. I like that they offer 24-hour service. I'm already a member on my phone. I'll definitely use their service again if I have the chance.

0x6ec1dd08bd45e84f_0xa339efd2ddb8dd45.text: Cozy & Care Animal Hospital is a conveniently located and easily accessible pet hospital. With a team of expert and experienced veterinarians and friendly, attentive service, it's a trusted choice for many pet owners. Upon entering Cozy & Care Animal Hospital, the first impression is a warm and welcoming atmosphere. All staff are greeted with a warm and cheerful smile, making you feel comfortable entrusting your pet to their care. Cozy & Care Animal Hospital offers a comprehensive range of services to meet all your pet's needs, including annual health checkups, general treatment, surgery, vaccinations, and pet care consultations. They also provide high-standard grooming services using safe and appropriate products for all pet types. Most notably, their service is heartfelt. All staff and veterinarians have a genuine love and care for every pet, demonstrating that they perform their duties not just as part of their job, but with love and concern. Furthermore, they regularly update owners on their pets' health, allowing them to track progress and feel confident that their pets are receiving the best possible care. If you are looking for a trustworthy and comprehensive animal hospital, Cozy & Care Animal Hospital is an option you shouldn't miss. With a commitment to excellent service and compassionate care, this hospital will make you and your pet feel warm and safe every time you visit.

0x6ec1dd08bd45e84f_0xa339efd2ddb8dd45.text: The hospital is a commercial building on the main road with convenient parking. There was no queue when we took our 25kg dog for check-up. There's also a grassy area in the back for pets to run around. The cat boarding area looks nice; the cats seem happy there. However, the dog boarding area is on the second floor, with only one room and many cages. It seemed chaotic, had a strong smell, and wasn't very clean. Updates on the dog's condition are provided via LINE. I saw a sign saying there's only one doctor, but they seem skilled. The male assistant was very helpful, carrying the dog to and from the car, and going up and down to the second floor – very kind. 0x3054f1e599cbc1a9_0xdfa5741668e8cbae.text: I attended this clinic whilst in Samui for ongoing shoulder pain I'd been experiencing whilst travelling. All staff spoke excellent English including the lovely friendly receptionist. The treatment lasted an hour. It was instantly effective with use of tens machine & combined ultrasound with electric stimulation, I think possibly her name is Rung. I booked a 2nd appointment for the same week. The 2nd Physio called Gift was very good at explaining the equipment which I haven't seen in the UK. She used a fantastic combination of heat, massage, Stretching & ultrasound electric stimulation to help relieve my pain. Again over an hour for treatment. She kindly sent me a follow up message with advice and pictures of the stretches she advise I perform. Excellent experience, wonderful talented staff. I'm sorry I'm not staying longer to avail of further treatment. Thank you Samui Physio Clinic
0x3054f1e599cbc1a9_0xdfa5741668e8cbae.author: Geraldine James

0x3054f1e599cbc1a9_0xdfa5741668e8cbae.text: I went in for treatment on my plantar fascia, and from the very first visit, I knew I was in the right hands. A special thank you to Gift, my therapist, who was not only incredibly skilled and professional but also one of the kindest and most caring practitioners I've ever met. She took the time to understand my pain, explained the treatment process clearly, and worked with precision and expertise to relieve my discomfort. After just a few sessions, I felt a significant improvement, and now I can walk without the constant pain that had been bothering me for so long. If you're in Koh Samui and need top-notch physiotherapy, don't hesitate to visit Samui Physio Clinic. Their team is fantastic, and their dedication to their patients is truly outstanding. Thank you again, Gift and the whole team, for your amazing care! 🙌😊 ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5/5 Highly Recommended!

I was able to get an appontment for the following day but I wasn't holding my breath, as it's usually too late when my back goes this bad. But... Gift was amazing and she sorted it! I felt much better some hours after my 1st session, and I did 2 more. It was truly unbelievable. She used machines that we don't have over here in Australia and the results are incredible! 0x3054f1e599cbc1a9_0xdfa5741668e8cbae.text: I was looking for a chiropractor, so I didn’t have high hopes when I booked my first appointment. I had no idea that Physio could work as well, if not better than chiropractic. My physiotherapist diagnosed my issue as a muscle issue, not a spine issue. In all of my years of using chiropractors, nobody has ever said that to me before. The results were amazing. The staff is very friendly and we’ll go out of their way to make you feel good. When I left Ko Samui, I was sad to leave this Clinic behind.

0x3054f1e599cbc1a9_0xdfa5741668e8cbae.text: Excellent experience! I came in for some last-minute treatment before my next overseas trip and made tremendous progress in just a few days. The procedure included ultrasound with electric stimulation, laser therapy, manual mobilization followed by application of K-tape and exercise routine for me. A detailed message was sent to me explaining all the details. I wished I’ve traveled here sooner. Thank you Karim!

0x30503ab756c18ceb_0x9992813465deff99.text: Absolutely the best dental experience I’ve had in a very long time! I arranged everything via email before leaving Melbourne, and Nipa was amazing — so helpful and responsive in finalising my treatment plan. In just four days, I had two teeth extracted, a deep clean, a 3-unit bridge, and dentures fitted to cover the front gap until I return in November to complete the rest of my treatment. The clinic is spotless and modern — I was even given a blanket because the air-conditioning was so good! I felt genuinely comfortable and at ease throughout. Surprisingly, I had no downtime at all apart from waiting for the local anaesthetic to wear off. A few hours later, I was back sipping cocktails and enjoying my holiday! I honestly couldn’t believe how pain-free the whole process was — completely different to my previous experiences in Melbourne. The technology and service are just as good (if not better) than what I’ve had back home. I was quoted $23K–$24K in Melbourne — I paid $3,380 here for all this work, and my upcoming visit in November (for a 4-unit bridge and 4 veneers) will cost $5,794.46. You do the math! 😄 Highly recommend. My new local — not-so-local — dentist! See you soon Nipa, Dr Chumporn and team.
0x30503ab756c18ceb_0x9992813465deff99.author: Rebecca Attard

0x30503ab756c18ceb_0x9992813465deff99.text: I recently had an unexpected emergency dental visit while in Thailand, and I am thrilled to share my experience. I broke a tooth and needed immediate attention. From the moment I walked in, the dentist and staff were incredibly friendly and professional. They promptly examined my tooth and provided me with several treatment options. Initially, I chose the most expensive option to resolve the issue once and for all. However, after taking X-rays, the dentist noticed an underlying issue that required a course of antibiotics and a week's time to heal. Instead of proceeding with the costly treatment, the dentist advised me to take a more affordable and suitable alternative. I was genuinely impressed by their integrity and thoroughness. Most dentists might have proceeded with the expensive treatment to pocket the money, but here, they prioritised my health and well-being. The entire team made me feel comfortable and taken care of during a stressful situation. This level of honesty and care is rare, and I couldn't be more grateful. A perfect 10/10 experience—I never thought I'd say that about a dentist visit, especially one abroad! Highly recommended for anyone in need of dental care while traveling.
0x30503ab756c18ceb_0x9992813465deff99.author: Christopher Thomas

0x30503ab756c18ceb_0x9992813465deff99.text: I had an old filling in my right, lower molar crumble & eventually disintegrate a month or so before travelling to Phuket. There are a LOT of dentists available in Patong, but I hit the jackpot going to New Smile. I didn't need any cosmetic work done, just a repair &/or replace my filling. I got a walk-in appointment & checkup done by the owner. She was experienced & just lovely. There was also no charge for the review, & no obligation to continue. I liked that. In Australia, that would cost you $100 alone. It was recommended to get an xray done (only 200Baht) to confirm there was no rot below the damaged filling. Good advice & it was certainly not a money-spinner for them. I felt reassured & I was booked in a few days later. I had a full scale & clean, as well as having the old hole prepared for the new filling. It was a painless, covid-safe, & professional experience. I'd have no hesitation in recommending this dental clinic & also going back myself next time. 🙏🏼 🇹🇭

Luckily for me I was able to be seen straight away and the dentist was great. He spoke English, which was relieving as I unfortunately do not speak Thai, so there was no language barrier. He informed me immediately after inspection that I’d need a filling and informed me of the price- 2,500 baht. The process was pain free (I didn’t need anaesthetic) and the service was very good. I would recommend this dentist to anyone and would like to reassure people that they can trust this clinic if they to find themselves in a similar situation to me.

0x30da3aa03025c223_0x8043421b3ef2b7fd.text: I have tried a lot of therapies, healing modalities, etc in my life and I can say that 3 sessions with Nick felt like the most impactful thing I have ever done. I recommend him so highly, if you are even remotely contemplating booking a session, just do it! In case you are wary of the term “hypnotherapy”, I will break down my experience. The first 30 minutes were more like traditional talk therapy, then Nick guided me through some breathwork and relaxation exercises to get me in a relaxed and receptive state. Then he guides you through a series of what I can best described as guided meditations and visualizations, he asks some questions, and I was welcome to speak at any time, but for the majority of the hypnosis portion of the session, Nick was doing the talking / guiding. I don’t know much about reiki, but I know that Nick is a reiki master and I now know that I would never want to do hypnotherapy with someone who is not a reiki master. His ability to follow the energy and manipulate the energy was one of the craziest things I have ever experienced in my life. My primary goal in these sessions was nervous system regulation. I am 2 weeks out from my time with Nick, and in those two weeks my HRV has increased by about 40% on average. (HRV is the key biometric indicator of if your nervous system is in fight/flight or rest/relax. The higher the number, the better). And I have felt a noticeable lightness and expansion in my body and mind. It may be too soon to tell, but my intuition says this feels permanent. My primary feedback to Nick was “I did not expect that to be so entertaining.” In the hypnotic state, I felt like I had my consciousness there watching the whole process unfold. And the theatrics that my subconscious and nervous system had to share were wildly entertaining to me. My sessions were immensely healing and helpful, but I can also describe them to others with lightness and laughter. In my experience, I was quite surprised that the things that came up in my session were not these moments of ultimate trauma and darkness, but rather misunderstandings of things that happened when I was a child, that are now very easy to understand and process as an adult. I don’t assume that will be everyone’s experience, but perhaps it is a reasonable expectation that the wounds that set you up for some darkness later in life are more easily addressed and healed than you might think, with the right guide and container. Thank you, Nick. I am so grateful that you exist and share all of your gifts and knowledge in this incredibly meaningful way.
0x30da3aa03025c223_0x8043421b3ef2b7fd.author: Optimistically Green

0x30da3aa03025c223_0x8043421b3ef2b7fd.text: I know what you were probably thinking when you first came across Nick's site/Google listing... Hypnotherapy? What nonsense. Trust me, I'm super logical, I don't believe things like that at first, and I was skeptical as all heck. What do you mean hypnotizing? How does that do anything?! But I wanted a therapist's support in person to help me with some challenges. Nick was the only male, foreign therapist I could find in Chiang Mai, so I signed up for some sessions thinking that worst case, I can always cancel them. LET ME TELL YOU SOMETHING: Signing up for sessions with Nick has been one of the best decisions I've made in the past years. Nick is extremely gifted, giving, and understanding. I was also worried he'd be too "woo-woo", seeing things about salt lamps, crystals, and reiki, on his website. But he's a very down-to-earth and real person as well that helps you work with your emotional/spiritual side, as well as your logical. His techniques have helped me work through challenges and things that I would never have been able to do on my own. Warning/heads up/suggestion: He's booked up for 2 months or so in advance. That should say something! Don't wait until you need urgent help, get signed up now and just start regularly seeing him. Otherwise, you're taking a huge risk and might never get in to see him. You won't know how it works until you go, and people tell me hypnotherapy works differently for every person so your mileage may vary... But I 110% recommend Nick and his techniques to anyone that is going through challenges, or just wants a bit of extra help. Well worth the price and time. Thanks for everything Nick!
0x30da3aa03025c223_0x8043421b3ef2b7fd.author: Noam Lightstone

0x30da3aa03025c223_0x8043421b3ef2b7fd.text: Nicholas is truly one in a million. I've worked with more than 10 therapists throughout my life, and no one has come close to Nicholas. He has a rare gift for helping people get to the root of what's really going on and actually work through it. What continually amazes me is that I can come into a session carrying something that feels heavy, painful, confusing, or stuck, and leave feeling like I've genuinely resolved it. Not just talked about it—resolved it. That has been my experience again and again. I've carried trauma and unprocessed emotions from childhood for most of my life. I also struggle with PTSD, and Nicholas has helped me tremendously in healing and processing wounds that I carried for years. Despite years of therapy, personal development work, and even powerful experiences with plant medicine, nothing was able to help me truly process and heal these emotions the way Nicholas has. The breakthroughs I've experienced working with him have been unlike anything I've experienced before. Beyond his incredible skill, Nicholas is one of the kindest, most compassionate, understanding, and caring people I've ever met. He creates a space where I feel completely safe, heard, and understood. I also genuinely enjoy talking with him. He has a warmth and humanity that makes every session feel natural rather than clinical. I consider myself incredibly fortunate to have found Nicholas and deeply grateful for the work we've done together. The impact he's had on my life has been profound. If you're thinking about working with him, my only regret is that I didn't find him sooner.
0x30da3aa03025c223_0x8043421b3ef2b7fd.author: Eli Rosen

0x30da3aa03025c223_0x8043421b3ef2b7fd.text: I feel very grateful to have met Nick, a compassionate, patient and devoted person. Only a 5-minute talk with him about my past, I burst into tears and emotional outburst already. It was so natural and so secure that I shared with him everything in my heart. I was amazed how patiently he sorted out the strands of my issues and figured out the root cause. We did a lot of healing. It was emotionally exhausting, but I felt a lot better. I really appreciate that he not only heals -- he is not only a professional therapist, but also a great teacher of life. Nick taught me lessons of life -- how to get along with myself, how to get along with my beloved ones and how to be a person, a happy and joyful person. Nick, thank you, sincerely from my heart. I'm very much indebted to you. I went from a long way to Chiang mai for Nick, and it has proven to be a correct decision, for it was a meaningful trip and a meaningful decision in my life. 0x30da3aa03025c223_0x8043421b3ef2b7fd.text: Meeting Nicholas has been my first personal experience with therapy — and especially hypnotherapy — and I received tremendous benefit from it. I feel like I could share any thought or memory with Nic, which is a great thing on its own already and made me realize the value of therapy. I was always able to get an appointment for the next one or two weeks. I suppose many people "hoard" a few appointments for the long term and cancel a couple of them eventually. So don't be disappointed and keep checking the schedule every other day.

0x30da3bd9c6f5c86d_0x9c1f80008b2d156d.text: I was actually hesitant to bring my cat to a proper pet hospital because in my previous country, a vet hospital nearly cost us 2000 euro just for a misdiagnosis. My thoughts changed when I brought my cat Tifa to Arak Animal Hospital. First of all, they have different entry for cat and dog patients (so cute!). After that, they have a cute waiting area for humans with a separate play area for cats. Tifa was handled by Dr. Boat. He diagnosed Tifa with FIP and he had to undergo nearly 3-month medication. The attention that was given by the doctor and the staff of Arak was very touching. They were so calm when handling Tifa, sometimes one of the staff came to play with Tifa for a little bit. It was very clear that they work there not only because it's their job but also because they love animals. They texted me through LINE to ask about Tifa's well-being, and also responded when I send them updates about my cat. Tifa is now FIP-free and a very happy cat. Unfortunately I stop going to this hospital because we have moved quite far away, but Arak Animal Hospital will hold a special place in my (and Tifa's) heart.

The staff and assistants were also very caring, friendly, polite, and professional. The clinic itself was clean, beautiful, and modern. The results exceeded my expectations! 0x30e29fc1d1e2410b_0x63ece8c11ce24120.text: I had the opportunity to be a case reviewer for ceramic veneers with Dr. Nutty. I have to say, I hesitated for a very long time before deciding to get veneers because I was afraid of tooth sensitivity, tooth thinning, and unnatural results. But after meeting Dr. Nutty, all my worries disappeared! Because I can honestly say that they use very little tooth preparation here. During the first consultation, Dr. Nutty was very patient. She sat down and talked with me in detail, asking what kind of smile I wanted, what my concerns were, what color tone I preferred, and how I wanted my teeth to be aligned. She then helped design a Smile Design for me to see what the results would look like before the actual procedure. Seeing the simulation before the actual procedure made me feel much more confident. During the process, the doctor explained every step, from tooth preparation and impression taking to trying on temporary veneers. This allowed me to see what it would look like before the final application. I have to say, I was impressed from the first time I saw the model because it matched almost everything I told the doctor. The result after the final veneers were fitted: my teeth look so beautiful and natural. They don't look unnaturally white, just as I discussed with the doctor. Every time I smile, I feel so much more confident. I feel like it was a worthwhile investment. If you're still hesitant, I recommend consulting with Dr. Nutty first. There's nothing a doctor can't answer! 🦷✨

0x3054f18088ed9989_0x834230b59b0baa3a.text: Highly recommended. I had two teeth removed together with a crown, and honestly, I was very nervous before the procedure. However, everything went much faster and smoother than I expected. The doctor also performed bone smoothing and placed stitches. During the whole process, everything was explained very clearly: what I might feel, what I might hear, and what was happening at each stage. This made a huge difference and helped me feel much calmer. They took X-rays three times to make sure everything was perfectly done, and the X-ray was done right from the dental chair, which was very convenient. The doctor showed and explained everything in detail. I also received clear instructions for healing, aftercare, and the next steps for further treatment. The clinic is clean, cozy, and welcoming, and the staff are incredibly kind, attentive, and supportive. In the end, the price was also very reasonable. This was definitely the best dental experience we have had on Samui, and probably one of the best overall. We have now chosen this clinic as our family dental clinic and will definitely come back for any dental care in the future. Thank you so much to the whole team. I highly recommend this place to everyone 💚

0x3054f18088ed9989_0x834230b59b0baa3a.text: If you are looking for a dentist that actually cares for you then Floss Dental is the place to go. I searched all around Samui for a dental clinic for Invisalign & even checked ChatGBT it recommended this clinic. I messaged them on WhatsApp they responded very prompt & clear about the services. Booked me in basically the next day. I went and had a consult and everyone was very nice and welcoming. Hygiene was very very good & I couldn’t fault it. I was given a quote and decided to go ahead and do the program with them. Dr grace didn’t leave any information out and spent the time to explain everything to me I didn’t feel rushed at all. Awaiting the program the communication has been by far the best and easiest. I then had my appointment for installation and to collect the trays. I was given a few bonus gifts & I honestly could not fault this place. I also had a dental clean on my first appointment and everything was really well priced. I was amazed how good this clinic was & fairly priced. If you are looking for dental work this is the place to go. Thank you Dr grace & the team i will highly recommend you to many people.
0x3054f18088ed9989_0x834230b59b0baa3a.author: J C

0x3054f18088ed9989_0x834230b59b0baa3a.text: One word: wow. This dental practice could teach Belgian dentists a thing or two. Arrived on vacation in Koh Samui with a toothache, contacted them in the morning, and was able to go the same day. And if you think that is already great service... I was warmly guided to the treatment room, which was extremely hygienic, by the way. They placed a blanket over me, and a super kind dental assistant ensured everything went smoothly. The dentist was very professional, spoke good English, and walked me through all the options. Even during the treatment, they repeatedly checked to ensure I was doing okay, which was very reassuring. Afterward, I was given painkillers, a cold pack, and mouthwash. When I got back to the hotel, I was surprised to receive a WhatsApp message with additional tips, explanations about potential side effects, and reassurance that I could contact them anytime if I had concerns. W.O.W. And all of this for a third of the price in Belgium! So, if you're on vacation in Samui, you can visit this dental practice with peace of mind—you’ll be in great hands! Thank you to the entire team—you are amazing!

0x3054f18088ed9989_0x834230b59b0baa3a.text: On the first day of vacation, a tooth broke off that held a bridge in the upper jaw, so that the bridge came loose. All dental practises, as well as the dental department at Bangkok Hospital, were already closed. Since the Floß Dental Office was open until 8 pm, we arrived 15 minutes before closing time. When they saw my problem, they wanted to help me. Since the broken tooth was no longer bearable, there was actually only one tooth left to hold the bridge. From a medical point of view, I asked the dentist to try to glue the bridge temporarily. He didn’t want to give me any guarantee that the bridge would last longer than a day. Nevertheless, he did his best and the bridge still holds after a week. Many thanks to the doctor and his team for this sensitive work. They saved my vacation on Samui

0x30fdab91592714c3_0xb6b80ad4d1e01cd5.text: As someone with a lot of dental experience, I can give a very strong positive recommendation about Dr. Obi, at S-Dental. I went to see him for a “2nd opinion”, about a possible cavity that a dentist in Chiang Mai claimed required extensive dental work. Since I had had no problems or symptoms with that tooth, I went to Dr. Obi to get re-evaluated. Dr. Obi took x-rays of the tooth, and carefully examine them. Next, he thoughtfully took the time to explain to me how he saw no evidence of decay or other problems, and no need at the present time to work on the tooth. Finally, he went above and beyond, by showing me images of what an x-ray might show, if there were a concerning cavity or other dental lesion. I was the last patient of the day, and, as it was Saturday night, I would expected the dentist and his staff to try and end the visit as quickly as possible. But Dr. Obi took the time to answer all my questions, explain and demonstrate why he did not see a problem to be addressed at that time, and gave me a good follow up plan. Thank you for a job well done, Dr. Obi, and the staff at S-Dental!

0x30e29eb179f4f45b_0x1c3449acdde35515.text: I took my 81-year-old father to the doctor. I recommend that anyone over 75 years old should walk in before 10:00 AM (we arrived at 8:15 AM) to get a special queue number for senior citizens, avoiding long waits and eliminating the need for online bookings. (Initially, we booked online for my father, but when they found out he was over 75, they gave him a senior citizen queue number.) The process for our first visit was: Go to the 8th floor > Fill out the medical history form > Submit registration > Receive a referral slip and rest for 10-15 minutes (to stabilize blood pressure) > Proceed to the blood pressure measurement area > Weigh yourself and measure your height > Wait for your turn at the central seating area > Check the screen; they will call you for medical history according to your referral slip number > Wait to see the doctor in the room number indicated at the registration counter > See the doctor for diagnosis > Proceed to the payment counter > Proceed to the medication counter (we paid for everything ourselves; we didn't claim any insurance). The entire process took less than an hour, which was excellent. The security guards and staff were all very kind and helpful, providing great advice to first-time visitors like us. Highly commendable! Also, the facility is new and very clean, even cleaner than some private clinics. The parking garage is in the same building as the examination hall. That's very convenient! 😊

0x31029743f3406791_0x2210fe0a5a1d0f6a.text: Today is finally the day to review The Loft Clinic! 😊 I was impressed from the start by Khun Koy, a sales representative who provided excellent advice to someone completely unfamiliar with any procedures. She patiently listened to my needs, calmly explained each machine in detail, and recommended which machine would be best suited for me. Then came the consultation with Dr. Bas. Dr. Bas was incredibly patient and kind; listening to his recommendations was so relaxing. My first treatment was Ulthera 500 Lines, with a promotional offer including Red Touch Pro 200 Lines. Dr. Bas performed the procedure meticulously, constantly asking if I was okay and if it hurt. Just hearing his voice gave me the courage to persevere! 🤣😅 I'm very satisfied with the results. My second visit was for a follow-up 5 months after my first Ulthera treatment, as I needed my face to look great quickly. This time I met with Dr. Ink. Dr. Ink explained both the machine and injectable treatments in detail, clearly differentiating the differences, and recommended a procedure that perfectly matched my needs, limitations, and conditions. This time, we did the MPT 600 line and got a free Volnewmer 600 line. The results were even more noticeably lifted immediately after the treatment. Plus, the sales representative, Khun Koy, was so kind to let us try Pico Toning as well (we understand that the freebies are based on purchase amounts and monthly promotions). But Dr. Ink also included Pico Toning, which helps with freckles and melasma, as a freebie. Since our skin needs time to scab over after the treatment, and we'd never had any procedures before, we were incredibly paranoid and stressed for the first week (Dr. Ink said the process would improve in two weeks... You need to trust the process 😅). But Khun Koy, Dr. Ink, and the clinic took amazing care of us. They answered all our questions and concerns, provided assistance, followed up on our progress, and gave us medication to reduce irritation. Our skin looks amazing now! All that's left is the minor touch-up on the freckles and melasma from the Pico Toning, which Dr. Ink will schedule weekly checkups for. I want to clarify that I'm not a paid endorser; I paid for everything myself. But I'm writing this review because I'm truly touched and impressed by the care at The Loft Clinic. Thank you to sales representative Koya for being so patient with me, even though I was a bit moody and sulky at times before I finally trusted the process 🤣😘 Thank you for being so understanding towards a newcomer like me. Thank you for making visiting the clinic so comfortable and allowing me to choose my own beauty treatments without anyone pressuring me to buy courses. Thank you to Dr. Bas and Dr. Ing for choosing treatments that were perfect for my skin, needs, and age. And finally, thank you to all the staff at the clinic who were always so cheerful and smiling every time I visited. (The clinic has many price options and courses to choose from, so you can find something that suits your budget. Sales representative Koya is lovely; please be kind to her!) 😉☺️

He kindly opened the clinic for me, accompanied by his assistant. Dr. Wu removed the pus sac that the old clinic hadn't completely removed, causing constant pain. He also inserted collagen and bone grafts. Now the implant is perfectly straight. I want to commend Dr. Wu. He was meticulous and attentive in every detail. He had 3 CT scans and 2 3D scans. The treatment cost 300 baht. And I haven't experienced any pain since the treatment! The dentist spent 3 hours fixing my dental work, and even when I offered to pay extra, they refused, saying they just wanted to do it for me. I don't know how to thank them enough. I want to spread the word that there are still incredibly skilled and honest dentists out there! I've never met such a good person before. If you're considering a dental clinic, check out BKK 48 Dental Clinic. You won't be disappointed with the price or quality. Guaranteed affordable.

0x3054f184076cd82d_0x819ac4eda3d1277e.text: I had eyelash extensions at this salon in Koh Samui, and it was the best choice I could have made. The technicians are super professional, gentle, and attentive to the client and to cleanliness. As for the cost, it's in line with island prices, negligible compared to the European average, and significantly lower than the quality, which is EXCELLENT!

0x30da250036ec1561_0x14b18ac6d4a7d01b.text: I highly recommend PhysioX, a physiotherapy and Pilates studio in Chiang Mai. After six months of consistent physiotherapy and guided Pilates training, I’ve already seen remarkable improvements—even though my doctor originally estimated it might take two years to recover. The studio has a warm, welcoming atmosphere, and the combination of physiotherapy and Pilates here not only helps with recovery but also supports long-term health and reduces the risk of future injuries. With qualified instructors like Teacher Looknok and a highly professional team, PhysioX has truly become one of my favorite places in Chiang Mai.❤️

0x3051c14477571b91_0x1aeef83a864699ea.text: My husband and I recently needed a COVID test to get back into the US but had a full itinerary and were worried about squeezing it in and we were also worried about overpaying. I was able to get in touch with this clinic over facebook messenger and they were super quick to respond and extremely helpful with my questions and requests. We only had a 30min time slot in our schedule to get tested before our boat tour, and they were so willing to work with us. They were super quick, efficient, and made sure that we were out of there on time. The Rapid COVID test was also only 200 baht which was a great price. The front desk was so polite and helpful and the facility was clean and organized. They are a fairly new business which explains the lack of reviews, but I would highly highly recommend this place if you are looking for a clinic!

0x3051c14477571b91_0x1aeef83a864699ea.text: An excellent experience. Following an injury that caused extensive abrasions to my arm, shoulder, knee, and foot, I had the opportunity to visit the Dr. OCEAN Clinic, where I received prompt and professional care. The treatment lasted a week, during which I was constantly monitored, supported, and cared for by the staff. I would like to express my gratitude in particular to Dr. Otto, who guided me with dedication and professionalism throughout the entire process. His thoroughness and attention to detail were remarkable. Special thanks also go to Dr. Su and Dr. Sim, whose contribution was crucial in managing documentation and communicating effectively. In short, if you need medical care, I highly recommend this clinic. I have personally witnessed the high level of satisfaction among patients, both Westerners and international.
0x3051c14477571b91_0x1aeef83a864699ea.author: Roberto Drazza

0x3051c14477571b91_0x1aeef83a864699ea.text: We went for our 12 year daughter’s stomach upset and vomiting. The doctor was young and made lot of effort to explain the problem. His treatment was good and effective. The doctor advised to IV drip, we opted for it, and my daughter was ok within a day. The treatment was very good, but for IV drip, injection and treatment, the cost came to about 8800 baht(335SGD, 250USD), which in my opinion it was extremely pricey. I choose to buy some medicine from pharmacy outside and saved 1800 baht from it. In short, the medicine here costs 6 times the pharmacy costs. This is probably done to encash from foreigners and their insurance. I don’t know whether clinic treatment in Thailand is this costly. If you are going here, make sure you have insurance, if not, be ready to spend a lot if you need big treatment.
0x3051c14477571b91_0x1aeef83a864699ea.author: Jithin Thomas

0x30e29f003e278a17_0x9fcc92323109eb3d.text: I have chronic knee pain from sitting for long hours at work without getting up often, plus I have a habit of sitting with my legs folded and cross-legged. I've tried several treatments, including 6 PRP injections and medication. My first visit to Dr. Kong was incredibly worthwhile. Every second of the 1.5-hour session was exceptionally valuable. Dr. Kong explained everything in detail and gave realistic advice. For example, instead of telling me to stop because I'm used to it, he recommended getting up frequently to reduce the pressure on my knees. This helped me understand the purpose of the treatment. He didn't blame me for previous treatments but focused on follow-up. He asked many questions and explained the reasoning behind each one, which was perfect for someone like me who is inquisitive and often does or doesn't follow instructions. During the first treatment, Dr. Kong found that the muscles in the painful thigh were different from the unaffected side. He used heat compresses, laser treatment, and shockwave therapy. After treatment, the pain in the previously painful area decreased by 75%, but I need continued treatment to strengthen the muscles and prevent recurrence. I have my second appointment tomorrow. The admin staff was also lovely; they messaged me before my appointment to remind me. 🙏😍

0x305031eab1c35885_0xc96472cd76cfb0bf.text: I`d like to describe our experience in this condominium, and show all advantages and disadvantages from our side 🧐 Hope it will be helpful for somebody 🙂 📍LOCATION: central part of Phuket. Close to the biggest mall in Phuket (few km) and big supermarkets (even by foot). But far from the beaches. 👨‍💼 PROPERTY CONSULTANT: good communication skills and English. He guided us very professionally in the very beginning and through our further staying. 🏡APARTMENTS: small, but pretty nice and cosy. We rented 1-bedroom flat, it`s 34 square meters, but to be honest, it feels less. Good enough for a couple. But maybe too small for family with kids and if you have a lot of stuff, so it would be better to rent 2-bedroom apartment. 🍽 KITCHENETTE equipped with basic culinary utensils and appliances, microwave, fridge, small electric stove, toaster (useless for us). We were in great necessity of any elementery coffee maker here instead of toaster. 🛋 LIVING ROOM and hallway in one. Here is a sofa (could be used as full bed), air condition, TV. 🛏 BEDROOM: good hard mattress, wardrobe, linens (2 sets), 4 towels and 6 pillows, TV, air condition. 🚿 BATHROOM: a shower with electric water heater, good ventilation in it. ⛱ BALCONY: with washing machine (it`s a great advantage!), hanger and some place for smoking or drinking coffee. 🏔We had mountain VIEW called «Monkeys hill» 🐒 (by the way, nice place to visit 😉). So it was quite in the morning and noon, but sometimes it was loud live music on the night market nearby till night. 🚗 🛵Guarded bikes and cars PARKING only for condo residents (you need to put special sticker on your bike or car to avoid a fine). Sometimes it`s not enough places for cars. 👨‍✈️ CCTV, access to condo only for residents, no strangers. Security guards and other staff are friendly. 💎2 elegant LOBBIES has enough space for relax or work, but air conditioning could be switched off and it becomes hot. 🌴Nice GREEN ZONES with lawn, trees and palms. Сleanliness maintained everywhere. Comfortable shared spaces outdoor and smoking area. 🏊‍♀️ SWIMMING POOL is clean, around 20-ish meters long. There is also small pool for kids. Available from 7 a.m. till 10 p.m. Depends on the time of a day it could be crowdy or nobody there. But annoying insects are 24/7 here 😁 🏋️‍♀️ GYM is too small, but better than nothing. 7 trainers for cardio, 2 benches and dumbbells (pairs from 2,5 kg till 25 kg). No barbell 🙁, so if you are training with free weights, you will have to exercise your imagination with only dumbbells 😃 Available from 7 a.m. till 10 p.m. Enough place for stretching or yoga nearby gym🧘‍♀️ To sum up briefly, nice place and good value for money. Recommended if you are going to stay for 1 month and more. To avoid any conflicts just follow the rules of using sharing areas, be polite and enjoy! 😊

0x305031eab1c35885_0xc96472cd76cfb0bf.text: Staying here in an AirBnB. Nice pool, small gym that has treadmills, crosstrainers, bikes and free weights. The guards are helpful when the Grab taxi gets lost on the way. There is not much space in the kitchen (or anywhere in the apartment) but a one bedroom is okay for a couple with few possessions or only staying for a few weeks. The condo has strict rules about not hanging laundry over the balcony rail, which can be tricky if you don't have a proper clothes horse. There is not a lot of useful places very close by, other than the Tesco Lotus (which has a Starbucks, food court and other vendors) and Chain of Love Cafe. If you stay here, you will need either your own transport or the willingness to spend on Taxis. Phuket is not a pedestrian friendly place if you're going more than a block.
