0x3054f7f6b91b2653_0x1df6cc6c26c7cb11.text: My husband and I were involved in a very serious traffic accident with multiple injuries, and I spent the first two weeks in the intensive care unit.During one of the hardest times of my life, I experienced an incredible level of care, kindness, and humanity in this hospital that I will never forget. The nurses and staff in the ICU were unbelievably kind, caring, and helpful. Whenever I needed anything, someone came within seconds. They washed and cared for me from head to toe every day, and they even braided my hair for me. Despite my condition, I was always treated with dignity and compassion. The doctors checked on me daily and carefully monitored everything. Because my condition was very critical and my husband was extremely worried, Dr. Dear constantly updated him about my condition and always took the time to explain everything. When I was transferred to the regular ward, I had the exact same positive experience. The nurses were incredibly attentive, loving, and always there whenever I needed help. Especially during situations that felt uncomfortable or embarrassing to me, such as being washed or having my diaper changed, they never made me feel ashamed. Instead, they always reassured me that it was completely normal and part of their job. After several weeks in the hospital, I began struggling mentally and went through depressive phases. Whenever the nurses noticed me crying, some of them would sit with me for up to 30 minutes just to comfort me and cheer me up. That kind of compassion means more to me than words can describe. The wound care team was also amazing. The man who cleaned my wounds every day was incredibly kind and made me feel completely comfortable. The nurses from the wound care department were equally gentle, professional, and caring. One moment I will never forget was my birthday during my stay in the ICU. I was heartbroken that I had to spend it in a hospital bed, but Dr. Joy, the gynecologist, and the nurses still managed to make it a beautiful day for me. They brought me a cake and even a gift. I will always be grateful for that kindness. There was also another doctor — unfortunately I cannot remember his name — who showed exceptional kindness. I had asked him why I had a heavy coating on my tongue even though I do not smoke and had barely eaten. He explained everything to me very patiently. I told him it would be enough if he simply told my husband where to buy the proper products. But the next morning, during his rounds, he personally brought me a mouthwash and a tongue scraper. I will never forget such a thoughtful gesture. The rooms were also excellent: very large, modern, and always clean. A cleaning service came every day. We had our own bathroom, a kitchen, TV, WiFi, and even a couch so my husband could stay and sleep beside me. The view was beautiful as well. I would never wish a hospital stay on anyone. But if someone ever needs medical care, I truly hope they receive the same level of treatment and compassion that I received here. Thank you to the entire staff — doctors, nurses, cleaning staff, and everyone involved.You have my deepest respect. Despite all the pain and injuries, you made my stay as comfortable and positive as possible.Thank you from the bottom of my heart.
0x3054f7f6b91b2653_0x1df6cc6c26c7cb11.author: Selin Baba

0x3054f7f6b91b2653_0x1df6cc6c26c7cb11.text: A Top-Notch and Affordable Healthcare Experience with Great Food at Wattanapat Hospital on Samui Three months ago, Wattanapat Hospital on Samui opened its doors to the public, providing an incredible healthcare experience that surpasses even its high-priced competitors. I recently had the pleasure of being a patient here, and I am compelled to share my outstanding experience with others. The hospital's modern, state-of-the-art facilities and commitment to maintaining a high standard of cleanliness left a lasting impression on me. The staff at Wattanapat Hospital is truly exceptional - caring, professional, and always willing to go above and beyond to ensure patients are comfortable and well taken care of. An additional aspect of Wattanapat Hospital that I particularly enjoyed was the fantastic selection of Western food available. As someone who appreciates good food, I was thrilled to find American-style pancakes and delicious cheese and egg sandwiches on the menu. The quality and taste of these dishes were excellent, providing a sense of comfort and familiarity during my stay. What sets Wattanapat Hospital apart from other facilities, such as the overpriced Bangkok Hospital on Samui, is its affordability without compromising on quality. The hospital offers a range of room options, including standard and VIP rooms. I stayed in a standard room and was thoroughly impressed by its spaciousness (over 30 sqm), spotless en-suite bathroom, smart TV, and super-fast Wi-Fi. Not only does Wattanapat Hospital offer a superior healthcare experience, but it also does so at a much more reasonable price point compared to other establishments in the area. This makes it an excellent choice for both locals and visitors in need of medical attention. In conclusion, Wattanapat Hospital on Samui has quickly become a game-changer in the healthcare industry on the island. With its top-notch facilities, caring staff, competitive pricing, and delicious food options, I wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone in need of medical care. Five stars well deserved!
0x3054f7f6b91b2653_0x1df6cc6c26c7cb11.author: Greg Borowczyk

0x3054f7f6b91b2653_0x1df6cc6c26c7cb11.text: I was on vacation with my family and unfortunately developed a high fever and diarrhea during the night. So I went to the hospital. I was seen immediately and filled out a questionnaire – the staff seemed a bit annoyed, perhaps because I was a tourist. After a short time, I was taken to the emergency room in a wheelchair. There, I received a check-up and was immediately put on an IV drip due to dehydration. Everything was very clean, and the staff were very friendly and even used translators if I didn't know the medical terminology in English. I was advised to stay overnight because, according to a blood test (the results were available just one hour after the sample was taken!), I had bacteria in my gastrointestinal tract. 🩺 After that, I was admitted to a ward. I was checked on every one to two hours, which made a very positive impression. The food was absolutely good compared to what I'd get in Germany. My medication was always brought to me, and I was given an explanation of its purpose. The staff always provided the medication and explained what it was for. . ... ❤️ A very special thank you goes to Dr. Sasipa (Tan) 🥰 and Kitiwan (Nam), 🥰 nurse – thanks to these two lovely ladies, I felt completely at ease and can only offer the highest praise. This is exactly the kind of treatment you want, no matter where you are, especially when you're in a foreign country with a different language. Absolutely fantastic!!! 👍🏼 This allowed me to catch my flight home the next day. I can definitely recommend this hospital from a medical perspective. At the end, I received a bag of medication to take with me, with individual instructions on what each medication was for and how to take it. 💊 Thanks to my international health insurance, everything regarding costs was sorted out on-site, and the process was smooth. 📑

0x30e29ed09ba26a03_0xdf2b2510162ac04e.text: The center offers treatment for back and spinal pain through the manipulation and realignment of slipped or painful vertebrae. The procedure begins with a medical examination, followed by muscle relaxation using a massage device. The therapist then works to realign the vertebrae of the spine and neck. The therapist then begins with manual massage of the treated muscles, followed by massage using sound waves and heat. Finally, pressure is applied to the painful areas to relieve pain, and stretching exercises are performed. A full session lasts approximately one hour, but complete treatment requires several sessions. However, you will feel the difference after the first session.

0x3102be6ebaf98977_0xc210511f5d614ae6.text: Since I heard it starts at 8:30 AM, I decided to go a bit early and wait. I arrived around 8:05 AM, but the doors were already open and the PCR testing area was accepting people. I received number 4. However, a woman came running almost as if she were trying to overtake me with only a 2-3 second gap. I was about to yield but decided against it. So, she couldn't overtake me. (This is where the twist begins.) But it turned out she was a travel agency employee who had brought Korean tourists. While I was getting my number, about 40 Koreans who had been on two minibuses rushed in. It turned out she was a local travel agency employee trying to get ahead of everyone else and register as a group first. Because of that 2-3 second difference, I almost ended up with number 44 instead of 4. It is really wise to go early and wait. If you are unlucky enough to be later than the travel agency shuttle, there is no hope. After that, several foreigners kept coming in as well. I recommend going as early as possible. They ask for a copy of your passport when you get your number; bringing it speeds things up a bit, but if you don't... they just make a copy for you there. I also heard that a plane ticket is required, so I printed out my airline e-ticket and brought it, but they weren't interested in it at all and it wasn't needed. They give you a paperwork form clipped to fill out. It's a questionnaire asking for your English name, nationality, occupation, address, whether you have COVID symptoms, whether you work in the medical field related to COVID-19, whether you came from a high-risk area for confirmed cases, etc., so most people end up checking "no." You just need to fill out your vaccination history, the name of the shot, and where you received it. I wrote it incorrectly and crossed it out with lines, but they said it didn't matter. I was too lazy to write the name of the hospital where I got vaccinated in English on the site, so I just wrote "hospital," but they later corrected it to "Korea Hospital." They overlook pretty much everything. ^^; I thought I would just clip my number, passport copy, and completed documents together and start right away, but I had to wait again. I sat in a chair like that until it started at 8:30. When it was my turn, they called out the number. After confirming my number at the table next to where I initially received it, they reviewed my completed documents and passport copy, made necessary corrections, and asked for 900 baht. After paying in cash, they gave me a stamped receipt. (You can pick up your results the next day using that receipt, so please keep it safe.) Then, I moved to a chair at the table right next to it. There, they re-checked my documents, stamped them, and said everything was done. I took that to the staff table near the waiting area. After reviewing my documents, they wrote my name on the test reagents and cotton swabs, and told me to take them and sit in the very front chair in that waiting area. Once there, I went to the testing chair in order to receive the test. One oral test, one nasal test. And that was it. It was around 8:50 when I finished everything. The process was on the slow side. When I asked on my way out, they told me to come back the next day at 10:30 to pick up the results. The email service was discontinued after the price changed to 900 baht. It costs 3,500 baht at the International Hospital in downtown Pattaya. A certain YouTube video claimed that if you book through a travel agency at a certain hotel, it costs 1,900 baht, so I asked that agency directly, and they said it was 2,400 baht. The price has gone up. And here, it's 900 baht. It's a profit even if you take a Bolt Taxi for a round trip for two days. When I received the results the next day, it showed that I was tested at 11:00 the previous day, and the printout indicated the results came out at 5:00 PM the previous day. Therefore, since the time starts counting from the day before the test, make sure to time your return within 48 hours. I hope you get tested cheaply and use the remaining money to treat yourself to something delicious one more time. I wish you a great trip! ^^
0x3102be6ebaf98977_0xc210511f5d614ae6.author: Vega

0x3102be6ebaf98977_0xc210511f5d614ae6.text: Visited on May 24, 2022. I arrived at 8:30 AM, the opening time, but there were only four people there. Even by 9 AM, when the PCR test was over, there were only about 10 people there. However, there's no guarantee that it will remain this crowded. All you need to bring is your passport. They'll make a copy of your passport there anyway. Of course, bringing a copy will speed up the process. They also give you a questionnaire, so just fill out the circled sections. It takes about 10 minutes. And even if you fill out the questionnaire quickly, you still have to wait for your turn. They always do the PCR test in order. The PCR test is very quick. They tell you to come pick up your results at 10:30 AM the next day. You'll be given your passport and receipt, which you should also bring. The price is 900 baht. Cash only. If you have time afterward, it would be nice to buy shrimp at the seafood market right next door and eat them on a mat. If you pay on the side, they'll cook it for you. Personally, I recommend the 300-400 baht per kilo.

0x31029660cf52e18b_0xc342db44c753983e.text: This bus terminal connects Pattaya to Suvarnabhumi Airport. It's also called Jomtien Bus Terminal. From Pattaya city, take a songthaew departing from the intersection of South Pattaya Road and Second Road for 10B. Note that buses to Ekkamai in Bangkok depart from North Pattaya Bus Terminal. Tickets to Suvarnabhumi Airport cost 143B, and reservations can be made two days in advance. Reservations are also available online (with a 25B handling fee). Any changes after purchase (such as changing the time) cost 50B. Buses depart approximately every hour from 7:00 AM, with the last bus at 9:00 PM. Carry-on luggage is free, but checked baggage costs 20B for up to 20kg, 50B for up to 30kg, and 100B for up to 50kg. The air conditioning on the bus is strong, so be sure to take precautions against the cold (though there is a toilet at the end of the bus). If the roads are not congested, you can arrive within two hours. Seats are unreserved. Please note that eating is prohibited on board the train.
0x31029660cf52e18b_0xc342db44c753983e.author: TAKASHI MIURA

0x31029660cf52e18b_0xc342db44c753983e.text: This is where the bus to Suvarnabhumi Airport departs. There are cafes, restaurants, and massage shops where you can rest, so arriving early is not a problem. Alcohol and smoking are permitted. It is easier to access than the North Pattaya bus stop and has a wider variety of shops, so it is recommended if you are going to the airport. It is about 20 minutes from Pattaya Beach. A Bolt taxi will cost 60-80 baht. You can also access it by songthaew, but you will need to transfer. If you have a fixed time, it is best to book your ticket online the day before. Online booking is not possible on the day of travel. However, even if you have booked online, please note that you will need to pick up a paper ticket at the ticket counter on the day of travel.
0x31029660cf52e18b_0xc342db44c753983e.author: chebutrip

0x31029660cf52e18b_0xc342db44c753983e.text: Arrived 10:30 am. No line. Depared 11:00 bus. Good leg room, aircon. Bus has narrow cubbies for storage inside. Modern Hwy to airport. Smooth ride. 130 baht as of November 2016 No aircon inside teninal so go across to the convience market. They have a fairly good stock of Western foods; cheese, pasteries, sandwiches etc. Don't forget your bag at the front security bag-check before you rush for your bus! Come early and grab a massage next door, or see a clinic doctor for your STD, or other ailments, a few doors down.

However, it seems some people were charged a baggage fee, so check at the terminal. There are massage parlors and restaurants nearby, so you can kill time there. There's also a supermarket. 0x30fdac6cc3be3725_0xae704c06ebde98b8.text: We arrived at the hospital 45 minutes early with our elder mini schnauzer on January 2nd. He was having breathing issues the night before. It got so bad as we were trying to wait until they opened, our pup laid down in the seat to die. We carried him up near reception, and there was nobody around. At this point he was expelling liquid from his nose, and his heart stopped as we walked up near the critical care unit door. A cleaning employee went inside the CCU, and out came I believe his name was Leo. I told him that our pup wasn’t breathing, and his heart had just stopped. He grabbed him, and ran inside with him. A few moments later the Dr. came out, and said our pup was stabilized. A few moments later we were able to enter and see him. They had a breathing tube inserted, and his heart rate wasn’t ideal, but it was ok. We visited him each day as he was recovering, and we were able to bring him home yesterday January 6th. He has been doing great so far, and seems happy to be back home. The CCU staff are amazing, and we appreciate everything your staff did to save our pups life. 🙏🏼🙏🏼
0x30fdac6cc3be3725_0xae704c06ebde98b8.author: Kirk Dershem

0x3054f3135a3ee25b_0x59e198fca8f58bc5.text: If you're visiting Thailand and want to see elephants, I highly recommend this place! All activities are elephant-friendly! Advantages: 1. You can tell the staff have a good relationship with the elephants (because the accommodation is right next to the elephants, and the environment is similar to theirs). 2. Although there are only two elephants, there's absolutely no animal droppings smell. 3. They always take videos and photos first, so you can see them before deciding whether to buy anything. I personally think it's a great deal when bundled with souvenirs. Their photography skills are good. 4. The package activities are really fun, and they don't force the elephants at all. 5. The staff are very friendly. Disadvantages: 1. The package activities are a bit short (maybe they don't want the elephants to be constantly disturbed). 2. The park is rather small, with only two elephants. 3. The souvenir is an elephant-themed notebook, but it's not very easy to write in. I personally loved it, but my travel companion was very confused; it's definitely not very practical.
0x3054f3135a3ee25b_0x59e198fca8f58bc5.author: E Nh

0x3054f3135a3ee25b_0x59e198fca8f58bc5.text: We chose Option C, and the entire activity was very well-organized in terms of timing and flow. It included feeding the elephants, preparing elephant food, and bathing them. There were people taking photos and videos throughout, and they even edited a great video at the end and provided a QR code for us to download at no extra charge. The elephants were also very well cared for, and we learned a lot about elephants. There was also an elephant veterinarian in the park. Overall, everyone in our group, including the children, thought it was a fantastic experience. 🫶🏻 Thank you for your thoughtfulness.
0x3054f3135a3ee25b_0x59e198fca8f58bc5.author: Zhen

0x3054f3135a3ee25b_0x59e198fca8f58bc5.text: For kind-hearted people sensitive to animal welfare, I recommend this place because it's truly ethical. At the elephant village, you learn about these animals, what they eat and drink, how they sleep, where they come from, you prepare their food with super friendly and very attentive guides, and you feed baby and adult elephants. I highly recommend it.
0x3054f3135a3ee25b_0x59e198fca8f58bc5.author: Ismael N.

0x3054f3135a3ee25b_0x59e198fca8f58bc5.text: Absolutely amazing experience! Very enthusiastic staff who love and care for the elephants. Definitely recommend.

0x30da3aa2fccccc1d_0x58226f9e7d906fbe.text: I had to get a crown whilst on holiday in Chiang Mai. I found Dr Pongsakorn's dental clinic and walked in off the street. I explained my problem and he took me in straight away as he had a spare appointment. He x-rayed my teeth and took me into his clinic and showed me the issue causing the problem on the x-ray screen. He discussed in perfect English 2 methods of treatment, outlining his preferred method and why. This was in fact the easier and less expensive route. I was booked in for treatment 2 days later. I had impressions taken, a temporary crown fitted and a repair made to another tooth which was sitting next to the proposed crown. The appointment was booked for 2 hours and the treatment was first class, no pain whatsoever. I was booked in for a further appointment 2 days later when the zirconium crown was to be fitted. After much attention Dr Pongsakorn was not happy with it's fit, although I thought it was fine. He apologised but said he wasn't happy and could I come back in 2 days. On the next appointment the crown was fitted, he showed me before it was fitted, it looked totally amazing. After fitting this time he was satisfied. I'm more than pleased. I asked to have my teeth cleaned also. Which I must say was second to none! In short, this man is a genius, his staff are so kind and friendly. I have never received such dedicated treatment anywhere. The treatment I had was probably one third of what I would have paid in the UK. I most certainly will be back to get more work done. His attention to detail is excellent!
0x30da3aa2fccccc1d_0x58226f9e7d906fbe.author: David Pointon

0x30da3aa2fccccc1d_0x58226f9e7d906fbe.text: This is truly a hidden gem of a dental clinic! 💖 I'm so lucky and grateful to have found Dr. Pongsakorn ✨ I had my teeth whitened, a two-hour procedure. The doctor and nurses were very professional, and the dentist cleaned my teeth very thoroughly. I'm extremely satisfied with the results! The stains are gone! My teeth are noticeably whiter! I'm so happy! Before this, I consulted with six clinics in the old city, and Pongsakorn offered the best price, including a cleaning! 👍 (Other clinics charged an extra 800-1200 baht for cleaning). The dentist can communicate in English, making the entire procedure very smooth. He's also very honest and straightforward, without any sales pitches. He explained to me that the difference between different whitening treatments lies only in the intensity of the light; the gel itself is the same. This dentist uses medium concentration light, which was perfect for my first whitening experience! 👍

0x30fdab8df1459dc9_0x437b2e53835e018f.text: A friend and I spent two challenging and rewarding weeks at Palapon in April. It was the low-season and initially there was only one other person at the camp and she left soon after we arrived. Instead of being in a large group, the two of us were fortunate to get individualized attention I signed up for the Intensive Fitness Program, and he focused on Muay Thai Training, although many of the classes overlapped. All of the instructors are professionals who are dedicated to their craft. The three yoga instructors had their own style and way of connecting with students. I was very impressed with their patience and willingness to adjust the class to suit our (my) limitations. Thanks to them my hips are no longer so tight. Klaus led the Body Weight class, which was the most fear inducing and painful activity of the day. The intensity of the movements and the focus on slow, contracted form made it a challenge. Having him stand over us provided added motivation. The Muay Thai instructors were playful but also serious about students getting the most out of the experience. I’m not naturally a puncher or kicker but I learned how to leverage angles for a more powerful kick and how to control my breathing when punching. Initially, the movements felt awkward and I was gassed after every round. By the end I felt more comfortable weaving, bobbing and striking. Klaus’ son Nick headed up the kitchen, as well as handled miscellaneous duties. The food was uniformly delicious and nutritious. We looked forward to every meal, which was always enough to power us through the day. Nick also gave us many valuable insights into Thai culture and history. His presence reminded us that Palapon is family business that was built from the ground up. For me the biggest take-aways surrounded good nutrition, consistency and mental toughness. I was already aware that I needed to improve my nutrition and push myself a bit harder. However, there’s a big difference between knowing something and experiencing it first hand. After two weeks I lost 2% body fat and about three kilos. I’m noticeably leaner (I’m 172cm and went from 74KG to 71KG), even if the physical transformation wasn’t huge. Now that I’ve returned to civilian life, I’m more conscious of my workouts and diet. The camp gave me the right tools to continue to improve my overall health. Final note: The living facilities are a bit rustic. We chose to live in the hotel down the block which was the right decisions for us. Palapon is for people who want to sweat and are willing to grind through the multitude of activities. Like any anything in life, you’ll get out of it what you put in. I highly recommend Palpon to anyone serious about optimizing their health.
0x30fdab8df1459dc9_0x437b2e53835e018f.author: Francis Huang

0x30fdab8df1459dc9_0x437b2e53835e018f.text: I recently completed the 3-month weight-loss program at Palapon, and it truly changed my life. I was very out of shape and depressed, I had completely lost control over my health, with no hope to regain it. When the scale hit 103 kg (227 lbs) and was diagnose pre-diabetic, I knew I needed to take serious action. At Palapon, I got exactly the help I needed I also needed a mental lift, and I found it there. I was lucky to have an amazing group with me, they made me feel welcomed and at home from day 1, and reminded me how much social connections can impact your health just as much as training and nutrition. I arrived open-minded, and followed the process without question. After all, my own way clearly wasn’t working! The meals were balanced, and I never felt deprived. I also practiced intermittent fasting, and surprisingly, I never felt weak or tired. I highly recommend approaching the program with this mindset, because it works. I lost 16 kg (35 lbs) — slightly below my initial goal of 20 kg (44 lbs), but I have no regrets, women nearing 50 don't lose as fast as men. What mattered most was consistency and progress. I started very round and soft and finished with visible muscles. I chose Palapon because I didn’t want a big gym full of perfectly fit people — I wanted a small group of real people like me. And that’s exactly what I found. I met amazing, supportive, and fun people, all sharing similar goals and challenges. I discovered mobility training, which I’ll definitely keep in my new routine. But my biggest revelation was Muay Thai — I absolutely loved it! I finally found a sport that I enjoy. For anyone who struggles with motivation, finding something you truly love makes all the difference. Now that I’m back home, I feel hopeful again. I still have about 15 kg (33 lbs) to lose, but it no longer feels impossible. Klaus is incredibly knowledgeable in conditioning and mobility, and he will not let you fall behind. My advice: leave your ego on the plane, trust the process, and give it your all. Push yourself, ignore the excuses your mind throws at you — but also learn your limits and when to rest. I learned how vital recovery is to real progress, the program is intense, especially when you are not already fit. I did most of it at the beginning and increased the load progressively. Palapon gave me more than physical results — it gave me hope, confidence, and a love for training again. 💪 . So even if everything wasn't perfect, I achieved what I was here for and more. I would love to do another program to complete my new goal now that I feel stronger. I am definitely happy it was an amazing adventure.
0x30fdab8df1459dc9_0x437b2e53835e018f.author: Ginny Bertier

0x30fdab8df1459dc9_0x437b2e53835e018f.text: Palapon!! Hua Hin's Hidden Muay Thai/ Fitness/Weightloss Sanctaury! Palapon is a fantastic Muay Thai and fitness camp. The training and the diet is second to none! Excellent regime and great instructors. What I'd say is... TRUST THE PROCESS. This was the second time visiting the camp for a 3 week weight loss stint. I was in Palapon before in Feb '24. I was also back there in Nov 24 for 10 x walk-in classes. I absolutely love this sanctuary. I'll be back again soon too. When walking on to camp you can't but notice the beautifully manicured garden with birds, squirrels and geckos moving around the place. The landscape staff are there most days doing their bit to maintain a fine relaxing environment for the participants! Klaus is an extremely knowledgeable fitness instructor. He helped me overcome a couple of injury niggles I had before arriving in camp. He architects the training to suit your needs and your abilities. While I was there I learned and developed a good habit mindset. This really helps from techniques, pushing yourself at the right time and diet and what foods are good and bad. He has a mind full of information. Tap into it while you're there!!! Klaus is also a very compassionate and empathetic person and helped calm down when receiving bad news from home. He listened and gave me advice and it really helped me. He's practically minded and to the point. I'm a firm believer of showing up on time for class and showing commitment to everything you do! Klaus thrives when he sees this! I would highly recommend Palapon whether you travelling solo or a couple or with friends. You'll meet so many different people from all walks of life. It's an absolute education learning about different cultures and environments. Amazing! From what I've encountered in Palapon, everyone is on the same wavelength bar the odd one or two. People are looking for the same or similar outcome or goal. But they are also seeking a new way of life to be able to take home with them. It's about creating good habits and being able to implement them when arriving home. The training I won't lie can be tough going especially in the 35C heat. But the satisfaction you get after achieving each class is brilliant. The accommodation is very good. You have a choice of an on-site camp room or the local Hotel with a decent 25m pool that's 5 mins walk away. The food is nourishing and is healthy and geared towards your program. Try the intermittent fasting with training! You'll achieve great results. Thank you so much Klaus! You're a legend and very good friend. Thanks for everything. I'll see you again soon! 🙏💪💯
0x30fdab8df1459dc9_0x437b2e53835e018f.author: Mick P

0x30fdab8df1459dc9_0x437b2e53835e018f.text: I recently completed a transformative two-week stay at Palapon Fitness Camp. At 47 years old, I'm in reasonable shape, though not nearly as fit as I used to be. Accompanied by a friend, we arrived pleasantly surprised by the well-maintained training complex, complete with beautiful gardens, a pool, and a cabanas. Klaus, the owner, is not only a gracious host but also an exceptionally knowledgeable trainer. He crafted a superb program that gradually increased in intensity, ensuring it was always challenging yet safe. The Muay Thai and yoga coaches—Dang, Bird, Anna, Ghan, and Chomphu—are top-notch, helping us to progressively enhance our skills and fitness gains. The meal plan, which included three meals a day for six days a week, was perfectly designed to boost energy, build muscle, and reduce fat. The breakfast consisted of yogurt, museli, protein powder and berries. The other meals, a combination of cuisines including Thai, prepared by Nick and Thi were consistently delicious, satisfying even the pickiest eaters without any cravings for external food. Inspired by the meals, I plan on recreating some of these healthy and tasty dishes back home. For accommodations, Palapon offers the choice between on-site bungalows and apartment-style residences a five-minute walk away. We opted for the apartments, and recommend this option to enjoy the added privacy, kitchenette, air conditioning, and your own showers—quite necessary after the rigorous workouts. The stats! Over the two weeks, I lost 3% body fat (2.4 kg), gained 200 g of muscle, and reduced my visceral fat from 3 to 1.9, thanks to the healthy diet. More importantly, I left feeling healthier, stronger, and leaner, with a renewed perspective on food and fitness and healthier habits that I now consider my new normal. For anyone considering a fitness retreat, I highly recommend Palapon. Make the decision after reading the reviews to change your life. Investing in your health is truly the best decision you can make—it always pays dividends!
0x30fdab8df1459dc9_0x437b2e53835e018f.author: Pong Yen

0x30fdab8df1459dc9_0x437b2e53835e018f.text: I was here on the weightloss program: Lets get one things straight if you are going here, you are not going on a lazy holiday. You will be suffering at times. If you want to be pampered, go to a luxury resort. But if you do it well, it can be a (life) changing experience in becoming more physically active and healthy person. What was exactly my goal. Not that I wasn't a happy person, but my habits and physique weren't like I wanted them and somehow i couldn't make that change on my own. Don't expect Klaus and his team to change that over night, but if your are in the right mindset the are a really huge help in the right direction! I made great progress during my stay and not only physically, that is something very positive and valuable i will take home. Next to some beautiful memories and precious friends i made there. A shared goal will unite 😊. In a bit under eight weeks my weight went down from 123,9 to 108 kilo. That is a loss of 15,9 kilo🥳 (35 pounds). I feel great and sometimes I almost don't recognise myself in the mirror 😆. Early 2024 I underwent surgery on my belly and was still experiencing pain of that when i came to Palapon in November'25. But since my stay then no more pain. If you think your stay is going to be an easy ride let me warn you: Unless you are used to working out and fastening, you will suffer, experience pain, feel sorry for yourself, ask yourself what the h*** have i started. At times I found my self whining like a little cry baby. Although that isn't my style. At those times I found Klaus and Tom a great help, listening and getting me back motivated. Thank you, @Klaus and @Tom for listening to my whining every "now and then". Klaus thanks for the very subtle (sometimes less subtle 😂)kicks under my butt to get me motivated and going again. "Life is like riding a bicycle. To keep your balance, you must keep moving! Team Palapon, thanks for the push i needed!
0x30fdab8df1459dc9_0x437b2e53835e018f.author: Harro Gerber

0x30fdab8df1459dc9_0x437b2e53835e018f.text: Palapon – No Nonsense, Outcome Focused, Life-Changing Reboot I spent one month at Palapon weight loss and fitness camp in Hua Hin, Thailand and would highly recommend this experience to anyone truly interested in a reboot to jump-start a fitness transformation focused on lasting results. In January 2025 I was the heaviest I have ever been, having neglected my personal fitness for over 5 years. I knew I needed time to focus intently on restarting fitness habits and searched globally for a program that would best suit my needs. I was not looking for a luxurious “holiday” fitness destination, but rather a program truly focused on structured exercise, nutrition, and results. Klaus, owner or Palapon, and his Team delivered. Over 28 days I dropped 8.5 kg – my target was 9.0. The structure and support were perfect. I enjoyed the camp setting and appreciated the sense of community Klaus creates as fellow “campers” encourage each other. The group size of roughly 12 participants maximum is perfect for getting to know and rely upon one another which goes a long way toward accountability – not just to your own goals, but to the group as well. The Team was fantastic – from the daily meal preparation and service to the personal attention during Yoga and Muay Thai classes and even a chaperone for our morning walk/runs. And finally, the personal attention from Klaus was outstanding. He provided nutritional counseling and led daily “Klausfit” sessions as well as mobility focused classes. There is no hiding from Klaus – be it during classes or when out on the town – he is always watching! Thank you Palapon – and thank you Klaus for the reboot and for providing a structure I have been able to incorporate into my daily routine. The fitness journey continues.
0x30fdab8df1459dc9_0x437b2e53835e018f.author: Don Bennett

0x30fdab8df1459dc9_0x437b2e53835e018f.text: Spent 10 days at Palapon in Feb 2023, and I would highly recommend it for anyone with a willingness to lose weight, get fit, or just to change up an unhealthy lifestyle. Owner Klaus and wife Valerie are lovely and really want to help you improve: Klaus will ensure that you put in the work, whilst Valerie's nutritional cooking is actually delicious. His kids are also very nice and helpful. Stay in the villas if you want the convenience of being on-site and to have somewhere close to relax or 'thai shower' between classes, or stay in the apartments (also close by) if you want greater privacy. Pool is relaxing after class, and the Hua Hin area is nice to explore if you have the energy. Trust me though, you may not! Inclusion of massages, body scans and medical tests was a nice touch. The classes are all good, I enjoyed the 'Klaus Fit' (think cross fit) and Muay Thai especially. Yoga was new to me (and more difficult than expected) but the teachers were excellent - and patient! One day a week 'off' is a much needed break that also allows exploration of the wider area, and there are some beautiful sites to visit. Flexible programs are available, I did some surfing whilst a few others were doing kite-surfing lessons alongside a portion of the daily Palapon activities. If you are wanting a luxury Club-Med 5-Star resort-style fitness program this might not be for you, but if you are intent on working hard to improve your life or lose the weight then I suggest going to Palapon. It might not be easy, but you'll get amazing results. I did and the other lovely people around me staying longer even more so. I'll be going back - hopefully next time for a longer to really cement the gains.
0x30fdab8df1459dc9_0x437b2e53835e018f.author: Cam Cowie

0x30fdab8df1459dc9_0x437b2e53835e018f.text: Thumbs all the way up for a real holistic fitness experience. During my stay of ten days, I gained a lot of information about my body, how it works and how I could make it work even better. If you are ready to accept the challenge, go for it! You will work out with Klaus only in the mornings and you might think he is just an ordinary instructor, showing some known moves. In reality, he is a real "sensei", watching you, analysing you, discovering your weaknesses which you are not even aware of and gently approaching you with suggestions - nutrition, exercise, massage, mental fitness boosters, etc. - which leads you to a life changing path. You will work in a small group, and yet Klaus will take care of each and everyone individually, keeping an eye on during the whole day! This is not a place for those leaving on the surface and urging to share fancy pictures of "things". But, this is a place for the ones who would accept the challenge, commit to goals and respect their instructor and at the end enjoy sharing a fancy picture of their own! Keep in mind that the camp is a camp and if you need facilities, consider staying at the apartment or arrange your own fancy five star. Palapon team members are all experts on motivating, they will not leave you on your own and push you to make the most out of your retreat. This might be exhausting, considering that you are totally out of your comfort zone. So make sure you bring your inner motivation and full commitment with you. Overall I would definetly suggest Palapon to those who are ready to face their weaknesses, to learn how to eliminate them and who are committed to reach their goals.

0x30e29fd7db9a62e7_0x8257a5e6a2dc2d2a.text: I came to BPC Sathorn to prepare for and recover from a stem cell injection for a serious left knee injury (Grade 3-4 cartilage damage). The program covered two phases: pre-injection VMO activation and weight redistribution work, and post-injection rehabilitation coordinated carefully around my recovery protocol. The assessment from day one was thorough. They identified weak quads, a 15-year weight-shift compensation habit, and a significant range of motion deficit. Rather than treating symptoms they addressed root causes throughout. Tul handled my post-injection sessions with great attention to detail, progressively working through IT band tightness and adapting exercises as the recovery advanced. At 6 weeks post-injection my range of motion went from 110 degrees to 135 degrees bending, and from restricted straightening to full extension. BPC was a big part of that result. Highly recommend for anyone managing a complex knee recovery.

0x30e29f2c6112a10d_0x6958ccb92e0dc5c4.text: I had a 2,700-graft DHI hair transplant with Dr Danai at BEQ Hair Center in September and had a really positive experience. I decided to get a transplant back in March and spent around two months speaking to different clinics in both Turkey and Thailand before choosing BEQ. One of the main reasons I went with them was that they really listened to what I wanted from my hairline. I didn’t want an overly conservative or already-mature/receded hairline, and BEQ were probably the most enthusiastic about finding a design that matched my goals while still being realistic for my donor area. I travelled from Japan for the procedure, and communication beforehand was always easy. The clinic itself is modern and clean, and on the day I never felt rushed. Dr Danai spent plenty of time discussing and designing the hairline with me and was very involved throughout the procedure. DHI was recommended for my case because I wanted to cover the areas where I’d already lost my hair while also bringing the hairline down, rather than simply filling in and maintaining my existing hairline. This was actually one of the main reasons I chose BEQ, as some of the other clinics I spoke to were much more conservative about lowering it. I’d originally been estimated around 1,800–2,200 grafts, but once Dr Danai assessed everything properly in person, it became clear that achieving the coverage and lower hairline I wanted would require more, so we ultimately went with 2,700 grafts. The surgery is definitely a long day, especially with 2,700 grafts, but I was really impressed by the patience of the whole team. The anaesthetic honestly wasn’t bad, and once it had kicked in, I couldn’t feel the extraction or implantation at all (although hearing the hairs being implanted into my head was pretty funny). The hardest part was probably just lying in the same position for a long time, but I recognise that mine was quite a big procedure. Despite working on my head for hours, nobody ever seemed rushed, annoyed or eager to finish. They remained friendly and attentive throughout and just kept going until everything was done properly. The whole medical team was very professional, and I felt completely safe throughout. I never really had any reason not to. The aftercare has also been very thorough. I was given medication and clear instructions for the recovery period and returned to the clinic for cleaning and follow-up after the procedure. It’s still far too early for me to judge the final result, but so far I’m very happy with the hairline, graft placement, and healing. I’ll update my review further down the line once the hair has actually had time to grow!

I also asked to get braces so the doctor recommended Danish 3-D braces which would work for my teeth and could be made during my time in Chiang Mai. Dr. Homdok was able fit my son into his schedule at a moments notice and complete the work without causing my son pain during or after the partial pulpectomy and filling. Dr. Homdok and his staff went above and beyond to provide exceptional services to me and my son as well as recommend places to visit in Chiang Mai. The receptionist, Shampoo called grab cabs for us and even dropped us off to our hotel a few times. We are grateful to this clinic for their dedication to their clients and for their affordable prices!!!! If you have a chance to visit to Chiang Mai and need teeth work, please visit AYESays Clinic or just drop in to say hello! We will be back for sure !

0x305031e5dcef26e7_0x12e63e89dc20b562.text: I visited Dr. Prasit's practice because of problems with my left ear, and I can only say: I highly recommend him. For over a week, I'd been experiencing discomfort—my ear was constantly moist, fluid was leaking, and I had an unpleasant pressure sensation, similar to what you feel on an airplane. I also kept hearing a popping sound in my ear. I arrived at the practice shortly before 5:00 p.m., even though appointments don't start until 5:00 p.m. At that time, there were already over 20 patients waiting. After checking in, I was kindly told to come back around 7:00 p.m. This worked perfectly: I didn't have to wait even five minutes and was seen immediately. Dr. Prasit is a very friendly and experienced doctor, speaks excellent English, and immediately recognized my problem. After the examination, he used professional instruments to remove a large amount of earwax that had accumulated in front of my ear canal. I'd never experienced anything like it before. I felt a significant improvement immediately after the treatment. I also received antibiotic ear drops and tablets from the pharmacy and am supposed to come back for a check-up in a week. Conclusion: Competent, efficient, friendly – ​​highly recommended.
0x305031e5dcef26e7_0x12e63e89dc20b562.author: Andreas Wiegant

0x305031e5dcef26e7_0x12e63e89dc20b562.text: They're living in the future here! Poor France, where I live. I'll explain how it works for foreigners. You go in and they ask for some kind of ID; I gave them my driver's license or something similar just to complete the paperwork—it's easier than spelling it out. You're in the waiting room, and your turn comes. Be careful, it's up to you to figure out roughly when it's your turn because I thought they were calling me, so I let several people go ahead until I understood. Then you see the doctor, who writes his report and sends it to the assistant in the waiting room. She calls you in and gives you the medication that's been prepared for your treatment. Basically, it took me 30 minutes even though there were at least five or six people ahead of me, and it would have only taken 20 minutes if I'd been seen first. But even if it had taken an hour, I would still have been happy because in France it takes between 3 and 6 months to get an appointment with an ENT specialist. I woke up at 9 a.m., I was in pain, I looked up ENT on Google, and by the time I'd gone there on my scooter and come back, by 11:30 a.m. I was in my hotel room with my medication! Incredible!

0x30e2993bbc8caf2d_0x11700c1696619f98.text: Review of LASIK Surgery for Someone with Very Severe Nearsightedness (8.75 diopters, 1.25 astigmatism) I booked through Dr. Namphueng's Facebook page, and the admin responded very quickly and efficiently. I was impressed from the start. Dr. Namphueng offers surgery at several hospitals, but since Saturday was convenient, I chose Thonburi Bamrungmuang Hospital. Due to my severe nearsightedness, I opted for the Femto Lasik technique. The hospital and Dr. Namphueng's team provided excellent care from the moment I arrived. The morning session included an eye exam, corneal thickness check, and a briefing on post-LASIK care. Around 11 am, we prepared for the surgery, which was very relaxing and painless. Each eye took only a short time. Finally, my world is bright again after wearing glasses for almost 20 years! The package deal cost 49,990 baht, including medication and contact lens fees. The hospital room fee was 1,500 baht. For anyone still hesitant about whether someone with severe nearsightedness can have LASIK surgery, I encourage you to get a checkup first. Your world will change! 💕💕 LASIK and Double Eyelid Surgery by Dr. Namphueng

0x3102bf4625707245_0x85aa4f962358a33d.text: My experience at Clear Vision Care Pattaya was completely different from most optical stores I've visited. As someone who is very particular about choosing lenses, I really appreciated the professional and detailed explanations provided by all the store staff. Consultation is by appointment, so each customer receives personalized time and attention. Dr. Tew is also an experienced optometrist, who has also worked as a professor and collaborated with one of Bangkok's leading hospitals. He is supported by a team of friendly and competent assistants. Their service made me feel like I was being treated with utmost care, something I rarely encounter in the optical industry. One of the most impressive things is their dedication to helping customers understand the products they will use. Instead of simply showing catalogs, they provide live lens samples and explain the differences between each option in great detail. The explanations are very easy to understand and helped me make the right decision for my vision needs. In terms of pricing, I found the offerings quite competitive. They offer the same lens brands as other optical shops, but with a service and consultation that I find far superior. The combination of professional expertise, customer education, and reasonable prices provides a very attractive added value. For tourists visiting Pattaya, this shop is not located in the main tourist area. However, because it serves a large local clientele and has a good reputation among the Thai community, I feel more confident in the quality of the service provided. The shop is also quite easy to find and not too far from the city center. I highly recommend Clear Vision Care Pattaya to anyone looking for a trustworthy optical service. They don't just focus on sales, but also ensure every detail is meticulously checked before glasses are delivered to customers. Their commitment to quality and customer satisfaction is what I believe sets them apart from many other optical shops.

0x30e29e5ab96bd301_0x198e636f2e2c9317.text: I had an excellent experience at Bangkok Hospital Dental Center, and I am truly grateful for the care and support I received from everyone there. I walked into the dental center without any appointment, simply to understand what options were available for my two missing front teeth. From the moment I arrived, one of the staff members kindly guided me to the reception, and to my surprise, they arranged a same-day consultation for me with Assoc. Prof. Dr. Kanokwan Nisapakulthorn. When I reached the consultation floor, I was warmly welcomed. Even before meeting the doctor, the team took my X-ray and prepared everything thoroughly so the discussion with the doctor would be clear and efficient. After reviewing my case, the doctor recommended dental implants. Since I only had 7 days left on my trip, she suggested doing the implant on the same day, which I really appreciated. At that point, I was not fully prepared for the payment due to card limit restrictions from my home country’s bank. Ms. Jantima Kachenchart, the Dental Manager, personally stepped in and helped me with all the required documents to submit to the bank for the card limit extension. The admin staff (unfortunately I didn’t catch her name) was also extremely attentive and supportive throughout the process. After a short waiting time of about 10–15 minutes, Dr. Kanokwan was ready and took me in for the procedure. She was incredibly caring, friendly, and professional. She explained every step clearly and performed two dental implants with bone grafting very carefully within about 1.5 hours. There was no excessive pain, and I felt comfortable and well-informed throughout the entire procedure. Overall, I am extremely happy with the service I received at Bangkok Hospital Dental Center. From the reception to the medical team, everyone was kind, friendly, and genuinely helpful. I highly recommend this dental center to anyone looking for professional, efficient, and compassionate dental care.

0x3054f557387b376f_0x208d6f6bce01195a.text: Golf (the owner) is a life saver. I lost my glasses in Koh Lipe and there were no optics there or in other small islands. I would only be in Koh Samui 1 week later and would stay for 3 days only, not enough time to make a new pair of glasses. I was lucky that my wife could track him down and talk to him to explain the situation. I had a digital copy my last prescription and we sent it to him. He said he would order the lenses for me, with no payment in advance, and once I would he in Samui I'd go the shop, chose a frame and he would cut the lenses into it "in less than 40 minutes. Maybe 20". A couple of days later I arrived in Koh Samui and went to the shop. He didn't have many options of frames that suited my needs. Instead of trying to compel me into buying one of his own, he encouraged me to look for frames in other shops (even gave me references where to go) and bring it to him. Very professional! Once I found a frame that fitted me, I brought it to Golf. He double checked my prescription by applying the sight test on me. As promised he did manage to assemble them in 20 minutes (impressive!). 0x3102968a40c8ce99_0x205d03e135c97cc9.text: A friend of mine in Jomtien recommended me to visit Ocean Dental Centre to investigate the cost of a crown, which my dentist in the UK had strongly advised me to have. After a thorough oral investigation I was quoted a price just a little over half what my UK dentist would have charged for a dental crown of the same quality. At my next appointment the excellent and friendly Thai dentist worked for over 2 hours with painstaking attention to every detail, right down to the matching of colours with neighbouring teeth – although ‘painstaking’ is an ill-chosen word here, as the whole procedure was completely painless. At the final session he fitted the newly minted crown, only to express some dissatisfaction with the seating, so he removed it, did a little remedial work, and finally the job was done. He handed me a mirror; I had to ask him, in all seriousness, which was the tooth he had treated. It was impossible to tell. This was serious, dedicated professional work. ‘Cherished’ is not a word I often use in connection with medical procedures, but here I felt cherished throughout. It’s common to hear people say ‘worth a detour’. Ocean Dental Centre is worth a very long detour indeed. Five stars, that being all the app will allow.
0x3102968a40c8ce99_0x205d03e135c97cc9.author: John T

0x3102968a40c8ce99_0x205d03e135c97cc9.text: My experience was TOP NOTCH ! ! ! Read on if you'd like to know why..... On an extended holiday I cracked an upper molar. Dr. Toto took x-rays and gave me a diagnosis and prognosis on the day I called. I was able to conveniently schedule all the needed dates for a root canal with a permanent crown. He and his staff were perfectly polite and professional. Every reasonable effort was implemented to reduce transmission of Covid-19. I've never had a numbing agent injection before that was administered with so little discomfort. I didn't feel it. The absence of pain is pleasure. As long as Dr. Toto is actively treating patients and I am in Thailand, I will never use another dentist. I am 100% sure, I could not find a better dentist. Price? I never checked around to compare. I can only say..... It seemed like a low price to me. Thank you again Dr. Toto and to all your wonderful staff. Francis

0x30da3b146208107d_0x1245338c57cb2f17.text: Very impressive and warm experience! I came here mainly to get help for my knee pain, but ended up receiving far more care and clarity than I expected. After three sessions, I finally understand what has been happening in my body for years. Dr. Pat didn’t just look at my knee — he looked at my whole system. He helped me see how my knee issues, my shoulder and neck tension, and even my TMJ are all connected. For the first time, everything made sense. Each session combined different approaches — physiotherapy, osteopathy-style adjustments, chiropractic-style releases, manual work, cupping, and targeted muscle therapy. In most places, I would have needed three or four different clinics to get this kind of integrated treatment. Here, I got all of it in one place, from a team that genuinely pays attention. My knee feels lighter, my shoulder and neck finally know what “normal” can feel like again, and even my TMJ feels relieved in a way I haven’t felt for years. More importantly, I now have a clear plan: what to train, how to sit, how to take care of my joints, and how to prevent the same problems from returning. I’ve seen doctors in Singapore and elsewhere before, but none of them connected the dots the way Dr. Pat did. I’m truly grateful for the care, the patience, and the kindness from him and his team. When I return to Chiang Mai, I will definitely come back here. Thank you, Dr. Pat and the whole team, for taking such good care of me.

0x30da3b146208107d_0x1245338c57cb2f17.text: As a digital nomad, I've experienced the discomfort of makeshift work setups while traveling. Recently, I pinched a nerve doing dumbbell deadlifts at the gym. The pain was intense, and I struggled to move or pick things up. After just one session with Mr. Patt, I regained 80% of my mobility. Following three more sessions, I felt incredible. The team is highly professional and knowledgeable about nerve and muscle connections. Mr. Patt accurately diagnosed my issue and provided effective treatment. Prices are reasonable at 1200 THB for the first visit and 1000 THB for subsequent sessions. They also offer certified sports massages for the same price, unlike many uncertified places in Thailand. The clinic is immaculate, and the service is exceptional from the moment you walk in. I highly recommend this place and will visit every time I'm in Chiang Mai!

0x30da3b146208107d_0x1245338c57cb2f17.text: The osteopathic adjustment experience here was excellent. Instead, they first assessed my body condition carefully, then gradually worked on releasing muscle tension, used some adjustment tools, and finally performed the alignment treatment. After the session, my neck and shoulders felt much lighter, and my whole body felt more “open.” Even walking felt smoother and more natural. The environment was clean, quiet, and very relaxing. Overall, the experience felt professional, attentive, and responsible. 0x30da255ae7380ae7_0x3bfcce7acc45cfac.text: My experience at Bangkok Hospital Chiang Mai was nothing short of exceptional. While traveling in Thailand, I unexpectedly needed emergency medical care — always a stressful situation, especially in a foreign country. From the moment I arrived, the professionalism and efficiency of the hospital staff immediately put me at ease. The level of care I received was truly impressive. I underwent a comprehensive evaluation that included an ultrasound, a cardiogram (ECG), and a chest X-ray. I was examined by three different doctors, each thorough, attentive, and reassuring. Communication was clear, and the staff spoke excellent English, which made the entire process smooth and comfortable. What stood out even more was the cost. Without any insurance, the total for this extensive emergency workup came to approximately 200 US dollars. Considering the quality of care, modern facilities, and speed of service, the value was remarkable. The hospital itself is modern, clean, and extremely well organized — comparable to high-end private medical centers anywhere in the world. There was no sense of chaos or delay, just calm efficiency and genuine patient care. Travelers often worry about healthcare abroad, but my experience here completely changed that perspective. The combination of high-level medical expertise, excellent service, and reasonable pricing was extraordinary. I would not hesitate to recommend Bangkok Hospital Chiang Mai to anyone traveling in Thailand. It provided peace of mind in a moment when it mattered most.
0x30da255ae7380ae7_0x3bfcce7acc45cfac.author: Joe Pazzo

0x30da255ae7380ae7_0x3bfcce7acc45cfac.text: My experience as a walk-in with minor injuries (road rash wounds & knee ligament damage from a bike accident), was top class 🙏 from the moment I got out of the taxi a porter was coming with a wheelchair to assist me. I was quickly assessed and then wheeled to the correct department where I was triaged and didn't have to wait long to see a doctor. It wasn't long again before I had an x-ray and again, a short wait until the results. Nothing was too much as they wheeled me and waited for two toilet visits and a cafe run (a very minimalist coffee/snack cafe in the hospital). The most note-worthy was my experience with a young female doctor and her assistant nurse. They were both so friendly and kindly spoke great English. They could see that gauze was stuck in my wounds from a previous treatment at a lesser establishment, and they were so delicate and gentle when removing them, constantly apologising and making sure I was ok! I'm from the UK and have never had a doctor spend time doing something like this, usually a nurse who is overworked and has to rush through. Their follow-up care and attention to detail with little gift-style hospital bags for prescriptions is a really nice touch. They have free water cups everywhere; high, wing-back comfy chairs; relaxing grand piano playing; high ceilings; large windows; plenty of light; modern interior and very friendly, relaxed atmosphere. Not very busy, just a nice steady pace. A very redemptive experience for me after some traumas in hospitals before.
0x30da255ae7380ae7_0x3bfcce7acc45cfac.author: Miriam Marshall

0x30da255ae7380ae7_0x3bfcce7acc45cfac.text: Broken Nose Surgery I’m sharing this because reviews here are mixed, and my experience was very positive. After a head injury that caused heavy bleeding and a cut near my eye, I was assessed quickly and given both an X-ray and CT scan. I initially wondered if this was excessive, but the CT revealed multiple fractures — so I’m glad it was done. I was then seen by a plastic surgeon who clearly explained the results and my options, without pressure. Based on the extent of the damage, she recommended immediate surgery under general anaesthetic. Naturally this was worrying (it’s your face), but everything was explained thoroughly, including risks, which I also independently verified with UK doctors in my family. The surgery went very well. My nose was realigned with minimal visible scarring once the stitches were removed. Aftercare was excellent, and the room and facilities were very comfortable. When you’re injured and anxious it’s easy to question timing, tests, or communication — I did at first. But with hindsight, the care was professional, thorough, and genuinely reassuring. If you have insurance, I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend this hospital.

0x30da255ae7380ae7_0x3bfcce7acc45cfac.text: For the past 2 years I've gone to the Bangkok Hospital in Bangkok for my annual checkup. Chiang Mai is also closer to where I live. I was totally impressed with the facilities. With a new building added and the original site renovated, this is a super modern facility. Some of the equipment were things I've never seen before. Staff are excellent. There's an obvious high degree of training, and they're also nice people. The hospital also has a "plaza" as in Bangkok, but it was not all fast food. There is a food court with Thai offerings, a sit down Japanese, and a Starbucks. I did have to wait a bit longer than previously for my final consultation with Doctor Vatanapunpituk, but in the end I had a much longer and more in depth consultation than in either of my earlier checkups. The doctor not only reviewed everything, but spent time explaining what it all meant and what I needed to do next.

0x30da255ae7380ae7_0x3bfcce7acc45cfac.text: After a fall, we needed hospital care and contacted two hospitals. One was unhelpful, but this hospital immediately told us to come in with no issues. The doctors recommended 24-hour observation as a precaution for any underlying issues. Everything was clearly explained and he was admitted immediately. The entire process took under two hours. We were extremely impressed with the hospital’s standards, cleanliness, and the professionalism of the staff. The room was excellent, complete with Netflix and room service. Every nurse knew my father by name and had a clear treatment and pain-management plan in place, including medications prepared and ready for discharge. The level of organisation was outstanding. Pricing was also very reasonable. Easily the best hospital experience we’ve had anywhere in the world, and we’ve been to more than a few. Would definitely recommend.

0x30da3be7dfcc4c87_0x843a6c20c13c7ae5.text: I visited an acupuncture clinic because the pain from tennis elbow was so severe that even clenching my fist was difficult. Although there are other long-standing and famous Chinese medicine clinics in Chiang Mai, I felt I would need multiple treatments, so I looked for a place nearby and ended up here. The doctor recommended five sessions, and I completed my fourth today. I had already been stuck in a vicious cycle of treatment and recurrence for tennis elbow in my left arm for nearly three years, and I have experience receiving Pro-Rinse injections twice in Korea and once in Chiang Mai. However, this time, I developed acute tennis elbow in my right arm, causing significant discomfort in my daily life, so I tried acupuncture treatment for the first time. Although it takes longer than Pro-Rinse injections, it is definitely effective, and I really appreciated being able to receive treatment for shoulder stiffness or wrist pain whenever I had them. I highly recommend this clinic to anyone suffering from chronic pain or sudden muscle and ligament pain. The doctor here is a young person who studied in China and is very kind and proactive. For your reference, communication in Chinese is the most fluent here for foreigners, but English is also available.

0x30e2999c93d404f9_0x51cf2c5ebbdf4f4.text: I learned about Dr. Itth and Issavee Clinic from YouTube. Before deciding, I watched and compared many clinics I found on YouTube. Ultimately, I chose Issavee because, based on their content, I felt that the doctor didn't focus on selling procedures, but rather on assessing and recommending what was truly suitable for each patient. That's why I wanted to try it myself. Initially, I came for a consultation regarding several treatments, but I was impressed from the consultation stage. The doctor took a very detailed medical history, including my treatment history, health, lifestyle, medications/supplements I take, and family history, before planning my treatment. What I liked most was that the doctor didn't follow every patient's wishes, but first assessed what was truly suitable and safe for me. After reviewing my detailed medical history and health, the doctor recommended some things that shouldn't be done at this time and suggested more suitable alternatives, prioritizing my health and long-term outcomes. This made me feel like I made the right choice. The doctor prioritizes the patient's long-term outcome over pushing procedures, and also provided advice on diet and supplements suitable for me. The staff was also lovely and provided excellent service. The aftercare was great, with follow-up appointments every 1-2 days, making me feel cared for and attentive from the first day to the end. I was very impressed with the doctor and the Issavee team.

0x30e29eba0f1c6fb1_0xb7f77176114b23bc.text: What a well-oiled machine this place was! Everything ran smoothly and everyone working was kind and helpful. I was able to input the correct location on Grab so my driver dropped me off at the door of the right building. As soon as you walk in, you’ll be asked to scan a QR code to register, and you’ll leave your passport with a woman at a desk on the far left hand side. She’ll make a laminated card for you to bring with you and then you’ll go to the third floor. Go towards the right and check in with staff. I had a consultation with a doctor who spoke excellent English and discussed each location I’d be visiting on my trip and a specific timeline for when I’d need to begin taking malaria medication. I also spoke with him about my intended stops on my trip and he recommended a yellow fever vaccine. Top tier care. Would absolutely recommend.

0x30502f4ed1ce7243_0xb4b6e3496ba586a.text: I rescued two 4-month-old kittens, Bob and Agnes, after their mother was hit by a car two weeks ago. I found them in a garage where my friend was working on his car. This same friend, who lives in Rawai, recommended Vetmed Animal Hospital in Phuket, and it turned out to be the best decision ever. After a blood test, it was revealed that both kittens had parvovirus, and one had mild FIV. The Vetmed team took exceptional care of Bob and Agnes, providing condition reports with pictures and videos at least three times a day. Their genuine passion for helping animals was evident, and they treated Bob and Agnes with incredible kindness. I would have loved for Vetmed to continue caring for them, but I live up north in Choeng Thale, so I had to bring them home after four days of being admitted. The doctor at Vetmed prepared all the necessary referral letters for me to take Bob and Agnes to a local vet to continue their treatment. As a first-time pet owner with no experience in looking after kittens, I was grateful for Vetmed’s ongoing support. They continue to reply to all my questions and even call to check on the kittens post-discharge. I am deeply grateful for their kindness and care for Bob and Agnes. I highly recommend Vetmed to any pet owners living in the Rawai and Chalong areas.

0x30e29f514e4255df_0xb0c0fad80afcc926.text: I've been coming here for dental work for a long time because I used to work in the building next door, so it was convenient to walk. But what I love most is the teeth cleaning; it's no longer scary! The dentist is very gentle. They constantly ask how I'm doing, if it hurts, and tell me if it's painful or sensitive. If I can tolerate it, they'll continue; if not, they'll ask if I want a local anesthetic. I get everything done here related to teeth (except braces, because I don't know if the dentist does orthodontics, haha). Oh, and I don't think they do wisdom tooth extractions or other tooth extractions, so you'll have to go elsewhere. But for basic dental work like teeth cleaning and fillings, I highly recommend this place. Even after leaving my job to become a housewife in Samut Sakhon province, I still come here for dental work because it's so good I wouldn't dare go anywhere else. But if you want to come in for dental work, I recommend making an appointment in advance. Or if you really can't wait, you can call the nurses to ask about availability or schedule an appointment for the earliest possible date. ~There's parking for 2-3 cars in front of the clinic. ~There's seating for 2-4 people waiting inside the clinic. ~The place is clean and not crowded. ~The shop is located right by the road, just a short distance in, very easy to find. It's on the left-hand side. ~Opening hours: Monday to Saturday, 11:00 AM to 5:00-6:00 PM (I think, but not sure because I've never been there close to closing time). ~Phone number: 02-681-2348

0x30e29f514e4255df_0xb0c0fad80afcc926.text: I've been using this dental service for a very long time. The dentist is lovely and attentive throughout the procedure. Every time I come, he'll teach me about teeth, why things are like this and what causes them. Most importantly, he has a very gentle hand. It doesn't hurt at all. 0x3054fcbad23093ad_0xa7fa3097922e41d8.text: I had a motorbike accident while making a turn at slow speed there was small gravel you couldn't see and bike wiped out. I went to a pharmacy that was close to where the accident took place and got it dressed and cleaned up, after 3 days noticing one of the scars wasn't healing fast enough I went to Ocean Medical Clinic. Nurse Ying and her team took great care of me! Staff was friendly and things were done sanitarily. And they always made sure I wasn't in pain as they were cleaning and removing dead skin, so that things would heal properly. I probably should have went sooner, even though it was much more expensive than what I was charged at the pharmacy can't really put a price on good health and the knowledge. And at ~US$275 total thats not too bad as it covered me going for 3 additional days to get everything changed. Would definitely have been way more back in the states

0x3102950003630487_0x364be3e818b33875.text: Stop looking at other places, this is where you want to come get your treatments! Like many other travelers who use Google reviews to find English friendly places; I did the same. A famous Muay Thai fighter came and left a review which prompted me to visit myself. I showed up unannounced without an appointment on a Tuesday at 11am. The front desk was very professional and courteous while asking questions in order to determine what treatments are necessary. They offer cupping, acupuncture, blood letting, gua sha, ear points and a few others. After speaking with reception, I had lucked out and there was a cancellation. I was able to receive electroacupuncture (once the needles were in place a small current is pulsed through) and cupping. My arm was formally paralyzed from a car wreck and acupuncture is what initially restored it (this was over 10 years ago). I still have some nagging/dormant muscles around my shoulder blade area, this procedure was AMAZING, the doctor was able to pinpoint the precise problem areas. Now for those of you on the fence about needles, there isn’t any pain, you don’t feel the needle going in, now you will feel it when it reaches your problem area but any pain associated with it will be fixed (think of it like the gym, it has to hurt before it can get better). Acupuncture is REAL, it WORKS, trust the process. Don’t hesitate to come here, amazing personnel and bedside manner. Oh and if you will be here for a while they offer multiple session packages. They are available on both Line/Whatsapp as well. Again, you want to come here if you are in Pattaya and seeking traditional Chinese treatment methods. I will most definitely be returning in the future!!!
0x3102950003630487_0x364be3e818b33875.author: Fred Jones

0x3102950003630487_0x364be3e818b33875.text: What a blessing Acura acupuncture has been in my life. I came from the USA with a few issues that have been bothering me for years. I was actually a patient at a pain clinic for The last 5 years in the USA. Receiving strong pain medicine to deal with my issues. I stopped the medicine before coming to Thailand. I have degenerative arthritis. Neuropathy in both feet which wakes me up in the middle of the night with stabbing pain. Walking on both feet is very painful as well. My feet are mostly numb maybe 50% feeling. I also have a problem with my left leg. My knee which was replaced was a complete failure and a constant source of pain. Needless to say I don't get around very well these days. I have been going to Acura for the last 2 months. I saw early on results in my feet that encouraged me to continue treatments. The stabbing pain in the middle of the night is gone. In fact I don't have any pain throughout the night. The pain I felt while walking is also gone. My feet are still numb but not as much as before. They feel so much better. Acupuncture has also helped with other issues and pain. Dr. BB is very competent and knowledgeable. She listens intently and answers all questions. Dr. BB and the staff are excellent and very friendly. They also speak good English. I don't take opiates anymore for pain. The strongest medicine I ever use is ibuprofen.
