0x30e281052755c763_0x4644793a66528c67.text: Review of LASIK Surgery using the Trans PRK Method -Day 1: Morning, I had my eyes examined and my intraocular pressure measured. The curvature of my eye lens was checked using specialized equipment. Next, the doctor measured my vision by having me wear glasses to determine my prescription. After the first measurement, the doctor administered eye drops to dilate my pupils and measured my vision again with the glasses. Once the prescription was determined, the doctor calculated the values ​​and scheduled the LASIK surgery. -Day 2: LASIK Surgery Appointment My intraocular pressure was measured again, and I prepared to enter the operating room. The nurse instructed me to wash my face and hands thoroughly and administered anesthetic eye drops. "The anesthetic isn't as scary as you think, don't panic!" I waited about 15 to 20 minutes for the anesthetic to take effect. Then came the climax!! When the doctor called my name, my heart started beating unusually fast. I wasn't scared, haha! I lay down on the bed with a large laser machine above my head. The doctor began using an instrument to hold my eyes open, but I didn't feel any pain. The anesthetic must have been working. It felt like they were applying some kind of cream to my eyelids, and there was tape to prevent eyelashes from falling out or touching my eyes. After that, the doctor moved our heads to align with the laser mark. The doctor instructed us to stare at the laser machine, which had a green light mark. While we were staring, the doctor constantly reminded us to look at the green light mark and not to look away. When the laser started firing to open the eye tissue, we smelled a burning odor, similar to pulling out and burning hair, for about 8 seconds. After that, the doctor fired at the cornea. The image we saw was a small green light mark. During the procedure, the green light mark appeared as a very large dot. After a few seconds, the green light mark returned to its small size. Then the doctor put on contact lenses to cover our eyes. This was done for both eyes. After the procedure was finished, the doctor had us stand up and checked the curvature of our cornea again. The image we saw was incredibly clear, even clearer than 4K. The doctor then put anesthetic eye drops in our eyes again, covered our eyes with eye shields, and gave us painkillers. We rested for about 15 minutes, waited to receive medication, and were able to go home. -Day 3: Pain began to appear. The pain was similar to having sand in our eyes and around our eyes, like staring at a computer for a long time. However, the pain wasn't severe, probably because we had used anesthetic eye drops and taken painkillers. The doctor prescribed antibiotic eye drops four times a day, pain reliever eye drops four times a day, and artificial tears to use whenever my eyes felt dry. I was also instructed to clean the eyelids with saline solution and avoid washing my face or getting water on my eyes for 7 days. -Day 4 The symptoms were no different from day 3. I continued with the eye drops as prescribed and got plenty of rest. -Day 5 I could start opening my eyes, but there was still some slight pain, irritation around the eyelids, and sensitivity to light. My eyes felt sore when I opened them. I could eat normally, but I should probably avoid fermented and pickled foods, as with most surgeries. -Day 6 I had an appointment with the doctor to remove the contact lens cover. After removal, my vision, which was about 70%, decreased to 65%. It will gradually clear up. I continued using the eye drops and artificial tears as prescribed. I stopped using the antibiotic and pain relievers. I could open my eyes in bright light, but I needed glasses because my eyes were sensitive to light and prone to dryness. I had to use artificial tears regularly in the beginning. After that, I waited for follow-up appointments at 1 month, 6 months, and 1 year. The doctor and assistant were very friendly and polite. The doctor and the team at the clinic explained everything clearly and let me choose; there was no pressure at all 😊☺️ I felt so good 😊 I didn't feel pressured at all 😍 until I decided to do it that day ✅ I was scared of PRK, but since I was already there, I decided to go for it and try it once in my life. Finally… I was impressed 💓 from the moment I walked into the clinic. It was clean, looked great, and the rooms were very well-organized. I received excellent care from the nursing team and the doctor. 🥰 🙏🏻 I must thank Dr. Namphueng for giving me the opportunity to see the world without glasses again. 😍 It's given me a bright new world once more. 🤓 I'm so excited for my follow-up appointment tomorrow! 🤩

0x30e281052755c763_0x4644793a66528c67.text: This post is for those with poor eyesight who have worn glasses or contact lenses their entire lives. For me, I've had this problem for over 30 years because I had pterygium (a growth on the eye) since birth, and had it removed when I was 7 years old. Since then, my eyesight has never been the same. I had a detailed eye exam yesterday with an optometrist and doctor. My left eye has 350 diopters and lazy eye (astigmatism), and my right eye has 300 diopters. After a thorough examination, the doctor said that the scar from the pterygium removal is fine and I can have LASIK surgery without worry. Astigmatism causes double vision, especially in bright lights, and it worsens after prolonged exposure to strong lights. It can become very blurry, similar to nearsightedness, especially if the prescription is higher. I've managed to live without glasses purely out of habit, but it hasn't been without its impact. Lately, I've noticed my eyes getting very tired under strong stage lights, especially during competitions. My face looks tired all the time because my eyes are working harder than usual, which is affecting my appearance and confidence. So, I decided to have LASIK surgery at @crytal_lasik_center. The optometrist and doctor did a very thorough examination before the procedure. The entire morning was spent on eye exams: vision tests, intraocular pressure measurements, corneal thickness measurements, and a manual examination. Afterward, I had my pupils dilated with eye drops and re-examinations were performed to calculate the best possible vision correction and the available surgical method. Dr. Som then recommended the most suitable procedure for me. I was considering PRK, Trans PRK, and SBK Lasik (I later learned that Dr. Som is a highly skilled ophthalmologist). I ultimately decided on SBK Lasik because the recovery time is minimal, as I had a TV shoot in a few days. During the procedure, the nurses and doctor were incredibly professional and patient, explaining everything I asked until all my concerns were gone. The procedure itself was very quick, taking no more than 15-20 minutes for both eyes. I was able to walk around normally immediately afterward. The only discomfort was a slight irritation, like feeling like you've just been on a rollercoaster with flashing green and red lights. 🤣 The doctor gave me eye drops and explained post-operative care. The main things were wearing X-rays at night to prevent scratching, avoiding washing my face and hair for a week (just wiping them), and wearing sunglasses in bright light. Honestly, I went back to sleep and woke up at 6 pm and the pain was gone already! 5555 This morning, I finally understand what those who've had LASIK surgery mean. Everything is clearer and brighter than before. I used to squint and strain to see; the sharpness and brightness are completely different. Today is my first day post-surgery. The only thing I'm still getting used to is my improved vision. If anyone wants to consult with someone, feel free to message them. Or you can ask Jeans. I'm happy to share my experience and answer any questions I can. I consider this the most worthwhile procedure of my life! 👍🏻

0x30e285690dde6bc5_0xde9eedfcd9c11df7.text: I came for 3D orthodontic treatment, which combined facial and jaw structure adjustment. My upper jaw was small, narrow, and protruding. Normally, jaw restructuring requires surgery, but I chose to expand my jaw using a natural jaw expansion device instead. After the procedure, my face had a larger chin, and when I turned to the side, my chin was clearly visible. The surgeon moved my lower jaw forward, which also helped me breathe better. My teeth are more aligned, and I feel more confident when smiling. If you have similar problems, you can consult with me first. The doctor and assistants took excellent care of me throughout my orthodontic treatment, including after the braces were removed.

0x311d5f9caaff522f_0xbc0a15a0fca652ab.text: This is probably the best dental clinic in Thailand. Usually, people are afraid of the noise and stressed about the pain when going to the dentist, but at SOL, as soon as you enter, you're greeted with a pleasant aroma. The soft, soothing music plays in the background. The place is spacious and incredibly clean. The moment you open the door, the receptionist is smiling, offers you a small bottle of mineral water, takes your blood pressure, and chats in a friendly manner. You completely forget you're there for dental work! Hahaha, it's like getting a Thai massage. And that's not all. Once the doctor is ready, as soon as you enter the room, the first thing you see is two nurses and the doctor, all bowing respectfully and greeting patients in a friendly way—they all bowed in perfect unison! The view in the back is of lush, green trees, very relaxing and pleasing to the eye. The doctor invites you to sit in the patient chair, and in front of you is a monitor displaying "Welcome, Mr./Ms./Ms./Mr./Ms ... After they finished, they checked my teeth again to see if there were any problems with any other teeth. I was very impressed. Normally, if it's another place, I'd be put off for a while afterward, but here, I feel like I really want to go back here for dental work again. Excellent!

0x311d5f3287922d55_0x1e7cc228e2b80cb7.text: We have been using Momo Smile Dental Clinic in PPT ParkMall, Nam Daeng, since 2022. It shows great care for patients, starting with small details and continuing to provide advice after the procedure. Simply outstanding! … Most recently, we brought my mother (78 years old) for a lower front tooth extraction. My mother has had negative experiences with dental work her whole life. Before the procedure, we consulted with the doctor because my mother has underlying conditions like diabetes, high cholesterol, and high blood pressure. We were a little worried, but the doctor introduced herself, reassured her that she should eat and take her medication as usual, and that the extraction wouldn't take long and there was nothing to worry about. Everything went smoothly on the day of the appointment. My mother was happy because she didn't feel any pain. The procedure was quick, and the doctor had excellent psychological skills, engaging in conversation to ease her anxiety and being very friendly. :) My mother asked us to see her again in two weeks for the remaining tooth. ***Dr. Mo is beautiful, lovely, kind, and very friendly with patients. 0x30fdac0a9d3b4441_0x2fe13681e590118.text: This is more than a review. THIS IS THANK YOU! I am more grateful to Siwalai and her team of healers than words can ever say but I’m going to try with this review. If you want the short version… here: 10/10 HIGHLY RECOMMEND! If you want to know why, read on. After a military training accident, I had a spinal surgery to replace two discs in my upper spine. Since the surgery and for a period of more than 10 years, I suffered from radiating pains, tingling sensations, numbness, muscle spasms and constant stiffness in my arms and legs that was mostly tolerable but ALWAYS present. I accepted my condition and dealt with it the best I could. In 2023, my entire case took a nosedive and I went from walking on my own, to cane-assisted, to a walker, and even a motorized buggy. I was hospitalized for a short period, saw at least a dozen doctors and specialists and went through the whole alphabet in tests (X-Ray, CT, MRI, etc.). No treatment, therapy, or drug saw any real improvement and by the end of 2023, I’d accepted that this was just my new reality. Then my wife and I booked a 2 week vacation to Thailand and while looking at all the activities available, my wife did some Googling and found Patcharapat Spa. We took a chance, booked an appointment, and it was the best decision I’ve made in recent memory. Siwalai is NOT your average Thai masseuse and this is NOT your average Thai massage! If that’s what you’re looking for, take $10 or $20 and go to any of the dozens of massage parlors located within a block of your hotel. Khun charges a premium. A 90-min deep tissue massage is about $90 but I would’ve paid DOUBLE for what she did for me. After a brief consultation and a few questions about my history, they got to work. Siwalai and her assistant put me on a table and twisted me into every shape imaginable. This was not a relaxing massage. They smoothed out old pains, created some new ones, and then smoothed those out too. At times, I felt I was in an actual meat grinder but I came out of the other side feeling better than when she started. That night in bed, I could still feel THROBBING in the muscles she’d touched. On her recommendation, (and after negotiating a nice discount), I went to see her FIVE MORE DAYS IN A ROW! I dreaded seeing her every morning in the middle of my vacation but I could not argue with the results: My muscle spasms disappeared. I felt better. I moved better. I kept l forgetting my cane everywhere because I walked better! IT WAS AMAZING! I’m back home now and while I’m not cured, I don’t wake up in crippling pain anymore. I still carry my cane but it’s mostly for stability while I retrain myself how to walk. I’ve got to regain some muscle on one side and it’s going to take a lot of work on my part but I'm motivated. While she tortured my body, she beat it into my head that I’m the one who has to keep this up by stretching and exercising every single day. If I combine that with regular sessions by a trained masseuse, I’ll have years of active life left in me. My entire attitude has changed right along with the changes in my body and I am forever grateful to Siwalai and her entire team. See you all soon! My next trip to Thailand is already being planned!

0x30fdac0a9d3b4441_0x2fe13681e590118.text: We visited Ms Siwalai about 20 years ago when she cured my husband’s chronic back pain after one session of therapy. 20 years older, my husband had new back and knee pains. 0x30e2995298bfabe1_0x39e8286126b0211e.text: My child was injured while visiting Japan for a short visit. We treated him in Japan, but his condition worsened, so we had him undergo surgery here. Because the injury occurred in Japan, insurance didn't cover it. We initially went to a private hospital, but the cost was so high that we requested surgery here. We were told that foreigners cannot be admitted to the general ward at Ramathi Hospital, so we went to the premium ward. When we explained that we didn't have insurance, we were told that, according to regulations, foreigners have to pay two to three times the price of Thai people. Even so, we were able to have surgery here for less than half the price of a private hospital. The hospital room is just as clean as a municipal hospital, and many doctors and nurses speak English, so it's reassuring. However, since the instructions are primarily in Thai, it may be difficult if you don't speak any Thai at all. A decent level of English is essential for the consultation. We paid the full cost out of pocket, and even with X-rays and blood tests, the total cost was within 1,000 to 3,000 baht. At a private hospital, the same tests would have cost 8,500 baht.

0x30e2995298bfabe1_0x39e8286126b0211e.text: From someone who used to use the regular ward at Ramathibodi Hospital: The regular ward is extremely crowded, and the wait times are incredibly long. You don't know when you'll be seen; you could go at 5:00 AM and leave almost in the evening. It's not an exaggeration to say you'll be at the hospital all day. But once you switch to Ramathibodi Premium, you'll realize the wait times aren't as long as the regular ward. The waiting times might not be as good as private hospitals, with a slight variation of +/- 1.5 hours due to more complicated cases from previous patients, but rest assured, the doctors here are incredibly skilled, and the equipment is top-notch and modern.
0x30e2995298bfabe1_0x39e8286126b0211e.author: Bow Auan

0x30e2995298bfabe1_0x39e8286126b0211e.text: 5 stars for medical service and 98.5% of the staff were excellent. However, there is a strong suggestion for improvement: The "Premium Internal Medicine Screening Unit," with only one staff member, should use standard conversational techniques. Specifically, they should describe the patient's symptoms, and if there's uncertainty about the diagnosis, especially for rare diseases, the patient should be consulted with the relevant department first. Don't rush to conclusions; patients already know the diagnosis and need further consultation. A patient is a person, a body, a life; they aren't treated as separate organs.

0x30da3009af68cb8f_0x25d8153a586d6f04.text: I arrived in CM four years ago with my 9 yoa Tonkinese. I've been to many clinics across the US, and one other in CM during the past 19 years as a cat owner. I brought a neighborhood soi cat into another CM clinic closer to my home a few months ago for treatment of wounds received from fighting, and a general exam. The very large size clinic treatment was satisfactory, with an English-speaking vet that I knew nothing about i.e., years of experience, education, etc. He did an adequate job, but the experience was somewhat impersonal and detached, making me feel as if we were on a conveyor belt along with the many other pets, doctors and staff that were running around this clinic. Several weeks ago Chai was afflicted with vestibular disease which devastated me, and was also difficult for Chai, needless to say. After a lengthy internet search for a clinic I could feel comfortable with we arrived at Dr. Nook's. Treatment for this disease requires office visits one/two times a week for several months, so we have been working with Dr. Nook for a couple months now. I could go on at length about Dr. Nook and staff, but instead tell you that I am thoroughly satisficed and comfortable with her and the clinic, and would highly recommend Dr. Nook if in the need of veterinary care while in CM.

You can truly see how well they looked after him — he came home happy, relaxed, and clearly comfortable from his stay. The staff treated him like their own. They gave regular updates, made sure he was safe, well-fed, and cared for, and they even paid attention to his little quirks and habits. It’s such a relief knowing that Vader was in a warm, friendly environment instead of feeling stressed or lonely. Thank you to everyone at the clinic for taking such good care of our boy. We will definitely trust you again the next time we travel. Highly recommended for pet owners who want peace of mind while they’re away! 🐾❤️ — Vader’s Owner

0x30da3009af68cb8f_0x25d8153a586d6f04.text: If you take your pet (my cat, in my case) to Chiang Mai and something goes wrong with it, go here! They are kind and explain exactly what to do in great detail! I failed the rabies antibody test I had done in Korea, so I had the test done here here, just like in Bangkok, Thailand. (Of course, I received the rabies shot at this clinic a month before the test.) I had my blood drawn a month after the rabies shot, and 25 days later, I received the rabies antibody test results for entry into Korea. When departing, you come to this clinic to get a health certificate (700 baht), then go to the Chiang Mai Quarantine Office and hand over your prepared documents to receive an exit permit (250 baht). See the photo below for the documents you need to prepare.

They use a spa massage room with a spa massage bed so I could sleep comfortably and breathe easily. They really pay attention to every detail of the customer. They start by having me lie face down, starting from my shoulders. They slowly and patiently massage my shoulders and back until both sides are done. Then, they apply a hot compress, making me feel even more comfortable and relaxed. In addition to the comfortable shoulder massage, they also massage other parts of my body, such as my legs and arms. Your clear explanations of every step and procedure, as well as your gentle manner made her feel safe and respected— a rare quality that not all dentists extend to young patients. We deeply appreciate your dedication to building trust and comfort. To Dr. Jirapat Jaroonvechatam: Your expertise and gentle care made my treatment painless and reassuring. Despite the complexity of scaling, polishing, fillings, and extractions, the entire process was painless and transparent. 0x30e29f3f1eecb53b_0x60e45896c5155392.text: This morning I had the pleasure of visiting Edelweiss Dental House Sukhumvit 15 branch, and I can't recommend them enough! From the moment I walked in, I was impressed by how welcoming and friendly the reception staff where (with a special mention to Wasinee 🤗) —they made the entire experience feel warm and inviting. I was able to walk in and make an appointment, which was incredibly convenient. The clinic itself is spotless, giving me instant confidence in their commitment to hygiene and patient care. When I met the dentist Dr Jirapat Jaroonvechatam and his assistant they were incredibly professional and took the time to thoroughly explain everything about the cleaning, polishing, and filling procedures. I felt fully informed and at ease throughout the entire process. Also the attentiveness in giving me a cosy blanket put me at more ease. The filling procedure was surprisingly quick and painless, which I really appreciated—no discomfort at all! Infact I didn't even realise the injection for the numbing of my gum had happened, Dr Jirapat is so gentle, offering me cleaning advice after the procedure. On top of all that excellent service, the pricing is extremely reasonable for the level of care provided. Overall, this has been the best experience I have ever had at a Dentist and will definitely be returning for my future dental needs. Highly recommend this clinic!

0x30e29f3f1eecb53b_0x60e45896c5155392.text: I traveled for other medical procedures and decided to see a dentist since I had been postponing it for years due to difficulties and previous experiences in my home country. The dentists and support staff are exceptional. They take the time to explain what is needed, give you options, and are open to any questions. They listen to your feedback during the procedure and explain each step as they perform it. The nurses anticipate your needs, like saliva suction, without you having to ask. I saw two different specialists, and both were outstanding. I'm actually writing this review while still numb from the anesthetic. I have a wisdom tooth extraction coming up and will update afterward. Highly recommended, with reasonable prices for the excellent service provided.

0x30e29f3f1eecb53b_0x60e45896c5155392.text: I wanted to get my teeth cleaned here in Bangkok and found this place on Google Maps close to my hotel. I was happy to go ahead with that and the original cleaning I wanted. The whole process was straightforward and painless. Approximately 5 minutes to treat each tooth and 15 minutes or so to clean. Glad I chose here. Prices are good and there’s a clear commitment to care from start to finish. I paid the equivalent of £150. Back home in the UK I had to pay almost £300 for just cleaning and 2 teeth to be treated on private treatment once. Thanks to all involved. Would definitely return for any more health or cosmetic work needed in future.

0x311d618d8ab606b1_0x44f69f47aa949313.text: Positively great experience at Wish Dental Clinic…I’m am American from California and come to Thailand often for all sorts of (the right) reasons and happened to need some dental work done. I feel so fortunate to have found this clinic. Basically I needed new retainers and thought why not just have my teeth cleaned since they were almost due, therefore negating the same thing in the Bay Area with my usual (I.e. insurance plan) dentist who I never thought was actually truly good. Proceeded to absolutely get the best, most thorough, cleaning I’d ever had. The doctor (Dr. Mick, and hope the spelling’s correct) saw that restorations that were done several years ago were not in good condition which I sort of suspected because I could actually feel rough edges. This was not something my regular dentist back home even once mentioned and I’d seen her less than 9 months ago. Dr. (speaking English) explained exactly what was going on with my teeth and showed me with the X-rays they had just taken and with a mirror so I could see directly…and, or course what he could do (very honestly) to re-restore seven teeth needing work. Instinctively I completely trusted him and his professional expertise…one just knows that they are in totally capable hands. We scheduled the appointment, I went back and could not be happier…Dr. showed me the procedure step-by-step in a mirror as each tooth was being done and gave me a little education on dentistry that NO dentist had ever come close to doing…He’s a true professional that clearly enjoys practicing dentistry. Even though I reside in Palo Alto, California, my new dentist is here in Bangkok, Thailand…I see him again in November for another cleaning and check up. Hopes this helps with anyone’s search for awesome dental care. Two days later I returned to Wish Dental Clinic to receive my new retainers. It was an another great visit…Dr. Mick tested the fit which was perfect and instructed me how to place them and take them out properly. He had me do it a couple of times to insure I did it right. He explained proper cleaning, storage and what could ruin them. I also got whitening gel which he also throughly explained the use of and how much whitening I should expect over how long. Again, I could have dreamed of receiving better dental care from Dr. Mick and his staff…I’ll wear the retainers tonight and if there are any issues (which I highly doubt) Dr. Mick wants to know so that they can be brought to the clinic and made perfect. Wish Dental Clinic is more than I could have ever wished for, and I feel super blessed to have found them!

After examining him, they said his left ear was fine and his right ear had a slight inflammation, adding that he likely had hearing loss. How could that be? We'd been communicating normally all along; the symptoms had only recently appeared. Finally, they gave him paracetamol and gave him an appointment with a specialist on November 10th, 2025. That's insane! He finally went to see a specialist on October 19th, 2025. Who would be crazy enough to wait that long? So I decided to search on Google and found this place. The doctor here uses the same equipment but diagnosed the problem differently, and my father's hearing returned to normal. The service was excellent, and the price was friendly. I don't know what else to say but 5 stars. Thank you so much!

They also removed any remaining hairs with tweezers (underarms were painless, the Brazilian wax was a little painful but tolerable – much less painful than plucking at home). The owner was incredibly clean, washing her hands almost every time she touched something, and washing again after leaving and returning the room. During the waxing, she explained aftercare instructions and how to treat ingrown hairs. The shop has a points accumulation program (scan points via the LINE app). After 10 services, the next service is free (up to 1,000 baht). (If I remember correctly) Prices, promotions, and opening/closing days can be found on their Facebook page. This isn't a paid review; honestly, if there were 10 stars, I'd give it a perfect score. I'll definitely be back. I highly recommend this salon to anyone looking for waxing services.

0x30da301ac3803597_0x2d700b85c518b291.text: After a very bad fall that resulted in a double ankle fracture, I was rushed to Rajavej Hospital Chiang Mai — and from the very first moment, I knew I was in good hands. I was taken almost immediately for X-rays and quickly admitted. The efficiency and professionalism of the team were incredibly reassuring during such a stressful time. I underwent ankle surgery to repair the two fractures, and throughout the entire process, my doctor was not only highly skilled but also genuinely caring and attentive. I was hospitalized for nine days, and I can honestly say my recovery has been excellent. Every nurse, doctor, assistant, and staff member treated me with warmth, compassion, and respect. They made me feel as comfortable and “at home” as one possibly can in a hospital setting. Pain management was handled perfectly — I received all the medications I needed to stay comfortable. The team also started physiotherapy promptly, helping me regain mobility, learn to walk with crutches, and prepare safely for my flight back home. What truly touched me was the level of care beyond medical treatment. The hospital provided everything necessary for my journey home and even arranged transportation to the airport. That level of service speaks volumes. While the hospital building may not be as new as some others in Chiang Mai, the quality of care and service is absolutely impeccable. In the end, it’s the people who make the difference — and the people here are exceptional. Thank you to all the nurses, assistants, doctors, and administrators. I will carry your kindness and dedication in my heart always. Krit was a godsend to us because he made sure that we understood everything and he took care of communications with the insurance company

0x30da3aa27418f391_0x868bb7d7058ee961.text: The Professional Face Lifting class was an amazing learning experience. I’ve studied Head and Face massage at several other Thai schools, and I even teach it at my own school. But I signed up for this course as much to learn from Dr. Nooy as to explore this specific modality. And now I've just completed an incredible two-week, 60-hour journey learning Traditional Thai Abdominal Detox Massage with Dr. Nooy. I have never been more exhausted from learning, but never been more satisfied with how much I have learned in these two weeks. From day one, I was blown away by this Dr. Nooy's techniques. Not a single technique overlapped with what I already knew from hundreds of hours of studying Thai massage. Plus Dr. Nooy’s teaching style focused on identifying what needed to be addressed rather than simply memorizing a sequence without considering the client’s unique needs. I was fortunate to be her only student for the Abdominal course, which meant that Dr. Nooy taught me at the speed I could understand. In the first week I did feel a bit overwhelmed, but after countless hours of working with clients that she brought in for me, by the end of the second week I was doing 2-hour treatments using techniques that were all new to me. The abdomen is essential to Traditional Thai Medicine for a number of reasons, but this is the first school and the first teacher who has not only given me practical techniques for working the abdomen, but, more importantly, helped me understand how to assess and treat what needs to be done for my clients. I haven’t even returned home to Canada yet, but I already have numerous bookings from clients eager to try both the Thai Face Lifting and the Thai Abdominal massage treatments. I highly recommend these courses to anyone looking to learn from a true master in the field. I am forever grateful that I found Sirichan Thai massage school. Thank you Dr. Nooy for the gift you have given me.

0x30da3aa27418f391_0x868bb7d7058ee961.text: Being already a certified massage therapist, I was looking some who could teach me new skills and techniques. So I chose Dr. Nooy's clinic in order to learn the art of traditional thai massage and bone setting. After taking the courses, I can only recommend Sirichan clinic and dr. Nooy to anyone who wants to seriously study massage in order to be able to heal others. Not only were the lessons very comprehensive, but Dr. Nooy has always been available to explain the details, demonstrate the techniques and clarify all doubts. Certainly what distinguishes this course is a great attention to the correct learning of the student and the application of massage techniques as a real tool to help the client heal. Furthermore, during the practice I had the opportunity to follow and massage various people and clients of the clinic, immediately putting into practice what I had learned. This is really a big plus, since in many massage courses you usually only practice with other students. Here, however, you have the opportunity to put into practice what you have learned on real cases, under the careful supervision of Dr. Nooy. Furthermore, the atmosphere is pleasant, familiar and relaxed, which certainly favors learning. If you are looking for a traditional Thai massage course or if you are looking for someone who can help you solve physical problems through this art of care, look no further and trust the Sirichan Clinic.

0x30da3aa27418f391_0x868bb7d7058ee961.text: Sirichan Clinic is so much more than the best massage you'll ever get. Having been in Asia for over a year, I've made frequent visits to massage places with mixed success. Sirichan Clinic is definitely a unique treatment compared to anything else! Dr. Sirichan Maneechai, aka Nooy, began learning traditional massage and medicine at the age of 8 from her grandmother Wissim. She later pursued formal education, eventually earning a doctorate in Thai medicine, midwifery, and massage therapy. Dr. Nooy has since developed her own unique approach to healing, incorporating over 12 Thai modalities. She specializes in a range of treatments, including traditional Thai massage, face massage, and herbal treatments, among others. Her approach is holistic, combining expertise with a clear understanding of health, body, and mind. You won't only get a massage. Dr. Nooy will give you the check-up that you perhaps didn't even know you needed! She fixed my leg so I could walk again and adjusted a muscle in my other leg. Furthermore, she worked on my entire body, using both acupuncture and abdominal massage. I came out as a new functional being! Before I went, she even gave me herbal medicine to drink before bedtime! This is the treatment we dream about every time we visit a masseuse! Thank you so much for a calm and holistic experience that I have never before encountered! Treat yourself to this. It's a true blessing 🙏☯️

0x30da3aa27418f391_0x868bb7d7058ee961.text: I recently completed the entire 4-week course with Dr. Nooy and her team and was truly satisfied with the wonderful Thai massage, walking massage, and bonesetting sequences I learned. Therefore, in addition to the sequences with the related SEN SIB theory, you acquire the tools to perform a careful assessment of the body to perform functional, personalized, and completely safe treatments. Furthermore, she and her team, in addition to being generous and empathetic, are open to receiving during the lessons, and as a result, you receive precise and useful feedback to understand exactly how to correctly perform the techniques. 0x30da315d1c7b3d8d_0xf944de49f7fdd5d0.text: #Clinic for those afraid of dentists. Today was my first time trying dental treatment here. I had a cavity at the age of 29 😳🦷. I'm usually afraid of dentists and hate going to the dentist, but I came because I know Dr. Pippo, a pediatric dentist. I booked an appointment with her because I thought a child dentist would be gentle 😆🤍. When I arrived, I was surprised to see so many children's toys! Once the treatment started, I was even more surprised when the doctor asked if I wanted to watch TV. So I asked her to put on a cartoon 5555 (but I had to wear glasses to avoid eye strain, so I chose Pikachu). During the procedure, the doctor kept telling me what I would feel, letting me know what stage we were at and how much was left 🤣. She didn't leave me wondering how long it would take! And importantly, she had a technique to distract me from the pain when injecting the local anesthetic. This was amazing! I followed her instructions, and before I knew it, it was all over 😌. I loved it – a new experience at the age of 29! If you're afraid of dentists, I recommend trying this place. Dr. Pippo is lovely and very kind!
0x30da315d1c7b3d8d_0xf944de49f7fdd5d0.author: Nae Kim

0x30da315d1c7b3d8d_0xf944de49f7fdd5d0.text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Dr. Penphong was very thorough and professional. She checked all my daughter’s teeth first before treating the complaint tooth. She also advised us to wait until my daughter is around 14 to see how a possible problem tooth develops, which made sense since teeth are still developing at this age. Honest advice, gentle care, and a clean, child-friendly clinic. Highly recommended.

0x30e29911142b4de1_0xb3e1c79f5a560c1b.text: This authentic traditional Thai medicine shop, known as Baan Mor Wan, is run by a highly respected practitioner of traditional Thai medicine. Established during the reign of King Rama VI, the business has been passed down through generations. The building is a beautiful yellow colonial-style structure. Inside, it not only sells medicine but also houses a museum showcasing the shop's history, displaying traditional ingredients and tools used in medicine preparation. Staff are available to provide information and share the shop's stories.
0x30e29911142b4de1_0xb3e1c79f5a560c1b.author: Panghom Jaa

0x30e29911142b4de1_0xb3e1c79f5a560c1b.text: I saw this place on Magazine B and really wanted to visit. The old building is beautiful, and the pharmacist(?) who served me was very kind. I think the four kinds of handmade Cheongsimhwan are their signature medicine, but honestly, I was worried so I didn't take a picture. The green balm mentioned in the book seemed similar to tiger balm. The packaging is pretty and makes a great gift. The digestive medicine in a tin case is available at the duty-free shop.
0x30e29911142b4de1_0xb3e1c79f5a560c1b.author: SooKyung Koo

0x30e29911142b4de1_0xb3e1c79f5a560c1b.text: The century-old pharmacy has been repackaged, but the storefront has been preserved in its original form. It sells over-the-counter medicines for colds, headaches, and indigestion, both topical and oral, as well as massage creams that have been featured in foreign magazines and reports. The shopkeeper is a young woman, so I came here specifically to take a look (you have to ring a bell and take off your shoes to enter).
0x30e29911142b4de1_0xb3e1c79f5a560c1b.author: Ray Chan

0x30e29911142b4de1_0xb3e1c79f5a560c1b.text: A pharmacy nestled in an old house, nestled in a winding alley. It's not a modern pharmacy, but rather a traditional establishment that manufactures and sells pills, massage oil, and balms. It may seem closed, but upon entering, you'll find a staff member who asks if you'd like to watch a DVD of their history. It's a delight to see their pride, and I highly recommend it for souvenir shopping and sightseeing tours!
0x30e29911142b4de1_0xb3e1c79f5a560c1b.author: 이범홍

0x30e29911142b4de1_0xb3e1c79f5a560c1b.text: Banmowan Pharmacy, a place where tradition meets sophistication🌿 Since COVID-19, the building hasn't been open yet, but the products were already on display at the door. From the newly released tube balm to the signature tin-case digestive aid, the pharmacist was kind enough to explain everything and even help me test it out, so I was able to buy them without much fuss☺️
0x30e29911142b4de1_0xb3e1c79f5a560c1b.author: 현경alphapurple

0x30e29911142b4de1_0xb3e1c79f5a560c1b.text: Really traditional thai herb and medicine from generation to generation. All stuffs and things are all original. Very great atmosphere surrounded by the thai herb scents. Wonderful and friendly owner who is awesomely informative. The gate is always closed, once arrived just ring the bell. One of the best hidden gems of Bangkok.
0x30e29911142b4de1_0xb3e1c79f5a560c1b.author: Sarah Watt

0x30e29911142b4de1_0xb3e1c79f5a560c1b.text: This is a really cool century-old herbal medicine shop. They provide information in both Chinese and English, and the staff are very friendly and will help you take photos and give you a tour! The small outdoor space also has a lot of historical charm, so it's definitely worth a visit!
0x30e29911142b4de1_0xb3e1c79f5a560c1b.author: HUI

0x30e29911142b4de1_0xb3e1c79f5a560c1b.text: A traditional pharmacy that feels like a hidden treasure." You can purchase massage oils with beautiful packaging, as well as digestive aids, headache medicine, and Cheongsimhwan. The door is firmly locked, but if you ring the bell, a staff member comes out to greet you warmly.
0x30e29911142b4de1_0xb3e1c79f5a560c1b.author: Donna Kim

0x30e29eb237dc27d7_0xe2ca43a06dd3cdc4.text: Other than my basic TDAP boosters [covered by my insurance stateside(USA)], which I received at a Walgreens [George Dieter & Pebble Hills, El PasoTX-USA] walk-in, I knew that the following travel shots/jabs [yellow fever, Japanese encephalitis, typhoid, rabies] would be muy caro/very expensive—unless obtained overseas. Other than a quick layover in Shanghai to ride the World-famous MAGLEV, ChiangmaiTHAILAND was my destination. My primary objective was visiting family, but also to finish the injections. The only place I could get the (lifetime) Yellow Fever shot/jab was in the Capital, Bangkok. After arrival there, it took me most of the day (11OCT2018) to figure out how to get to this FANTASTIC hospital/travel clinic. Fortunately, I had ample assistance, beginning with my first stop, Red Cross. The nurse not only gave me oral directions, but she also gave me an excellent map to my next location, adjacent to the snake house. Unfortunately, they were out of the Yellow Fever vaccine, but readily gave me excellent directions to the Hospital for Tropical Diseases. Using the highly efficient BTS elevated trains, I was soon at registering at this hospital and then whisked upstairs to the travel clinic where the Yellow Fever shot was administered. I did have to wait another 45 minutes afterwards to ensure no immediate (bad) reaction to it (there is a very slim chance that “older” people can die from it), but heck, life itself is a risk! Besides less cost, my valid passport was also required to ensure all paperwork/documentation was correct. I am so thankful & grateful to this clinic, hospital and all Thai—THANK YOU! You certainly have my enthusiastic “Wheel of Approval!”
0x30e29eb237dc27d7_0xe2ca43a06dd3cdc4.author: John “Juanito Hayburg” Eyberg

0x30e29eb237dc27d7_0xe2ca43a06dd3cdc4.text: Today I went for my vaccination. The doctor took a thorough medical history before the injection and provided excellent advice, demonstrating true medical ethics (unlike some private hospitals where people act more like salespeople getting commissions). The doctor explained and analyzed the situation clearly, which I found very impressive. The nursing staff were also efficient and provided good service. However, the finance department doesn't yet have a scanning payment system; you have to use a credit card, debit card, or cash. Booking online was very convenient. Upon arrival, there was already a list of those who had booked. I just needed to fill out a few additional forms. Actually, you can fill it out online or print it out and complete it. The parking in the building was always full. I had to park at the valet parking lot next door, which is an apartment building. It cost 40 baht for the whole day. I circled around 4-5 times before I found a parking spot. 😅
0x30e29eb237dc27d7_0xe2ca43a06dd3cdc4.author: Ying Onarnin

0x30e29eb237dc27d7_0xe2ca43a06dd3cdc4.text: You can come here as a foreigner without health insurance and they will accept you as a walk-in! Some of the staff speak just enough English to communicate the registration process (which can be done online via QR code when you arrive). Came specifically for the Thai Travel Clinic on the third floor to treat diarrhea. They’ll ask for a stool sample and have it analyzed in an hour. Afterwards the doctor can discuss your results with you and prescribe the necessary antibiotics and oral rehydration salts. At the time of this review, the visit cost around 500 baht and the medication cost around 500 baht, so you should expect to pay around $30-40 USD if you are needing treatment for food poisoning or something similar. You can pay with Visa! Highly recommended for foreigners who need a walk-in clinic on a short notice.
0x30e29eb237dc27d7_0xe2ca43a06dd3cdc4.author: Frienditas

0x30e29eb237dc27d7_0xe2ca43a06dd3cdc4.text: Schedule services online or walk-in during clinic hours for travel-related medical care including a wide range of vaccines (influenza, COVID-19, rabies, hep A and B, yellow fever, you name it they probably offer it), traveler’s diarrhea, malaria and other ailments, at this efficiently run university-managed clinic. Clinic is on the 3rd floor, accessible by lift. Staff on each floor are very helpful directing visitors to where they need to go. Consultation with physician is included with all services, even vaccinations. Cash or card payment accepted. Service was very prompt even for walk-in patients like myself. On the way out you will encounter food stalls with enticing offerings, as well as a canteen that serves staff and visitors alike.
0x30e29eb237dc27d7_0xe2ca43a06dd3cdc4.author: P W

0x30e29eb237dc27d7_0xe2ca43a06dd3cdc4.text: I came here from Canada to get the Japanese Encephalitis (JE) and rabies vaccines. I booked my appointment online and arrived 30 minutes early, but they took me in right away. Everyone speaks English, so communication was very easy. The doctors are kind and helpful and took the time to answer all of my questions and concerns. The clinic is very organized and efficient. The price is also very reasonable - for two shots including all fees, I paid the equivalent of CAD 70. I need a second rabies shot, and they simply advised me to book online again - it only takes a couple of minutes. I highly recommend this place for anyone looking to get vaccines that are difficult or impossible to access back home.
0x30e29eb237dc27d7_0xe2ca43a06dd3cdc4.author: Aimee V

0x30e29eb237dc27d7_0xe2ca43a06dd3cdc4.text: I visited the clinic for vaccination and had made a reservation online in advance, so everything went smoothly. First, I checked in and ① filled out and submitted a medical questionnaire. ② I had a consultation with the doctor to decide on the vaccine. At this time, I told them where I was visiting so they could give me advice. In my case, it was PAK. ③ I paid after deciding on the vaccine; credit card payment is accepted. ④ I received five doses of the vaccine (one in each arm). ⑥ After vaccination, I had a consultation and waited for 30 minutes. The website clearly states the cost of the vaccine and consultation, so I recommend it for its transparent pricing.
0x30e29eb237dc27d7_0xe2ca43a06dd3cdc4.author: M Maro

0x30e29eb237dc27d7_0xe2ca43a06dd3cdc4.text: Excellent service - Anyone who is worried about getting vaccinations abroad, don't be, this clinic had far more information than we were provided with in the UK (Check out their website). All the staff were very helpful, accommodating and professional. We each received 4 vaccines (JE, Rabies, Influenza, Hep B) after discussing the various ones we might need for our trip across South East Asia with their team. I worked out it was roughly 10 times cheaper than getting them in the UK.
0x30e29eb237dc27d7_0xe2ca43a06dd3cdc4.author: Matty

0x30e29eb237dc27d7_0xe2ca43a06dd3cdc4.text: Open at 8:00 AM. It's recommended to register for your travel card online beforehand to receive your HN number. If you walk in, contact the staff on the 1st floor to receive your card and then proceed to the 3rd floor to process your card. After that, wait for the Thai Travel Clinic staff to arrive and request a queue number at the counter. If you get one of the first numbers, the wait shouldn't exceed 1 hour. Booking an appointment online will speed things up even more.
0x30e29eb237dc27d7_0xe2ca43a06dd3cdc4.author: Sonya Ch

I met with the Dr and explained that I liked the shape of my lips and just wanted them fuller with a few adjustments. The Dr asked if I had any photos of the shapes that I like and I showed him. He suggested 2 different types of filler - restylane kysse and Flore. I chose the Flore because it is more cost efficient (I think around 7,000THB per cc). Once the Dr made the suggestions I then left with the sales associate who showed me the products and took me through pricing. I paid, sat with the numbing cream for about 40 minutes and then the Dr administered the filler. He was extremely nice and professional, took his time and told me that we could take a break whenever I wanted and also asked me if I was okay several times. The assistant was also so sweet and attentive. The clinic is well-managed, pretty and clean. Everybody smiles at you and they provide water while you wait. 4 days later and the swelling has gone down and I'm SUPER happy with the results. There is some swelling but the shape and feel is exactly what I wanted - soft and smooth with no bumps or hardness. I will go again for any other aesthetic needs and highly recommend. Lastly, they did not offer any incentive for a review and nor did I request or expect one - they did not even mention a review. Adding this as another clinic I went to offered me a discount for a 5-star review and that made me concerned that the reviews I had seen were not honest.

0x30da3aa6cdeb45fb_0x2e9cf506833dd80d.text: I ve been a patient of Dr Tawatchai and his clinic staff for 35 years . Im 70 now and in great health . My brother and several other members of my family are also doctors so I often consult with them before or after visiting the clinic . To make a long story short Dr Tawatchai has always cured my problems and his strategy has always been spot on with what I was advised would be the approach by medical professionals in Canada. He 's recommended the very best specialists in CM for me and subtly and with great diplomacy steered me away from others. Most recently we saw him for annual health check up .First time we have had it done in Thailand (covid has had us here for almost 2 years now,). It was extremely thorough .chest and abdomen x ray EKG and myriad blood tests etc. Blood drawn in the morning all lab results by 6 pm and a very thorough explanation of all results including very diplomatic suggestions on what he would recommend as strategies to stay healthy or remedy issues. There is no computers in his office {maybe one at the reception now) so he looks a you not a computer screen when you visit. He was great doctor 35 years ago and he has aged like fine wine . I cant say enough about him . Fine doctor and fine human being as are all his staff.

0x30da3aa6cdeb45fb_0x2e9cf506833dd80d.text: Saw a wonderful doctor there who spoke very good English post- a Muay Thai injury. Ascertained that my toe wasn’t broken - just swollen and infected inside the skin. Prescribed a course of antibiotics and a tetanus jab - all done within an hour. Toe has healed well after a week or so. Local Thai prices (all in for 670 baht) as it serves the local Thai community - though still very willing to help me as a young British male. Helpful, capable and friendly nurses and staff. Likely best to arrive at around 7.30am before the clinic opens to be within the first customers as many arrive around 8am. There are two entrances - maybe best to stand/sit at the entrance facing the coffee shop as that is where most people line up. I sat on the side entrance and had to be saved by a lovely Thai lady who knew I was second in line as I arrived a 7.15am or so. I can recommend very highly - I will aim to go again should I ever be in Chiang Mai and need to visit a clinic.

0x30da3aa6cdeb45fb_0x2e9cf506833dd80d.text: I had a bad cough and wanted to get looked at by an english speaking doctor and was lucky enough to find this clinic. Everyone was calm and orderly, I was checked, got an xray and was given meds. Just amazing! Our doctors at home have alot to learn from them. Dr spoke english, clearly explained everything, no stress at all. They open at 8am. If you want to you can get there earlier as there will be a queue. Payment is in cash only after treatment. You wait till you are called and the whole process took 90 mins, but so calm and everyone waits their turn patiently. After the xray and seeing the dr again, he gave me a full explanation of which meds etc and the pharmacy there prepared and gave them to me. And all this for 720 bht! And without computers, just human beings treating human beings. I was so worried about being sick in Thailand and this place completely upturned my preconceptions! Big Thanks to this clinic

0x30e29db63f469177_0x109b1ff1ba533942.text: I'd like to share my personal experience, especially for those with a significant fear of dentistry. I personally have a very high level of anxiety about dental procedures, and what I prioritize is being able to fully express my symptoms, concerns, and questions before the procedure, ensuring mutual understanding between the dentist and patient. However, in this experience, I felt that almost every communication point before I could finish explaining my concerns was interrupted or contradicted, making me feel like I didn't have the opportunity to fully articulate them. For those who don't fear dentists, this might seem like a minor detail, but for those with intense fear, the dentist's willingness to listen fully, explain patiently, and give the patient time to understand before making a decision significantly impacts feelings of safety and trust. This doesn't mean the treatment is ineffective, and this is just my personal experience. But if you have a very strong fear of dentists or value communication and active listening between dentist and patient, I recommend considering this point before deciding to use dental services.

0x3054f2391350ee7d_0x491c31870936c84d.text: I decided to do the Source’s detox to-go program for 21 days in June this year after having amazing results with 14 days of the retreat program last year. Where to begin… First up, the 14-day retreat program last year was truly powerful. I lost some weight and it helped with a skin issue I had, but it was the results after the program that had the most impact. I felt like I had a new mindset and started noticing lots of little synchronicities. For example, some new job opportunities essentially fell into my lap, I met some very interesting new people, and some small things I'd wanted for a long while seemed to just materialize in my life. It’s difficult to explain, but it felt like there had been a change externally as well as internally. I’d wanted to stay longer, but had to go back to work, so I decided to return this year after a trip to Singapore and do the full 21 days to keep the positive momentum going and complete the change in myself (but as the detox to-go option, so I could still follow my regular routine). Initially, it was a little more difficult, and I felt I needed to increase the amount of juice I was drinking to match the energy I was spending on work and going to the gym. Ivor was on-hand to talk me through the process though and give me some recommendations. After 21 days (and two liver flushes), I lost 8kg! And my skin issue had cleared completely. Even though the process was a little harder during the longer detox, I finished with a remarkable sense of peace and clarity. I was a bit worried I was too relaxed (!) and had lost my drive a little, but my motivation soon returned after I slowly reintroduced food. Apparently this calm feeling was related to clearing all the acid waste from the body, as it had become much more alkaline. If you’ve ever fasted before, you know the detox clarity I’m talking about. It’s not like your problems disappear, more that you aren’t so worried about dealing with them, and are content to let things just unfold. I really feel like it has been the ultimate reset for my body, both physically and mentally. I’m writing this just over a week later and it’s like I have an entirely new perspective. Everything feels remarkably in flow. It’s going to be exciting to see what changes happen in my life as a result. If you can’t do the retreat program, it’s entirely doable to make the juice yourself at home or elsewhere on Koh Samui and go about life as normal with the detox to go (I did it in an Airbnb nearby and Ivor lent me a juicer!). I highly recommend doing the full 21 days if you can. It feels life changing!
0x3054f2391350ee7d_0x491c31870936c84d.author: Simon Fogg

0x3054f2391350ee7d_0x491c31870936c84d.text: This is my first time completing a Detox Program of this nature. I have used colonics over the years and occasionally done parasite cleanses which I haven't successfully completed because they're too hard to take. I like to detox in the spring. Since my family and I are now based in Asia, I did a Google search for "Detox program in Asia" (after not hearing back from a certain program in the Philippines). The Source popped up & I emailed to express my interest and motivation to do the program in a few weeks. Ivor at The Source immediately responded, reached out to me on Whatsapp & gave me instructions and recommendations for where to stay etc. The whole process of logistics was easy, thanks to Ivor's help. Getting to Thailand and finding accommodation was the easy part. The harder part was doing the Detox. Truth told, I wanted it to work but was low key worried, nervous and anxious that it may not work due to my sensitivity in general and food sensitivities in particular. I had a sense of how colonics worked but had no reference point for this herbal detox program. Upon my arrival in Koh Samui & going to The Source for my first consultation, Ivor did his best to educate and reassure me without hyping up the program and for that I am grateful. I got started on the OJ Fast that same morning and couldn't believe how easy it was to take everything including the capsules, syrups, tonics, tinctures. Everything was surprisingly tasty. 4-1/2 days and several bathroom trips later I have lost a lot of waste from my guts and approximately 9 pounds! I nearly cried in disbelief at what had happened and how quickly. I gained healthier, glowing skin and I am learning to eat foods in the right way at the right time! There are so many amazing bonuses built into this program like the amazing massages at The Spa Resorts and the incredible sessions with the man, the mystic, the Master himself, the Healer Jet Lee. ✨️ His sessions alone are priceless. I just got home from the program and for the first time in my life, I am enjoying eating a salad; not just tolerating it! I am loving tomatoes now which was a food I couldn't have before due to sensitivities. ❤️ This program is a game-changer for anyone seeking to live a sustainably healthy lifestyle or anyone struggling with weight loss issues. I highly recommend this program! I think it's one of the best in the world! I am already recommending to family and am planning to do it again!
0x3054f2391350ee7d_0x491c31870936c84d.author: Lorna Blake

0x3054f2391350ee7d_0x491c31870936c84d.text: I did Program B at the Source in April for 2 weeks on the OJ fast after trawling through reviews of all the available detox programs on Koh Samui. Previously I did a one week program at The Spa Resorts about 5 years ago. While I had great results then losing 5kg in a week, I was keen to try a program without colonics. I expected to lose at least 5kg again but ended up losing about 1 kg a week instead. I still highly recommend this program as I feel it was a holistic reset and one that is good for your body and soul. I would definitely do it again because I continued to lose weight when I got home even though I was eating again. While I am mindful of what I eat, social events meant I was dining out and drinking and even having dessert but the weight still came off. I think this is because of a full body reset plus introduction of some healthy habits (introduction of 5 minute HIIT workout daily). The entire program genuinely helped me to recover my energy levels. I became very unwell during Covid with my thyroid function destroyed by autoimmunity. The extra weight stacked on during lockdown, being over 40 and having PCOS all worked against me and for the past few years I felt exhausted all the time with no energy. Since coming home from the program my energy levels have returned and I have the bounce back in my step. My skin became insanely soft and silky smooth during the program. I’m back to my pre-Covid figure. I’ve lost weight on the areas that matter especially all the belly fat I was carrying. Jet Lee (not the actor - LOL) I had the privilege of seeing Jet Lee 4 times as I was on Program B. This was unlike anything I had previously experienced and I would say it is worth traveling to Koh Samui just for this treatment. I don’t want to say too much more because I feel that it is very much up to the individual - what you personally are ready to get out of the treatment - that sets the tone for your results. For me, it was completely unexpected what happened for me and far exceeded my expectations. Ivor provided excellent support throughout the whole process. He answered questions, provides you handouts, and communicates regularly via WhatsApp. He sends you further info and support there when you need it. So if you’re reading this review and still wondering whether to book, just do yourself a massive favour and reach out to Ivor. It will be the best thing you’ve done all year.
0x3054f2391350ee7d_0x491c31870936c84d.author: Jae Yeo

0x3054f2391350ee7d_0x491c31870936c84d.text: I have just completed a 7 day detox with Ivor at the Source in Lamai . Although I have a healthy lifestyle and follow a balanced, natural plant based diet I was feeing a bit sluggish and noticing that some patterns had snuck in, like ‘needing’ a daily afternoon pick me up or a sweet treat at the end of the day and decided that a detox would be a good way to reset. The program is simple to follow and well supported and you will receive as much individual attention as you need through the process. I opted for the orange juice fast for the first 3 days and then moved to green juices and clear vegetable broth ( in the evenings ) for the remaining 4 days - I would have stayed with the orange juice for a longer period but my supply dried up after the 3 days so moved to plan b. After feeling a bit of fatigue for the first 2 days a real sense of clarity and lightness prevailed for the remainder of the week. The herbs and tonics support the detox process nicely and I noticed that my digestion continued to work well though the week. This was a gentler detox than ones I have done in the past and I really appreciated the natural approach. I loved the fact that once you have the herbs you could really do this detox wherever you find yourself provided that you have easy access to fruit and vegetables and some extra time on your hands to truly get the full benefit of the experience. I came to the end the week feeling clear and alert, sleeping really well and also noticed a significant decrease to my resting heart rate - a good indication that my body was functioning well. My sweet cravings had also completely gone- this really was an excellent reset! . I would definitely recommend this program if you are looking to reset, it is so easy to follow, comes with excellent guidance and the optional extra acupressure treatments from Jetlee are a must! Such a wonderful, balancing addition to the program!
0x3054f2391350ee7d_0x491c31870936c84d.author: Gill Breetzke

0x3054f2391350ee7d_0x491c31870936c84d.text: I live and work on Koh Samui where The Source is based and, despite being surrounded by wellness retreats, gyms, open spaces and mountains, beaches, pools and yoga venues, I only really manage to go out on my bicycle in terms of fitness, albeit for reasonable distances at a time. I also work hard and consistently felt pretty low on energy, flat and a little heavier than my ideal. So it was with this background that I popped into the office of Ivor (the amiable owner and practitioner of this business) knowing that I needed to do something with my 'system' but not sure quite what. I spent a fascinating half an hour with him consulting on the various programmes (I was interested in detox) that he had. We settled on the 7-day detox plan and he very patiently explained to me what it entailed, what to expect in terms of my body and described the various supplements, potions and pure water he supplies you with. I had planned on having a two week programme but at the end of this period I upped it to a month because I was really feeling the benefits. Apart from the weight loss (7kg in all which was a bonus) I was astounded by the quality of the sleep I was getting, how refreshed and ready-for-the-day I felt each morning (this got better), my energy levels, blemish free and clean skin and crystal clear eyes. I really did feel that the toxins had been flushed from my system. I was delighted with the results and I honestly felt better than I had for many years, even in my 20's. I'm, ahem, somewhat older that that now :) I would recommend using a detox programme provided through The Source whether you are on a holiday, a wellness or yoga retreat or an islander who just needs/feels like a detox. Visited May 2016
0x3054f2391350ee7d_0x491c31870936c84d.author: David Griffiths

0x3054f2391350ee7d_0x491c31870936c84d.text: Great weight loss results at The Source. 0x3054f2391350ee7d_0x491c31870936c84d.author: Melissa Drummond

0x3054f2391350ee7d_0x491c31870936c84d.text: I did my first detox programme last year when I visited Samui for the 1st time. In my life I have tried all laxatives and medicines to cure my constipation problems but nothing works better and natural than the Flow Formula. 0x3054f2391350ee7d_0x491c31870936c84d.author: Cristina Brambilla

0x3054f2391350ee7d_0x491c31870936c84d.text: This was my first herbal detox at the age of 24. I had previously completed many fasts & juice cleanses however nothing as amazing as this! In my 14 days I lost 5kg, mainly from my gut and stomach with noticeable loss of fat in my face making my face structure more defined which was a result. My days were filled with an orange juice fast protocol & whole fruit fasts while taking a variety of powerful herbal formulas from capsules to syrups and tinctures. Since the detox my sleep has improved, my skin is clear & I also no longer have stomach bloating. After being home in the UK, numerous family and friends have commented since my return on how ‘glowing’ I look. I shall definitely be returning next year and look forward to sharing this experience with my close ones as I understand how life changing this herbal detox and the knowledge can be. 0x30e29f27b7b68775_0x4ade461d83edea9a.text: Relatively fast and seems to be the cheapest place to get vaccinations. I needed a Japanese encephalitis vaccine and originally tried to book an appointment with a travel clinic based on googling, but that clinic was fully booked up. Found this on Google maps and this was perfect. No appointment needed, the clinic is purely for vaccinations so they have a very streamlined process. I showed up at 9AM on a Saturday, was a bit longer than expected, but the process kept moving. Shots received by 10:10, out the door by 10:25 after the 15 min monitoring period. JE shot 600THB, Rabies 350THB. Fees 50+20THB. Really accessible pricing, considering I was going to pay a private clinic 1000 for just JE. Most prices are all on the website. However, the whole thing is a process and all the locals seem to know the steps, while we didn’t at all. Some tips: - the pic on Google maps is not the building for the vaccination clinic, at least not as of March 2024. Walk to the left of the building (see attached pic). It is directly across from Snake Farm, like 10 steps away. Sorry I forgot to take a pic of the building. - bring passport / local ID - grab a number and fill out the patient intake form at the booth outside. Once they call your number (in Thai only), they will register you. Prob a good idea to keep eyes peeled for people that grabbed a number before/after you so you know if your number is called - take your passport and new paperwork, walk inside the building and put into the bin at the registration desk. They will do more processing. Tell them you don’t speak Thai if you need help and they’ll keep an eye out for you. The rest was straightforward! Hope this helps!!
0x30e29f27b7b68775_0x4ade461d83edea9a.author: Janice Leung

0x30e29f27b7b68775_0x4ade461d83edea9a.text: Highly systematic and professional vaccination experience. This place is incredibly well-managed and the whole operation is very fast and systematic. When you arrive, it starts with a pre-screening where you get a queue and then measure your blood pressure yourself at a self-service station—it’s very easy, you just have to press one button. After that, you wait for your queue to be called so the staff can check your results and confirm the vaccine you’re taking. Then you move inside for a consultation with the doctor, who was the highlight for me—very nice, helpful, and provided such deep knowledge. Once you've made the payment, you’ll receive your vaccine in a small basket to carry with you to the final vaccination room. Even though there were many patients, the staff remained very active, calm, and professional throughout. The atmosphere is nice and clean, and the entire process is just exceptionally efficient. Highly recommended!

0x30e29dffca5a8ffd_0xed9fc6674714b660.text: I am absolutely delighted with the care I received from this clinic, from my very first consultation right through to my full recovery. From the moment I walked in, I felt welcomed and reassured. The professionalism of the entire team (special mention to James) was outstanding, from the nurses to the support staff — everyone exceeded my expectations at every stage. I was also really pleased that the clinic staff spoke excellent English, which made communication easy and put me completely at ease throughout the whole process. What really stood out to me was the aftercare. My post-operative medications and dressings were all included in the price, which made recovery so much simpler and gave me real peace of mind — I didn't have to worry about extra costs or running around trying to source supplies myself. The staff were thorough in explaining how to care for myself afterward and checked in on my progress regularly. The clinic itself was immaculate — spotless, well maintained, and clearly held to a very high standard of hygiene. Throughout my entire journey, from pre-op to post-op, the staff were always available to answer my questions, no matter how small, and I never once felt rushed or ignored. I am beyond happy with my results, and the whole experience exceeded everything I hoped for. I cannot recommend Dr. Tho and Amarante clinic highly enough — the care, professionalism, and attention to detail were exceptional from start to finish. If you're considering eye bag removal and subbrow lift, I would not hesitate to recommend Amarante Clinic to anyone. Please see attached unfiltered, natural and no make up photo of my eyes. 0x30e29dffca5a8ffd_0xed9fc6674714b660.text: I'm sharing my firsthand experience with Picosure treatment from start to finish at Amarante. I was impressed from the first day until the last course, and I still give them a perfect score without any deductions. The housekeeping staff, the other staff, and even the doctors were all incredibly friendly, attentive, supportive, and provided excellent service. The equipment was of the highest standard and quality. I received treatment directly from Dr. Ton (I was so happy!). He was incredibly kind and friendly. During every treatment, I felt his dedication, carefully adjusting the equipment and changing the heads to address my specific problems – a true professional with extensive experience. He also provided encouragement and advice throughout the treatment. My skin problems, including dark spots from scratching due to seborrheic dermatitis (I kept scratching until I bled), and dark marks around my neck from weight gain due to psychiatric medication, all faded noticeably. Even my acne scars, which I'd had since middle school (the kind that people used to tease me about as "crater-like" or "toad skin"), have significantly improved. People around me even complimented me on how much better my skin looked in just a few months. I want to express my deepest gratitude for helping me regain my confidence and allowing me to dress up and wear makeup without worrying about what others thought. You don't need to be reborn to become more beautiful; you just need to choose the right clinic and see the right doctor. External treatment isn't just about looking good; it's about healing your mind as well. Simply looking better and more beautiful in your own way, and receiving compliments from those around you, is a step towards overcoming your fears and anxieties about what others think and say. If you're deciding or researching, I hope my experience can help you make a decision more easily, and I assure you that you will receive the same excellent care I did.

0x30da3b412002c12b_0xa2dcd77622a01c4b.text: I'd like to share my positive experience with this physiotherapy clinic. 💙 I took my brother for treatment of Office Syndrome. Initially, we didn't inform the clinic that my brother was undergoing cancer treatment. They had already prepared an electrical muscle stimulation device. However, upon learning of his cancer, and knowing that electrical stimulation could potentially stimulate cancer cells, they immediately canceled the treatment for my brother's safety. What impressed me most was the incredible kindness of the staff and physiotherapists. They showed no frustration or displeasure at all, even though they had to cancel the entire preparation. They were incredibly patient, explained everything in detail, and even taught us physiotherapy exercises that could be done correctly at home. 🙏 Importantly, the clinic didn't charge us anything, despite the time and equipment they had already prepared. I could truly feel their care and professionalism. Thank you for prioritizing patient safety and providing such sincere advice. I highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for a physiotherapy clinic that offers knowledge, professionalism, and a warm, welcoming atmosphere. 💙

0x311d7df408b50fa1_0xa00bda6d9d203fa9.text: I initially came here because they had the medication I needed, so I chose this place. On the first day, my actual weight before eating breakfast before going to the doctor was 63.2 kg. After work, I weighed 64.35 kg. (This was after eating). The result is that I currently have one last injection left, this coming Friday. My current weight is 57.10 kg. Weight loss using the pen isn't 100% automated; you must also use the pen to control your hunger through diet and food intake. 1. You must consume a balanced diet with both protein and calories, calculated based on your weight and height. 2. Eat less than your TDEE (Total Daily Energy Expenditure), but not too low. 3. Combining this with exercise will yield the best results. My behavior included frequently eating salty foods (like spicy papaya salad) and sugary drinks almost every day. After starting the pen treatment, I changed my behavior because I wanted to see results after paying for it. I adjusted my diet to consume as much protein as possible equal to my body weight, while keeping my calorie intake within my TDEE. I stopped drinking sugary drinks and started buying protein shakes to mix with my coffee. Protein shakes are beneficial and high in protein. My diet focuses on vegetables first, followed by protein and calories in the right proportions. I include some carbohydrates, but avoid excessive consumption. The result is the weight you see! Thank you to the doctor for the recommendation. I bought the Monjaro pen, 5mg size. I do it myself at home because the doctor did it the first day and it wasn't painful. This way I can manage the long travel time every week. Each person's body requires different dosages, so I recommend consulting your doctor. I want to say that they don't pressure you into buying courses. The doctor is kind, and the staff and doctor follow up continuously every week. I highly recommend them if you want to lose weight effectively. I was someone who couldn't lose weight for many years. When I tried to lose weight on my own, I would gain it back, and I didn't achieve the same level of health. Anyone interested should contact the doctor; it's excellent and well worth the money.

0x3050370f5dde0f13_0x7d4982141ba42576.text: Dr. Jasmine Suriya, MD was extremely helpful and thorough. She diagnosed me with Upper respiratory tract infection with Eustachian tube dysfunction causing ear blockage, which makes perfect sense. I was really surprised my ears weren’t full of wax or water, because they’re so stuffed. The Eustschian tube dysfunction makes it make sense. I also got a nebulizer treatment, because my lungs were too closed to let in good medicine (I have Sarcoidosis, so my breathing is bad, anyhow). I’m glad to finally know what’s been bothering me the last ten days. Everyone who works there are really kind and supportive. They made me feel safe and not alone. I really appreciate the care they showed me. I also like how there are rails next to the toilet for people who need help getting up. If the toilet seat were higher, that would help even more elderly and disabled. I will definitely go back here soon. The prices are affordable if you don’t have insurance. I really appreciate that, because when you’re sick, you worry if you can afford treatment.

0x3051949ecce9e4bd_0x56a4cfd9d9374573.text: After a very long flight, a vigorous jungle trek, and carrying a travel bag over one shoulder for days, I had a headache in three places and really need a chiropractic adjustment. I found out there are no chiropractors in Krabi (couldn’t find one in Bangkok either) but lucky for me a person at my hotel told me about this place. This therapist used pressure, heat, ultrasound and I think one other thing and yes my headaches went away! As a huge proponent of chiropractic I was thrilled and frankly surprised that physio could do this for me. I have had my share of physio treatments but she is different so I went back the next day to see what she could do for my chronic recurring hip tightness and pain. She used laser, TENS, ultrasound, heat, another type of laser and a magnetic device. Wow. That night falling asleep I still help a minor amount of pain but today my hips feel amazing. She also gave me basic good physio advice on how to take care of myself going forward— be gentle, be consistent, stretch and strengthen daily….all the things I know but need to be reminded of. You want to go here!
