0x3051949ecce9e4bd_0x56a4cfd9d9374573.text: I had been suffering for several months with frozen shoulder which was extremely painful. I had been to hospital but their treatment was not working. I heard about a treatment using “Shock wave” but the hospital didn’t have the equipment. Doing further research I found “Krabi Physical Therapy Clinic”. The physiotherapist graduated from Mahidol University, top university in Thailand, and she has experience for 30 years. She also had done many additional trainings here in Thailand as well as abroad. She has all the modern equipment as well as using hands on manipulation. Over the weeks that I have been seeing her my shoulder has improved by leaps and bounds. It still isn’t completely right but the improvement has been extraordinary. I highly recommend her, Krabi Physical Therapy Clinic, to anyone who is suffering with chronic pain. Mark R Miller
0x3051949ecce9e4bd_0x56a4cfd9d9374573.author: Mark Miller

0x3051949ecce9e4bd_0x56a4cfd9d9374573.text: I visited Ms. Tantapakul’s clinic after I strained something in my arm and/or neck, and the mild but persistent pain had been driving me crazy for three days straight. She asked very detailed questions about my symptoms, then gave me a physical therapy session followed by an EMS treatment (electrodes are placed on the muscles and a gentle current is used to help them relax). After about an hour, the pain was gone. It returned slightly later in the afternoon, but after a good night’s sleep it was mostly gone the next day — and it completely disappeared the day after that. Ms. Tantapakul also showed me her impressive collection of diplomas from therapeutic courses with trainers from all around the world, which gave me even more confidence in her expertise. Highly recommended.

0x30e29f1fd5e01287_0x829be335803b656b.text: Out of 10, I'd give it an 11 for the service. I'm very impressed by both the optometrist and Oat. I started by wanting to find good glasses for my dad, as he usually buys pre-made ones himself and complains that his vision isn't very clear while driving. I happened to be looking for a shop that accepts tax-deductible E-Receipts, so I stopped by without an appointment. I was very welcomed. The optometrist took my dad to get his eyes measured right away. He measured and checked his eyes carefully, showing him how to read them. He seemed to understand eyes very well. He asked if my dad had diabetes. Out of curiosity, I asked how it was related. He explained it very well. I could see the picture. He explained that older people might start to develop pterygium, what causes it and what the effects are, and why older people tend to have presbyopia. He explained well, answered questions, and was very patient. After the examination, he took me to get recommendations on lenses, which brands were available, how they differ, and what the prices were. He also offered a selection of frames, from plastic to famous brands. Oat explained the differences and compared prices. The prices at the shop were in line with the quality of the lenses and frames we chose. After comparing with other shops, it was quite okay. You can pay through any payment method. At that time, I didn't bring my wallet because my original intention was to just go jogging in the park, so I only brought my phone. Since I also wanted to accumulate credit card points, the staff helped me find a way to pay using my phone. They were very patient. Overall, I was very impressed. If anyone has any suggestions, I would definitely recommend this shop. 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻

Be sure to fill in as honestly as possible so that the doctor can use it to assess your symptoms during the physical examination. 🔰 Step 2: A deep balance check with the doctor. Each area was sore depending on the severity of my symptoms. The staff were lovely and informed me of any areas that might be particularly sore, so I could prepare myself. 🔰 Final step: Drink warm water and listen to post-treatment self-care instructions. Then, I made my next appointment. I was very impressed. 🥰 The clinic seemed safe. The doctor and staff were lovely. The massage room was clean and private. 0x30da3b23031b7fb1_0x60518723b582b7f5.text: I dread going to the dentist, as I was so traumatized from watching MARATON MAN as a kid. THAT chilling scene between Dustin Hoffman sitting on the chair and Lawrence Olivier, as the dentist, interrogating: IS IT SAFE? IS IT SAFE?!!! The fear is totally irrational, I know. So, based on a string of 5-star reviews heaped on CIDC, I made an appointment for deep cleaning and a couple of fillings. That day, I saw Dr. Thanyalak, and she explained to me in fluent English as to what the dental procedure would entail. Gentle solo piano music played in the background, and my anxiety eased under the very capable hands of the doctor deftly doing the work. The whole experience was quite pleasant really. Kudos to Dr. Thanyalak for her warmth, empathy, and professionalism! And to the receptionists who cheerfully accommodated my busy traveling schedule!

0x30da3b23031b7fb1_0x60518723b582b7f5.text: My daughter broke a front tooth quite badly while we were on holiday. On our return to the UK the dentist that we have consulted to finish the work was very complimentary about the treatment and advice given to my daughter by CIDC. The dentist was friendly, spoke excellent English and explained everything clearly, gave good rationales for the work he could do and couldn't do. My daughter is very anxious about all forms of dentistry and dentists and was made to feel entirely at ease during her treatment. I can see there are a couple of lower starred reviews for CIDC but I can honestly say this was not reflective of our experience and I would recommend them.

I came as a private patient without referral, the doctor spoke great English and was explaining everything beforehand. 0x30da3b2d49d7f79f_0x111fd74163e5210a.text: I had a foot massage for 190 THB for an hour, and it was incredibly good. There was no air conditioning, only a fan, and instead of healing music, they were playing pop songs on the radio, so it was a different atmosphere from a typical massage parlor, but there was a strange sense of openness and I was able to relax from the bottom of my heart. According to the sign on the wall, a room with air conditioning costs an extra 10 THB, they are open until 11 PM on Sundays (maybe because of the Sunday market), and although the temple closes after 6 PM, they are open on the adjacent property (I'm not sure where...).
0x30da3b2d49d7f79f_0x111fd74163e5210a.author: みおいま

0x30da3b2d49d7f79f_0x111fd74163e5210a.text: We stumbled upon this place and were surprised by the price difference compared to other Thai massage parlors. Entering through a narrow alley, we saw satisfied customers leaving, all agreeing that the massages offered in the temples were well worth trying. And they were right. They gave us clean clothes to change into and treated us to an authentic Thai massage from head to toe. The place was air-conditioned with relaxing background music, although some of the masseuses were talking amongst themselves and on their phones during the massage, which was a bit distracting. You leave exhausted but refreshed.

0x30da3b2d49d7f79f_0x111fd74163e5210a.text: It was really refreshing because they rubbed all the way to the bones.. haha ​​The next day my whole body ached and I thought I was going to die^^ But considering the price, there is no place better than this. I paid 190 baht for an hour and then the lady said she needed to work on my shoulders more.. I came back for 290. At first, she chatted with the people next to her and took it easy, but after a while, she showed off her power that could even break a cow's bones. haha ​​I still recommend it. Highly recommended!

0x30da3b2d49d7f79f_0x111fd74163e5210a.text: I got a foot massage. The massage was really the best, much better than the expensive shop I went to yesterday. I got a massage while feeling the breeze from the fan, so it was cool for me, who easily gets hot. 0x30da3b2d49d7f79f_0x111fd74163e5210a.text: For such a low price, it's truly excellent value for money! 0x30da2f10e578b461_0x565f62d729c5e3b3.text: I came here to see Dr. Warangkana with a blocked middle ear after attending the hospital. Dr. warangkana inspected my ears, nose, and throat. She was nore thoroughly than the hospital ENT. She found that when the hospital ENT had removed a hair from my ear that they had damaged my ear drum. There was a small blood clot in my ear. We discussed that I had a flight in a few days. We discussed multiple treatment options and decided that a myringoplasty was the best option for removing the blockage. Dr. Warangkana explained the procedure and the risks. She the expertly performed the procedure. After 3 days, the ear was still blocked. I returned to the clinic. She examined my ear and showed me that the swelling in my ear had subsided. She inspected my nose and throat again. She wrote a detailed medical certificate noting all the medications and treatment for my doctor when I return to Australia. About 2 hours after leavjng the clinic my ear began to feel air and then finally popped. I flew to Bangkok. I followed the Dr. Instructions on the flight and the last of the blockage came out as the plane decended. My hearing has now fully returned. Thank you so much for your immediate, kind, and honest treatment. I am so thankful to have my hearing restored.

0x3102bdfe5d7390d1_0xa1147f4d920450e1.text: First and foremost just want to state that this review was made out of good will and for contribution to patients and the doctors and nurses in the medical industry. As commonly seen Thai doctors and nurses are amazing kind and especially skillful by industry standards. No ill intentions or prejudice against particular persons. Went to seek urgent cure as I suspected i had cholera or diarrhoea due to food poisoning. But after getting registered a government hospital nearby to this private hospital suggested waiting was too long for my urgent condition so the counter staff helpfully redirected me to come to Pattaya Memorial hospital. And so I was here and got registered at the front counter staff was ok. But not the second staff at another counter who took my body temperature. She passed the thermometer and gestured to insert under my armpit. I then answered an important call as I need to prepare payment for hospital expenses and inform my family members and work partners in case I need be hospitalised after. That nurse was frowning and looking horrid while seeing me busy talking over the phone, she finally reacted to point at my arm meaning she wanted to retrieve the thermometer from me. So I took it out and handed it to her and she didn't even know to say thanks or excuse.Next she told me to wait there but who was she talking to I'm not sure me or another patient, and where exactly outside which room and the way she said it to me was like definitely rude because by medical care standard she should have gently shown the patient so there was no error. So judging from her initial attitude, the patient service outcome would be expectably far worse if my wife (Thai) wasn't with me all the while there. Soon my turn came the doctor examined me. He was courteous, attentive and cautious when checking my condition.He finished off with instructions to stop taking solid, indigestible, spicy and sour food during treatment period and prescribed oral medicine. We wai thanks and goodbye to him and he warmly wai back to us. Later experience with the pharmacist, the cashier was great too. But bill was over 2000baht bit too costly for outpatient treatment of this category. Main factor for improvement is hopefully the pricing and also taking greater care in hiring of nurses as wrong staff selection pose a risk to patient's wellness and health.

0x3102bdfe5d7390d1_0xa1147f4d920450e1.text: I was looking for a dermatologist to check for skin cancer as I have had previous basal cell carcinoma that required treatment and surgery. I hadn’t had a checkup for two years. I researched a number of hospitals in the Pattaya/ Sattahip region and made a decision on Pattaya Memorial Hospital. Pricing varied across the four different hospitals I contacted from 1,400 THB - 2,500 THB which was for the consultation with the dermatologist and additional costs for any treatment. I hadn’t been to any hospitals in Thailand so my first experience was very positive. I was advised that no appointment was needed and just turn up which I did, on arrival I went to the registration desk advised what I wanted, I provided my passport, confirmed my address and phone number. They took my photo, photocopied my passport and directed me to another station where my weight and blood pressure was checked. I was then directed to take a seat. This was undertaken within 10 minutes of arrival. A staff member came over and provided a registration form which had my details completed including my photo, I was asked to sign the form and wait for the dermatologist. A further 5 minutes passed and I noticed that there were signs requesting that everyone wear a mask, I asked one of the staff and they obtained a mask for me. I was then admitted to see the dermatologist who checked the area’s of concern, she explained very clearly which spots were potentially problematic and used photos to explain why. Treatment was provided liquid nitrogen and ointment was recommended for the following month with a further evaluation in 6 months. I paid for the consultation, treatment and ointment and was out of the hospital within 35 minutes of arrival. I found that the whole process was extremely efficient and the staff engaging and importantly for me the dermatologist had an excellent command of English. The waiting room was clean and comfortable. The bill was higher than expected but I would definitely recommend this hospital. Thank you to everyone who assisted me yesterday ✌️
0x3102bdfe5d7390d1_0xa1147f4d920450e1.author: Tony Otsujt (TJ)

0x3102bdfe5d7390d1_0xa1147f4d920450e1.text: This hospital accepts both Japanese and foreign emergency patients. There are no staff members who speak Japanese, but thanks to the development of translation apps, there were no communication problems. An acquaintance of mine had eyelid edema due to an acute allergy and was referred to this hospital's emergency department by Muang Pattaya Hospital. There were various patients including Westerners, Japanese, and Thais. The patient registration process for emergency patients was very smooth, and they were guided to the emergency department without any problems. My acquaintance received emergency medication and recovered quickly, so they were discharged in an hour. The billing for discharge and the handover of medication after discharge were also smooth. The total medical cost was about 15,000 yen. 0x3102bdfe5d7390d1_0xa1147f4d920450e1.text: I express my deepest gratitude to the doctors and medical staff at this hospital. I was admitted there on May 15th with a stroke. 0x30e2b9b8c7f0689b_0xa8bd02b5544fef11.text: I had my circumcision done at Dr. O's clinic. My problems were similar to many of the videos I've seen on TikTok. I was one of those people watching. Immediately after the circumcision, I wasn't very good at wound care or bandaging. I walked a lot, and my wound almost opened up. Luckily, the clinic noticed and scheduled a follow-up appointment to teach me how to properly bandage. I brought my housekeeper along to watch and help. I tried to walk less, stay home more, and try to stay in an air-conditioned room with a fan to prevent sweating. My housekeeper helped with the bandaging, and the swelling really subsided in about 3-4 days. I remember my staples starting to come loose about 3 weeks later. In the beginning, every time I had an erection, I was nervous and afraid the wound would separate and I'd need stitches again. But I survived. For those who have recently been circumcised, I recommend bringing your housekeeper to watch how to bandage. If I had done it myself, the wound probably wouldn't have healed well. Now the wound has healed, and the scarring is gone. Cleaning is so much easier now. For those who are still hesitant, I highly recommend being patient for the first 1-2 weeks after the circumcision.

0x30e2b9b8c7f0689b_0xa8bd02b5544fef11.text: Home wound care after surgery: Days 1-3: Avoid getting the wound wet. Use a towel to wipe yourself down instead of showering. Apply the cream recommended by your doctor. Once the wound begins to heal, apply the ointment to the wound three times a day. During home wound care, always seek advice and guidance. In my case, the wound healed almost completely within 3 weeks. After the procedure, urine doesn't remain in the wound, keeping the penis clean and reducing the risk of bladder infections.

0x30da3bcc4fd0f04d_0x2ac623a448035ad8.text: Before I met Dr. Bee, my cat, Giant, had peeling paws and sores on his mouth. I took him to many vets, and they all said it was a fungal infection or an allergy to floor cleaner. But he didn't get better, and his condition worsened. He couldn't eat, vomited, and when his mouth hurt, he would drink very little water. He also had digestive problems. Then I met Dr. Bee, who is incredibly kind. She diagnosed Giant with a protein allergy and has been treating and caring for him ever since. Whenever we leave Giant with her, we feel so secure, like we're raising him ourselves (he's even happier with a vet than with us, haha). Dr. Bee seems to genuinely love Giant. Normally, Giant is very timid and dislikes vets, but since being with Dr. Bee, he's not afraid at all. Regarding baths, Giant's fur always gets wet no matter where we bathed him. Then we met Dr. Bee, who recommended a special shampoo. She's the only vet who can dry Giant's fur so quickly that we don't need to come back to blow-dry him anymore. For us, it's well worth the price.💓💓 Sometimes they even have promotions and discounts, and they also do photo shoots for various festivals. As for boarding at a pet hotel, Dr. Bee and her assistant take such good care of Giant that he's become quite fond of it. Every time we leave him at the hotel, Giant never wants to go home!
0x30da3bcc4fd0f04d_0x2ac623a448035ad8.author: baitoey ppsw

0x30da3bcc4fd0f04d_0x2ac623a448035ad8.text: I highly recommend Pawjai Pet Clinic. The veterinarian is very competent and made a relevant diagnosis for two cats I entrusted to her care, each with very different problems. In both cases, the veterinarian demonstrated competence and administered the appropriate treatments. The veterinarian and her staff are true animal lovers, and the gentleness with which they provide care is remarkable. Everything is done to minimize stress for the pets, and hygiene is impeccable. A telling detail: outside near the entrance, there is a food and water dispenser for stray cats. The veterinarian is even currently vaccinating a beautiful and adorable healthy male cat found on her doorstep and is looking for someone to adopt him. The prices are reasonable compared to other places. And contrary to what another person wrote, the prices for foreigners are not exorbitant. The doctor doesn't overcharge foreigners. I saw Thai people paying prices equivalent to mine. The entire team at Pawjai Pet Clinic truly deserves the excellent reviews they receive on Google.

This clinic truly lives up to its name; it's incredibly satisfying. ♥️♥️♥️

0x30e29f40529b4625_0x87ec10e46f53f701.text: I have just completed a series of hyperbaric oxygen therapy (HBOT) sessions at Abloom Wellness Centre, and I cannot say enough good things about the experience. After surgery, I was looking for a place to support my recovery, and Abloom more than delivered. From the moment I walked in, I was struck by how knowledgeable and friendly the staff are. They took the time to explain exactly what the hyperbaric oxygen process would involve, answered all of my questions patiently, and made me feel completely at ease. That level of care made a huge difference — especially in a recovery phase where trust is everything. Each session left me feeling surprisingly energized. It was more than just relaxing; I genuinely felt renewed, like my body was getting a deep reset. I’m confident that these treatments are helping my wounds heal faster, and that sense of progress has been deeply reassuring. What really sealed the deal for me was the ambiance. The view from the centre is absolutely amazing — particularly if you book an evening session. Watching the city lights as you enjoy a drink after your session adds a peaceful touch to the therapy. Beyond HBOT, Abloom offers a wonderful range of services — from infrared sauna and ice baths to IV drip therapies and therapeutic massage. It’s clear they’ve curated a holistic wellness program that goes far beyond standard treatments. All in all, I would highly recommend Abloom Wellness Centre to anyone looking for professional, effective, and deeply restorative care. Whether you’re recovering from surgery or simply need a wellness boost, it’s a sanctuary that truly backs up its promise of helping you “come back to yourself.”
0x30e29f40529b4625_0x87ec10e46f53f701.author: Tanz Roxburgh

The combination of a 60-minute foot reflexology session and traditional Thai massage was deeply relaxing and skillfully performed — the therapists were clearly well-trained and highly knowledgeable in alternative medicine techniques. The highlight for me was the Hyperbaric Oxygen Room, which left me feeling rejuvenated and refreshed. The staff took time to explain the benefits and made sure I was comfortable throughout. The spa itself is beautifully maintained, with state-of-the-art, accredited facilities that reflect true professionalism and care for clients’ wellbeing. It’s clear that Abloom Wellness Spa takes a holistic and evidence-based approach to health and relaxation. Highly recommended for anyone looking to invest in their wellness and longevity — I’ll definitely be returning!

0x30da33213b1bc5f7_0x561529e0ba379399.text: I can say without a shadow of a doubt that selling my car to fund my time at The Dawn was the absolute best decision of my entire life. Healing is rarely ever supposed to be comfortable. In a community setting like this, you will run into every type of personality that exists in the outside world, often in its most extreme form. Other clients will complain, and the process will feel incredibly challenging at times. But there is a profound, undeniable healing that happens through authentic connection. Here, I learned to get used to discomfort, to finally speak aloud the things heavily tied to guilt, shame, anxiety, and fear. I learned that it is okay to say the wrong thing, and that true growth happens when you allow yourself to drop the mask and be seen. The staff and doctors here are elite professionals who intimately understand the mechanics of trauma: Robert, my focus therapist, is genuinely the best therapist I have ever had in my entire life. Helen, the clinical director, proved to be not only an exceptionally skilled practitioner in the healing process during our brief talks, but also an avid, inspiring leader. The entire staff, from the nurses to the support team, is incredibly polite, compassionate, and professional. In two months, I did not encounter a single person who showed attitude or didn't want to be here. I chose the Viva package (off-site residence) for two months, though due to renovations, I spent the first six weeks on-site. While the Viva accommodations are perfectly good enough to get the job done, staying on-site is incredibly useful because it gives you immediate access to professional help, nurses, and medications at odd hours of the night. Furthermore, being on-site allowed me to utilize the amenities, like the gym and the piano, for an extra two hours a day, which is surprisingly worth it. Every single aspect of the programming is intentionally tailored toward mental health and nervous system regulation. The activities, including TRE (Trauma Releasing Exercises), sound healing, massage, yoga, and Muay Thai kickboxing, are purposeful. Even the food is scientifically part of the narrative. Having studied nutrition for mood stability myself, I immediately noticed the intentional inclusion of beets, pumpkin seeds, and dried apricots. Furthermore, when the intense "cycle" of processing trauma triggered massive cravings for carbohydrates and chocolate, I was incredibly grateful that the dining room always had cookies and snacks on hand, and that the store had plenty of treats to help. If you are considering coming here for trauma, I HIGHLY recommend booking 56 days over 28. That extension grants you access to the specialized trauma group. You absolutely need those first 28 days in the regular groups just to stabilize, understand the process, and learn how the community works before diving into the deepest layers of your past. I thought I learned everything I needed until I entered the second group, and I couldn't believe how much deeper the path of connection and acceptance could go. It may not feel comfortable every day, but please trust that this place knows exactly what they are doing. I am leaving with a sense of groundedness I didn't think was possible, and I cannot wait to see where life takes me from here. — Joseph
0x30da33213b1bc5f7_0x561529e0ba379399.author: Joe Bryan

0x30da33213b1bc5f7_0x561529e0ba379399.text: Struggling with mental health and addiction while living on a vacation island in Thailand isn't fun at all. I’d never felt properly diagnosed, and my anxiety was creeping into every corner of my life, especially work. Things were getting harder to manage. After diving into some online research, I found The Dawn. I reached out, and Nathalie from the admissions team got in touch right away. She explained everything to me with patience, answering every one of my (many!) questions. Deciding to spend a month there was a big choice—work commitments meant I couldn’t stay longer—but looking back, it turned out to be one of the BEST decisions I’ve ever made for my well-being. Thank you very much to the Dawn!!! From the moment I arrived in Chiang Mai, the warm and welcoming staff made everything so smooth. I was greeted at the airport and driven to The Dawn, where I got a full tour of the grounds: the relaxing pool, a spacious gym and wellness center, a little convenience store, the sleek library, meeting rooms, and a gorgeous dining area overlooking the river. After settling into my cozy room, I had time to relax before meeting the rest of the team and my peers. The team at The Dawn is incredible—professional, compassionate, and always there when you need them. The support staff were ready to listen and hold space for me, my therapist Albert was not only extremely knowledgeable but truly passionate, and the doctors and nurses were top-notch. Then, there’s the fantastic gym team, the skilled massage therapists, and the people working behind the scenes—cooking delicious meals, maintaining the beautiful grounds, and keeping the whole place running smoothly. You’ll meet peers from all over the world who truly understand your struggles. The treatment blends Western and Eastern approaches, giving you a holistic path to healing. Each day is packed with group sessions (where you gain valuable insights from peers), individual counseling, educational sessions on psychology, fitness classes (like yoga, pilates, gym workouts, walks, aqua fitness, pickleball, zumba), meditation, sound bowl sessions, and evening time for journaling, exploring emotions, and practicing gratitude and CBT. If you’re struggling, don’t hesitate to ask for help. It’s not easy to face your fears and deepest, darkest secrets, but the relief that comes with shedding that weight is worth it. Don’t expect to walk out fully “healed”—this is real work, and it requires vulnerability. But with the incredible team at The Dawn guiding you, you’ll be equipped with tools that, if you continue to use them, can set you on the path to your best self for the future. Just remember: from dusk till dawn, take it one day at a time, one step at a time.
0x30da33213b1bc5f7_0x561529e0ba379399.author: Sandra Schneeweiss - Representative Koh Samui

0x30da33213b1bc5f7_0x561529e0ba379399.text: I’m writing this review on the final day of my second one-month stay at The Dawn, and I can only describe both of my experiences here as fantastic and life-saving. If you're considering a residential treatment facility, I strongly recommend reaching out — just make an enquiry and see for yourself the brilliant, holistic program they offer. I first came to The Dawn in April 2024, in the depths of addiction and the mental health issues that came with it. After my initial stay, I returned home clean and went on to live an awesome and fulfilling life for nine months. Unfortunately, a series of significant life events triggered a return to addictive behaviours. But thanks to the strength, knowledge, and tools I had gained from my first time at The Dawn, I was able to hit the brakes early and return — this time in a very different, much stronger place. During my second stay, my counsellor and I quickly identified what felt like the missing piece of the puzzle. I focused all my energy on that work, fully engaging with the facilities and the wide range of activities and practices that support every core aspect of the program. I’m leaving this stay feeling strong, confident, and empowered. The opportunities are here — and you truly get out what you put in. From start to finish, the staff at The Dawn are incredible people who want nothing but the best for every client. Their ethos of care, compassion, and friendliness is all-encompassing — from the cleaning staff and security guards to the counsellors, support team, admissions staff, chefs, fitness and yoga instructors, massage therapists, and the nursing team. Everyone plays a role in creating a deeply supportive environment. And then there are the clients. Across both my stays, I’ve met some of the most amazing, inspiring people I’ve ever known — many of whom I’m still in touch with and plan to stay connected to. The level of support and solidarity within the group was unlike anything I’ve experienced before. We came from different backgrounds with different struggles, but we all shared the same goal: to become the best versions of ourselves. As I now move into the next chapter of my recovery, I can’t thank The Dawn enough. My family and I will be forever grateful. Keep up the amazing work!
0x30da33213b1bc5f7_0x561529e0ba379399.author: Andy Threapleton

0x30da33213b1bc5f7_0x561529e0ba379399.text: This was my second experience of residential treatment. I arrived with an understanding of what therapeutic work involved, but not what this specific process would ask of me. I planned to stay four to six weeks. I stayed several months. I arrived at The Dawn numb and in a state of near emotional paralysis. A few years of recovery under my belt, yet more disconnected from myself than ever. The setting itself is inherently healing: beautiful grounds, comfortable accommodation, and a holistic programme that attends to the whole person. It is a genuinely good place to do hard work. It's worth noting that The Dawn isn't only for people in early recovery. I came seeking deeper psychological work, and the facility was fully equipped for that. The therapeutic offering goes well beyond addiction treatment. The work here is serious and substantive. I was able to engage with a range of modalities, including somatic work, held by clinicians who clearly understand that recovery isn't just about the mind. The emphasis on reconnecting with the body, not just processing cognitively, made a profound difference for me. This isn't a facility that offers one-size-fits-all treatment. The team took time to understand what I needed and built something around that. And when I had feedback, it was genuinely listened to and, where appropriate, acted upon. There were moments during my time at The Dawn where I couldn't see a future waiting for me on the other side of the gates. As is often true of any meaningful therapeutic process, things got worse before they got better. And they got better. I leave equipped with the skills to sit in discomfort rather than run from it, to move towards a fulfilling life rather than away from myself, towards a future aligned with my values and one that doesn't require me to contort myself into impossible positions (unless on a yoga mat). After a lifetime of jumping from buoy to buoy, fighting the tides, I seem finally to have learned to swim with rather than against them. I'm not looking for the next goal, but moving in a direction. And much like The Dawn itself, all I have to do is keep showing up. To everyone at The Dawn, thank you for all that you do.
0x30da33213b1bc5f7_0x561529e0ba379399.author: C D

0x30da33213b1bc5f7_0x561529e0ba379399.text: My experience at The Dawn Rehab Centre in Chiang Mai has been nothing short of life-changing. When I arrived, I was struggling deeply with addiction and trauma, unsure of who I was or how to move forward. After completing a 12-week bespoke program, I can genuinely say that I feel like a completely different person; grounded, empowered, and truly ready to step back into the real world. A huge part of this transformation is thanks to the incredible people who supported me every step of the way. My focal therapist, Alan Wood, guided me with compassion, insight, and unwavering care. His approach helped me confront the core of my issues and rebuild myself from a place of understanding rather than shame. I also want to express my gratitude to Helen Wells, the Clinical Director, whose leadership and vision shape the remarkable therapeutic environment at The Dawn. Her presence and expertise were felt throughout the entire program. The support team was equally extraordinary. I want to thank David, Abdulla, Pang, Jack, Top, Bas, Ping, Nora, Mary, Beam, Mun and Linh each of you played a unique role in my healing. Whether it was a conversation, a smile, or guidance during difficult moments, your kindness made all the difference. And to the amazing admissions team, Alex Holland, Marcus, Daryl, and everyone else involved, thank you for making the process smooth, reassuring, and filled with genuine care from the very beginning. The entire staff at The Dawn work together like a family, and during my stay, I truly felt part of that family. The environment, the personalized therapy, the structure, and the warmth of the community created the perfect space for deep healing and growth. I leave The Dawn with clarity, confidence, and a renewed sense of purpose. This journey has changed my life in ways I will forever be grateful for. Thank you, The Dawn. You gave me my life back.
0x30da33213b1bc5f7_0x561529e0ba379399.author: Aniket Patel

0x30da33213b1bc5f7_0x561529e0ba379399.text: During my time here I have gained the insight to address my mental health issues. I arrived thinking I was depressed and that my anxiety was under control. I see now that anxiety and burnout played a much bigger role than I realized. I was told that you will get out what you put in' and I fully agree with that. I can't say what specifically caused a shift, but I participated in the programs and very quickly started noticing changes. My therapist, John, was extremely knowledgeable and was able to identify issues I had no idea were causing me problems. I felt heard and understood and he has really helped me reclaim my life. He provided handouts and videos and books to help me understand what was going on, and more importantly, how to manage this in the future. This was my first time participating in peer groups, and as uncomfortable as they were at times, they were valuable. The facilitators provided little pearls of wisdom' during almost every session that will stick with me. The holistic and fitness sessions helped me feel a sense of peace for the first time in a very long time. The MBI sessions with Amanda were very beneficial. She has a gift that she is generously sharing with the clients here. I am leaving feeling like I have the tools to navigate life.
0x30da33213b1bc5f7_0x561529e0ba379399.author: France Pichakorn

0x30da33213b1bc5f7_0x561529e0ba379399.text: This is a continuation of my review - one year on from when I joined The Dawn and at one year sober, one day at a time. I remain very grateful to all the staff at The Dawn and in truth I sometimes rather miss the tranquility of the place, the friendliness, the myriad of things to do, but life carries on and luckily for me, The Dawn has allowed me to carry on with life, sober and certainly more at peace than I was before. Thank you The Dawn. I had a great experience at The Dawn and am very grateful for all the support and care I got. This hasn't been my first rehab, but undoubtedly it was the best. The staff are amazing - from the Support team, to the fitness team and of course the counsellors - but all of them play a part in welcoming you, making you feel at home and getting you back on track. The experience isn't as rigid as some of the UK rehabs I have been to but the outcome is significantly better. There is a lot of focus on CBT - and I now realise that unless I change my thinking, I will always go back to the hell that is addiction. I will be forever grateful to The Dawn - a fantastic rehab with excellent facilities, lovely people and a great atmosphere.
0x30da33213b1bc5f7_0x561529e0ba379399.author: Wyndham Clark

0x30da33213b1bc5f7_0x561529e0ba379399.text: I had the most beautiful and grounded intake experience with Alex Holland from The Dawn. He held space for me in a way that was rare—genuinely present, kind, and truly listening to *who I am* and what I needed. I’ve spoken to so many people over the years about treatment, and this was different. Alex didn’t rush or push anything. He was thoughtful, transparent, and answered every question with care. He gave me insight into the Bespoke and Signature programs, helped me feel into what would be best for my nervous system, and made me feel *seen* as a neurodivergent woman in a healing season. It’s rare to feel safe during intake calls, but Alex offered something more—he reminded me of what’s possible when someone simply listens. This was more than a consultation; it was a point of healing. Thank you, Alex. I hope this review helps others find their way to The Dawn, because you truly are the kind of person people need at the beginning of this path. With gratitude, Anslyn

0x30e29f8bd4107e0b_0x45458aed3fae74f7.text: Convenient location near BTS On Nut, less than 100 meters away. Clean restrooms. You can schedule appointments online in advance. No waiting upon arrival; appointments are scheduled on time. The person in charge of coordination and management provided excellent and detailed information. I inquired about social security benefits and was informed that they could be used (ID card required). Regarding treatment costs, a clear list of treatments and prices was provided. The prices are standard, but considering the convenience of the location, the time saved from scheduling in advance, and the service and treatment itself, it was more than worth it. I was treated by Dr. Lertlak Ruangsinpinya. Upon entering the examination room, the doctor asked about my symptoms and explained the possible causes. Then, the doctor began examining my teeth, offering me a mirror to view my teeth while she examined them, so I could understand what was happening. After a (detailed) examination, the doctor mentioned a small cavity and offered three options: 1. X-ray for a more detailed examination of any problems. 2. Filling (optional, as the cavity was small, but prompt filling was recommended). 3. Scaling (tartar removal). The cost of each item was also explained. I opted for all three treatments. It started with an X-ray. When the results came back, the doctor pointed out and explained every detail, showing where the dark spots (on the film) might be and why. The doctor then thoroughly examined the problematic areas. The results showed only one cavity, exactly as the doctor had initially examined. Then they began filling the tooth and scaling. During the treatment, these are some of the things I remember hearing: "Close your mouth, rest your mouth," the doctor knew my mouth was tired (lol), "Raise your left hand if it hurts," "I need to go a little deeper here," "Relax your mouth," "Turn to the right, bend down a little," "Adjust the chair." Everything I've written here is to convey that the doctor communicated with the patient exceptionally well, clearly, professionally, and always considered the patient's needs. I knew in advance what would happen during the treatment. Other doctors I've been treated by elsewhere were also very good, but Dr. Lertlak was exceptional. She paid attention to every detail (lol), and it created understanding and peace of mind as a patient. The doctor's assistant was also very helpful in answering questions and highly skilled. The doctor communicated with the patient throughout the treatment, but the assistant hardly needed to be told what to do. Then, during the post-scaling irrigation, the assistant suctioned the water very well. I didn't feel like my mouth was flooded with water at all. While writing this, I also saw reviews about other doctors here. They all provide excellent treatment. I recommend you try it! For foreigners reading this review, you should definitely visit this clinic. I couldn’t recommend it more. The service and treatment are excellent. The price is standard—actually even cheap compared to what you receive. You can check the prices before deciding, as they clearly list all prices and keep them fair.

I had a different doctor today because my schedule does not match Dr. Piboonsri, but it is absolutely fine. The doctors communicate very well with each other and the staff are also well communicating via LINE. Upon the day of surgery, I was literally super nervous. But Dr. Apichaya’s bedside manner was a 10000/10. She was super chill, which made me calmer. She paid attention to details and was really talking me through the process and provided me with a heads up if it’ll be slightly painful or not. She kept on checking on how I was doing the entire time. I absolutely LOVE her. This whole experience has been amazing because of how she treated the session. Apart from this experience, my husband has also been going to DentalWise for almost 2 years. It’s always been smooth and amazing each visit. Would recommend it for everyone.

0x30e29fac08c782a1_0x50a2558ecc627260.text: I am from Switzerland and I have been a patient with Dr. Napong for 2years. I’ve done an Invisalign treatment which was combined with orthodontic treatment. It's a far way to go to the dentist but I must say it's really worth it. Dr. Napong has a broad knowledge of different dentistry areas. He works very professionally, examining, and providing solutions by priority. The technology of the dental equipment used is the most modern I’ve ever seen, which added to the comfort during and after all treatments. 0x30e29fac08c782a1_0x50a2558ecc627260.text: I’ve tried a few dental clinics in this area, and one thing I noticed is that many places tend to push extra treatments right away (like X-rays, deep cleaning packages, etc.), which can feel a bit overwhelming if you’re just going in for something simple. What I appreciated about Dental Wise Clinic is that they took a much more straightforward approach. I went in for teeth whitening, and instead of immediately upselling, they first checked my teeth and explained my options clearly. There was no pressure to do additional procedures, which made me feel a lot more comfortable. The staff were attentive and professional, and the whole process was smooth from start to finish. One small but important thing: they’re very responsive on LINE, which made booking and asking follow-up questions really easy. If you’re considering this clinic, I’d say it’s a good option if you want: • a no-pressure consultation • clear explanations before committing to anything • easy communication and quick responses That said, I still recommend checking a couple of clinics first, prices and approaches can vary a lot in this area. But based on my experience so far, this is one of the more honest and comfortable ones I’ve been to.

0x30e29fac08c782a1_0x50a2558ecc627260.text: I'm currently receiving Invisalign treatment here. I've always had fairly good teeth alignment, and I never thought orthodontic treatment would be necessary for me. However, as I've gotten older, my upper and lower front teeth started clenching together, causing pain. Initially, I suspected cavities and visited DentalWise, but Dr. Napon explained that the problem was due to a bad bite. After having a scan done and seeing my teeth objectively, I started noticing my overbite, something I hadn't worried about before. I couldn't forget the straight, beautiful smile I saw in the simulation, so I decided to start Invisalign here. I remember feeling relieved when they told me, "Many of our patients undergo orthodontic treatment not only for straighter teeth, but also to keep their natural teeth healthy for a long time." The staff are all warm and kind. I want to congratulate myself for making the bold decision to undergo orthodontic treatment in Thailand. It's a bit embarrassing, but I've included photos of my significantly overbite before treatment and my beautiful teeth afterward for reference. (The left is before, and the right is after. No teeth were extracted.)

0x30e29fd0ab1794f9_0xc62352c8206c53ae.text: This is my second time getting braces. I had them 12 years ago at another clinic. Dr. Ing gave good advice (my front teeth are misaligned; the doctor suggested implants, costing 4500-5000 baht, but it's optional. If I do it, treatment will take up to 5 years. The X-ray also showed a root problem with one tooth and a chance of one front tooth dying, but the doctor said it might not happen). The treatment plan is for 2-3 years. I'm a little worried and scared because I'm older now, and I've been afraid of dentists since I was a child. I'm getting braces because my teeth feel spaced out, my front teeth protrude, and they're starting to become crooked (I didn't wear my retainer regularly). I've read good reviews, and it's close to home. I'll give it a try and share my review later. Currently, the braces cost is 2100 baht for cleaning and scaling (900 baht under social security, plus 400 baht for the rest). The first time the braces are fitted is on August 19th, 2025 (upper teeth, lower teeth not yet fitted; the doctor said to adjust). The doctor asked... We chose the orthodontic treatment package, Package 1, priced at 37,000 baht. The first four months were paid at 3,000 baht each, followed by 1,000 baht per month thereafter. The first payment included a brush set and service fee of 350 baht, bringing the total to 3,350 baht. On 23/9/68, the rubber bands were changed, the lower braces were reattached, and the front teeth were hitting the braces, requiring the last tooth on each side to be lifted (1,000 baht). The total cost was 4,100 baht. The tooth lifting caused a malocclusion; I can't bite properly and have to eat soft foods in small bites for now. On 26/10/68, the wire at the back came loose from the bracket. I had to see the dentist urgently and also got my teeth stained (3,100 baht).

0x30e29da9afcd3e4b_0xa65dcbb44beb6cec.text: Started my Invisalign here and so far it’s been a good experience. The clinic is clean, parking’s easy, and the staff are really helpful with follow-ups. I saw lots of Invisalign boxes around, so feels like they’ve got plenty of cases and know what they’re doing. Price is fair with a clear timeline, and now I’m just excited to see the results in the next 10 months. ——— **[10-Month Update]** I am updating my review after completing my initial treatment plan to provide a more comprehensive reflection of my experience. When I signed up, I opted for the extra plan which was presented as including refinements if the initial results weren't fully satisfactory. (They do offer a 39k promotional plan, but it came with conditions and excludes refinements). After completing my first set of 20 aligners, some gaps still remain and further adjustments are needed. There’s an additional fee for rescanning and ordering the new refinement lot (anyway, the new set of refined aligners are already included in the plan). Including various miscellaneous costs along the way, there’s around 5k additional fees on top of the original plan—and this does not yet include the post-treatment retainers. Regarding the clinical care, I once met with the dentist during the initial consultation, scanning, and treatment planning phase. The explanation provided at the time was quite brief. For all subsequent visits—including the placement of attachments, progress monitoring, and the final check of the first 20 sets—the care was delivered entirely by dental assistants. In conclusion, this clinic delivers the service, but it is important for prospective patients to be aware that you may not see the doctor during your routine visits, and you should anticipate additional miscellaneous costs beyond the base package price. Btw, staffs are wonderful.

0x30e2994d4732f35b_0xd0721f04fbadd0f3.text: I've seen Dr. May three times now. She's incredibly skilled; she diagnoses quickly and accurately pinpoints trigger points. Second visit: Office syndrome, right neck, shoulder, and upper back pain. Three shockwave treatments completely resolved the issue. Third visit: My left hand was numb and my left neck, shoulder, and upper back were very stiff. I had trigger point injections; it was sore for three days, but the lump on my shoulder disappeared. Another shockwave treatment was done by P'Yui (the physical therapist), and the numbness in my hand is 90% gone. It's not just the doctor who's amazing; all the physical therapists here are incredibly skilled. They hit the right trigger points every time, are thorough and attentive to patients, and answer all questions. I trust this place completely. It was painful, but the results were amazing. I'd had one extracted before by the same dentist who was also skilled, quick, and didn't bruise my gums, but they live in another province and it wasn't convenient to travel. So I came to Dr. Kamol. 0x30e29bd7339e2905_0x5595b60612ca2f67.text: I went to the dentist because of a sharp, shooting toothache that sent shivers down my spine. It was caused by a cavity I'd been scaling up. My old dentist said I needed root canal treatment, but the appointment was at the end of the month. The next day, the pain returned, and I couldn't wait any longer. I called 4-5 clinics near my place, but all had appointments at the end of the month. Finally, I found this clinic. The person who answered said I had an appointment the next day, so I rushed over. I saw Dr. Supoj. He X-rayed my wisdom tooth (which he didn't find at my old clinic). He explained that root canal treatment with a crown wouldn't last long because the wisdom tooth, which had been pushing against the other tooth, needed to be removed. After removal, my tooth would become loose. He recommended extracting my molar and the wisdom tooth, followed by a dental implant. Dr. Supoj was so kind, like a father figure! I'm usually terrified of dentists, but meeting a doctor who was like a respected elder made all my fear disappear. After that, I scheduled another appointment for the molar extraction and wisdom tooth surgery. I saw Dr. Kaew, who was incredibly kind. She constantly asked if I was okay and talked to me about what she was doing. The atmosphere was very relaxing. The assistants were attentive and even applied Vaseline, as mentioned in previous reviews. It was a very positive experience with both my wisdom tooth extraction and other tooth extractions. Finding a doctor who understands their patient is truly wonderful!
0x30e29bd7339e2905_0x5595b60612ca2f67.author: Fern Feuille

0x30e29bd7339e2905_0x5595b60612ca2f67.text: Since I started going to the dentist, I've never met a dentist as skilled, gentle, and kind as Dr. Supoj. He explains every step in detail, is patient, and truly helps patients feel relaxed, so much so that I've overcome my fear of going to the dentist. The atmosphere here is wonderful. Soft music is played during treatments, creating a calm and relaxing environment. The clinic also gives away free Buddhist books by Luang Por Pramote Pamochcho. It's clear they care about both the physical and mental well-being of their patients. Another commendable aspect is that the doctor provides free treatment to Buddhist monks, a rare act of compassion. I had severe tooth pain for several days and had been to other clinics, but they couldn't find the cause. But here, the doctor immediately diagnosed the need for root canal treatment. My condition improved instantly after the treatment. The cost is reasonable, not expensive at all. The clinic is clean, modern, well-equipped, and very easy to get to as it's right next to the MRT Purple Line (Ministry of Public Health Station). The staff are all friendly, smiling, and provide excellent service. P.S. I recommend calling to book an appointment in advance and arriving on time for the convenience of both the patient and the medical team.

0x305037325bacf68d_0xbfaf7ea0eee85d0d.text: In my opinion, Blue Tree Phuket Water Park is a fantastic place for a fun and relaxing day out. It offers a great mix of excitement and comfort, making it suitable for families and groups of friends. First, the experience is exciting and enjoyable. The lagoon is huge and clean, and there are many activities like water slides, zip lines, and paddle boarding that keep visitors entertained for hours. Second, the service is friendly and well-organized. The staff are helpful and safety-focused, which makes the experience stress-free. Although the price is higher than some, local waterpar the facilities are modern and well-maintained, so it feels worth the money. The food and drinks taste fresh and flavorful, though they can be a bit expensive. Overall, I highly recommend Blue Tree Phuket Water Park because of its fun activities, good service, and clean environment. Even though the prices are not cheap, the overall experience makes it a great place to visit.

There are plenty of food options too, from cafés to restaurants, so it’s easy to spend a few hours there. It’s also very practical as it provides lots of parking, pet-friendly areas, and is great for families. Kids Planet is a big plus if you want some time to yourself. You can also run errands, grab groceries, browse shops, or pick up clothes or jewelry without going elsewhere. Overall, it’s a well-designed, convenient place where you can do everything in one spot.

0x30e29e515b92e783_0xeda42350fbd005c8.text: I have already purchased the three-session dark spot removal course. I am posting this review immediately after my second laser treatment. After two visits, I can say that the treatment isn't just about using the laser and then being done with it; the follow-up care is comprehensive, giving me a sense of security and trust. I feel that the price is well worth it, so I highly recommend it. About a month after my first treatment, I feel that my dark spots have lightened slightly, and with more sessions, they will gradually disappear and my skin will become more beautiful. The treatment consisted of a 10-minute cleansing session, followed by a consultation and photo shoot with the doctor. The laser treatment without anesthesia was tolerable, and I was informed that treatment could be given to my lips this time. The entire treatment, including my lips, took about 10 minutes. The laser was used to treat the dark spots using six different levels, using two heads, and was tailored to the type of dark spot. Every time the laser power level was changed, an interpreter explained the laser treatment and confirmed any pain, staying close by, so I felt at ease. After that, I was given a thorough cooling and serum application that took about 40 minutes in total, starting with towel cooling, followed by 15 minutes with a slightly warm machine, followed by 10 minutes with a mask (no sheets), followed by wiping, followed by three types of natural creams that seem to be good for the skin. I was surprised when I looked in the mirror right after the serum application, seeing how pale and toned my face had become. I brought my nearly three-year-old child with me on my first visit, and while I was undergoing treatment for about an hour, the staff kept him company, showing him a YouTube video, and I was very grateful that they allowed me to bring my child.
0x30e29e515b92e783_0xeda42350fbd005c8.author: おおとえりな

0x30e29e515b92e783_0xeda42350fbd005c8.text: I've been receiving treatment here for over two years. My face was burned after a laser treatment for age spots at another clinic didn't work for me, and you fixed it here. I can't thank you enough. The doctor and the Japanese interpreter were all very attentive and listened to me, even giving me advice like, "Try this cream!" The serum injection after the laser feels so good, I love it. Last time, I also tried acne injections. I thought, "Of course a facial injection would hurt...! I can't do it!", but I was troubled by the acne and scars that appear around my monthly menstrual cycle, so I inadvertently tried them. It hurt. Of course it hurt. But I'm so glad I did it. Seriously. I was so impressed by how well my acne healed. Considering how well it healed in such a short amount of time, the pain of the injections was practically nonexistent. People who suffer from acne and acne scars shouldn't get them without thinking. I'll do it again. I look forward to seeing you again next time.

0x30519461d08f0115_0x24e1315d43e6a8b8.text: ⭐Tourism Hemodialysis Experience at Krabi Nakharin Hospital⭐ My father is a CKD patient who requires routine hemodialysis. Here's the breakdown of our experience for those who are looking: - I contacted several hospitals in Thailand's beach destinations >3 months in advance to decide on the potential place for our holiday. This hospital was the first to reply (all their responses were very prompt, typically <30 minutes). - They have a fully functioning Dialysis Suite that divided their sessions into 3 appointment slots: 6AM, 10AM, and 2PM. We managed to book a 2PM session on a Saturday. - Try to book as early as you can. Booking is FOC, but you will need to send a follow up email with the medical documents / blood test reports for their team's reference. They will reply with a confirmatory email upon receiving all your documents. - Our impression during the visit: facility feels newly renovated with a clean and comfortable environment. Spacious but not too big. Not much difficulty to navigate self around. - We first had to register at the Reception Counter near the Emergency Department. Standard procedure for registration was done (make sure to bring your passport!). Once registration was complete, a staff member accompanied us to the Dialysis Suite. - At the Dialysis Suite, standard procedure was carried out by the Nursing team to check vital signs, weight, general assessment. All the nurses were very professional and experienced. My father was hooked to the HD machine by 2:15PM and finished by 6:20PM. He was regularly assessed in 30 minute intervals and was very comfortable throughout. - Last but not least: PRICING! Charges were very reasonable and, most importantly, did not break the bank. We were already informed of the exact price upfront during booking and no hidden costs were charged during payment. Please be noted there is a 4% credit card fee if using any type of card payment, which we were informed too. If you would like to avoid this, then carry cash with you. Just some other points to add for reference: - Please do not pack your schedule too tightly if planning for an appointment on the same day. We booked the 2:00PM slot but started the dialysis session slightly later at 2:15PM. As this is a hospital, we understand that appointment times are tentative and can vary depending on the situation. - Meals aren't provided during treatment (which is a common practice at our regular HD Centre). I'm not sure if it's because ours was the 2PM slot (after lunchtime). Please eat before you arrive and bring some light snacks with you, where necessary. - There isn't much commercial shops around. There's a 7Eleven at a walkable distance, but apart from that there's not much else. Be prepared to hang out at the hospital if you're waiting it out. There's plenty of sofas at the lobby if you'd like to lounge. - For Muslims, there's a musolla / prayer room at the Ground Floor to pray. Halal food joints aren't many around the area and are either mostly closed during daytime or only accepts cash. The locals at the shops aren't fluent in English either (as I think the area is less commercial compared to other parts of Krabi). Bring cash if you'd like to try and eat nearby, or just take a Grab to eat someplace else. - For non-Muslims, there's plenty of food joints around the area that are at a walkable distance. We didn't try visiting them, but I would also suggest to carry cash if you want to eat nearby. All in all, we've had a very good experience here and are happy that we found a reliable facility for my father to get his routine dialysis during our holiday. Thank you to the wonderful Nursing and Reception team who were very kind and professional throughout! If we were to visit Krabi again, we'd definitely utilise the services again when needed 😊
0x30519461d08f0115_0x24e1315d43e6a8b8.author: Farah Yunos

0x30519461d08f0115_0x24e1315d43e6a8b8.text: I just want to say that you never plan an accident and you never plan where you're going to be getting the care to work yourself back to being healthy again. I can say beyond a doubt that this Hospital and staff along with the nurses the support staff were fantastic. I was so lucky and blessed to have been able to recover from a serious accident with a motorcycle running me down on the street that the ambulance took me to this place for recovery. The doctors nurses and staff did a fantastic job and it was reconfirmed by the orthopedic surgeon here in Canada. My physiotherapist could speak good English and was able to help me with some of the issues around the language barrier. She became a friend. One thing I learned is the Thai people in Thailand are some of the most beautiful people in the world. Thank you again for your care and compassion towards me even though there was a huge language barrier we figured it out. Thank you again and I can't wait to come back and say thank you and walking on my own 2 feet. Also thank you Lisa and your colleagues in the international hospitals office for all your help and getting all the right forms to my insurance companies. This was much appreciated. Your Canadian friend Dave
0x30519461d08f0115_0x24e1315d43e6a8b8.author: Dave Fischl

0x30519461d08f0115_0x24e1315d43e6a8b8.text: My wife and I were blown away by our experience at Krabi Nakharin. We suffered an ATV accident. Luckily the agency organising it had insurance and we were rushed to Krabi Nakharin. All we had to do was email them our passports and they sorted out everything for us. Treatment started immediately, they treated us with great care. X Rays were done. Nurses were available for our dressing. Since my wife had a fracture, they admitted us and gave us a very high quality room with a side bed so I could attend to her and sleep. The doctor had a surgery in the evening but made sure to drop in during the night to consult with us and was very helpful in articulating options. Every little detail was attended to and great care was provided. They even offered to drop us to the airport and had an accompanying attendant who spoke Thai and arranged for the wheelchair from the airline staff. We have lived in India and Singapore which have high health standards and this hospital took it to a different level. Outstanding, world class experience international experience! THANK YOU team Krabi Nakharin and the staff! I would highly recommend this hospital to international patients.
0x30519461d08f0115_0x24e1315d43e6a8b8.author: Ramesh Gopalakrishna

0x30519461d08f0115_0x24e1315d43e6a8b8.text: This large private hospital is located in a side street off Maharat Road. The hospital building is a large structure, divided into departments on each floor. There's a large covered parking lot at the back of the building and a small outdoor parking area in front. I visited the hospital on a Friday morning in mid-February, experiencing fatigue and dizziness, symptoms similar to rhabdomyolysis. It was my first time at the hospital. The staff took my medical history before referring me to a doctor. The doctor ordered blood tests to check various values. The total cost for the day, including doctor's fees, medication, and lab tests, was approximately 5000 baht. I had insurance covering half of the cost. Overall, it's a private hospital that isn't overcrowded. The referral process to different departments is quite efficient. The hospital's internal management is well-organized. The atmosphere inside is quiet and peaceful. The staff, including nurses and other personnel, are polite and not rude. Waiting times for examinations and other procedures aren't excessively long. However, this comes at a high cost. Parking within the hospital is relatively convenient.
0x30519461d08f0115_0x24e1315d43e6a8b8.author: pakinai kasiwat

0x30519461d08f0115_0x24e1315d43e6a8b8.text: Our insurance company contacted this hospital on January 1st at 12:00 PM. Our child had a stomach infection. We arrived in very poor condition. We were admitted quickly, no lines, and immediately given an IV and medication for vomiting and diarrhea. The symptoms subsided immediately, but by evening our temperature had risen, and we decided to stay overnight. Over the course of 24 hours, we were given four 900ml IVs. We were placed in a large room with a regular bed for our child, a sofa bed for my husband and me, a separate kitchen with a sink, kettle, and microwave, and a large shower. We were also given everything necessary for hygiene. The nurses were very helpful; they inserted the catheter very carefully and secured everything so that our child slept peacefully and nothing was damaged. They came frequently to measure our temperature, blood pressure, and blood oxygen levels. We didn't stay the next day, even though we could have; we were given medications to take home and discharged. A huge thank you to the doctors, nurses, and insurance partners of T-Bank!
0x30519461d08f0115_0x24e1315d43e6a8b8.author: Карина Лахтычкина

0x30519461d08f0115_0x24e1315d43e6a8b8.text: I was "lucky" to end up at this medical facility on the morning of January 1st with a high fever, headache, back pain, and joint pain. The doctor was alone at the time, so I had to wait about an hour and a half. Seeing that I wasn't feeling well, they put me on the couch - I even took a short nap. They took some tests and within an hour at most, they diagnosed me with Dengue Virus. Dr. PIBUN explained all the treatment and options in detail - since I sought treatment in a timely manner, there was the option of being treated at a hotel, but he recommended staying in the hospital. I listened and have never regretted it. It was a difficult couple of nights. And it was impossible to get such treatment, monitoring, and care at a hotel. 0x30da3527850c443d_0xf22583e841b29c53.text: I have been involved in therapy and counseling for most of my adult life. I am 49, and have had challenges with chemical dependency, depression, anxiety and some basic and devastating life problems as well. With all the PHD, PsyD and CSAC's (certified substance abuse counselor's) and likewise accredited behavioral health professionals, though the years, I have found that Brett to be the most effective and well rounded thus far. He has great knowledge and insight, is sincere, and cares. Brett far surpasses my expectations and is one of the best I have had the fortunate experience of crossing paths with finally. I am currently and have been, for quite some time now, working with Brett 2x a week, and have found that his depth and perspective to be very enlightening, motivating, and helpful. I need the help! I often do not look forward to working with a therapist, as I have had so many. However, now I like too, and want to with Brett. I am now understanding not only my issues, but how to better manage them, while MOVING FORWARD at the same time. Many therapists are too academic, some are too 12-step based and some have had no real-life experience with the subject matter at hand. Brett knows all sides, which for me keeps it objective, realistic, and balanced. Some therapists just ask open ended questions and are too agreeable. Brett is able to offer up different viewpoints, often to the point where I can learn, as opposed to someone who just agrees with me all the time is often just not helping me, in my experience. This becomes a waste of time and resources and I do not get better or begin to change/heal. He offers suggestions regarding short and long term strategies, whilst offering up specific tactics (actual means) on how to achieve those goals, too. 0x30fdabbb852d7101_0x7597c0601ed02b68.text: I was having an issue with one of my eyes. I thought it might be another “floater” but it was more than that. With some “prompting” from my friends they recommended I see Dr. Pairat at the Pairst Eye Clinic in Hua Hin for an eye examination. I saw him the next day and after a thorough examination he advised me I had a detached retina! As a guest to Thailand, going home for treatment was not an option given the urgency of the situation. Dr. Pairat recommenced I attend a hospital in Bangkok for treatment purposes. He referenced a few hospitals, so after discussion with others who underwent eye treatment in Bangkok, I selected the Rutnin Eye Hospital. That is where I underwent surgery to repair the damaged eye. The treatment and care I received at this hospital was superb. Following discharge from the hospital I saw Dr. Pairat for checkup purposes. Once again he conducted a thorough examination of my eye and recommended the desired treatment until I am able to return home and see my doctors there. So thank you Dr. Pairat, along with the support staff at your Clinic, for the service you provided me. It was truly appreciated. You may well have assisted in my not losing the sight in my eye. i would not hesitate at all recommending your Clinic to others in need. Many thanks for the service you extended me and may you enjoy continued success! Kindest regards.
0x30fdabbb852d7101_0x7597c0601ed02b68.author: Frank Anderson

0x30fdabbb852d7101_0x7597c0601ed02b68.text: I had lens replacement surgery on my eyes in Korea several years ago. The process was painful and left me almost blind for 2 weeks. Hence I was reluctant to have invasive surgery on my eyes again. I was buying increasingly more powerful spectacles to overcome the challenges I was having seeing my laptop, reading and any close up work. This came to a head yesterday when I bought my 3rd pair of spectacles in as many weeks, that were again not entirely successful. Therefore I visited Dr. Pairat. He gave me a thorough examination and said he could repair the damage to my eye with laser treatment. He explained that it would be entirely painless and only take a few minutes. I agreed and true to his word, it was painless and quick and I had no difficulty driving home afterwards. After a nights sleep, I have no discomfort and am writing this on my phone, which would have been impossible previously. Also not forgetting the ladies in the doctor's office. They all spoke excellent English, were friendly, professional and a credit to their profession and I thank them very much for making my visit so pleasant.
0x30fdabbb852d7101_0x7597c0601ed02b68.author: Keith Brown

0x30fdabbb852d7101_0x7597c0601ed02b68.text: Dr Pairat has been around and seen more than a few farangs that are after cheap and high quality service and staff that can explain any eye problem in English language or in the case of French farangs the use of graduate level French language - Germans naturally in high German language, not Bavarian. Preferably in an office surrounded by all the latest high tech equipment that can speak any language determined by AI and back-noised by digital gadgets and of course headsets for everyone. You are better off going back to Miami, London Harley street or Heidelberg. I had work done at Dr Pairat for many years, including cataract surgery performed by him at the Bangkok Hospital, and found it very acceptable although the 'shoes off' and sitting there for an hour can sometimes feel a bit boring. I tried every physical therapy method, including Shockwave, PMS, and Ultrasound, but nothing completely cured it. So I decided to try acupuncture to stimulate the muscles directly at the painful point. The first 1-2 sessions might not show much effect because the muscles were sore from years of treatment. But by the third session, my symptoms improved steadily. Now, after completing a course of 6 sessions, my pain level has dropped from 8.5/10 to just 2/10. My life is easier and I'm much less stressed. Things I liked: 🩷 Doctor: Kind, gave precise advice, the acupuncture was painless and took about an hour (acupuncture + cupping). 🩷 Service: The admin responded quickly and managed the appointments very well. 🩷 Location: The clinic is located in a gas station, easily accessible with plenty of parking. For anyone experiencing similar chronic pain, I recommend trying acupuncture treatment consistently. It's definitely worth the money. This is based on my personal experience.💯

0x305030f213e8fec5_0x5463bc6a7cffdf8a.text: Doctor's name: Khun PONGSAKORN. Removal of old breast implants due to suspected rupture. For personal reasons, I could not undergo the procedure under general anesthesia. I do not tolerate certain types of anesthesia well, and even tooth extraction is life-threatening. Clinics and hospitals (I consulted in 4 places) refused to use local anesthesia. In addition, I wanted the incision to be made along the old scar around the areola, and not under the breast, but the implants were very large. This surgeon was the only one who communicated with me properly, listened to my wishes, and did everything perfectly. He made incisions over the old scar and removed the implants under local anesthesia. ✅️Quick and painless. ✅️Without new scars. ✅️The cost was extremely reasonable for me, several times lower than anywhere else. He has a perfectly clean and advanced operating room on the second floor with all the necessary equipment. He has many years of experience behind him and has done many things hundreds of times. His assistants have been working for 18 years and are very experienced. Linens and "patient clothing," instruments, optimal, safe anesthesia - he doesn't relax and takes care of us. He is a man who changes people's lives. I am also sure that he has the best-invisible sutures in the world and that he performs Botox injections flawlessly. He is a master of his craft, very passionate about his work, a true professional, and a very good person. You can trust him with your secrets. He is very professionally honest. A heart of gold and golden hands are what distinguishes this doctor.
