0x30da3a7d9a4abd79_0xab608efde5483493.text: I needed to have a wisdom tooth extracted. I read the reviews of all the dental clinics. There was one for this place that I trusted. The bad reviews made me wary, but they were about poor service. My experience was great! Everyone was very kind! At all times! There are several steps to follow upon arrival, which might be confusing. But it's super easy, and many people speak English. If you have trouble, I recommend using your phone's translator. Also, read the directions to the places to go upon arrival, which are in one of the comments. First, you have to go to reception and fill out a form, then go to another area, then to the dentist who will evaluate you. If you need to have the tooth extracted or go to another area, they will tell you. If you have to go to area 3, which is for the tooth extraction, when you arrive, you have to open the window and leave the pink slip of paper in the basket, and they will call you later. This is important because you might arrive at department 3 and sit and wait, and they never call you. Remember, if you have any questions, ask; everyone is very kind and will help you. Then a student will attend to you and extract the tooth. If they have any complications, they'll call the professor. You pay when you leave. I had asked how much it would cost beforehand, and they charged me what they told me: 4 euros. They explained the ENTIRE procedure to me at ALL times. I got very nervous and cried from fear before starting, and the student who attended to me held my hand, calmed me down, and told me that we wouldn't start until I felt ready, that she would wait as long as I needed, and not to worry, that she was there for me. She was an angel. Very professional. When they finished, they gave me gauze. I'm very grateful. It's important to understand that this is a faculty where you're seen by students supervised by professors, so obviously it's not the same as going to a specialist. There's a risk that something might go wrong, but there are very professional professors, and the price is very affordable. Everything was incredibly quick and painless, and everyone was so kind. Dentists in Thailand are highly professional! And everything is very hygienic. My congratulations to the student and professor who treated me, as well as the reception staff and all the other personnel!
0x30da3a7d9a4abd79_0xab608efde5483493.author: Carol Ramallo

0x30da3a7d9a4abd79_0xab608efde5483493.text: I can directly compare my experience at this facility with expensive UK private healthcare for the same issue, and this place was so much more efficient, it's scary. I had a rare abscess in the root of a tooth, it had been developing for about a year and was just getting bigger and bigger. I went to a regular dentist in CM, who referred me here. It took about 3-4 hours for me to get assessed, referred to various departments, x-rayed, and presented with treatment options. I chose the surgical option but was told I would have to wait 3 weeks for the surgery. I was due to visit home in the UK in 3 weeks, so I decided I would get it done in the UK when I went back. I made an appointment with my UK dentist for the day after I arrived in the UK. He referred me to a specialist, that was about a 6-week wait (and this is private healthcare, NHS probably would have taken a year). The specialist didn't need to take x-rays, because I brought my CT scan from CMU Dental Faculty, if I didn't have it, that would have been another referral and more weeks/months waiting. The UK specialist (a renowned facial reconstructive surgeon, it turned out), gave me the EXACT treatment options I received at CMU Dental Faculty. Again, I choose the surgical option. The wait for surgery was another 6-8 weeks. If I had done the entire thing in the UK, it would have taken about 4 months to get to the same stage it took 4 hours to get to at CMU Dental Faculty. Then the wait for surgery was more than double. My surgery in the UK went amazingly, my Doctor was one of the best facial surgeons in the world, so I'm very happy with the outcome. But I don't understand how UK healthcare can't move as fast as it does here. Everyone I saw at CMU Dental Faculty was knowledgeable and able to explain to me what was going on and what my options were. I felt in good hands all the way.
0x30da3a7d9a4abd79_0xab608efde5483493.author: Charlie Parker

0x310295fd683462cb_0xe649c843be6f5443.text: I like this Dental clinic. I first went there in November of 2023 after much research on Dentists in the area. Everyone agreed they did good work and that their prices were reasonable. I saw Dr Monthirada Leekpai for a cleaning and assessment. I knew the assessment was necessary since I had not seen a dentist for over 8 years. The cleaning was fast and efficient, No issues and no pain. The cost of the cleaning was 700 THB. I needed to get 2 crowns and 2 fillings. On my second appointment it took 1 hour to prep the teeth for 2 crowns and finish 1 filling. Total cost was 18,000. I elected to go for the ceramic crowns at 9000 THB each. The porcelain crowns were only 5000 THB each. I did ask about the gap in my front teeth, I have had various dentists attempt to fix the gap by attaching tooth material there. Dr. Monthirada told me that it would probably not work well and that I did not need it. I find this to be admirable, instead of trying to sell me another fix, she was honest about the outcome. One week later I was back to have the crowns installed and the second filling - which turned out to be fixing a chipped tooth. I do not really remember what I paid for this visit. Maybe 500 to 700 THB. Now - fast forward to June 2025 and while chewing a toffee one of my crowns popped off. Luckily I was able to save it. I called the dentist on Monday morning and was told to come in at 3 pm. I arrived early and was seated by 3 pm. Dr Monthirada arrived shortly after and asked me how many days ago did the crown pop off. I saidf 3 days. She immediately got to work putting the corwn back into place. Making sure my bite was still good with the re-installed crown. It took about 1/2 hour. She told me I should get my teeth cleaned, but that was it. I went back to reception to pay for having the crown re-attached. Shortly thereafter the assistant came out to tell me that there was no charge to re-attach the corwn. I was very surprised. I have had nothing but good experiences at Dental Care Center. I definitely recommend them for professional service and reasonable prices.
0x310295fd683462cb_0xe649c843be6f5443.author: Alexander Beviss

0x310295fd683462cb_0xe649c843be6f5443.text: I had all-ceramic crowns and one dental implant done on my upper jaw here, and six molars replaced on my lower jaw. The dentist is very skilled. But this dentist is amazing; the entire treatment process was virtually painless for several months, with only one or two painful episodes that subsided after medication. 0x30da3ae9e183baeb_0x172427bc8f1c1441.text: I'm an older adult who experienced a very sudden vision symptom -- one which could rapidly lead to sudden blindness. I went to St Peter Eye Hospital for diagnosis and possible treatment. My experience there was excellent, and I highly recommend them. HERE'S MY STORY: My scary symptom was sudden-onset floaters in my left eye combined with light flashes in the same eye. I discovered these symptoms could be indications of a detached retina. My USA ophthalmologist directed me to have this checked out immediately -- it might be something minor or it be something that might rip further at any time causing blindness in one eye. This definitely got my attention and created some natural anxiety. I reached out to several friends I trust here in Chiang Mai for recommendations and insights. They each recommended Dr. Kupakanjana at St Peter Eye Hospital based either on personal first-hand experience or word of mouth. Although he had just landed that day from a flight, Dr. Kupakanjana (or Dr. Nickie for short), took my call that afternoon. He then had his staff make an appointment for me the next morning. I received a thorough examination (actually several types of exams). The news I received was mixed -- no emergency or risk of sudden blindness, but instead an age-related degeneration that might continue to advance over time (much like a mole on my retina). But I was very relieved. I also appreciated the professionalism of the staff there and the time Dr. Nickie took to explain the problem and my future options. By noon I was finished and able to return to my apartment with my wife (my eye was dilated from one of the exams). The cost for his services was very fair. As an indication of the value at St Peter -- I ordered two pair of bifocal prescription sunglasses while I was there because they were a better value than the optical stores I had visited in town. This was unrelated to my emergency visit, but I felt good enough about my care that I made these additional optional purchases. Note: there were a few reviews I read (only a handful of 1-star reviews) about St Peter that gave me pause as I did my initial research about selecting an eye doctor. I realized those reviews were ALL old 5+ years and with a different doctor. Recommend you google Dr. Kupakanjana and note his credentials and record. He came from a strong practice elsewhere to Chiang Mai for family reasons. I feel very fortunate that he relocated here!
0x30da3ae9e183baeb_0x172427bc8f1c1441.author: ALM

0x30da3ae9e183baeb_0x172427bc8f1c1441.text: I would have awarded Dr. Nikki Tayakorn 10 stars but we are only given a maximum 5. I am very nervous about my eyes, not least because I had laser surgery for a torn retinal 10 years ago and was given the prognosis of early cataract complications as a result. My eyesight for the past 3 years has plummeted to the point where I was virtually blind in my left eye. I met with Dr. Nikki, through a personal recommendation of another patient - explained my nervousness but that I understood the technicalities of the cataract replacement procedure. Dr. Nikki explained everything in perfect detail, calmly, kindly and slowly and thoroughly reassured me to the point that I willingly agreed to have the procedure done via local anesthetic only. During the procedure of the lens replacement Dr. Nikki kept me fully informed of exactly what was happening, so there were NO SURPRISES. His surgical and patient skills are exceptional. My follow up appointment a few weeks later was a very detailed examination resulting in prescription medication to take care of a not uncommon condition that follows this type of surgery. I am usually quite a demanding hospital patient, requesting detailed reasons for medical advice.............NOT with Dr. Nikki, whose every professional opinion I accepted without question, such is the confidence. he instills in me. I live in Bangkok and chose St. Peter hospital on the recommendation of a close friend who had cataract surgery last year but more importantly because of Dr. Nikki - the safest pair of hands I can imagine. He has restored my sight in my left eye to the same strength I had as a young boy and I can't really begin to describe the improvement in the quality of my life as a result. Thank you so much Dr. Nikki and your wonderful staff - and see you next month for my next check up.
0x30da3ae9e183baeb_0x172427bc8f1c1441.author: Richard

0x30da3ae9e183baeb_0x172427bc8f1c1441.text: Trifocal lenses have truly changed my life. For about three years, I'd been feeling frustrated and annoyed with the difficulties of daily routines and driving because I had to switch glasses for reading and driving, both day and night. In short, I needed three pairs of glasses in my bag for every activity. Forgetting one would be inconvenient. So, I consulted an ophthalmologist about how to make life easier. The ophthalmologist conducted a thorough examination and asked many questions. They recommended cataract removal and a trifocal lens replacement, which would allow me to see without glasses anymore. The doctor mentioned that I might experience some glare initially, especially when driving at night, and that it would take some time to adjust. I had the cataract removal and lens replacement on the 10th and started driving during the day on the 14th, and everything went perfectly. On the 18th, I drove at night for almost an hour. When glare from oncoming traffic or from cars behind me reflected in the rearview mirror, I experienced a slight glare, but it wasn't significant. Overall, I give my left eye, which underwent cataract removal and a trifocal lens implant this time within just 8 days, a 90 out of 100. I will be scheduling an appointment with the doctor for cataract removal and a trifocal lens implant for my right eye as well. I would like to express my sincere gratitude for the detailed consultation, explanations, excellent advice, and surgery performed by Ophthalmologist Thayakorn Kupkanjana (Dr. Nickie) St. Peter Eye Hospital, Chiang Mai.
0x30da3ae9e183baeb_0x172427bc8f1c1441.author: Jomkwan Donavanik

0x30da3ae9e183baeb_0x172427bc8f1c1441.text: This hospital is amazing. I came in for cataract surgery and IOL placement. Dr. Nickie decided to start with one eye, and wait two months to evaluate as I was leaving for a 2 month trip to Vietnam. In my job, I am used to work with highly trained professionals. Dr. Nickie is nothing less than excellent. He provided detailed yet understandable information about my problem and the treatment procedure. The surgery was a breeze. Impressive work. One day later, I could read and write without my glasses. After two months, I came back for evaluation and assessment of the other eye. Dr. Nickie and I decided together not to treat the other eye, as my distant sight was still very good in that eye. So I had the best of both worlds. I can’t be more happy with the result. I am used to European hospitals. St. Peter exceeds the quality easily: in service, in kindness, and in professionalism. At every moment, I felt like the most important person in the room. 0x30da3ae9e183baeb_0x172427bc8f1c1441.text: My heartfelt thanks to Doctor Rewat and Doctor Tayakorn for performing a successful procedure with excellent results (even better than expected). 0x30e29ed2500b5899_0xcd79ccc9f5dc2353.text: Nawabutr Siam IVF Clinic truly stands out as a compassionate and highly effective fertility center. My experience there, particularly undergoing IUI with Dr. Annop (คุณหมออรรณพ), was overwhelmingly positive, culminating in success on the second attempt – a testament to their expertise. From the moment you step in, the clinic's environment is remarkably spacious and impeccably clean. This creates a very reassuring and comfortable atmosphere, which is so important during what can be an emotionally taxing journey. The waiting area is well-appointed, and they thoughtfully provide complimentary milk and water, adding a touch of warmth and care for patients. What truly sets Nawabutr apart, however, is the exceptional service from Dr. Annop and all the staff. Everyone, without exception, is incredibly friendly, warm, and genuinely supportive. They go above and beyond to make you feel comfortable and at ease, which significantly reduces the stress often associated with fertility treatments. Dr. Annop's expertise is evident, and his approach, combined with the team's dedication, instills a strong sense of trust and confidence. In terms of logistics, the clinic's location is incredibly convenient. You can easily reach it via BTS, making public transport a viable option. For those who prefer to drive, the ability to park directly within the Chula Book Centre building (Wittayakit Building) is a huge advantage in this busy part of Bangkok, ensuring a stress-free arrival and departure. For anyone navigating the path of infertility, I wholeheartedly recommend them for their professional excellence, comforting service, and convenient accessibility.

0x3102b777e240e6ad_0x7a915a12160762e.text: The clinic is very clean. I booked an appointment a week in advance and got it done right away. The doctor is very skilled. The nose surgery took less than an hour, but the waiting list is quite long. I booked the 6999 baht nose surgery package and paid a 1000 baht deposit. When I arrived, we discussed changing the silicone and other things. The sales representative informed me that there would be a fee for filing the nasal base, which would add 8000 baht. Those who booked the package would have to pay this extra cost. This was a price the clinic didn't inform me about. So, I chose the standard pre-made silicone. The total price was 15990 baht. During the consultation, the doctor seemed to recommend artificial silicone for a more prominent nose, which would cost an additional 10000 baht, but it was up to the client. I didn't choose that option. The total cost was around 17000 baht. They injected local anesthetic during the procedure. It was probably the most painful part, but once it was numb, I didn't feel anything. The nurse was very helpful. -I didn't get a nose evaluation beforehand, so I don't know this part. I recommend coming in for a consultation before doing anything. But the doctor did a great job; the results are beautiful and complete. They also took before and after photos. The medication you'll definitely get includes painkillers, anti-swelling medication, antibiotics, and some wound care supplies. This doesn't include the 990 baht cold pack, which is quite expensive. /I'm not sure if it's mandatory. But I did get it. I bought a cold pack from a pharmacy outside for 90 baht per piece, just in case. (I recommend consulting them beforehand, not going on the day of the procedure lol) (The salesperson seemed a bit pushy.) I give it 4 out of 5 stars. For those who are going to take a Grab taxi, check the location carefully. The pinned location isn't accurate.

0x3054f65b515fd31b_0x483a8866aa78da35.text: I had the most wonderful experience with Rapheepan Clinic throughout my entire pregnancy and delivery. Dr. Rapheepan guided my pregnancy from the very beginning, and I always felt safe, supported, and truly cared for. She is calm, highly professional, and very confident in her decisions — which gave me so much trust during such an important time in my life. My labor was extremely long — 35 hours of contractions — and it was not easy. With another doctor, I am quite sure I would have ended up with a C-section. But Dr. Rapheepan gave me the opportunity to continue naturally. She monitored everything carefully, supported me patiently through the process, and when necessary, we made the decision to break my water. Thanks to her experience and steady guidance, I was able to give birth naturally. I am deeply grateful for that. Now I happily bring my daughter for regular pediatric checkups at the clinic as well. It feels comforting to stay with the same team who supported me throughout my pregnancy journey. Highly recommended for any mother looking for professional care with genuine heart and dedication. 💛

0x30e29f2aced2bdcd_0xbd91eaef0edae763.text: The three days I had this caregiver were wonderful. My room is cleaner, and I don't feel lonely, day or night. Wherever I go, she follows me, helping carry things, bringing a water bottle, and preparing my medication. She takes care of my insomnia and sleep problems, even when I get up to go to the bathroom at night or have acid reflux. She stays by my side, just like a mother. I can talk to her, she encourages me, I can cuddle her, and she's taught me how to take care of myself. She cleans my room to prevent dust and allergies, takes me to buy fruit to help with obesity, encourages me to do light exercises and stretches in my room, takes me for walks in the park, recommends sour fruits to help with digestion, and shares her personal story to inspire me to continue living, especially since I used to have suicidal thoughts.

0x30da3b4a464dc33b_0x521cf0aa7f8655b8.text: I highly recommend this physiotherapy clinic. They genuinely focus on identifying and treating the root cause of your problem rather than just masking symptoms or telling you to stop exercising. The approach here is movement-based: instead of prescribing rest or painkillers, they work with your body to restore proper function. The team is highly professional and clearly experienced in working with athletes. I’m active in tennis, cycling, and gym training, and I came in with two issues: shoulder pain and numbness in my thigh. Both problems were resolved fairly quickly. My treatment included physiotherapy sessions, cupping, and hands-on muscle release techniques. Most importantly, they taught me specific exercises to activate the correct muscles, improve strength, and build an effective warm-up routine for tennis. Overall, I’m very satisfied with the results and the level of care.

But here, it was completely different. The process began with a very thorough and structured examination. The doctor and team took detailed photographs of my teeth, performed comprehensive assessments using advanced equipment to evaluate the gums, nerves, and overall dental condition, and completed both small and full-mouth X-rays so I could clearly understand the full picture of my oral health. What impressed me the most was what happened next. Instead of a quick explanation, the doctor invited me into a consultation room and spent more than 30 minutes carefully going through everything with me. Every detail was explained clearly, patiently, and in a way I could truly understand. The doctor continuously encouraged me to ask questions, and even asked several times if there was anything more I would like to clarify, making sure I felt completely comfortable and informed. Then, what surprised me even more—the doctor spent additional time summarizing everything in a structured and professional format, printed it out, and provided it to me as a complete documentation of my condition and possible treatment options and estimate price. When I reflected on the entire process, I realized that the doctor had spent well over 1 hour of time, attention, and expertise only for this session. That level of dedication alone made me feel that the consultation at this clinic was truly worth it. and reflect their price. At that moment, I understood something very important. This clinic is not focused on rushing into treatment. Their priority is to ensure that the patient fully understands before making any decision. For me, this level of care was truly impressive. And now I clearly understand why this place is not comparable to typical street clinics in terms of pricing. The difference is not just in treatment—but in the depth of care, time, precision, and respect given to each patient. If you are looking for the cheapest option, this may not be the right place. But if you value clarity, professionalism, and a truly comprehensive approach, this experience is absolutely worth it.

0x3054f054115765cd_0xdcd0f8ffec8ac421.text: Let me share my experience. This clinic is not for everyone — and that is exactly why it stands out. If you are looking for cheap dental treatment, this is not the place for you. The standard here is not just international — in my opinion, it is even higher than many international hospitals. This is a truly medically-driven clinic where every step follows strict professional protocols. Before coming here, I visited two other dentists. They were cheaper, yes — but the quality was simply not comparable. Only after coming here did I truly understand what real medical standards should look like. The price you pay here is absolutely worth it. This is not a place for quick fixes. Every procedure is carefully planned with long-term success in mind. They take the time to diagnose properly, explain in detail, and execute treatment with precision. Nothing is rushed, nothing is compromised. They use premium Western equipment and materials, and it clearly reflects in the outcome. In my case, they were able to solve a complex problem that my previous dentist considered too difficult. Here, it was handled with confidence, expertise, and a clear strategy. I strongly encourage anyone to come here for quality — not for price. If you value long-term results, true medical standards, and professional integrity, this clinic is absolutely worth it. I have deep respect for the doctor and the entire team. 😊

0x3054f054115765cd_0xdcd0f8ffec8ac421.text: I was on vacation in Koh Samui in November 2025 and developed excruciating tooth pain—so bad that I couldn't even eat. At reception, there's a tablet with a translator for those who don't speak English. I briefly explained my situation, and after only a 10-minute wait, I was seen. The dentist examined my teeth very carefully and then took X-rays. Diagnosis: Inflammation of the tooth root. Afterward, I received excellent advice, and all the treatment options, along with their respective prices, were printed out for me in German. This allowed me to calmly decide what I wanted to do. The dentist recommended root canal treatment. I agreed, and everything was done immediately—no appointment necessary, no calling ahead. I just walked in. My pain was completely gone the next day. This dentist definitely saved my vacation. The whole thing cost approximately €750. I received a detailed invoice, and everything was covered by my insurance. I can't understand the bad reviews – it was one of the best dental experiences I've ever had.

0x30503159f71be5cf_0x2301ad4f7cfeecd7.text: I just had a tooth extracted yesterday. I had tooth sensitivity for about two weeks, but I thought it was just a simple cavity, so I went to a clinic in another province to get a filling. After the dentist examined me, they recommended extraction because the cavity was deep and a filling probably wouldn't hold. But I'm afraid of needles and tooth extraction, so I insisted on getting a filling first. The dentist filled it but warned me that if I still had pain or sensitivity after a month, I should get it extracted. Before filling, the dentist asked if I wanted local anesthesia, and I said no. It was very sensitive during the procedure, and afterward, it hurt a lot for about three hours. Even paracetamol didn't help. About 1-2 weeks later, I started having pain in the same tooth that had been filled, so I decided to have it extracted at this clinic because I'd seen good reviews. Honestly, I was terrified before the extraction. The staff checked my blood pressure twice because my heart was beating fast. After the examination and X-rays, the dentist said the tooth was decayed. I decided to have it extracted. The dentist injected local anesthesia, and I didn't feel any pain. I waited 10 minutes for the anesthesia to take effect. Then, the dentist extracted the tooth in 10 seconds – it was very quick and easy. I was still wondering if it was over already; it was so fast! The dentist was great, and the staff were polite and provided good service. They also gave me a post-extraction instruction sheet. Having a tooth extracted at this clinic wasn't as scary as I thought. When I got home, the anesthetic was wearing off, so I ate some meatballs. After the anesthetic wore off, I didn't feel any pain at all. Now I just have to wait for the wound to heal.

I waited for a short while because I arrived before my scheduled appointment time, but it wasn't too long. After speaking with the physiotherapist, they took a thorough and detailed medical history. The physiotherapy and ear calcium deposit check were done well, without rushing, and with careful examination. Afterward, the physiotherapist also relaxed my neck, shoulder, and upper back muscles. They were very skilled at relaxing the muscles in the correct locations, which significantly improved my symptoms. Then, they examined my hand and finger muscles. The physiotherapist checked to make sure there was no bone issue, according to treatment principles, and used shock wave and ultrasound stimulation, which made my muscles feel much more relaxed and improved. In total, the treatment took about 3 hours and cost 3000 baht. I consider the price reasonable given the lengthy time and the fact that the clinic informed me of the cost beforehand. This was my first time at a physiotherapy clinic, and I was very impressed.

0x30da25e8117f7519_0x66ef961f1fc173d7.text: When you find a good doctor, you have to share! I'm an amateur golfer who has suffered from chronic injuries from the sport for over two years. My right back is hunched, I have chronic pain in my right shoulder blade, shoulder, and neck, stiffness in my right hip and lower back, and severe pain in my knee and ankle – basically, the entire right side is problematic. In the past, I've received recommendations from well-wishers to seek treatment, including injections, massage therapy, and chiropractic adjustments at various places, both in Bangkok and at well-known clinics throughout Chiang Mai. In fact, I was listed as a patient at all those famous places. But two days ago, these symptoms returned. This time, I decided to consult Google, read reviews, and called to inquire about the cost. I found out that a course of treatment (approximately 1 to 1 hour 40 minutes, depending on the severity) was less than 1000 baht, which I found acceptable. So I went there. I found a small clinic in San Na Meng Subdistrict, San Sai District, located almost at the end of a right-hand side street. There was a small parking area. The team consisted of three people: a tall, well-built male doctor named Dr. Ko, a female doctor, and a nurse assistant. They took my medical history... They checked my blood pressure and inquired about my symptoms, following the standards of a good clinic. They then described the treatment methods they thought were suitable for my condition. Since my symptoms were numerous, I opted for two courses. It started with a muscle relaxation massage, followed by cupping therapy (I'm allergic to cupping), and other miscellaneous treatments. The female doctor had very strong fingers; it wasn't painful because she pressed on the right pressure points, but with great power. Meanwhile, the other doctor, a man in his 40s, engaged in pleasant conversation and exchanged insightful ideas. Then came the chiropractic course, which I must admit was unlike anything I'd ever experienced before. Both doctors worked together, meticulously manipulating, pressing, and adjusting the bones. I was particularly impressed by their use of a cloth to manipulate my neck (a technique only some well-known clinics offer). The most impressive technique was their ankle-locking method to apply force to my hip bones (which I've had chronic pain in), a technique they waited until the end after everything else had relaxed. I'd never seen this method anywhere else. After the treatment, I felt incredibly relieved, more so than ever before. The treatment took about 3 hours, included a large packet of herbal medicine, and cost a total of 1905 baht, which was still cheaper than many well-known clinics I've been to. After returning home... In the evening, there was some soreness (as Dr. Ko had predicted in advance), but I slept longer at night, only waking up to go to the bathroom once (compared to the usual 2-3 times a night). In the morning, I felt relieved, my head felt better, and my body felt more relaxed. I need to go to the hot springs and cold springs and choose to eat only one type of fruit all day for one day to detox my intestines before returning for further treatment here. I have found hope, a feeling that my chronic condition can be completely cured here.

0x311d636b42332787_0x1b6a4dda71ac6a2d.text: I was recommended to Dr. Nack by a friend who had his hair transplant done at Pakinpah Clinic last year. Initially, I was skeptical because the price was much lower than most hair transplant clinics in Bangkok. However, during my initial consultation, Dr. Nack quickly put my concerns to rest. He was incredibly patient in answering all of my questions, and at no point did I feel any pressure or hard-selling. Instead, I genuinely felt that he was sincere in helping me find the best solution for my hair loss. After careful consideration, I decided to choose Pakinpah Clinic and Dr. Nack for my hair transplant. On the day of my procedure, Dr. Nack personally welcomed me and walked me through the entire process once again. He explained every step clearly, including why he had chosen a particular hairline design that would best suit my facial features. His professionalism and attention to detail gave me a great deal of confidence before the surgery began. Throughout the procedure, Dr. Nack and his team made me feel safe and well cared for. At one point, I experienced a panic attack, but they responded immediately by checking my vital signs, reassuring me, and making sure I was comfortable before continuing. Their calm and compassionate approach helped me regain my confidence, and I was able to complete the surgery with peace of mind. After the procedure, Dr. Nack took the time to explain the aftercare instructions for the next two weeks. His guidance was clear, straightforward, and easy to follow, which made the recovery process much less stressful. I would like to sincerely thank Dr. Nack and his entire team for this life-changing experience. Their professionalism, kindness, and genuine care made me feel safe and confident from my first consultation through to the end of the procedure. I am currently in my first week of recovery, and everything has been going well so far. I look forward to seeing the results over the coming months.

0x3054f681b7231897_0x4366064a62cf021a.text: My experience getting a motorbike license in Thailand Documents required: • Passport • Residence certificate • Medical certificate • Copy of passport • Copy of entry stamp You need to come on Monday, Wednesday, or Friday around 7:20–7:30 AM, take a queue number, and wait for your turn. When it’s your turn, the lady at the counter will check your documents and send you to wait in the classroom. Then you’ll take the physical test, which includes: • Identifying whether the light appears on the left or right • Choosing the correct color (red, yellow, or green) • Gas/stop reaction test • Aligning two sticks to the same level After that, you’ll watch 3 hours of traffic rules videos, then have a lunch break from 12:00 to 13:00, followed by one more hour of video. Then you’ll take the theory test on a computer (phones must be placed in lockers, and you can’t use it for translation, but you can ask for clarification if needed). If you pass the theory test, you’ll take the practical test the next day at 10:00 AM. It includes: • Riding onto the track, using the left turn signal, and stopping before the stop line • The slalom test • Riding along a narrow line on a small slope If you already have some riding experience, it’s quite easy. You get two attempts. The hardest part for me was the narrow line, but don’t worry - you can always retake the test on another day. Once you pass, you go to pay the fee, check that your name and details are correct, take a quick photo, and get your license within a few minutes. In total, the whole process takes about 2 days. Good luck!
0x3054f681b7231897_0x4366064a62cf021a.author: Kris Yaskevich

0x3054f681b7231897_0x4366064a62cf021a.text: I was there on Friday at 7 AM. For the driving license test(Motorbike), you have to go to the 2nd floor. I didn't have an appointment. Around 7:30 AM, the first staff members arrived. They told me I needed an appointment and a QR code.(DLT Smart Queue App) I said I didn't have one and that I was from Koh Phangan. Because of that, I was told to wait until 8 AM, if there were any spots left, I could take the test today. And that’s exactly how it went. I had all the documents. Copies of: * Visa * Passport * Yellow Book and Pink Card * Medical Certificate (Samui Home Clinic, 100 THB) That was it. Then I was sent to Room 1, where you wait to be called. After that, you have to do 3 different tests. But no vision test regarding distance. After that, you have to watch 5 hours of video material, with a 1-hour lunch break. Then the test on the PC begins. You have to hand in your mobile phones. If you pass it successfully (45/50)... ...you can take the practical test on the next working day. Everyone speaks English; if necessary, you can communicate using Google Translate. Everyone was super nice, great service. PS: If you fail the test, you can retake it on the next day.
0x3054f681b7231897_0x4366064a62cf021a.author: Patrick Felician Mayer

0x3054f681b7231897_0x4366064a62cf021a.text: I passed my Category A driver's license here in two days, having prepared all the necessary documents in advance. It's important to note that Monday, Wednesday, and Friday are the days when they accept your motorcycle documents, while other days, I assume, are for a car. On the first day, I watched five hours of lectures and took a test in English, which the DLT training website was a great help in preparing for. The questions in the actual exam are different from the preparatory tests you can find, but the logic remains the same. Thanks to completing numerous practice exams, I passed the official exam 46 out of 50 on my first try. You need to score at least 45. The organization was excellent, with minimal delays. The pleasant staff members were helpful and literally held my hand, explaining everything clearly. I took the practical part of the exam at 10:00 AM on the second day, riding my bike. This is convenient. If you fail the theory test on the first day, you need to come back at 9:00 AM and try again. The hardest part is the theoretical exam; if you pass it and ride a bike well, you won't have any problems with the practical test.
0x3054f681b7231897_0x4366064a62cf021a.author: Алексей Рябик

0x3054f681b7231897_0x4366064a62cf021a.text: The Samui Transport Office definitely needs improvement in terms of service. You can hardly get any useful information over the phone, meaning you really have to go there in person every time. I've been there four times now, which is why I'm happy to share this information and these pictures. Driving tests are always on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays; be there by 7:30 a.m. to get in right away. First, you'll do some physical tests (an interesting experience), and then there are several videos about the rules, signs, etc., until about noon. There's an hour's lunch break, and then it continues from 1:00 p.m. to 2:30 p.m. Afterward, there's the theory test with 50 questions, of which only 5 can be answered incorrectly. The following day, you can either retake the written test in the morning if you don't pass, and the practical driving test starts at 2:00 p.m. You have to take the test twice for both car and motorcycle licenses. There are also several websites to help you prepare for the test. The official Thai websites are only in Thai, but there are excellent English alternatives.

0x3054f681b7231897_0x4366064a62cf021a.text: On 5-8-2025 I went to DLT Koh Samui for renewal car and motorbike license. I arrived as a 'walk-in' at 09.20 am and everything was done at 11.00 am. 0x30e29cfd0101df13_0xdfe1ddc8ff466622.text: About two or three years ago, when I wanted to get braces, I visited many places. From clinics with huge advertising signs along the way to those near my condo, I thought it would be better to be close if I had to come often. I started with a large, modern-looking clinic, then medium-sized ones, and several small ones. The prices weren't much different, until I almost didn't go to the last one – I was too tired. It was the smallest and looked the oldest (it seemed like it'd been around for a long time). I just went in to ask about the price, but the staff suggested I talk to the doctor; he was there and the consultation was free. I was surprised and hesitant because I didn't want to make a decision right away. The doctor was kind and lovely, and the price was comparable to the other clinics. I was won over when the doctor said, "You're a beautiful person, Ms. Moo. You'll be even more beautiful if you get braces." That's what made me decide to pay the deposit immediately! 555 And the doctor didn't disappoint. It's a small but warm clinic. The doctors here are patient and kind to everyone, even if I'm sometimes naughty and don't take care of my teeth regularly. None of their words hurt my feelings. Not only is the clinic highly skilled, but they also have a great understanding of customer psychology. In addition, the clinic is decorated with beautiful framed pictures on the walls. Each visit features a different set of plants and flowers, creating a refreshing atmosphere. Even the exterior boasts meticulously arranged small potted gardens along the roadside. As someone who enjoys gardening, I can see the effort and care that goes into achieving such results. Today, a staff member from the clinic asked me to review their clinic, and I gladly obliged. My experience working in the five-star hotel industry reflects the exceptional service mindset of this small clinic. This is a business run with genuine care and a true customer satisfaction! 🌷❤️👍

0x30e285199072c433_0x1fec0af9badb742d.text: I previously suffered from chronic back pain for 10 years due to prolonged driving and heavy lifting. I sought treatment at many places and through various methods, including Thai and Chinese medicine, physical therapy, shockwave therapy, acupressure massage, etc. Everywhere said the same thing: my back was very stiff, the condition was severe, and it would take a long time to treat. They advised me to avoid long drives, take frequent breaks, and avoid heavy lifting. However, in my work life, it was unavoidable. I became discouraged and started taking Norgesic and Arcoxia, but even those medications were not good if taken excessively. I just endured the pain on days I didn't take them, until a relative recommended this clinic. My first meeting with the doctor was very attentive and thorough. The physical examination took about 15-20 minutes before starting treatment. I was curious and asked many questions, and the doctor happily answered them all. They weren't just giving short, dismissive answers; they were polite and explained things clearly. Before I left, they gave me physical therapy exercises to do at home to speed up the treatment process. They weren't prolonging the treatment unnecessarily; they were honest with their patients – saying if I needed to come back, I should, and if not, I shouldn't. This was the first place that told me my condition wasn't severe because the adhesions hadn't formed yet. Hearing that gave me hope. After the treatment, my pain disappeared completely. From weekly appointments to once every 1-2 months in just a few months, my condition improved rapidly thanks to my own home physical therapy, which helped both the doctor and myself, as I wanted to be free from this suffering quickly. I am very impressed and highly recommend this place. The doctors are very kind and lovely, both male and female. You won't be disappointed. This is a review from a real patient, not a paid endorsement.

0x30e285199072c433_0x1fec0af9badb742d.text: Very friendly and kind people who are great at what they do! 0x30da3bc7ad694363_0x85fecbd20be68d57.text: I just returned from Thailand and had the most amazing time at Ayurah Spa during their Rejuvenate Wellness Retreat. I was warmly welcomed with a delicious herbal drink (no sugar, which I loved!) and then had a wellness consultation with Miss Waew. She was so kind and professional, guiding me through a private yoga session where she patiently helped me with poses and breathing techniques. Next, I experienced a deeply relaxing oil massage and traditional Tok Sen therapy with Miss Na, a skilled and caring therapist. Her touch melted away all my tension—I felt completely renewed. I also had a Tibetan Bowls sound healing session with Miss Nan, which was truly incredible. The vibrations and sounds brought me into such a deep state of calm that words can’t fully describe the benefits. The day continued with a nourishing organic lunch from their wellness menu—healthy, clean, and absolutely delicious. I ended the retreat with breathwork, meditation with Tibetan bowls, a detoxifying body wrap, and a facial massage. Every step of the experience was thoughtfully designed and delivered with so much care. I can confidently say this was one of the best spa experiences of my life. If you are looking for a true wellness escape—one that heals your body, mind, and spirit—I highly recommend Ayurah Spa. I will definitely return again.

0x30e29eaab671b12f_0xb502c4c4ca8424d8.text: Sam Sen Railway Station" has two platforms (arrivals and departures). It is an old station that once had modern, grand platforms. However, the "Hopewell Project" resulted in the demolition of the beautiful and elegant "mushroom-shaped" platforms, leaving behind two "mushroom-shaped" buildings, 53 years old (as of 2024), which should be preserved as a proud asset of the State Railway of Thailand. - The remaining "mushroom-shaped" buildings have four walls and house the ticket office, station master's office, and information desk. (Clearly visible from Thoet Damri Road) - Originally, all trains on the Northern, Northeastern, and Southern lines coming from "Bangkok Station (Hua Lamphong)" had to pass through this area, including ordinary trains, suburban trains, tourist trains, etc. - It was a transit route for His Majesty King Bhumibol Adulyadej (Rama IX) on 28 royal train journeys. - In 1891 (March 9th), King Chulalongkorn (Rama V) held a groundbreaking ceremony at Bangkok Station to begin construction of the railway. - In 1896 (March 26th), Rama V presided over the opening ceremony of the railway line between "Bangkok and Ayutthaya," a distance of 71 km. - Before reaching "Bang Sue," there is a bridge crossing "Khlong Sam Sen." This area was therefore "the transit route of the country's first railway line." Later, as the community grew, - A station was built on the north side of "Khlong Sam Sen," marking the beginning of the first and second eras of "Sam Sen Railway Station," which was constructed from wood. - In 1971 (September 23), the Sam Sen Railway Station building opened, marking the third era. The building and platforms were shaped like "mushrooms," with central pillars extending to form a square roof, creating a beautiful and futuristic design. - Due to the modern design of the platforms, it was used as a filming location for several movies, from the 1971 film "There Will Never Be a Day When We Part" to the 1990 film "Cheng Ka Deh." - The "mushroom-shaped" platforms were eventually demolished. Because the construction of the pillars for the "Hopewell Project" (construction plan December 6, 1991 to December 5, 1999) was replaced by the "Year 4" building which has been in use for over 32 years (as of 2024). - 1.4 km before Samsen, there is a "Ramathibodi Hospital" train stop (north of "Chitralada Royal Railway Station"). - 1.5 km from Samsen, there used to be a "Pradipat Train Stop" (for boarding and alighting on Pradipat Road) before reaching "Bang Sue Junction" (2.9 km from Samsen). 0x30e29eaab671b12f_0xb502c4c4ca8424d8.text: Located in the Phaya Thai / Dusit area of Bangkok, this classic ground-level railway station is a historic intermediate stop offering a glimpse into authentic local neighborhood life. Core Features Nostalgic Local Atmosphere: Retains an open-air platform design and classic railway tracks surrounded by old neighborhoods and street food stalls, capturing everyday Bangkok lifestyle. Transit Stop: Serves as a key intermediate station along the State Railway of Thailand (SRT) Northern and Northeastern lines for local commuter trains. Experience & Advice Nearby Access: Positioned conveniently near both the Ari neighborhood and the Dusit administrative district, making it a pleasant stop for off-the-beaten-path urban exploration and photography. Practical Tip: Station facilities are basic and mostly open-air. 0x30da2f9f80bdbcf9_0xc639046ff6fd4b42.text: I had bilateral knee replacement surgery six months ago and was able to stand and walk within 24 hours. However, I needed a walker for about three weeks, then switched to crutches, and finally stopped using them in the third month. Initially, I had to take painkillers and anti-inflammatory medication, but I stopped in the third month because the pain lessened. I only experienced some stiffness at the surgical site and fatigue when walking or standing for long periods, as the surgical wounds needed time to heal. However, I could bend and straighten my legs immediately after the surgery and had good flexibility in movement. The doctor was pleased with my progress. Two and a half months later, I traveled back to my home country, using a wheelchair but no longer with crutches, and continued with physical therapy abroad to strengthen my muscles. Getting up, sitting down, and climbing stairs were the most time-consuming tasks, but by the fourth month I could do it, by the fifth month it was easier, and by the sixth month it was almost back to normal. I'm so happy to have regained my quality of life. With my knees free from pain and suffering from osteoarthritis, my mental state has also improved. Now I can walk normally, although I still need to be careful when climbing stairs. There's a little stiffness at the surgical site, but it's nothing to worry about. I'm incredibly grateful to the doctor for the best advice and treatment. When the doctor sees patients, he takes his time and listens attentively; he never makes you feel rushed. Anyone with chronic knee pain should consider this. I highly recommend consulting your doctor.

0x30e29a03f448e001_0xfa6a9fb02206935.text: If you don't like reading a lot, here's a short review: 1. The dentists (whether for root canal treatment, crowns, scaling, or retainers) are skilled, meticulous, kind, lovely, and beautiful. 2. The staff are lovely, attentive, polite, mature, and definitely not rude. They're also beautiful. 3. The place is clean, bright, and quiet. There's complimentary drinking water, milk, and fresh coffee. There's parking available. If you like reading a lot and want a complete review, please read the full review below. I've intended to write this review many times, but my review style requires a complete account of my experience, so I haven't had the time. Haha. Today, I'll keep my promise. Around the end of 2024, I had terrible tooth pain, like the worst possible. I was also busy with several exams and couldn't study. So I tried to find a dental clinic urgently. My regular dentist at the time was unavailable, no matter how much I tried to get an appointment. So I searched on Google and found this clinic near my house with pretty good reviews. That's why I went to this dentist, and after that, I never went back to my first regular clinic again. No matter how close it is (555555555555), we'll share our experience in detail, one thing at a time, in case it's helpful for those looking for emergency dental care like us. 1. The staff is incredibly lovely. Five stars! When I called, the queue was long, but I left a message on LINE saying that if there was an earlier appointment, please let me know. The staff were incredibly lovely, answered my questions in detail, and even remembered my case (I guess I waited for the appointment for ages!). It turned out that before my appointment, the staff messaged me to schedule my visit. Thank you for remembering me! It was a lifesaver! I was so happy because I had been in pain for almost a week. After that, I continued to go to this dental clinic, and I found that both of the staff (the two I saw most often) were lovely. They were polite, friendly, mature, and had excellent emotional control. 2. The doctor is lovely, kind, and has a gentle touch. Five stars! On my next visit, I was very impressed. Dr. Oranusa said that if the toothache was severe, it was possible I might need root canal treatment. She asked if I wanted root canal treatment right away, as she could call a root canal specialist that day. I really wanted root canal treatment, but I had an exam in the afternoon, so I scheduled it for another day and endured the pain while taking my exam. But it was truly impressive because everyone here tried their best to help us, even though we were new here. 3. Root Canal Treatment and Crowns: Five stars. Regarding price, to be honest, we've had root canal treatment much cheaper elsewhere. However, in terms of skill, we rank this place number one. The attentiveness, meticulousness, and gentle touch of the dentist here are exceptional. During the root canal treatment, it felt incredibly clean and thorough, meticulously cleaning all four of our root canals (this is just my feeling, not based on scientific evidence). One of the most important things is that after the root canal treatment, we experienced no pain, no discomfort, and no side effects at all. This is different from the previous clinic we went to, where we experienced pain at the treatment site for about two weeks (which we thought was normal for root canal treatment). Therefore, in terms of gentleness and meticulousness, we give this place the top spot. The price is a bit higher, but honestly, if you compare the average price of root canal treatment across all clinics, this place is in the affordable to mid-range price range. The crowns are also different people; the root canal specialist and the crown specialist are different individuals. The dentist for the crown is Dr. Oranusa, who is very meticulous and kind. I also had tartar removed by another dentist, who was also kind and lovely. In short, all the dentists are skilled, lovely, and meticulous. 4. Making a new retainer to correct the gaps between my teeth, which is now back together. Five stars. After the root canal treatment, I had another dental problem. I had braces for many years, and lately I haven't been diligent in wearing my retainer, so my teeth shifted. This shifting affected my front teeth, causing a gap that many people commented on. So I consulted the dentist. The dentist suggested trying a new retainer, but if my front teeth didn't close up again, I would need braces again. I trusted the dentist and got a retainer, trying to wear it consistently. Now my front teeth are back together again. I'm very happy. But the dentist also advised me to practice swallowing saliva again because I swallow like a child (haha, so embarrassing). 5. The place is clean, with drinking water and coffee available (the staff served water every time I came to see the dentist, which was very nice, but I think I could have gotten it myself too). There is parking available. Five stars. As mentioned above, I think this is a sufficiently detailed review for what I can remember. Hopefully, this will be helpful to many people who are looking for a good and lovely dental clinic to become their regular clinic like we were. Thank you very much to the team of doctors and staff. If you read this, I hope this message will be an encouragement for you to continue maintaining such good things, like salt preserves its flavor.

0x30da300e2851a37b_0xca86709c6ef6bddb.text: Allow me to share my experience and impressions of Your Smile Dental Clinic. Yesterday, I had severe toothache and swollen gums, which worried me because I had a week-long trip to the mountains with a group in just two days. A worsening condition during the trip would have been very difficult. So, I called the clinic, even though it was close to closing time and the staff were packing up. When I explained my concerns about the upcoming trip, the doctor was incredibly kind. She inquired about my symptoms and said that if I could arrive in time, she would be happy to wait and treat me. That simple answer relieved me and filled me with gratitude. I immediately went to see the doctor. Throughout the treatment, the doctor was attentive, explaining the cause of the problem and the treatment plan in detail. She was patient and genuinely listened to my concerns, making me feel confident and comfortable, even while dealing with the pain and anxiety about the trip. Besides the doctor, the assistants and all the staff were equally impressive. Everyone was polite, smiling, friendly, and willingly helpful, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere in the clinic from the moment I walked in. What impressed me even more was that after the root canal treatment and I returned home, the clinic called to follow up on my condition the next day. They inquired about any pain, swelling, or other additional problems, a small act of kindness that means a lot to the patient. Today, my pain and swelling have significantly improved, making me feel more comfortable and confident for my upcoming journey. I believe that good treatment isn't just about professional expertise, but also about care, understanding, and compassion towards the patient, which I received in abundance here. Thank you to the doctor, the dental assistants, and all the staff at Your Smile Dental Clinic for helping me when I needed it most, and for providing me with both excellent treatment and a heartwarming feeling. If anyone is looking for a dental clinic that provides excellent treatment, cares for patients, and serves with genuine sincerity, I highly recommend this place based on my personal experience. 🙏😊

0x30503205cdc66cf3_0xab19a6f33f5e7e13.text: Clinics rarely have high ratings, because when people are dissatisfied—especially in a vulnerable state—they almost always leave a negative review. But when everything goes well, most just pass by and forget. While I was in this hospital, I kept thinking about how underrated the doctors’ work is: day and night they save lives, run examinations, provide help, and still remain kind and attentive. To me, that is an act of true heroism. I want to share my experience. At another clinic, I was given a wrong diagnosis—food poisoning. Medications and painkillers didn’t help. Appendicitis was suspected. I came here at 7 p.m. to the emergency department. They admitted me immediately, ran all the tests, and despite many patients (including accident victims and burn cases), they soon sent me for a CT scan, which confirmed the diagnosis. Before that, I was given IVs, and they constantly checked my pulse, blood pressure, and temperature. The hospital has very modern, high-quality equipment, even though it is public. Before surgery, a woman came up to me, held my hand, and said: “Now I am responsible for you. You are safe with me. I will make sure everything goes perfectly.” In that moment—facing severe pain and pre-surgery anxiety—that reassurance meant the world to me. Thanks to her, I went into the operation completely calm. The surgery went well, the wound was carefully stitched, and afterwards I was transferred to a ward. I spent a day in a private room with a beautiful view and very attentive care from the nurses. They were kind, many spoke English, constantly checked on me, changed IV lines, and helped with any request, even getting up to the bathroom. The food was surprisingly good for a hospital: shrimp soup, rice porridge with meat, little omelets. The doctor encouraged me to get up and walk right away to avoid adhesions. Just 36 hours after surgery, I was discharged, since they follow modern protocols and don’t keep patients longer than necessary. They used waterproof dressings, so I could take a shower. After that, I was prescribed oral medication and outpatient dressing changes. Now it’s the fifth day after the surgery, and I feel well. Unfortunately, I don’t know the names of the people who saved my life, but I am endlessly grateful to each of them for their dedication and care. P.S. The view was amazing
0x30503205cdc66cf3_0xab19a6f33f5e7e13.author: Anna Rodina

0x30503205cdc66cf3_0xab19a6f33f5e7e13.text: T-Bank Insurance assigned me to this clinic when I applied, and it took me 40 minutes to get there by car. Everything was organized inside: they took my medical history and documents right at the entrance, and gave me a ticket with directions to the 5th floor. On that floor, they assigned me to a staff member, scanned my passport and insurance card, and waited about 30 minutes for them to test me for COVID and flu. After the test, I waited about 2:30 for the results. Based on the test results, the doctor examined me and prescribed medication. The assigned person collected my medications about 30 minutes after the examination. I didn't have to pay on the spot; my T-Bank insurance allows direct payments (the bill was 5,100 baht) (the bank manager was always in touch and coordinated everything). Overall, everything was very convenient, but the wait time was extremely long. I arrived at 9:50 AM and left at 2:00 PM (there were no lines). The staff was polite and helpful. Special thanks to T-insurance for having good clinics as partners.
0x30503205cdc66cf3_0xab19a6f33f5e7e13.author: Anastasiya Shvabauer

0x30503205cdc66cf3_0xab19a6f33f5e7e13.text: My wife has had a cough, sore throat, and phlegm for three days. At 5 a.m., we decided to go to the hospital. Tinkoff Insurance sent us to this hospital (it turned out to be a long way). We arrived at the hospital around 6:30 a.m. While we were figuring out what was going on, at 7:30 a.m., a nurse gave us plane number 1 and told us to wait for the doctor until 9:00 a.m. We spent an hour and a half sitting outside on chairs. A young doctor came, gave us a quick examination, and sent us to wait for a prescription. About 15 minutes later, Mrs. Maxim, the doctor, took us to the 5th floor of the hospital, asked us to email her the insurance policy, and then sat us down again. About 15 minutes later, my wife returned, we signed the paperwork, and we were given 4-5 packets of pills. It seemed fine, but it took a very long time. If we hadn't arrived in the morning, we would have spent another hour or more in line... It seems like it's a paid appointment... We don't have to wait for paid appointments.

0x30e29f2ebaee5b65_0x3fe96e506a2f9aa6.text: I received treatment at Sala Daeng Physical Therapy and was very impressed. It started with a tennis elbow injury. I went to Sala Daeng Physical Therapy and met with a physiotherapist who gave excellent advice. Before treatment began, I had pain in my right elbow, which radiated to the nerves in my neck. They found a problem with the muscles in my right shoulder blade, which were tight, and also issues with my cervical spine. The symptoms were similar to office syndrome, with added symptoms like rounded shoulders and forward head posture. Treatment began at the cervical spine, using acupressure to release nerve and muscle tension. They applied pressure to various points around my shoulder blade and the muscles around my right elbow. They also used several tools, such as shockwave therapy, ultrasound, infrared, and a PMS machine. Hot and cold compresses were used, along with neck stretches. The final step involved hot compresses and electrical stimulation on my back and elbow. Before I left, the physiotherapist gave me excellent advice on stretching exercises and self-care after each treatment. I received treatment four times in total. My back and neck function have improved significantly; I can raise my arm fully to my ear. It's like having a new body! The right elbow still requires more treatment, but it's much better now. And then I received good news from Sala Daeng Physical Therapy that I won a backpack and two doll figurines as a prize, which my daughter loves very much. Thank you very much! I highly recommend Sala Daeng Physical Therapy.

0x3102be000c13381f_0x9a2966014fc7a1c4.text: I didn't go to this clinic to use their service, but saw an ad on Facebook and wanted to share with you my story. I had my ink removed on my four fingers in Canada. The total sessions were 2 visits. I was supposed to go one more time, but I was happy with the result and didn't go on the 3rd and final session. The cost per session was about $100-$120 CAD, but that was over 15 years ago. I wouldn't pay more than 10,000 baht for some small black and white tattoos in Canada or Thailand. Big, colorful tattoos will need a lot more sessions and cost more. Also note, the tattoos I had on my four fingers were done by hand. So the ink probably didn't go too deep into my skin and came off more easily than machine-done tattoos. Maybe that's why I needed 2 sessions. The guy below me was asked to come for 12 sessions. So I think that's a rip off, for only black ink WITHOUT color. It worked for 2 sessions on me, plus technology should have improved since I had mine removed 15 years ago. I think even color tattoos don't need 12 sessions, unless it's a really big ink.

0x30e29fcd225e0a1d_0x781026fb1d03154a.text: Le Physio Clinic is all about action. They don’t make empty promises — they deliver. They focus on treating you with the fewest visits necessary, while still giving the recovery process the care and time it needs. There hasn’t been a single injury they couldn’t help me with. A torqued ankle that I thought would make racing impossible was fixed within a day, allowing me to fly to Chiang Mai and successfully compete in the MTCM. A lower-back disc prolapse that left me partially paralyzed improved within three visits using the stretch bed and PMS. My shoulder, which limited most back and lateral movements, is already improving — and I’m looking forward to the next session. Highly recommended for athletes and anyone dealing with chronic pain who feels like they’ve run out of options. 0x3054f04bacc23397_0x4d0d346f08a7e62d.text: A 10/10 Dental Experience in Koh Samui ​I had been putting off much-needed dental work, hoping to get it done affordably in Thailand. I was even told by another clinic that getting two crowns done in my two-week timeframe wouldn't be possible. Thankfully, I found Chaweng Dental and was completely blown away by the service. ​From the moment I walked in, I was met with professionalism and genuine care. Dr. Nuntida Lorprasertkul and Dr. Watchara Suksong were incredible. They were not only meticulous and highly skilled but also spoke fluent English, which made everything so much easier. They assured me that I could get all the work I needed done within my two-week trip. ​What started as needing two crowns turned into a full mouth transformation. I ended up getting three crowns, four fillings, a deep clean, and a whitening treatment. The most unbelievable part? The total cost was the same price I was quoted for just two crowns back in Australia. ​The entire experience was a pleasure. The staff were fantastic, and I honestly looked forward to my daily appointments. This was, without a doubt, the most positive dental experience I have ever had. If you're in Koh Samui and need a top-notch dentist, don't look anywhere else. The entire team at Chaweng Dental gets a 10 out of 10 from me!🦷💯
0x3054f04bacc23397_0x4d0d346f08a7e62d.author: Helen Mouzakiti

0x3054f04bacc23397_0x4d0d346f08a7e62d.text: My wife and I are both in our sixties and we both needed some work done and which we were told by our dentist that crowns and root canal work would need to be done, the cost of this was excessive and as we were going to Koh Samui for a holiday and after a extensive search on the web I selected Chaweng Dental Care. It was one of the best decisions I have made, our Dentist, Dr Watchara Suksong was so caring that he made us feel very safe in his hands. I had some veneer work done which also involved a crown and my wife had a filling done, at home she was told she would need root canal work and a crown. The cost of this work was well under the quote I received at home(Australia) it was pretty well painless and at all times Dr Suksong and his staff kept my welfare and comfort as a premium concern. I would recommend Chaweng Dental Care to anyone wanting dental work done, the savings in having the work done there well and truly off set the cost on my holiday when compared to the cost of the proceedure if done at home.
0x3054f04bacc23397_0x4d0d346f08a7e62d.author: David Pratt

0x3054f04bacc23397_0x4d0d346f08a7e62d.text: Like most people, I'm not exactly a big fan of visiting a dentist, especially in another country. But Dr. Nuntida changed my mind. She speaks very good English, and also knows how to listen. Another thing that I like is that she's not trying to force anything on you and saying openly that some things are most likely unnecessary at this point (wisdom teeth removal and a crown on one of the molars). The clinic itself is clean and neat. It also well-equipped: they have portable x-ray and panoramic x-ray. They also readily send the scans to your e-mail or messenger. Pricing is also seems adequate. All in all the place leaves a good impression of an establishment where people know what they are doing. If you happened to need a dentist attention during your stay on Samui, pay Dr. Nuntida a visit — even if only for a consultation. Adequate evaluation of your situation is a crucial first step. You'll then decide for yourself what a best course of action should be. Stay healthy and happy everyone. Cheers!
0x3054f04bacc23397_0x4d0d346f08a7e62d.author: Andreas Flanco

0x3054f04bacc23397_0x4d0d346f08a7e62d.text: This business has recently moved to a new clinic at 83/14 Moo 2, Bo Phut, Koh Samui. The new clinic is beautifully fitted with modern equipment and decor (see new pictures) and is run by a lovely husband and wife team. Prices were very competitive when comparing to other dentists in the area: -1,500 Baht for teeth cleaning using Airflow technology. -10,000 Baht for teeth whitening which included clean + Airflow, scale, polish, LED whitening and home kit. -1,000-1,500 Baht per filling -9,000-10,000 Baht per Veneer. I had all of the above done and was very impressed with the results. The staff at the clinic were gentle and caring throughout the process. They were also able to accommodate appointments at short notice and the overall cost was a fraction of what I would have paid at home. Definately worth looking into - I did my research and was glad I chose Chaweng Dental Care!

0x30da3aa0b074b0a9_0xb23d55a8109657bd.text: Awesome chiropractor! I went for the first time today. And though it was 1000 Baht for the first trip (500 for subsequent visits) it was worth it. My lower back has been hurting which has been causing my mid and upper back to adjust and hurt as well. The chiropractor spent time talking with me and getting a sense of what’s wrong. His English wasn’t fluent but was very functional. He then popped the mess out of my back! But never in a painful or seeming dangerous way - it was always methodical and smooth. Afterwards, he gave me advice on stretches and exercises to do to help avoid the problem in the future. When I asked if he wanted me to return, I fully expected him to say “oh yeah, this will require many visits” as maximizing income has been a motivation for some of the chiropractors I’ve visited in the past. Instead, he said that I should wait a week and see how I feel. If I still hurt then I should return, otherwise I’m good to go. Very refreshing! Don’t be put off by this being in a neighborhood and at his house. That’s just the way Thais roll sometimes. If you’re looking for a good chiropractor, stop digging cause you’ve struck gold.
0x30da3aa0b074b0a9_0xb23d55a8109657bd.author: T Cason

0x30da3aa0b074b0a9_0xb23d55a8109657bd.text: I had a good experience with Krit. (He was trained in Taiwan.) I had not seen a Chiro since Dr. Perry moved earlier this year. I struggle with my hips and eventually, overtime, my right leg ends up short than my left...usually only 1/2 inch or so. Well, it was 2 1/2 inches shorter when I saw him yesterday. My right knee had been hurting a lot and I could just tell when I ran that something was wrong. Every Chiro I have seen from Mauritius to Kenya to the USA to Thailand has treated my issue differently. Krit also treated differently. He was a lot gentler in his approach and when he finished my legs were the same length again. Today I could tell a difference on my run and my knee is barely hurting today....so thankful to have found someone who can fix this issue when it flares.
0x30da3aa0b074b0a9_0xb23d55a8109657bd.author: Denise Gray

0x30da3aa0b074b0a9_0xb23d55a8109657bd.text: I very rarely leave reviews, but I’ve found one of the best chiropractors ever here in Chiang Mai for a ridiculously cheap price too. I’ve needed regular adjustments for 20 years, which is problematic when travelling and have visited some shockers and charged the Earth for it (£100 for a quack in Jakarta in October). He certainly knows he stuff; identified my subluxations immediately and cleared them with the most gentle manipulations I’ve ever had. As it had been 2 months, there was a lot to do and I went back a week later and was charged only 500. Baht as opposed to 1,000 for a first visit. His place is some 12 kms from town in a suburban street, obviously his home = he’s well cheap; but I’d be prepared to pay way more, he’s that good!

0x30da3aa0b074b0a9_0xb23d55a8109657bd.text: We were on vacation and my husband really needed an adjustment after our long flight, and he has a chronic knee issue that impacts his back and posture. 0x31029668009da175_0x3e7b435da507d30d.text: How Dr Patrick saved my life Dear Sir / Madam I am a patient of Mrs Gay at the rehabilitations centre. She is fantastic at her job and has really helped me . I have a trapped sciatic nerve which she has been treating. Dr Patrick suggested I have a neck and spine X-ray , which I went and had done. Unbelievably , Dr Patrick noticed something on my X-ray and asked me to go and arrange to have a heart checkup . I already have a full heath check annually at a hospital . So regardless , I called Bangkok Bangkok hospital in Bangkok and arranged to go and see a specialist to get further tests . They found most of my arteries were blocked with calcium, my right leg was 85% blocked and around my heart was also not so good . The specialist said , thank god Dr Patrick noticed this , or at the most ,6 months you would have had a massive heart attack . I have had 4 stents fitted around my heart , then next week I will go back in for my leg . Dr Patrick , I would like to thank you , you really saved my life. You deserve a medal Regards Martin Holmes

0x30e29eb18003e231_0x627d0a895da6d152.text: Little Miracle for Pediatric ICU Patients By Children's Hospital Foundation Donate Project Details The Children's Health Institute serves as the final point of treatment for complex and serious pediatric illnesses in Thailand, particularly in the Pediatric Intensive Care Unit (ICU). This unit is designed to accommodate critically ill children with severe and complex conditions, requiring urgent and close monitoring by a diverse team of medical professionals, including pediatric specialists, nurses, and radiology staff. Comparing the number of ICU beds to the total number of patients, the Children's Health Institute should ideally have 68-90 ICU beds to accommodate children aged 1 month to 15 years. However, due to certain limitations, the institute only has 38 ICU beds. Nevertheless, simply increasing the number of ICU beds may not be enough. Because critically ill patients require a wide range of medical equipment, including ventilators, pacemakers, continuous dialysis machines, heart and lung support machines, cardiac monitors, and other medical devices such as catheters, the shortage of pediatric critical care beds, equipment, and medical instruments is a significant problem in ensuring that pediatric patients have access to appropriate, equitable, and timely care, especially those with the most severe and complex co-morbidities.
