0x305195a6fb06692d_0x8cd0aeb22d432fec.text: From the very beginning, everything about our day on The Odyssey felt seamless and high-end. Communication was incredibly easy—they were responsive, friendly, and clear through the WhatsApp app, which made planning effortless. The captain and first mate delivered truly exceptional service—professional, warm, and genuinely attentive. I started the day feeling pretty seasick, and they were so thoughtful and reassuring, checking on me often and doing everything they could to help. After having the lunch they provided, I felt much better and was able to fully enjoy the rest of the day. While the fishing was slow in the morning, they were determined to find the right spots, and the afternoon completely turned around with nonstop action and plenty of fish. As someone who isn’t a seasoned fisherwoman (my husband has been fishing for years), I really appreciated how patient and encouraging they were, taking the time to teach me and make the experience fun and stress-free. The boat itself was outstanding—very new, immaculate, and extremely well maintained. I’ve honestly never seen a cleaner bathroom on a boat. Every detail felt intentional and premium. Food service was handled with care; the captain put on gloves before touching any food, everything was kept cold in the cooler, and they even provided towels. They truly provided everything you could need for the day—the only thing you need to bring is sunscreen. They finished the afternoon with a beautiful fresh fruit platter and fresh coconuts to drink from, which was such a thoughtful touch. They also brought a GoPro and captured amazing footage of us catching fish. To top it all off, we got to choose the fish we wanted to keep, and we took it to a local restaurant where it was prepared for us. An incredible day, breathtaking views, unforgettable memories, and true five-star service from start to finish. The Odyssey exceeded every expectation and is absolutely worth it.
0x305195a6fb06692d_0x8cd0aeb22d432fec.author: Sarah Morgan

0x305195a6fb06692d_0x8cd0aeb22d432fec.text: Unbelievably great experience. They handled our pickup from airport to hotel. Amazing itinerary each day. We went in off season too (mid August) and came early on a day where it went raining at first. It cleared up and we dod the kayaking tour and.got to swim in the water where they filmed the most recent Jurassic Park. One of many perks of going there early and not waiting for perfect weather, which brings the crowds. Dod the island hopping tour w snorkeling amd paddle boarding. Our driver, Mr Pakit (Son) was amazing and patient, as we often stayed later than we were supposed to wherever we were. Same goes for our ship crew on the speedboat. Super friendly and helpful. Fully catered days no matter where we were. Fresh coconuts they let's us cut open on the boat. One for all 6 of us! And Odyssey even allowed us to shift plans last minute when we realized we wanted to stay on Phi Phi island over night rather than stay at our hotel in Krabi again. Wish I could stay here for ever and do a different tour each day. God bless everyone that helped us at Odyssey tours. Thank you for making our (family) honeymoon extra amazing!
0x305195a6fb06692d_0x8cd0aeb22d432fec.author: Jeremy Dayton

0x305195a6fb06692d_0x8cd0aeb22d432fec.text: I had an incredible experience with Odyssey Travel Krabi on the Phi Phi Island tour! The speedboat was clean, spacious, and very comfortable. One of the best parts was that the boat had an onboard toilet, which made the trip much more convenient — especially for a full-day tour. The captain and crew were fantastic — professional, friendly, and very attentive. They made sure everyone was safe, relaxed, and having a great time throughout the journey. We were also provided with snacks, soft drinks, fresh fruits, and cold water — all perfectly timed and refreshing during our boat ride. Another fun touch: they had a Paddle Board for us to use while swimming and relaxing at the beach stops. It was a great way to enjoy the crystal-clear water even more. Everything was well-organized and on time. This was a smooth, safe, and absolutely unforgettable trip. Thank you, Odyssey Travel! Highly recommended for anyone visiting Krabi.
0x305195a6fb06692d_0x8cd0aeb22d432fec.author: Garn Dejyothin

0x305195a6fb06692d_0x8cd0aeb22d432fec.text: We had an amazing experience on both the Sunset Tour and Phi Phi Islands Tour. A special thank you to Jimmy (Captain) and Sonny (Assistant) for making our trips so enjoyable. Both of them were friendly, professional, and incredibly helpful throughout the tours. They were constantly looking out for us and always made sure we were safe and comfortable. They brought us to beautiful, breathtaking locations and timed our visits well, allowing us to enjoy the scenery without feeling rushed. We also appreciated the privacy they gave us, allowing our family to relax and fully enjoy each destination at our own pace. Their care, attentiveness, and positive attitude made the experience truly memorable. Thank you, Jimmy and Sonny, for helping us create wonderful family memories in Krabi. We highly recommend them and would gladly join another tour with them in the future.
0x305195a6fb06692d_0x8cd0aeb22d432fec.author: Ali Yousouf

0x305195a6fb06692d_0x8cd0aeb22d432fec.text: This boat trip with Odyssey Tour Krabi was "beyond expectations" 🤍✨ From the moment we boarded, the staff took excellent care of us, paying attention to every detail. They were friendly yet highly professional, making us feel safe throughout the trip. Each spot they took us to was truly beautiful, with crystal-clear water where we could clearly see the fish 🐠💙 There were opportunities to swim, snorkel, and see coral reefs, as well as plenty of beautiful photo spots without having to compete with anyone. The food and snacks on board were plentiful and comprehensive 🍊🥥 It felt like a relaxing vacation, but with an experience that far exceeded the price. Overall, it was a trip that was "beautiful, fun, and relaxing" 🌿 If you're visiting Krabi, I highly recommend this trip. It's truly worth it, and you'll definitely want to come back again 💛
0x305195a6fb06692d_0x8cd0aeb22d432fec.author: Phawarahn nucharum

0x305195a6fb06692d_0x8cd0aeb22d432fec.text: We did the fishing + 7 islands program with the boat ODYSSEY in Krabi and absolutely loved it. From start to finish everything was perfectly organized — they picked us up from our hotel and dropped us back, which made the whole day stress-free. The crew was super friendly, professional, and helpful, always checking on us and catering to our needs. The boat itself is very well equipped — snorkeling gear, paddle board, and everything you could need for a full day on the water. The lunch was very tasty with great presentation, and the fresh fruits provided were incredibly sweet and delicious. A real highlight was when the captain prepared sashimi on the spot from the fish we caught, which was an amazing and unforgettable touch. Overall, an outstanding experience. Excellent captain, great crew, fantastic boat. Highly recommended — 10/10 🚤🌴🎣
0x305195a6fb06692d_0x8cd0aeb22d432fec.author: Raivo Baritis

0x305195a6fb06692d_0x8cd0aeb22d432fec.text: We decided with my boyfriend to go to Krabi for a boat trip to Hong Island, and we chose Odyssey Tour Krabi and we’re really glad we did, because it was truly an amazing experience. My boyfriend loves fishing, so we combined the trip with fishing and snorkeling. We sailed around beautiful limestone cliffs and fished nearby. we managed to catch a beautiful fish, which they later served to us as sashimi—and we’ve never eaten anything better! Drinks were available at all times, including fresh coconut. The lunch provided was also very good. The snorkeling was great. The guides were very kind and prepared lovely snacks and fruit for us. The boat was comfortable, and we really appreciated that it had a toilet. We couldn’t have chosen better. Thank you for making our stay in Krabi more enjoyable! Highly recommend to everyone.
0x305195a6fb06692d_0x8cd0aeb22d432fec.author: anilorak lol

0x305195a6fb06692d_0x8cd0aeb22d432fec.text: Had an amazing tour of the Phi Phi islands with Jimmy and Sunny! We had 4 kids and 4 adults for our private tour and they anticipated our every need! They supplied drinks, snacks, an awesome lunch with ice cold young coconuts, and post snorkeling fresh fruit. They had motion sickness medications on board for anyone who needed it. Boat was brand new, pristine, and powerful. Sunny came out on the paddle board when we were snorkeling and quietly drifted in the area the kids were, providing them a landing spot when they wanted a break out of the water. They took pics the entire trip and sent them to us the next day. Cannot recommend highly enough!
0x305195a6fb06692d_0x8cd0aeb22d432fec.author: Hang Claus

0x305033eb8b3ca5fd_0x301f2b76dac993d5.author: Boss Boss

0x3054f388c04b4ff3_0x6b6961ef38fdc8ca.text: Travel is the ultimate test of one's health, especially as you get older. If your constitution isn't strong enough, any problems that arise will be amplified. A series of discomforts started in Bangkok: a runny nose and sore throat requiring cold medicine; in Chiang Mai, insect bites on both feet caused swelling and redness extending to the ankles; in Phuket, antibiotic ointment was bought, and while the foot wounds began to heal, the cold symptoms escalated into a persistent, phlegmy cough that wouldn't stop, especially at night; and finally, in Koh Samui, this morning, a slight movement while coughing resulted in a strained right shoulder! All of this made me decide to stop taking medicine and seek treatment from a traditional Chinese medicine practitioner! I found this clinic online with excellent reviews, easily located it, and rang the doorbell. There I met Claire. I filled out an online form and scheduled an appointment. She patiently listened to my explanation and treated me from head to toe with acupuncture and cupping. She also thoughtfully gave me many tips on how to maintain my health. This considerate and personalized treatment made me feel very cared for! It felt like home! Thank you, Claire, for your kindness and professionalism! The most amazing thing is that after I left the clinic, all the coughing and phlegm were gone! My back also felt much more relaxed! I think I'll feel even better when I wake up tomorrow! I hope this message can help those in need. You can come to this clinic for care and relief. 😊
0x3054f388c04b4ff3_0x6b6961ef38fdc8ca.author: T L

0x3054f388c04b4ff3_0x6b6961ef38fdc8ca.text: Accidentally seen this clinic whilst on holiday. Dr Claire is honestly a walking Wikipedia with a heart. I came in feeling confused, frustrated and very over being medically gaslit (as so many of us women are), and left feeling actually listened to, understood and supported. I went mainly for period issues and stubborn weight gain, and she didn’t just brush it off — she explained everything so clearly, in a way that finally made sense, and created a treatment plan just for me while I am in Koh Samui. I saw a noticeable improvement with my very next cycle, which felt nothing short of a small miracle. I also tried acupuncture and cupping for the first time (slightly scared, not going to lie as I don't do well with needles), and I ended up loving both. Surprisingly relaxing, and way more effective than I expected. If you’re tired of being told “everything looks normal” while you feel anything but — go see Dr Claire. I’m genuinely so grateful I did. 💛
0x3054f388c04b4ff3_0x6b6961ef38fdc8ca.author: Evelina Vaičiūtė

0x3054f388c04b4ff3_0x6b6961ef38fdc8ca.text: How is it that we can find things when we're not even searching for them? I quite literally passed by the Piraluna Clinic one afternoon by pure chance. One quick message, followed by a prompt response confirmed my appointment for my TCM consultation. As they say, there's a first time for everything and this was certainly an excellent place to start a journey in acupuncture. Combined with cupping therapy, there was definitely a noticeable relief from a persistent pain in my left knee following the treatment. Not only this, I was given some advice on how best to prevent further recurrence of the pain. Of course, prevention being better than cure. However, I also know that I have a strategy to deal with the knee pain if it returns. I could not have hoped to find a better practitioner in Claire. Incredibly knowledgeable, calm and gentle. More than that though, a thoroughly lovely person with impeccable English. Highly recommended!
0x3054f388c04b4ff3_0x6b6961ef38fdc8ca.author: Simon

0x3054f388c04b4ff3_0x6b6961ef38fdc8ca.text: I've been suffering from awful neck pain so visited this clinic for some TCM, it's just opposite Macro which wa handy for parking. I had a warm welcome, it appeared very clean and my practitioner Claire was excellent, friendly, helpful and clearly very experienced. The consultation process was clear and took about ten minutes. I then received a combination of treatments (I won't confess to know the names of them all), including some kind of muscle rub, cupping, acupuncture and heat treatment. I left feeling much better and so far the absolutely terrible neck pain I have been experiencing has been eliviated which feels like some kind of miracle considering I've already had two rounds of physio without much change. 0x30e2997a8e768451_0xe3b8542f5664a8c6.text: The doctor is incredibly kind, and the atmosphere is warm and friendly. Coming here made me feel comfortable, relaxed, and stress-free. The doctor and the medical team are very attentive and caring. The clinic looks modern and very clean. The doctor is very friendly and easy to talk to, creating a relaxing atmosphere. They offer fragrant tea, osmanthus tea, and cookies while you wait to see the doctor. The doctor inquired about your symptoms and examined your physical condition, explaining how to balance your body according to Traditional Chinese Medicine and determining a treatment plan including acupuncture, cupping, and herbal steam therapy. On your first visit, the doctor will perform a pulse diagnosis and ask about your symptoms. They will check the functioning of your internal organs, blood circulation, and pulse to restore balance to your body. The doctor's diagnosis was very accurate. The doctor also showed videos on breathing exercises to lower blood pressure and abdominal massage. I was very nervous and afraid it would hurt during my first acupuncture and cupping session. It turned out the doctor was very gentle; it didn't hurt at all, just felt like something was passing through my skin. Some felt less painful than an ant bite, but it was worth it because it helped various systems in my body function better. It wasn't as painful as I expected. It was great! The doctor's conversation made me feel less stressed. I also brought my father, who received electrical stimulation and targeted acupuncture. Those experiencing aches, pains, and stiffness in the neck, shoulders, and upper back can receive acupuncture treatment simultaneously. If two people come, the doctor uses a red infrared lamp focused on the acupuncture area, creating a warm sensation. Soft music is played to help relax. Essential oils are rubbed on the palms and inhaled to promote relaxation beforehand. After acupuncture, cupping therapy is performed. The first time, you'll feel a warm, tense sensation at the points where the cupping is done, accompanied by a pleasant herbal aroma. The heat in the cups draws blood to the surface, relieving blocked circulation and relaxing muscles, reducing neck and back pain. Cupping itself isn't painful, just a slight tension in several areas of the back. Afterward, there are purple circles on the back. The doctor explained that this might indicate areas with poor blood circulation, and that the treatment improves bodily functions. The treatment is then complete. Afterwards, you change into a gown and are ready to go home. The doctor provides healthy tea, healthy snacks, and cooling patches to try. The cost is very reasonable. The doctor and the treatment team are very attentive and caring. The location is convenient with ample parking. After the acupuncture, I felt I slept better and more soundly. My bloating and gas decreased, my stomach felt more active, and my blood circulation improved. I also found it easier to fall asleep earlier than before. I woke up feeling refreshed and not tired. I was very impressed with the treatment and the doctor's advice. I want to continue treatment to further improve my health and body balance. Coming here makes me feel relaxed, like I'm on vacation. I'm so glad I came to Rela Traditional Chinese Medicine Clinic.

0x3054ef003a93f087_0xa8f4a3e4abacf351.text: Male 54years 204cm tall 126kg weight My history is that I was a professional rugby player, playing at a high level around the world. These activities led to me suffering serious lower back pain for the last 20 years! I have honestly tried every avenue to get some relief: chiropractor, osteopaths, massage, gadgets, acupuncture, cupping etc etc. Some of which provided minimal relief some made my situation worse! To the point of last year on a visit to Australia whilst in excruciating pain, in my back and hips whenever I was stood, I then lost all sensation in my legs and started to collapse and fall to the floor which was the most frightening feeling I have ever had. On my arrival to Koh Samui in December I had heard wonderful things about Aveya clinic so as a last chance to get my life back I came and had a visit. I have been having spinal decompression treatment followed by photodynamic laser treatment twice a week. I am currently on week seven and I have to say it has given me a new lease of life, I’m now walking 6km each morning and playing Pádel 3 times a week with no pain. It is truly remarkable! The clinic is immaculately clean and the staff are the most professional, attentive and polite people I have ever come across. They make you welcome and at ease the moment you walk through the door! I would highly recommend this clinic as I’m sure their whole range of treatments would be on the same level as the treatment I have received. I can honestly say over the last 20 years of trying every kind of treatment and therapy this is working better than anything I’ve tried , thanks again 🙏x

0x30e29f3ad9823fdf_0xc26324bb23396a5c.text: First of all, I have to say I'm terrified of dentists. Lately, I've had symptoms like my teeth were falling out, they were all loose, I had cavities everywhere, and I've been experiencing unexplained migraine headaches. I also had lead fillings on three molars (two on the innermost upper jaws and one on the lower jaw). After enduring it for so long, I finally went to the dentist. Ultimately, I needed root canal treatment on two upper right molars (they removed the fillings and redid the rest), and another on the left. I was terrified, but unbelievably, the dentist was incredibly gentle, kind, and careful not to let anything go into my throat. Dr. Jirihathai, a small female dentist, was like a goddess to me. I expected the injection to hurt, but it didn't at all. When she drilled the root canal, it felt so comfortable, like someone was massaging my nerves. That's when I realized my migraines were coming from my inflamed root canals. When she treated the other root canal, I felt so much better. The migraine pain in my forehead, left eye socket, and back of my head disappeared completely. I finally understood that the left-sided migraines I'd been experiencing for ten years, taking painkillers daily, were actually caused by inflamed root canals. The dentist was excellent. They were quick, gentle, and meticulous, ensuring no saliva or debris entered my throat. For me, being a dentist isn't just about skill; compassion and care are equally important. I give them a perfect 10/10 for skill, a perfect 10/10 for care and attention to detail, and a perfect 10/100 for making me overcome my fear of dentists. Dr. Peerapat also did my crown, which is beautiful and incredibly detailed. My tooth was crooked, and he carefully prepared around it to prevent me from biting my cheek. I'm allergic to lead, and he was wonderful. When he removed the silver filling, my tooth cracked, but he secured it and crowned it after the root canal treatment. I was very worried about lead leaking into my throat, but it was perfectly fine. There was also Dr. Sornsiri, a male dentist, who helped remove the silver lead fillings from both lower molars. He worked very quickly and painlessly. The fillings turned out beautifully. He was very attentive, preparing the crooked tooth that I couldn't reach to make using a dental floss easier. He even used a rubber gauze to prevent any debris from entering my throat during the procedure. His attentiveness and explanations made me feel comfortable lying with my mouth open for the treatment. I want to express my sincere gratitude. This is a genuine review. I paid for everything myself; no one paid for it, and there were no discounts. But I really liked the treatment I received here and am very thankful for it, which is why I'm writing this review. Thank you, Dr. Jirihathai, for helping me overcome my fear of dentists. Thank you also to Dr. Peerapat and Dr. Sornsiri. This is Walirat.

0x30da319d71f41cc1_0xf491a29a2987b0ac.text: I’ve been so grateful for Dr. Kittipan’s help with varicose veins. I recently had an easy, minor surgery to correct varicose vein leakage and was thrilled with the results. A friend recommended Dr. Kittipan to me as a very kind, caring doctor. Upon meeting him, I found that to be very true. He is so personable and easy to talk to. I felt perfectly comfortable being able to ask him questions and talk about my vein problems. He speaks English perfectly which made our conversations very easy. At Dr. Kittipan‘s clinic, he used ultrasound to show me the problem with vein leakage. He discussed this with me and showed me photos of ulcers that can occur if this type of vein is left untreated. Then he explained various options for treatment and gave me his recommendation to insert a tiny laser fiber into my leg to inject the vein with high heat which seals the vein and solves the leakage problem. The body then absorbs the sealed vein over time and creates a new vein if necessary. This procedure has around a 98% success rate. The surgery was handled in the most professional way in the operation room at Rajavej hospital. All the staff were kind and helpful. Dr. Kittipan was very reassuring as well. The surgery only took a short time, maybe just under one hour! I was awake through the process and felt no pain other than the quick, initial anesthetic injection. I spent around one more hour in the recovery area walking around to make sure all was well. There were no problems whatsoever and although I got a ride home just to be safe, I honestly felt I could have driven myself home from the hospital! I hardly had any pain in my leg after the surgery, just a bit of tenderness. I barely even had any need for pain medication afterward. I was given an elastic nylon stocking to wear from my foot to my knee which really helped to support my leg for the week after the surgery. I was told I should walk around 30 minutes per day to help with the healing process. This was no problem. There was a waterproof bandage on my leg so that I could shower regularly until Dr. Kittipan removed the bandage at our one week follow up appointment at his clinic. At my one month follow up visit, I was shown by ultrasound how the vein had been absorbed and the leakage problem solved. I honestly can’t think of how the surgery could have been any easier, less invasive or problem free! I have had complete trust in Dr. Kittipan throughout this process. He has been very helpful in talking with me about various vein issues I have and the different options for treating spider veins that might just need easy, in clinic cosmetic treatment to varicose veins like mine that require minor surgery. I highly recommend Dr. Kittipan and his leg/vein clinic. Act quickly so that your problem will not increase in severity. He can direct you regarding the best option for you.
0x30da319d71f41cc1_0xf491a29a2987b0ac.author: Jenese Thorup

0x30da29440f4dc1db_0xe46a305a582933c5.text: Where do I even begin? This was the most incredible experience with the most professional company I’ve ever encountered. From start to finish, everything was seamless. Quick communication and incredibly helpful staff made the process so easy – I even booked the day before via chat! It was no problem for them. They arranged a private driver to pick me up, and I was greeted with a brand-new car that smelled great and a driver who was courteous and professional. Upon arrival, I was asked to wait briefly, signed my waiver, and then got suited up with a helmet. Although the staff didn’t speak much English, Google Translate bridged the gap effortlessly. From the very first step, I felt completely safe and well-cared for. They even provided water and a stunning sunset view while I waited for my turn. When my time came, they strapped me in, handed me a GoPro, and off we went. The view was breathtaking – like stepping into a painting. Words can’t describe the feeling of being up there; you have to experience it yourself. The pilot was professional, ensuring a safe and smooth ride both up and down. I highly recommend the 30-minute sunset flight – it’s truly magical. I left with the biggest smile and wished I could give them more stars than Google allows. Truly unforgettable!
0x30da29440f4dc1db_0xe46a305a582933c5.author: Tord Donnum

0x30da29440f4dc1db_0xe46a305a582933c5.text: This is a powered paragliding experience in Chiang Mai, offering breathtaking aerial views of fields, mountains, and countryside. The feeling of flying is both thrilling and liberating, making it a truly unique and unforgettable experience. Highlights • The powered paragliding experience is truly unique, allowing you to genuinely feel the sensation of "flying." • Takeoff and landing are handled by professional instructors, making it suitable even for beginners. • Wide-open views of the surrounding natural scenery of Chiang Mai. • A smooth yet exhilarating flight experience. Pricing • Flight price: 3000 THB/person • Photo + video service: 2500 THB (1-2 people) Important Notes • Advance booking is recommended, as flight times are subject to weather conditions. • Wear comfortable clothing and closed shoes. • Those with a fear of heights or health conditions should participate with caution. Overall Review This is a highly recommended high-altitude experience. While not inexpensive, the flight perspective and overall experience are exceptional. If you want to add a true aerial adventure to your Chiang Mai trip, this is a worthwhile option.
0x30da29440f4dc1db_0xe46a305a582933c5.author: Sanj

0x30da29440f4dc1db_0xe46a305a582933c5.text: A free shuttle picked us up from our accommodation, and the journey was quick. The feeling was amazing, the wind on my face was cool and refreshing. The landing was smooth and not scary at all. I highly recommend it to anyone who's easily scared like me – you'll love it! 0x30da342e8e6773dd_0x3933532854d2810d.text: I am a workaholic - have known this about myself for many years. And, my long term career in the US entertainment industry has been a perfect outlet for my addiction. What I've also known about myself for many years is there were some deeply traumatic events in childhood and early adulthood that weren't properly addressed resulting in a C-PTSD diagnosis at the end of last year. And, it all came crashing down at once. After many, many years of running myself into the ground, I had a major life event at the start of 2025 that I couldn't put my head down and work through - the end of a long term relationship. The lack of foundation having never done "the work" ultimately led to a mutually agreed separation of employment at the same time. And I'm grateful it did -- because without those two things happening concurrently, I'm not sure I ever would've taken the time to stop, center myself, and face the trauma I had been trying to outrun for many years. In researching places to go, I heard about New Paradigm through a mutual friend who had a friend that went through the program and called it "life changing." I made an inquiry immediately as I was desperate to get on the first flight out of the US so I could "fix it" and get back to the grind. It didn't quite work out that way. There were a lot of things I needed to "fix" within myself on home soil first. I spoke to Dirk for the first time in February and we decided together that I needed to be a bit more emotionally stabilized before making the 26 hour trip to attend the program. So, I started regular counseling sessions with him and began to dive in to EMDR. I dedicated every minute of the next 3 months prepping for my trip which was scheduled for May. I felt like a different person and that all the "healing" I'd done would make the program a breeze. It wasn't. It was hard. Really hard (especially the first week). And my deep seated need to try to control my environment was the first major hurdle. I had developed hyper vigilance over the years as a form of protection to keep myself safe, not realizing it was doing exactly the opposite. I quickly realized that this wasn't my show and I wasn't in control - but that wasn't an easy surrender. The second major hurdle was the surrender of all forms of technology. When that happened, my brain kicked into ruminations lasting what felt like every hour of the day from sun up to sun down. Dirk worked with me using methods to try to break the ruminations, but they were incessant. And my brain? It was focused solely on my relationship dissolving. The grief and shame that I had for not showing up differently as a partner due to my burnout / depression from my job. Guilt for not going to therapy sooner when I was being pushed to do it. The resentment for how it ended. We did a lot of EMDR around it, but still there was little relief. After about the 9th day Dirk had a talk with me and said "we're going to cut the fuel line to what's going on. There are all these fires around you that we're putting out, but we need to cut the gas." So, we went deeper and back to childhood where we found the root cause of the issue. Adandonment. Feelings of unworthiness. Unresolved issues with my mom that mirrored some issues in my romantic relationship. And once we did EMDR around those things, the clouds started to lift. Now, nearly a month of from the program having had some time for the EMDR to really set in and lots of reflection, I feel good. Really good. In fact, I'd say my time time at New Paradigm was life changing. I learned more about myself in 14 days than I had in the previous 38 years. I can clearly see when my work addiction developed, why, and how my lack of relationship to self led me to a REALLY dark place. My focus now is on implementing the tools to aid in my recovery and I know for absolute certainty that I will NEVER be in the position I was in at the start of the year -- because now I have a foundation. I know who I am and I love myself. I highly recommend New Paradigm - it was the best thing to ever happen to me.
0x30da342e8e6773dd_0x3933532854d2810d.author: DaLyn Bauman

0x30da342e8e6773dd_0x3933532854d2810d.text: Having received traditional treatments of Mental health Challenges such as Talk Therapy (CBT) and multiple Medications for half a decade, I can say that nothing has pulled me out of my Misery and Self Deprecation as much as the Full, Complete Holistic treatment that Dirk offers at New Paradigm. My journey into the world of Mental Health Challenges are like many others who suffer a great difficulty navigating their own mind. Constant depression, Severe Anxiety, Lack of energy and passion, Self Sabotages, Failed relationships etc. When I realised my mind was a threat to my being, to my livelihood, to my health, I started rushing to seek help. It started with talking with friends and family, then Counselling, then "Self improvements", then Therapy, then medication, lastly Hospitalisation. Even with all the unraveling alongside seeking help, It wasn't clear to me that the treatments I was receiving was not helping me and some even made me worse off. Until I was at my lowest and was referred to New Paradigm by a professional that beliefs in innovative approach to treating Mental Health challenges and illnesses. It might be obvious where I am going with this message right now, yes New Paradigm pulled me out of the mud that is my mind, my thoughts, and yes just as others have said the Place is absolutely amazing and beautiful and one of the most comfortable stays you'll ever have. However, the core of what makes me believe in New Paradigm for treatment to Severe personal and medical mental challenges is truly the "Holistic" Approach. To me, Holistic encapsulates treatment that focuses on The Whole, the body, the mind, the spirit and any other things you got inside of you. At New Paradigm, you aren't just taught through talking and thinking, you are also taught through not talking and not thinking. You are taught through movements (exercises, walks, swimming), but as importantly you are taught through not moving (meditation, sitting, breathing). Everything in the programme have their reasons and those reasons are to heal and strengthen you, most importantly to allow you to be that version of yourself that persists through the storm, to be able to sit or walk in serenity and enjoy each day and each task again with peace and joy. To conclude, New Paradigm treats you like a family that are equipped with decades of knowledge and tools around mental health challenges. Once you arrives you are a part of that family, sure you have some daily tasks but as a small tight knit community everyone has a part to play. Luckily all parts are there just for you to regain your inner Peace and Health. New Paradigm will treat you like a member or a friend, and not a patient or a client. If you are lost, if you feel you need help with your mind, if you have chaos in your head, contact Dirk and His family. They will change you for the better. ps. from the bottom to the top of my heart, Thank you Dirk, Kae, Atith and other staffs at New Paradigm for giving me another perspective on life, a new beginning. and Thank you to my family for supporting me and allowing me a chance at New Paradigm. I am eternally grateful
0x30da342e8e6773dd_0x3933532854d2810d.author: Nino Jj

0x30da342e8e6773dd_0x3933532854d2810d.text: Throughout my life and professional career, I never felt that I needed professional help. Somehow, I always managed challenging situations myself, both in my personal and in my work life. A few months ago, however, I started to have mental blockages, strong and constant neck pain and I felt an emotional exhaustion beyond anything I had experienced before. It took me a while to realise that I was “burned out” on several levels and that a beach holiday with the family would not be enough to put me back into shape. In retrospect, no wonder, given that I work and live most of the time, away from my wife and children, in a “frontier” country that currently is at war with itself. Over there, daily life and work means daily crisis management and dealing with a lot of negativity, with varying intensity, and over a long period of time. Luckily, I realised that I need professional help and started do the research, looking for a program that I could join and that specialises in dealing with “burn out” cases and trauma, as I was quite sure that some older, traumatic experiences would need to be addressed as well, as certain thought patterns kept coming up, again and again. In other words: I was looking for a holistic program that could address my specific needs and restore my mental strength and emotional imbalance in a relatively short time. The one program that stood out and that resonated with me instantly was the one of New Paradigm in Chiang Mai, Thailand: a maximum of 4 participants only are accepted at a time, for a 14-day retreat that sounded intense but holistic, designed to address the mental, emotional, and spiritual aspects of oneself. To cut an incredible, life-changing experience short: I finished the program a week ago and have to say that it was the right program at the right time with the right “content”, developed and operated by the right expert: Dirk J. Lambert has grown up in the West, specialised in trauma treatment, hence understands the Western mindset, and at the same time is a two times ordained Buddhist monk who is living in Asia for more than 35 years. His uniquely designed program combines Western “treatment” models with Asian spiritual practices, resulting in a very practical and not difficult to apply “path” of recovery. Stepping onto the path helped me to gain back my mental strength and more importantly provided me with the tools, the self- care and the confidence that will prevent me from running into the same mental “traps” again. I could not have asked for a better retreat and for better personal guidance. Thank you, Dirk & team – you did an outstanding job!
0x30da342e8e6773dd_0x3933532854d2810d.author: Jens Uwe Parkitny

0x30da342e8e6773dd_0x3933532854d2810d.text: New Paradigm’s program successfully blends mindfulness practices with modern trauma modalities to create space for new growth and a new sense of hope. Some of the philosophies (waking early, observing silence for the majority of the day, restricted electronics access) may seem intense at first. After completing the program, I would not want it any other way and know it would not be as effective without them. Dirk has a kind of mindful maverick quality to him that makes him a very effective therapist. While grounded in researched backed methods like meditation and EMDR, he diverges from the conventional strategies of talk therapy and seeks to dive into the root of the issue without wasting time with extraneous tangents. He will challenge you, sometimes directly, but never without compassion and your best interest at heart. I found this to be a refreshing approach compared to past experiences with traditional psychologists. After all, most of us have come to New Paradigm’s gate because the conventional methods haven’t yielded much success. It is clear that all the pieces of the program have been well thought out to work together and were fine tuned over many years and many patients. Try to remain open minded, listen more than speak and slowly put the ideas into practice over the two weeks. When the work is challenging, sustenance is all the more important and that’s where Kae comes in to the program with her amazingly delicious, healthy meals and afternoon snacks. Gratitude comes easier in the morning when you know you have three of her meals to enjoy during the day. There is also a fun cooking class towards the end of the retreat and recipes to take home! Sonny is the yoga and fitness instructor who can generally be seen working hard and uplifting people with his positive spirit. He really is the definition of diligence and his morning walks, albeit feeling painfully early at first, became something I looked forward to. If you’re feeling stuck or can’t move on from the past, I would recommend New Paradigm as a potential catalyst for a healthier perspective. None of us can change the past, but we can remodel our view of it to better suit a positive path moving forward. Thanks for all the wisdom, care, food, memories and good laughs. All the best to you Dirk, Kae and Sonny, Sean
0x30da342e8e6773dd_0x3933532854d2810d.author: Sean Cooper

0x30da342e8e6773dd_0x3933532854d2810d.text: It was a last-minute decision for me to join the 7days retreat at New Paradigm in Chiang Mai. I had been comparing many mental health well-being retreats in Koh Samui, Phuket, Indonesia, the Philippines and Bangkok, but New Paradigm in Chiang Mai felt much more personal and intimate. They only accept four people in the program and during my stay there were just three clients including me, which made the experience very focused and genuine. On the first day everything felt a little unfamiliar, but I chose to trust the process and go with the flow. Dirk listened deeply and gave me a sense of psychological safety that I had not felt in a long time. I finally felt understood in my struggles, my weaknesses and the reasons behind some of my reactions and behaviour patterns. He taught me powerful techniques that helped me transform negative energy into something that supports me rather than hurts me. And more important for me personally is the power of letting go and forgiveness. You must be willing to open your mind, heart and soul for the healing to work. Dirk provides the foundation, but you must participate and take action. The true change happens when you embrace the learning and commit to the journey. Sunny, the son of Dirk, kept us on track with all the physical activities. He supported us with so much passion and genuine encouragement. Every time he said you can do it, he truly meant it. He is also an all-around support for the retreat and even takes care of cleaning our rooms. The quality of his work shows how much love and care he puts into everything he does. Kae, the wife of Dirk, cooked the most delicious Thai food. You can feel the love she pours into each meal. Her warm smile each day added so much comfort to the experience. Dirk has created a very unique focus program for people who are ready to help themselves and take responsibility for their healing. With the balanced support of Sunny and Kae, the experience becomes a true renewal of life. Thank you Dirk for your wisdom and care. Thank you Sunny for your motivation and uplifting energy. Thank you Kae for your loving meals and kindness. I am truly grateful to each of you for helping me reconnect with myself, renewed, stronger and ready to face the present & future. All the best, Vivian of Switzerland

0x30da342e8e6773dd_0x3933532854d2810d.text: Sometimes all it takes is letting go of what was and taking a little better care of yourself. During an intensive retreat in Thailand, my days started at 5:30 in the morning with a quiet walk, followed by the sauna and ice bath, and then morning meditation. After breakfast, we had counseling and trauma therapy, light therapy, Muay Thai training, and Thai massages to bring our bodies back into balance. I can honestly say this was the most beautiful and necessary experience of my life. Not only because of the journey itself, but because of the people I met along the way. Ross and Chris from Australia and England, Sunny who guided us through all activities, Kae who cooked the most delicious food every day and cared for us with so much love, and Dirk, who guided us through deep treatments that allowed us to reconnect with our past and transform the way we carry our pain. We were also given the chance to say goodbye to someone we miss, or to someone we were never able to say goodbye to in the past, simply because we couldn’t let go or didnt know how to. And in between all that healing, there was so much laughter. Chris even drew a picture of the three of us, me as Super R the Meerkat, Ross as a hamster, and Chris as the whale. We called ourselves the Holy Trinity of trauma treatment and laughed our asses off. These moments are now memories but will stay with me forever. It was a truly magical time. If you ever feel the need to pause, realign, or take time for yourself, I can only say this is an experience I deeply recommend. Speaking as someone who didn’t take enough care of herself and was constantly overworking and trying to hold everything together: take care of yourself and don’t be afraid to let go and stand alone. When you surrender unconditionally, the most beautiful things can happen. Love, Remke

Furthermore, his calm, confident, and approachable demeanor greatly contributes to a sense of comfort and confidence in the patient. Throughout the treatment process, I felt exceptionally well cared for and under the responsibility of a physician possessing both knowledge, skill, and a true medical professionalism. 0x30e29f304c3eba4f_0x6c8a2cc93bfd15f1.text: Advance Surgery Center - BKK Hospital The medical staff did such an amazing job here. Located in Building D. I came here to get a minor surgery done. From meeting with my doctor to consult my options, to nurses prep. It was so smooth. The surgery was done under 45 minutes and I was able to check out same day. My two nurses (I wish I remembered their names) were so kind, with a smile and helpful 😊 After the surgery my nurses said we will do additional testing on the surgery tissue to make sure everything is ok with no issues. They gave me pain killers and the pills were very good. I had no pain the day of the surgery or the week after. Few weeks later, as promised, I received an email with my final results. They sent me few images as additional proof, along with entire written results. Everything came back great, nothing to worry about. After your Surgery Center visit, you will go outside the glass doors into a large patient waiting area to pay and get your medication. In this spacious area, you will find comfortable seats. You will also feel at ease, listening to live piano music with violin playing. If you’re traveling to Thailand and looking to get your medical services done, I would highly recommend this facility. No one was rude with me and I felt comfortable during my visit.

0x30fdabb040b887b1_0xd441f5ee2e743cf.text: When our child is sick, the first place we think of is Dr. Prapan, a pediatrician at San Paulo Hospital. The staff, including the doctor, were incredibly helpful. They explained that because of the high fever, hospitalization would allow for better monitoring and assessment of her condition compared to home care. And indeed, once our daughter was admitted, the children's ward was beautifully decorated and perfect for young children. The staff didn't wear their uniforms, so our daughter wasn't afraid and was happy with the care. The food was delicious too. Most importantly, on the second night, she improved significantly after receiving medication, medication adjustments, nebulizer treatment, and the care from the assistants and nurses. (Our daughter loved Auntie Chu so much! She helped bathe and dress her, even getting wet herself, and she didn't scold her at all.) Before going home, we also got to see the playroom, which was so fun, with a ball pit and other toys. If you're still looking for a pediatrician, we highly recommend Dr. Prapan. It's like having a brand new ear, after experiencing intermittent muffled and blocked hearing for so long. 👏👏 He also checked my eardrum and confirmed it was normal, and there were no other inflammations. The doctor provided excellent service, spoke kindly and politely, and gave great advice and consultation. **The doctor explained that the earwax, which was already abundant, swells and becomes wet when exposed to water, obstructing hearing. I am very pleased with the quality of the service, the attitude, and the responsiveness. Dr. Nu is also a dentist and orthodontist by profession, and his main specialty is braces. 0x30e29e55a8dbc7bd_0xe4fb214a7fe4600c.text: Our whole family uses their services. Especially when our children catch a cold, we can almost always get an appointment even on the same day, which is a great help when we need to see a doctor urgently. When I go for appointments myself, DYM's interpreters are often very skilled; they listen carefully to what I want to say to the doctor and translate it for me, so I don't feel much of a language barrier, which makes the visit very stress-free. Also, being able to make and change appointments via LINE is very helpful. The health checkups are especially quick, so even though I usually go to a designated general hospital, I always think I'd like to have them done at DYM. They are very thorough, providing results for mammograms and ultrasounds on DVD. The only thing that always causes me trouble is the medication. The "dosage and administration instructions" are clearly written on the Ziploc bag containing the medication, but there is nothing written on the medication itself. (Especially bottled medication) I have to write "2ml 3 times a day for [medical condition]" myself with a marker and store it in the refrigerator. Sometimes, even permanent markers repel the ink and disappear... and I wonder whose it is... I wish they would put labels on the medication itself. That's about the only thing that bothers me; the hospital staff are really kind and even entertain the children during examinations.

0x30e29c50a35fbf31_0xec5e11c75f0bd468.text: I had a really positive experience at Avatar Treatment and it stood out from most massage places in Bangkok because the session felt much more focused on how the body actually functions rather than just a standard relaxation routine. After explaining the areas I was dealing with, the therapist adjusted the treatment and worked specifically on areas where tissue felt restricted and where adhesions had formed. Instead of just applying pressure, they used a combination of techniques to gradually release tension and improve movement. During the session they used several methods including hands-on manipulation, targeted work on fascia and soft tissue, and instrument techniques. They also used a wooden therapy tool and a small hammer-style instrument to help stimulate deeper tissue and loosen adhesions. It reminded me more of sports therapy, myofascial release, or chiropractic-style bodywork than a typical Thai massage. What I appreciated most was that the therapist seemed to understand the mechanics of the body and how tension in one area can affect movement elsewhere. The treatment was clearly adjusted based on what they found during the session rather than following a fixed routine. It’s obviously not a miracle cure, but I did leave with noticeably less pain and much better mobility than when I walked in. If you’re looking for therapeutic massage in Bangkok, especially something closer to structural bodywork, fascia work, adhesion release, or sports-style treatment rather than a simple spa massage, this place is definitely worth trying.
0x30e29c50a35fbf31_0xec5e11c75f0bd468.author: Rollo

0x30e29c50a35fbf31_0xec5e11c75f0bd468.text: I have had problems with my lower back for months on and off, and i tweeked my shoulders doing a workout at my hotel which is by the MBK mall. I went in to see if they could do a couple of adjustments and maybe massage the knots out and give my lower back some relief as well. They went through a whole process of adjustments and hitting pressure points, doing what we call in Canada, A.R.T…active release therapy, and they dug in deep with elbows into my shoulders and my lower back, and while it was a bit uncomfortable at times, its definitely needed and I felt quite relieved after the appointment. The lady doing my therapy also gave me a numbing spray and also gave me capsules to help with sleep and vision, they were so nice to me and went out of their way to make sure they did the best they could to help cause they could see I was suffering a bit from the back discomfort. If you are having deep muscle and tissue problems, I highly recommend coming here, its gonna be uncomfortable at times but this is seriously the only thing that has helped me in a long time and I do dry needling back home with massage/physio therapy as well. Its too bad I got to only see them once before I have to go back home. Located on the 6th floor. Well worth the money!

The odds seemed insurmountable. But they defied all expectations, accomplishing what felt like the impossible. 0x311d5fef28a1eb3b_0x909a2bb9e96e13f3.text: This was my first decision in 10 years to see a dentist because I had terrible wisdom tooth pain and needed to find a clinic to have them removed. I'm terrified of needles and anesthetic injections. People around me who have been to dentists say that only the anesthetic injection hurts, but I wanted a clinic where the injection wouldn't be painful. I looked at many reviews until I found this place. Almost 100% of the reviews said the anesthetic injection was painless, so I decided to come here. The first thing that impressed me was how lovely the staff and dentist were; they spoke so politely. The place was relaxing, like a cafe. The main point was that the dental check-up revealed I had four wisdom teeth, two above and two below. The dentist recommended removing them two at a time, which meant one would be extracted and the other would be surgically removed. I was terrified because I'd heard from people who had had them removed elsewhere that even just one tooth would cause excruciating pain and make it impossible to eat. They recommended removing them one at a time because removing both at once would be incredibly painful. But I decided to have both removed at once. On the day of the procedure, I was excited, scared, and couldn't sleep. First, the anesthetic injection was painless; I didn't feel anything at all. Pain score: 0/10. The dentist had a very light touch. I only felt something when they were probably prying or extracting the tooth with the instruments. But the doctor always tells you when you might feel pain or not, so don't worry. After the procedure, I bit on the gauze for 2 hours and felt a throbbing sensation, starting to feel like it might hurt. Once the gauze was removed, I took just one paracetamol tablet and slept. When I woke up, I didn't feel any pain at all! I ate soft foods for about a day, then ate normally until the stitches were removed, and I didn't feel any pain at all. My cheek was slightly swollen, but you wouldn't notice it unless you looked closely. For anyone who is afraid of wisdom tooth extraction or afraid of needles like me, I highly recommend coming here. It's great! ✨🫶🏻
0x311d5fef28a1eb3b_0x909a2bb9e96e13f3.author: Praweena Chanchompoo

0x311d5fef28a1eb3b_0x909a2bb9e96e13f3.text: Review of my experience getting a dental scaling treatment from someone with receding gums who was afraid of scaling because of the sensitivity that might be more severe than others. I had to change clinics every year because I hadn't found one that met my needs. I saw this clinic because it's near my house and I drive past it regularly. The place is beautiful, like a cafe. I thought the service must be very expensive. I searched on Google and found only good customer reviews, so I decided to try it. On the day of my dental scaling appointment, this was the first place that came to mind. I was impressed from the moment I messaged them; their responses reduced my anxiety and made me feel welcome. My next impression was the service and the respect they showed. No matter how shabbily I was dressed, everyone at the clinic smiled and provided excellent service. Dr. Ae was very kind and understood my concerns. I requested local anesthesia because of a bad experience before. Dr. Ae only injected anesthetic into my lower teeth where gums were severely receding, showing how gentle and patient she is. She carefully inserted the needle and administered the anesthetic; I didn't feel any pain. Even when scaling my upper teeth, which weren't anesthetized, I didn't experience any sensitivity, whereas before I would repeatedly stop the doctor because I couldn't bear the pain. Dr. Ae's assistant was also very attentive. I didn't choke on the water at all. (I always choke when I get teeth cleaned elsewhere.) The doctor was polite, kind, and patient. The doctor said he's a dental implant surgeon and doesn't do scaling anywhere else; he only does it for clients at his own clinic. He also wanted to create a clinic for people who are afraid of dental procedures. I feel very lucky to have met him; it erased my negative memories from previous teeth cleaning experiences. As for the price, which I was worried about being unaffordable, it's the normal price for a private clinic, and I can use my social security insurance. In short, I was very impressed. 0x30e2981f517139c3_0xd8651e425a6cc12e.text: I am the administrator of Khwanjai Dental Clinic. I would like to use this space to clarify your review, kan saibua. If only the crown had come loose, we would guarantee to reattach it free of charge. However, in this case, not only was the crown loose, but the post was also missing. Therefore, a new post had to be made, and there was only the cost of the new post itself. (The dentist also gave a discount out of consideration for the patient.) The crown reattachment was done free of charge, as per our guarantee. Allow me to use an analogy to illustrate further: Imagine buying a new mobile phone. After using it for a while, it gets bumped, and the phone case comes off (comparable to the crown coming loose). You can't put the case back on yourself, so you take it to a shop. When the technician inspects the phone, they find that the battery is missing (comparable to the post). The shop recommends buying a new battery and installing it before putting the case back on. They also give you a discount because you've purchased multiple phones from them. Then, the technician installs the new battery and case, and you only pay for the new battery, not the service fee for reattaching the case. That's a similar scenario. ^^ P.S. This applies to cases where the crown has come loose. Our clinic guarantees free crown placement for 6 months from the date of crown placement. In fact, our dentists are often generous enough to extend the guarantee to 1 year. If the crown comes loose after the warranty period has expired, there will be a charge of 500-800 baht for crown placement.

0x30502fe8c894dbcb_0xfcf080b0fc7e34ed.text: I’m shocked that there are only 5 reviews here. I can honestly say that this service is one of the best investments I’ve ever made in my life. (USA) If you come to this area of Phuket you probably have fitness goals, and you may get advice from influencers or whatever on social media and YouTube on how to get the results you want with your fitness and body, but our bodies are different and unique, what one person may need to reach a similar goal as yours may be completely different than you need (calories, macros, specific workout routine etc.) so by following the advice of what works for one person may leave you spinning your wheels and getting no where, it’s very frustrating. So because our bodies are different and unique, we need something customized to our needs if we are going to reach our fitness goals without wasting precious time we can’t get back. That’s what this service gives you, one on one time with a professional who will analyze your body with the best equipment available and break everything down to you so you can understand it and move forward. If you are serious about your health, don’t skip this. It’s worth every baht, dollar or whatever, you came all this way to change for the better and I can’t think of a better way to start than here. 0x30e29ed26abee065_0x8594f2e6103372b7.text: One of the most wonderful clinics I have visited in Bangkok so far has to be Central Clinic that is located in the most ideal location in Bangkok, especially if you are a tourist since Siam Square One is in the vicinity of popular touristic spots such as Siam Paragon Mall and is right next to the Siam BTS Sky train station. Central Clinic is definitely one of the finer clinics in the city which goes above and beyond to serve its patients from the moment they enter the clinic! The staff is so friendly and accommodating and clearly explained the entire process step by step and also offered some refreshments with snacks! I was thoroughly impressed by their organization and ability to work so smoothly to deal with every patient, foreign or local. I think it is very important to research well when it comes to clinics in Bangkok so if you’re looking for a good place, this is definitely one to check out! I went for their HIFU treatment for the face and also to get their YAG Laser done on the elbows to lighten some discoloration. I also received a relaxing and beneficial facial treatment that really improved the appearance of my skin and removed any discoloration/sunburn that was there as well. If you’re a tourist in Thailand, this is something you can definitely benefit from before heading back home as well! The staff is very helpful and you can ask them about the treatments during your visit and they’ll address everything very nicely for you! The doctor was extremely knowledgeable and understanding when I spoke about my expectations from the HIFU treatment and where exactly I needed it (Jaw and Neck area specifically). You’ll definitely not have any issue in communication since the doctor along with the staff know English quite well. They made sure that I wasn’t feeling any pain during the treatment as well and had applied general anaesthesia to the area beforehand as well which was great since I have done the HIFU treatment before as well and sometimes it does feel painful because of the anaesthesia not being enough time to fully work on the targeted area. I really appreciated how they all worked together to make sure that I was comfortable throughout the treatments! I was informed about all the possible symptoms and also post-treatment care for better results in the form of a small pamphlet which is an extra step that I haven’t seen many clinics doing so I really liked that too! It’s been a month since I have been to the clinic and can really see visible results from both the laser and the HIFU. My elbows are visibly even-toned and the discoloration has really subsided plus the HIFU has really improved the structure of my face and helped slim it out in the way I had hoped for. Overall, I’d highly recommend this clinic for their excellent service, wide variety of services and great follow-up procedures as well where they make sure to be in constant contact with the patients after they have completed a treatment and they made sure that I shared any symptoms I had later on and even advised me how to correct them easily!

0x30e29fac0e11e9b3_0x47e1dc3b8fb95c05.text: I wanted to write a review because I was so impressed with the service. The reception staff and employees were very polite and provided excellent service with a high level of service mind. Everything was truly excellent. The clinic is beautifully decorated, giving a relaxing spa-like feel that greatly reduced my fear of the procedure. The treatment rooms, restrooms, and cleanliness standards are on par with a hotel. Everything was convenient and comfortable. The location is excellent, conveniently accessible via the Phloen Chit BTS station. It's located next to the Four Points Hotel BTS Phloen Chit, accessible from both the side alley and the hotel itself. If you park in the hotel, take the elevator to the lobby. From the lobby, walk towards the bar, and there's a side exit; open it, and you'll find the clinic on your right – no need to walk outside. I decided to have my first Ulthera treatment here because I was confident in the quality of the equipment and the doctor's professionalism, based on my consultation before the treatment. The results were excellent; it wasn't as painful as I expected. I could feel the meticulous attention to detail and care from the doctor and the entire team. I want to support such a high-quality, honest clinic. For anyone looking for a clinic, I highly recommend this one. Try scheduling a free consultation with the doctor before deciding. The prices are standard; while it looks luxurious, they aren't more expensive than other places, and not suspiciously cheap either. They don't push unnecessary things. From someone who consulted at many places, I finally chose this clinic from the very first meeting with the doctor. I had the consultation and then proceeded with the procedure right away, and I'm truly not disappointed. Thank you so much to the doctor and the team for taking such good care of me.

0x30e29f421401cb9b_0x275ab29bbacc81c9.text: Highly recommend this clinic. We were traveling in Bangkok and had raw shrimp in the evening. Since it was already after 9 PM, most clinics were closed, and this was one of the few places still open, so we came here immediately. Dr. Pungkava Sricharoen was extremely professional, careful, and patient. He measured my brother’s vital signs thoroughly, examined his symptoms in detail, and provided immediate treatment with injections. After the treatment, he also asked my brother to stay for observation to make sure his condition had improved before allowing him to leave. I am writing this review about 40 minutes after my brother received treatment, and most of his symptoms have already disappeared. We are truly grateful for the doctor’s professionalism, kindness, and excellent care. This is a very reliable clinic, especially for travelers who need urgent medical help in Bangkok.

As someone who doesn't speak English or Thai, I was very anxious about my first treatment abroad, but the Japanese staff provided excellent support, which was very reassuring. Sylfirm is a machine that pricks your face with needles, so I wondered if it would be painful... but they took their time applying the anesthetic cream, so there was absolutely no pain. There was also a cooling mask for downtime, so by the time I left, there was almost no redness. On my way out, I bought AC cream and AHA cream and received a cute drawstring bag with a reindeer pattern!

0x30e29f7e394e33bb_0x2231316e9ec2b16b.text: I'm constantly creating content, often outdoors: in the sun, in the water… As a result, my skin got a deep tan, not just on my face but all over. But let's be honest, my face is what I use the most. Even with makeup, you could see my skin looked dull and tired… 🥹 Before the treatment, my skin was dry and dull from the sun (especially the day I wore the pink Thai outfit). Then a friend recommended I go to Labelle for a Hydra Facial. Honestly, the price is super reasonable (4990), as I've found it more expensive elsewhere, and I could see all the impurities coming off my skin 😳 dead skin cells, blackheads, clogged pores… everything just washed away with the water. What I loved was that before applying the vitamins, there's a deep cleansing. So, the skin really absorbs everything thoroughly. The team and the doctor are lovely 🥰 For those who need a quick glow, I also recommend asking for the Skin Booster as an add-on. You can contact the clinic directly for advice and pricing. The result? From the very same day, my skin was much more hydrated, radiant, with a more even complexion, and my blemishes and acne marks were diminished. The difference is clearly visible between the day I wore the silver Thai outfit and the day of the Louis Vuitton photoshoot (the same day!). My makeup stayed perfectly in place, and my skin was glowing. And a week later, at a hotel event, everyone complimented my skin 🥹 I even have a makeup-free photo taken in my room. My skin is still tanned, but it's so much more hydrated, soft, and luminous, as if it had been plumped up. Thank you so much, Labelle 💖 I'm truly impressed. For those who need to get in top shape quickly, like me... I 100% recommend it! I'll definitely be back 🤗✨

Get a queue number. 2. Wait to be contacted by staff downstairs before going up to the second floor. 3. Present your queue number at the registration counter. 4. Weigh yourself, measure your height and proportions, have your temperature and blood pressure checked. 5. Wait to be called to your examination room. 6. Enter the examination room. Overall, the staff provided good service.

0x30da3b04e1660925_0x144172fec11615ed.text: If possible, I would rate Dr. Tanyathorn Teeranoraseth higher than 5 stars. I had been unable to smell and taste for more than a year due to benign polyps in my nasal cavity. Dr. Tanyathorn saw me on short notice, CT scans confirmed the presence of the polyps, and she led the surgical team that removed the polyps. What should have been a 1-2 hour surgery took over 5 hours because Dr. Tanyathorn discovered numerous additional polyps in my sinus cavities. She expertly removed all the polyps, and also fixed my deviated septum. Over the following three weeks, I had three follow-up appointments with Dr. Tanyathorn. She answered my questions (in excellent English), explained to me approximate timelines for recovery, and carefully removed scabs, clots, and fibrin. I felt slightly embarrassed to see some of the stuff Dr. Tanyathorn was pulling out of my nasal passages, but she just said, “It’s okay, it’s my job!” To say I feel relief would be an understatement. My nasal passages feel clearer than they ever have, and I’m so grateful to Dr. Tanyathorn for helping improve my quality of life. She explained that the first month would be the toughest, and I’m at three weeks post-op today. I started to regain my senses of smell/taste a few nights ago, and while not 100% yet, it’s better than the 0% I’ve had for the last year. I had my last follow up appointment with Dr. Tanyathorn, then went to the Saturday Walking Street. I felt like I was being led by my nose: meats grilling, waffles baking, durian on display, incense burning, perfume … After not being able to smell for a year, I felt overjoyed to remember what it was like. If you are suffering from any ENT (ear/nose/throat) issue(s), especially sinus, I would highly recommend Dr. Tanyathorn without hesitation. She is kind, professional, communicative, and a subject matter expert in sinus-related issues. Thank you for massively improving my life, Dr. Tanyathorn! Khup khun mach, khup! 🙂
0x30da3b04e1660925_0x144172fec11615ed.author: Dominic Alexander

0x30da3b04e1660925_0x144172fec11615ed.text: When you’re in a foreign country and something bad happens - things can get scary very quickly. So if you’re in Chiang Mai with a ENT issue… This is your place. My partner and I came here on holiday when we had a freak accident during an underwater activity in Pattaya. My partner’s ears were compromised and we were absolutely shook. Dr. Chaiwat answered the phone a little before opening hours and let us know that we could walk-in. His patience, understanding and generosity to carefully listen and help a frantic Korean couple (us) meant a lot! Of course, his expertise and communication skills in not only diagnosing but meticulously explaining why and what has happened was truly impressive and appreciated. My partner’s ears were bloody from ear barotrauma due to a sudden change in pressure. Thereafter, we left with solutions and hope for recovery with appropriate medicine and medical advice. On the taxi back to our hotel, my partner and I discussed how not even in Australia nor South Korea could you find such a doctor who would hear out all of your questions and thoroughly answer them with a such a sincere heart. He is truly leading and outshining the new generation of healthcare professionals in Thailand + yonder. Thank you again Doctor and we wish you all the best!

While visiting the people, he saw villagers making pottery in the shape of a frog with its hand covering its chin, as if someone had a toothache. He asked to buy the frog. Upon returning to his residence, he radioed one of his personal dentists to send a patient with a toothache for treatment. The dentist eagerly awaited the patient. Later, it turned out that the dentist received a special patient in the form of a pottery frog as a gift. 0x30e29f6a08247aa1_0xd30bf36503e2a34f.text: I had laser mole removal at Agafar Medical Clinic and was very impressed. The staff gave detailed advice, provided excellent care, and the doctor was kind and didn't push unnecessary package deals. I've had about 1-2 sessions already, so I wanted to share my real experience because I feel the results are significantly different from other places I've been to. From the first visit, the procedure and aftercare were explained straightforwardly. There might be a short wait during busy periods, but overall, the process is well-organized and not rushed. During the procedure, you'll feel a slight warmth or tingling sensation, which is normal with laser treatment. However, the staff constantly checks on you and adjusts the intensity, making it tolerable. The treatment feels very thorough, not just a quick, superficial job. Another thing I liked is the all-inclusive package for unlimited mole removal on the face and neck, making it very cost-effective. Overall, I'm impressed with both the results and the service. If you're looking for a laser mole removal clinic near Siam Square One, I highly recommend this place!

0x30da3a9fdf6eb275_0x6a6a54a132bf1f30.text: Review of Dr. Woraphot's Dental Clinic (Treatment with Dr. Beam) I recently had my lower wisdom tooth extracted and my upper wisdom tooth removed by Dr. Beam today. I must say, I was very impressed. From the moment I walked in until the procedure was complete, it was an unexpectedly positive wisdom tooth extraction experience. Dr. Beam explained every step in detail, clearly, and in an easy-to-understand way, from reviewing the X-rays and analyzing the wisdom tooth's position to the various risks involved (I am 33 years old and have diabetes, and the doctor gave very careful advice). Before the surgery, the doctor checked my blood pressure, explained everything calmly, and told me exactly what he was going to do next, which made me feel very comfortable and not anxious at all. He injected the anesthetic twice to ensure complete numbness. The first injection was enough, but the doctor was so attentive that he even wanted my lips to be numb for added comfort during the surgery. Once the surgery began… I must say, the doctor's touch was incredibly gentle. My lower wisdom tooth was also "lying" (intermittently), but it took less than 10 minutes. Afterward, the doctor asked if I wanted to have it extracted completely, which I agreed to. The upper wisdom tooth took less than a minute to complete. The doctor spoke to me throughout the procedure. “You’ll hear a loud sound here.” “You’ll feel a slight push here.” “Just a little more. Excellent!” The feeling was great. It was like the doctor was perfectly timed and meticulous. After the procedure, Dr. Beam gave a very detailed post-operative instruction summary. He also provided gauze, medication, and scheduled an appointment for suture removal. Regarding the price, I think it was very fair. X-ray: 500 baht Lower wisdom tooth extraction + upper wisdom tooth extraction: 3,700 baht (including suture removal) Medication cost: 40 baht Overall, it was very worthwhile considering the meticulous work and care received. For anyone who is afraid of dentists, afraid of pain, or has had bad wisdom tooth extractions before, I highly recommend Dr. Beam. He’s gentle, kind, explains things well, works quickly, does a great job, and is very safe. ⭐ I left feeling, “I’m so glad I came here.” Truly impressed! 🙏💚
0x30da3a9fdf6eb275_0x6a6a54a132bf1f30.author: Tanpasut Kit.

0x30da3aaf60f92399_0xa79fc9b940d648a2.text: I had researched breast augmentation at many places, and most reviews mentioned pain and the need for drainage tubes for 2-3 days after surgery, which made me very hesitant. On the day of the surgery, the team took excellent care of me, and the atmosphere was relaxed. After waking up, I felt less pain than I expected, and most importantly, the scar is very small, almost invisible. As weeks pass, it blends seamlessly with the skin, making it almost impossible to tell I ever had surgery. I recovered almost normally in just a few days, without the worry of drainage tubes or discomfort I experienced with the traditional method. Now my breasts have settled beautifully and look natural. I feel much more confident wearing any type of clothing. When I wear a swimsuit or tank top, no one notices that I've ever had surgery. What impressed me most was the doctor and the team's attention to detail in every aspect, from planning, size, and silicone selection to post-operative follow-up. Every step made me feel safe and confident that the results would be excellent. If you're hesitant because you're afraid of pain, a long recovery period, or concerns about scarring, I highly recommend this clinic. 0x3050318767080131_0xfc0fa098afa1d884.text: I recently had the pleasure of visiting this new dental clinic in Phuket, and I must say, it exceeded all my expectations. From the moment I walked in, I was greeted with warmth, and the modern, comfortable, and impeccably clean interior immediately put me at ease. The dentist, who also happens to be the owner, was incredibly friendly and took the time to explain every step of the teeth whitening procedure to me, as it was my first time. Before starting, he recommended a thorough teeth cleaning for optimal results, which turned out to be the most gentle and thorough cleaning I've ever experienced. For someone who's usually apprehensive about dental visits, I can confidently say that this clinic is perfect for anyone with dental anxiety. Throughout the whitening procedure, the staff stayed by my side, constantly checking on my comfort level. When I experienced discomfort in my neck, they promptly offered a pillow for support. Moreover, when the treatment became too uncomfortable for me, the dentist acted swiftly to end it, ensuring my well-being was the top priority. Although I experienced some discomfort (commonly referred to as zingers) for a day following the treatment, I found that doing it in the evening after a substantial meal helped, and by the next day, I felt much better. The results were remarkable, and all my friends noticed the difference in my teeth – a testament to the clinic's expertise and care. I wholeheartedly recommend this place to anyone seeking professional dental care in Phuket. It's rare to find such a combination of modern facilities, skilled professionals, and genuine concern for patients' comfort and well-being.
