0x30e29f7d05adb82b_0xe1ac2143b0b4f3fe.text: Through a referral from a Thai hair transplant service in Japan, I underwent a no-shave, 2500-graft FUE hair transplant at HAIR RESTORE BY DHT CLINIC during the May holidays. DHT CLINIC was a clean and comfortable clinic. The medical questionnaire was in English, and another male patient was also there, and they kindly explained everything to me, allowing me to undergo the surgery. Thank you so much. While Japanese anesthesia can be painful, DHT CLINIC administered the anesthetic after cooling the area, so there was no pain during graft harvesting and implantation, which was reassuring. During the surgery, there were breaks, and I was given khao man gai, snacks, juice, and bottled water each time. During the surgery, I was kindly allowed to use the restroom about five times, showing consideration for the burden and pain of the surgery. A nurse gave me a full-body massage. Despite the burden of the surgery and my hands being sore from the massage, their kindness and consideration allowed me to undergo the surgery with peace of mind. Thank you so much. The following day, the aftercare was very warm, and the massage nurse kindly lent me a portable fan. Despite it being a day off, they provided kind, gentle, and thorough treatment and explained everything in translation. I had two unsatisfactory hair transplant surgeries in Japan, but at DHT CLINIC, I was able to recover from those two failures with their state-of-the-art hair transplant surgery. I believe that if I had chosen DHT CLINIC from the beginning, the grafts wouldn't have been wasted. They also showed concern for my post-operative progress, and I receive monthly post-operative photos. To everyone at HAIR RESTORE BY DHT CLINIC: You welcomed me, a foreigner, with a smile, and provided kind, gentle, and thorough care. The pain and downtime were minimized, and I was able to receive state-of-the-art hair transplant surgery with great satisfaction and peace of mind before returning home. Thank you so much.

0x30e29f7d05adb82b_0xe1ac2143b0b4f3fe.text: This was my second time getting an FUE surgery. The first time, I had it done elsewhere, and sadly, the result did not meet my expectations. Although she is still young and has less experience in the hair transplant field, a quick search reveals she has won many awards in this area. Dr. Ramida is actually a student of Dr. Pathovamich. Impressively, Dr. Ramida is the first Thai to achieve the rank of number one in the world in the field of hair transplantation. My whole experience, from consultation to the transplant, was perfect. All of the staff were very generous. After the surgery, one staff member (sorry, I forgot the name) even walked me to my hotel. I was able to sleep through most of the procedure as there was no pain (the first time I had it done elsewhere, it was very painful). I just got the transplant yesterday, so I can't comment on the results yet, but I have a very good feeling it will turn out well this time. I asked the staff why they don't have many reviews on Google, and she told me that they are a branch of the DHT clinic and they just opened about a year ago. I think Dr. Ramida will become well-known in this field very soon. I am glad that I was able to get it done by her.

0x305031fee0e5c4ff_0x5d28a49d08e01bb4.text: It's difficult to share my experience as a guide and encouragement for doctors. The picture is from breast augmentation done 10 days ago by Dr. Kob Naruephon. I decided to have it done here because a clinic I used recommended him. We consulted, agreed on the price, and decided to use Motiva Ekinmonic silicone with an embedded chip, the top model at the clinic, because I liked how soft and natural the silicone was. Personally, I wanted my breast augmentation to look natural. On the day of the surgery, I arrived as scheduled at 9:00 AM. The doctor gave me one pill to relax me (I heard some places require nine pills!). The surgery was at 10:00 AM. I have to say, the anesthesiologist was very skilled and professional. I think other women should also be aware of this. With over 20 years of experience, the doctor explained what to expect, talking to me and gently stroking my arm to keep me calm. Importantly, this clinic uses a scarless technique – no stitches, just grafts. You can get it wet immediately; no need to wait weeks. I woke up looking great. I don't know if others experienced this, but I woke up without dizziness or pain. I thought, "Okay, day two is going to be tough." Day two arrived, though slightly painful because I was wearing a tight bra and couldn't lie flat properly (initially I had to lie with my head elevated at 45 degrees). I took one pill and it was fine. Day three was very relaxed; I didn't need anyone to help me get up, sit up, or shower because there was no pain, just some stiffness. On day three, I went to the beach. On day 4, I ate out. On day 5, I drove because I didn't feel any pain at all. I didn't see the point in staying home. On day 6, I went to work and drove comfortably. The doctor wasn't worried at all about this case. The doctor said I could start exercising in a week, like walking or cycling. Weightlifting should wait 3-4 weeks. Things to avoid: alcohol, beer, cigarettes, and fermented/pickled foods. (I drink alcohol, but don't try this yourself! Everyone's body is different. I didn't experience any pain.) I'll end it here for now. "Being run over by a truck" is a myth. Implantable contraception is much more painful, I'm telling you!

0x30502e29179da9ed_0x62d43c85b4aee144.text: Everything from the moment you’re getting into the ER reception area to the moment you’re leaving the hospital - is great. First, what I would like to highlight is that - receptionist / nurses/ doctors/ pharmacists - all of them can speak decent English. As for the expat, who can’t speak Thai - this is really important part. After taking the first registration- the receptionist informed me, that as a Thailand resident I can use my social security number and be taking care for basically as local Thai person - one more star goes here as well. After that - Doc’s consultation/ explanation/ prescription took a little while, but ! - everyone actually knew what they were doing and I didn’t have to use a translator even once. Since I got there, till the moment I could leave was 1,5 hours gap ( but then again, it was a live-queue, so no complaints here) In the end - the pharmacist-lady gave me detailed instructions about the drug, which doctor prescribed and even told me everything about the drug ( what can I mix it with, what group of drugs it comes from, how exactly it works etc) Now, I know, that it is probably should be a bare minimum in hospitals all around the globe, but when you live in Asia for a while, you know, that sometimes language barrier accures, or else ( who knows- you know), anyhow, getting everything done and feeling taking are of - matters. Last, but not least - not that pricy as Bangkok Hospital- so 5 well-deserved stars 🌟

0x30502e29179da9ed_0x62d43c85b4aee144.text: While on vacation in phukhet our infant granddaughter [less than 1 yr] got sick with high fever. In addition it was not expensive. They accept international medical insurance but you need pre approval email sent to them. Also what was interesting was the thoroughness and professionalism of the Dr. She asked for blood sample to check if the infant had influenza or infection. Then she recommended appropriate treatment which was effective. Thank God. Total time spent at hospital was 3 hrs which could have been improved. There is a need to improve the process. We had to remind the nurse station all the time otherwise we could have been forgotten. By the way there is a Muslim prayer room which is a bonus to us and also a reasonably priced coffee shop. However the CAFETERIA is extremely bad. Overall the Dibuk hospital in Phukhet is recommended

0x30e29e83cd1efdff_0x9118cd8fd1563fbe.text: I've been coming to see a doctor here since high school, and it's been 25 years now, and I'm still coming regularly. Today, I went to see a doctor with flu symptoms. Usually, I can recover by self-medicating, but this time, after taking medicine for 4 days, it didn't go away, so I decided to see a doctor and get a medical certificate. While they were taking my blood pressure, they asked what I needed the certificate for. I said I needed it to confirm to my workplace that I was genuinely sick—I'm working from home, I just can't go to the office. I've been sick for 4 days. The nurse said they couldn't issue it retroactively and spoke in a tone as if I was asking for a certificate to use for something bad. I said okay, I was just explaining that I'd been sick for 4 days. After that, they told me to sort out the medical certificate with the doctor myself. I said okay. When I went to see the doctor, I explained my symptoms. The doctor's question was, "Why did you wait 4 days before coming to see me? Why didn't you come on the first day?" Well, I didn't think it was a fever, I thought it was just a common cold with medicine, which would go away with normal medication. I hardly ever come to see a doctor. Then the doctor examined me superficially and said the medical certificate only covered today's sick leave. But the point is, I didn't take any leave! I was working from home when I developed a fever. Then they said okay, they'd prescribe some medicine. In the end, when I checked later, they gave me everything except cold medicine, because the doctor focused too much on the medical certificate. It made me forget what illnesses the patients had or what questions needed to be asked. In the end, I had to go back to the pharmacy to buy more medicine. My whole family is done with them, we're never using them again. 😡👎👎👎 ----------------------------------------- Update: After reporting the issue, the clinic called to inquire and ask for permission to provide services again, and they offered complimentary items and discounts on some tests. Personally, I'm okay with that and will return for their services because their intentions were good and I want to continue using their services. Regarding the things that weren't okay, the clinic promised to improve, which I completely agree with, because I've used their services hundreds of times. 👍
0x30e29e83cd1efdff_0x9118cd8fd1563fbe.author: Rassarin Buaprasert

0x30502f85faa2d047_0x669e3086d969b67f.text: I ran in a marathon last year. I really injured my knee. I had an MRI. The doctor told me I couldn't exercise. I was very skeptical when herbs were put on my knee and set on fire. It looked really cool, but I didn't see how it could help. But guess what? IT DID. It's not just ONE treatment and you're fixed, but the Thai Traditional doctors have a diagnosis process that is far more personal and attentive than when you visit a hospital. They use different techniques to identify problem areas. They actually know what they are doing with their hands. They don't just press in one or two spots and make a diagnosis. They really check everywhere. Now, after several weeks of treatments, my knee is starting to feel better. I can actually walk down stairs without being in pain. I'm undergoing treatment for another issue now that has bothered me for YEARS and Choojai Clinic is the first place that has made any progress. I'd give them 6 stars if I could. It changed my life.

0x30e299980a45da1b_0x9df73981d6f050e6.text: It's a small dermatology clinic. The waiting area is quite limited, but the place is clean. The doctor is a specialist in dermatology. The staff provides good service. I brought my mother to have skin tags removed from her face with a CO2 laser. There was one large tag and several smaller ones. The doctor estimated a flat rate of 15,000 baht for the entire face (excluding the neck). After the procedure, we received: * 2 tubes of ointment for the wounds * 1 tube of anti-inflammatory cream * 1 tube of cream to reduce dark spots * 1 tube of moisturizing cream Additional medication and doctor's fees were 1,240 baht. Total initial payment: 16,240 baht. The price is quite high, but we chose to have it done because the doctor is a specialist and it's conveniently located near our home. There was a follow-up appointment in about 1 month. The doctor informed us that post-laser hyperpigmentation could be treated with additional laser treatments. However, if there's no rush, you can continue applying the cream for about 3-6 months to gradually fade the scar. My mother chose to continue applying the cream first. The second time, there was an additional cost of 440 baht for medication and an additional 300 baht for follow-up and doctor's fees. I've reviewed the costs and procedures in case it's helpful information for those who are making a decision. A point I'd like to see improved is the documentation of expenses. After paying both times, we did not receive a receipt or a summary of the treatment costs. Issuing such documentation would help patients understand the details of the expenses more clearly. Additional note: The clinic now provides complimentary drinking water while waiting.

0x30e2990011bbf78d_0xc300c6fe384a52a1.text: I want to say what a wonderful experience I had over the past couple of days with the team at Quora Medical Wellness located in the lobby of the Bangkok Peninsula Hotel. Coming from the states and being treated by doctors in the US I came in with a preconceived notion of what I was looking for. I had just taken a comprehensive blood test as part of my US quarterly regime and forwarded it on for the Quora doctor's review. I was staying at the Peninsula Hotel so for me access was a piece of cake. At the time of my appointment, I was met there by three wonderful young women: the manager, the nurse and an assistant speaking the Queens English. Each of these young women was smartly dressed and professional. All were extremely attentive and kind. I was escorted into meet the doctor who is extremely qualified and professional. When I told him the injection medication I was looking for he politely questioned my choice. Then of course he asked the right question which was what am I trying to accomplish. He explained why what I was asking for was outdated and based on the issues I presented the alternatives seem much more in line than what I had asked for. Again believe it or not when it comes to wellness and longevity East Asia has us beat. I proceeded with one of the drip intravenous treatments and a different hormone compound than the one I was seeking. Looking at the medical Journal graphs and other information I was presented the injection I would receive should be more potent for a longer period of time than what I have been taking and what I had asked for. Following each procedure I was given time to relax, offered tea and stacks and enjoyable conversation. I cannot recommend this group more as they are not only extremely kind and gentle but very competent as well. I had little pain from the glute injection and no mark from the IV. Throughout the entire time the young women were kind, gentle and caring. Certainly something that is lacking in the medical offices where I come from. I would not hesitate to wholeheartedly recommend this group and please take the time to explain your issues and what you're trying to accomplish and leave it up to them, these cutting edte professionals, to present a plan.

0x30da31f0826bfda5_0x3b37c6418ae3c9e9.text: I have had varicose veins and leg pain for 3-4 years, and the pain has been severe for about a month. I wanted to see Dr. Kittiphan for treatment. I started by researching and asking friends from Chiang Mai, and then contacted Dr. Kittiphan via Line to plan my trip. I received excellent responses, saving me travel time. I was able to check before leaving whether Dr. Kittiphan's clinic was open that day. I arrived at 5:15 PM. The housekeeper suggested I have something to eat first. The nurse arrived at 5:30 PM, and Dr. Kittiphan arrived at 6:30 PM. This allowed me to plan everything. Upon examination, Dr. Kittiphan, with his high level of expertise, found an abnormality and scheduled surgery for the next day. He explained the treatment plan, including laser and radiofrequency treatments, including saline and cooling treatments, and inquired about my insurance coverage. We decided to have surgery at the Sri Phaphat Building. The surgery didn't take long; I was able to get out of bed and practice walking in the recovery room soon after. There was no pain or swelling. No pain, no swelling, no bruising. Dr. Kittiphan explained how to behave and basic first aid if any abnormalities occurred. The treatment exceeded expectations because there was no pain at all. I rested overnight without any pain or wounds. The room was comfortable and clean. The next day, the doctor visited, and I was able to go home and have a follow-up appointment in one week. The doctor also recommended that I bring my mother for a check-up. I was very impressed. The doctor provided close care, explained things thoroughly, and gave excellent advice. This treatment felt like receiving care from a family member, truly cared for with all their heart. Thank you to all the team members, and my deepest gratitude to Dr. Kittiphan. The pain is gone, the swelling in my leg has significantly decreased, and I can walk normally now!

0x30e29f3133d6c9ef_0x7c0792b7f43cbc94.text: This was my first time getting Sculptra injections with Dr. Gift here. I've had it done elsewhere twice before, and I remember it being very painful and causing extreme swelling. I read reviews beforehand saying Dr. Gift has a gentle touch. I booked through Line, and the admin service was excellent and responsive. The clinic staff were also very welcoming. I booked for 1:30 PM but didn't get the injection until almost 4:00 PM. The wait was extremely long, so I'm deducting one star for that. I was very impressed with Dr. Gift's kind demeanor. The injection itself was minimally painful; normally, local anesthetic makes me sting and tear up, but this time it didn't. The doctor constantly asked if anything hurt, showing great care for the patient. It's much better than my previous experience where the doctor rushed and had a heavy hand. 0x3054f6521da4919f_0x63e1b8b1f6f0d43a.text: I couldn't equalize after landing and could barely hear the entire day of my arrival. I then called the clinic at 4:55 p.m. and immediately got an appointment for the next morning at 9:30 a.m. The clinic looks a bit unusual by European standards, but everyone was wearing masks and gloves, and the doctor disinfected all instruments during treatment. So I have no concerns about hygiene. The young receptionists are very friendly and speak good English. After they briefly took my medical history and measured my blood pressure, I was immediately allowed to sit down in the examination room. The doctor came right after and asked me about my problems. I told him my ear was blocked and I would like to have my ear canals cleaned. He did that and then examined my ears and nose with an electronic otoscope. His diagnosis: incipient middle ear infection. He then gave me helpful tips for everyday life, how to prevent it, performed a nasal irrigation, and administered medication. I got all of that (shower, 2 sprays, drops, antibiotics, effervescent tablets) along with silicone earplugs for swimming. Those helpful and pleasant 20 minutes cost me 3,300 baht. I can't understand all the complainers here. The travel insurance covers the costs anyway. If you don't have any, you've probably taken the risk knowingly... Especially since 3,300 baht for competent medical treatment + medication is affordable from a "Western perspective.
0x3054f6521da4919f_0x63e1b8b1f6f0d43a.author: Sebastian Lerf

0x3054f6521da4919f_0x63e1b8b1f6f0d43a.text: I visited Dr Ning due to stuck water in my right ear. The diagnosis was fast and clear - I had a little opening in my eardrum and a very little infection - which wasn't too serious. She cleaned my ear using some sort of specifically designed "vacuum cleaner" to prevent the infection of spreading and gave me some antibiotics that I was supposed to take for 7 days. Although I still couldn't hear properly - she basically did the best thing there was to do at that time. I am now back in Germany and visited a local doctor here and he gave me another appointment for upcoming Friday and said that Dr Ning did everything in a correct manner and that the hole will probably grow back together on its own... so I am now on supervision. I payed 2100 Baht for the antibiotics and the whole treatment which seems very fair to me - I will try to get the money back from my insurance here in Germany. Thank you DR Ning for treating me!

0x30e29e92adfc3ad5_0x70d1b1f27e586311.text: Dr. Chidchanok is an amazing orthodontist! I found her through a social media review. After receiving treatment, I found her to be truly skilled and caring. I was impressed from the consultation. I had consulted with 7-8 other orthodontists, and none of them had a treatment plan like Dr. Chidchanok's. Some said traditional braces weren't possible and only Brius or clear aligners were suitable. But Dr. Chidchanok suggested that traditional braces were possible for my case because of her excellent treatment planning skills. Importantly, she wasn't pushy at all. I felt like I saw a ray of hope when I started treatment with her. The price wasn't exorbitant at all; it was even lower than I expected, considering she's a specialist in orthodontics. I thought it would be very expensive, but it wasn't. She gave excellent advice, explained everything thoroughly, was gentle, patient, spoke kindly, answered all my questions in detail and directly, leaving no room for lingering doubts. She was incredibly respectful of her patients; she even apologized for being a few minutes late, something I've never experienced before. I'm so glad I found her. Thank you to the reviewer for sharing this information! If you're driving, convenient parking is available. I recommend parking at Fortune Town and walking over. It's not far and you don't need to cross the street. ***Update after 1 year of orthodontic treatment: My teeth are much better and much faster than before! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️*** After 1 year, my teeth are so well-aligned that I'm already very happy. The improvement is incredible. My previous orthodontic treatment took 4 years, and my teeth didn't progress as much as they did after just one year with this doctor. Regarding my scissor bite (3 pairs of teeth), I consulted with 10 clinics, and 8 said my case was very difficult and metal braces weren't possible. They said even if I did get metal braces, they weren't sure what the outcome would be, and it would likely take up to 8 years. They only recommended clear aligners or Brius. Only 2 clinics said metal braces were possible: a professor at Chulalongkorn University and Dr. Chidchanok at this clinic. I chose her because she explained the treatment plan very clearly, offered alternative treatment options, and answered all my questions from the first day of treatment until a year later. She's still exactly the same! My teeth are aligning very quickly. Other clinics said this problem was irresolvable or would take many years to fix (Fact: my previous treatment took 4 years, and my crooked teeth were still crooked). (Because the scissors bite problem couldn't be fixed at all) But the doctor managed to fix it within a year. My teeth are now perfectly aligned, and I can smile confidently. It might not be completely fixed yet, but the alignment of my teeth is significantly improved. I've made her my go-to dentist. I've recommended her to everyone I know, telling them to always consult Dr. Chidchanok first! You'll get a great opinion and she won't be pushy. Thank you for finding her, Dr. Chidchanok. It's one of the luckiest things in my life to have met such a good doctor. 🙏
0x30e29e92adfc3ad5_0x70d1b1f27e586311.author: Lalipons Kosuma

0x30e29e92adfc3ad5_0x70d1b1f27e586311.text: Before having my last wisdom tooth extracted (a prone tooth with a crooked root), I was so afraid of the pain that I endured it for almost twenty years. It grew to the size of my little fingertip 🥹 – huge! The root started causing pain in my cheek, and food particles constantly got stuck, forcing me to carry floss in my bag. Finally, while traveling abroad, I consulted a colleague about where to get it done. They recommended this clinic, saying it was minimally painful and healed quickly. I was skeptical, but I went anyway. They X-rayed the root and overall condition; it was prone to overlapping and the root was crooked. The doctor was incredibly skilled and quite young. He decided to grind the tooth into pieces and then carefully extracted it with forceps, instead of prying, to avoid further gum trauma and pain. The hole in my gum was exactly the same size as the tooth that was ground away, with a smooth, clean edge. It didn't look bruised or infected like I'd seen in Google posts. The sutures were neatly hidden and perfectly aligned with my jawline. Even after I could open my mouth, the scar looked incredibly well-made. I was so scared during the surgery, I almost had a meltdown. But after the procedure and the anesthetic wore off, there was a lot of pain for only about half an hour. Applying ice to my cheek quickly relieved the pain, and then there was no more pain at all. There was just a slight tightness from the stitches. Touching the wound with my tongue only caused a little ache. It didn't hurt at all; it was completely indifferent unless touched, which surprised me. This was a real wisdom tooth extraction! The only thing to watch out for is food particles getting into the tooth cavity. You have to either remove them or, like I did, use a children's syringe to inject saline into the cavity, and the food particles come out. It was so much fun! 🤣🥹 The wound healed quickly, in less than two weeks. The extraction was also very easy, just a smooth, slippery motion. I had eight more teeth filled right away. The dentist said these fillings would last almost two more years. I give this place a perfect ten out of ten. It was amazing!

I am a health consultant by nature and I researched the benefits of Stem cell therapy which all indications was very positive. I was introduced to the Vitaxcell owners who were very accommodating and extremely professional. My consultantion process with the leading Physician Dr Ann was enlightening and very informative about the entire proccess. Further to the ongoing arthritic pain I also suffered with errectile disfuctiion which further added to the declining quality of my life. I am now three months post stem cell therapy. My results are absolutely amazing. I am completely pain free for the first time in over 15 years. 0x30502fd066cf7e49_0x3a3c30375e3b75c5.text: Hi everyone! Today is our last day at this wonderful preschool, and I can't help but mention it. Honestly, the only thing we'll miss when we leave Phuket is this preschool. It's simply wonderful! We've been taking our daughter to Yana (the speech therapist and preschool director) since last May, for a year and three months now. At first, we took her to a speech therapist because as soon as we arrived, we immediately enrolled her in preschool (a different one at the time). Only then did we start looking for a speech therapist, since at three, our Eva barely spoke (well, maybe a little in her own language, but it was practically impossible to understand). Within a year, she started speaking fully, everyone understood her, and all that was left was to correct her speech impediment. But then, the preschool we attended ran out of children. Last year, they were there for a while in the summer, but this year, almost everyone went home for the summer, and Eva was left with only her four-year-old and a two-year-old girl, and that was it. It was a complete disaster, as they say. This happened literally at the end of May, a little less than three months had passed. We couldn't stand it anymore, and knowing that our favorite speech therapist, Yana, had a group of Eva's peers, we decided to ask them to join us for at least three months before leaving, so that Eva wouldn't be alone at the preschool. So, we changed preschools and were simply stunned by the conditions. Honestly, I still can't believe this is possible. There, we had to bring snacks and even bottled water with us because they only fed us once (they gave us some food in the morning, of course, some crumbs, but only one proper lunch). Here on the first day, Yana said, "Why did you bring anything with you?" We have everything here, we'll feed them four times.... Karl!!! Four times a day.... Oh my God, four times. I'm shocked. All the food is Russian, I started eating porridge because of it; I never ate it at home before, but they taught me here. There's always compote, soups, everything Russian. It's simply amazing. Besides the excellent food, I can't help but mention the five teachers who work with the children all day. Among them are two speech therapists. And this is with about 10-12 children, and they're always there in such numbers. Imagine having five people watching and caring for your child, not two at most like we had before. It's a world of difference. Everything is in Russian, the children are Russian-speaking (although they teach English, of course), which certainly helps with their development. But such care and nutrition aren't everything; there's an even more important thing that we never expected. Eva started speaking completely within her first month there, even starting to pronounce the letter "R"; she now communicates completely in a completely understandable language. Her development has begun before our eyes; it's clear that she's being given time. She draws a lot, draws at home too, sings songs—in short, there are no words. I'm writing this review with great pleasure; we were so lucky to have chosen Yana. If we'd known, we would have gone there from the very beginning; it just happened that way. But these three months have been a godsend for us; we're truly lucky to have this preschool. Honestly, those Thai international preschools are a bit of a bummer; when you try everything a little, you end up with no results. But as soon as we arrived at the Russian preschool, she changed dramatically. It's a shame that we'll have to go to another preschool in another country. We really wouldn't want to leave, but as they say, it can't be helped. Today, as I already said, is our last day here. I recommend everyone send their child here; you will be very grateful in the end, I know it!
0x30502fd066cf7e49_0x3a3c30375e3b75c5.author: Вадим Забелин

0x30502fd066cf7e49_0x3a3c30375e3b75c5.text: In short, it's a wonderful preschool! I hadn't planned on sending my daughter to preschool until she was at least three, but after arriving in Phuket, she became very interested in other children, so we decided to give preschool a try. Although this preschool wasn't the most conveniently located option, several children from our condo were already attending, and everyone was very happy. We listened to the reviews and didn't regret it. I'm so glad my daughter's first preschool turned out to be exactly like this! The adjustment to preschool was extremely smooth, and pretty soon she started staying for naps, which still amazes me, because at home, no one but me can get her to sleep, but at preschool, we managed it! What I especially want to note: Since this was my daughter's first preschool, it was very important to me to have access to information about her progress. Yana always sent me photos, and if anything was bothering me, she responded promptly. The children have a lot of photos and videos, which is wonderful and important to us. During her time at the preschool, my daughter's speaking skills have improved greatly; she can pronounce more complex words. She even learned a few English words. Her horizons have broadened—almost every time we ask her in surprise, "How did you know that?" she replies, "I learned it at preschool." Wonderful developmental and creative activities—the children were constantly drawing, gluing, and sculpting. The food was Russian, and my child loved it. The teachers were very kind and attentive. My daughter preferred to communicate with Russian-speaking teachers, but from what I saw, the Thai teachers were also always responsive and attentive. In general, the issue of teachers and educators is, in my opinion, the most important thing in a preschool, and we are doing just fine in this regard: it's clear the specialists are genuinely interested in the children and genuinely care. Wonderful holidays—the children had a wonderful New Year's celebration with Father Frost, games, and gifts. For March 8th, the children learned poems about their mothers, drew portraits, and gave gifts. The attention to detail and shared care are also one of the reasons why our kindergarten has become so important to us. A natural challenge after our wonderful kindergarten—it seems we'll have a hard time finding a kindergarten in Moscow that even partially meets the high standards set by Yana and her wonderful staff.
0x30502fd066cf7e49_0x3a3c30375e3b75c5.author: Ольга Гаврилова

0x30502fd066cf7e49_0x3a3c30375e3b75c5.text: We attended this preschool for over a year, only stopping because we moved from the island. To say it's the best preschool is an understatement! The development of emotional intelligence and critical thinking, sensory integration, art therapy, and speech therapy are just some of the areas the children are taught. My daughter learned self-regulation (given her age, of course), how to follow instructions, and how to understand and communicate her feelings. If you are looking for a place where your child will not only be taught, but also loved - this is it!

0x30503a98680bb22f_0xc3a4ce0f09509128.text: Came to Patong to do my crown, polish and whiten my teeth. And... This is my second zirconia crown (first one did it in a private clinic in Singapore) and the experience is far better than my first. Dr Pook was gentle and very efficient, completed my temporary crown in 1 hr. I had no problem with it at all and my permanent crown was ready in 4 days and once again Dr Pook installed it gently and efficiently and improved it even by leaving a smaller gap between teeth. My first experience had my temp crown coming loose in just 3 days and took 2 weeks for my perm crown to be ready. Dr Tanya took care of my polishing and whitening, and she was super professional advising me on the pros and cons of whitening due to my 2 front teeth having an existing filling. She gave me the best advise for my benefit allowing me to device whether to proceed with whitening and on the polishing work, she did a superb job, removing all stains and smoothening rough teeth surfaces! Highly recommended and not forgetting to mention, costs a lot less than in SG (the crown costs less than half of my first one) while able to enjoy a relaxing holiday here in Phuket!! Double thumbs up for Dr Pook, Dr Tanya and the team at Dental Plus Patong!

0x30e29c2cb67afa49_0x7759801c0ad28f8.text: To be honest, I was really skeptical regarding getting the surgeries done at this clinic. I agreed for a rhinoplasty and liposuction altogether. I had my face to face consultation with the plastic surgeon and we went through what would be done. Please be aware that he has limited spoken English, however there is one nurse who speaks fluently English, Margi, I believe her name is. She has been very helpful in the communication gaps. Ensure that you have a list of questions. Information is provided when asked. The process prior to the surgery day, is that they sent you to the hospital to get all the blood tests, ECG and consultation with a cardiologist to get the all clear. Once this is done, I waited till the day. On the day, you go to the clinic and the anaesthetist, who you mean only on that day will put a canular on and put you to sleep. Once you're asleep, that's when the job is done. ~3 hours later, you are woken up with no pain, just a numbness at the cut area. You are taken to a room where you recover. I have chosen to stay in the room overnight but you have the options to return to your hotel room dependent on your state. I went unaccompanied, which in hindsight wasn't the greatest decision. The following day, I was discharged with all the medications and care instructions, with several follow ups. This is day 5 post op, and I'm on the mend for the next few weeks. In turn of pain post op, it was quite minimal for me. I'm tender and swollen in those areas, which makes the experience quite uncomfortable. In hindsight, I probably would have done only one surgery instead of two in one go. In terms of the outcome, I'm pleased. I hope this review is helpful. What I found is the reviews here were minimal. So I have tried to provide as much as I could. See below a picture of my abdomen day 3 post op.
0x30e29c2cb67afa49_0x7759801c0ad28f8.author: Peter

0x30e29f5bb5eb13bf_0x71297c8b611ea1d7.text: The physical therapist gave excellent advice and treatment. I had constant, severe, sharp headaches. The hospital and the general ward aren't luxurious, but were comfortable enough, and our main concern was quality medical care, which she got. The nurses and doctors were meticulous about every detail that was contributing to her condition, and periodically checked on her every hour, sometimes more when there was an issue. I've seen some negative comments about the politeness of staff but I disagree, the one thing that made our week here bearable was the warmth and care that the nurses gave my mum, and the patience with which they showed us how to help in caregiving. There were always some nurses that knew some English and were able to communicate with us effectively. Even the insurance department were patient with us when our insurance company were taking long to respond to the claim. All in all, I would definitely place my faith in this hospital, from my experience

Thank you to the doctors, nurses, and staff who cared for me throughout my admission. Now I will try my best to prevent the wound from getting infected again so I don't have to bother them again.

0x30fdab08ef561fcd_0xe34272d9e56b6691.text: At 32 years old, I found myself trapped in a cycle of crippling depression, burnout, and anxiety. For years, I had turned to different therapies, medications and doctors with no success. I tried everything. I often turned to drugs and alcohol to help numb the pain, and I knew deep down that this was not the life I wanted to live but I had no hope of ever actually recovering. I eventually started looking at inpatient mental health treatment and spent months searching for an inpatient center in the U.S. that I could afford, but everything was so expensive and often had unsettling reviews and policies I was not comfortable with. I found nothing that seemed to fit what I was looking for that was even remotely within my means. Then, during one of my many desperate Google searches, I discovered a Reddit thread discussing rehab centers in Thailand and their affordability and world class reputation. After doing extensive research, I narrowed it down to four options. Among the options, The Diamond definitely stood out immediately, and after my first call with Clinical Director, Craig Bilton, I knew this place was it. That initial conversation filled me with a hope I hadn’t felt in years, and now, I can confidently say that choosing The Diamond was the best decision I have ever made. What sets the Diamond apart from others is that it doesn’t just treat surface-level issues—it addresses the root causes of your struggles with compassion, precision, and expertise. It is mind, body and soul rehabilitation. Craig Bilton and Travis Roby, who are without a doubt the most skilled and insightful therapists I’ve ever encountered, played an instrumental role in my healing journey. Their intelligence, dedication, and genuine care for their clients created a therapeutic environment where I felt truly seen and supported. They didn’t just help me work through my challenges—they gave me the tools and understanding to take control of my life in ways I never thought possible. The progress I made during my 10-week stay was nothing short of miraculous. The depth of knowledge and healing I gained under their guidance was life-changing, and I will always credit my recovery to their incredible work. It isn’t just the world-class therapy at Diamond, but also its holistic approach to creating a supportive, comfortable, and nurturing environment that makes it so unique. Every client has their own private villa, which ensures privacy and peace, while cleaning and laundry services take away everyday stressors so you can focus on your recovery. The gourmet food, cooked to order, is another touch that shows how much they care about every detail of your well-being. On weekends, the excursions are not only fun but also help you reconnect with the joy of life and the world around you. This isn’t just a facility—it’s a sanctuary designed to make you feel safe, cared for, and valued as a person. The sense of community at The Diamond is unlike anything I’ve experienced. The staff, from the nurses to the therapists, genuinely care about you, and their kindness makes you feel deeply supported every step of the way. The nurses, in particular, became like surrogate mothers to me, always ready with a kind word or comforting gesture when I needed it most. The clients I met there were incredible, ranging in age from their 20s to their 70s, each with their own unique stories and strengths. I formed bonds with people who I now consider lifelong friends—people who understood me in ways others couldn’t. This sense of connection and shared growth was one of the most healing aspects of my time there. Looking back, I can only describe my experience at The Diamond as transformational. It is, without a doubt, the best rehab in Thailand and easily one of the best in the world. I only wish I had gone sooner. The Diamond didn’t just help me recover—it gave me my life back in ways I could not have imagined. For anyone struggling with mental health challenges or addiction, I cannot recommend this place enough. It’s not just a rehab center; it’s a place where miracles happen.
0x30fdab08ef561fcd_0xe34272d9e56b6691.author: Taylor Michel

0x30fdab08ef561fcd_0xe34272d9e56b6691.text: I will forever be grateful to The Diamond, and to everyone who makes this place the life-changing sanctuary that it is — the counselors, psychologists, nurses, massage therapist, support staff, housekeepers, kitchen team, and security. From the moment I arrived, every single person treated me with kindness, understanding, and compassion. When I came here eight weeks ago, I was completely broken, lost, and hopeless. I didn’t believe I had anywhere to turn. But through the combination of powerful group sessions and deeply personal one-on-one work, I slowly began to rebuild myself. The journey was not always easy — it was filled with tears, anger, and uncomfortable self-work — but also moments of joy, laughter, connection, and deep gratitude. Extending my stay from one month to two was one of the best decisions I have ever made. Today, I am leaving with not just sobriety, but with hope and the knowledge, tools, and sense of self I never thought I’d find again. The Diamond is more than just a rehab center — it is a community. I will never forget anyone I have encountered here. From the moment I arrived, I was surrounded by people who understood me in a way the outside world often couldn’t. Fellow clients quickly became confidants, cheerleaders, and mirrors, reflecting both my struggles and my progress back to me with honesty and compassion. The staff foster an environment where bonds can form naturally, and where vulnerability is met with understanding rather than judgment. This sense of connection has been just as healing as the therapy itself, reminding me that recovery doesn’t happen in isolation, but in the presence of people who truly care. I want to say a heartfelt thank you to Caroline, my psychologist, for always being so kind, patient, and caring. She created a safe space where I felt truly heard, and she gently guided me as I unpacked and worked through my past. Her calm, reassuring presence helped ease my anxieties and gave me the confidence to keep moving forward. I’m deeply grateful for the compassion and understanding she’s shown me throughout our sessions. Last but not least, I want to thank the clinical director and my counselor, Travis, who I truly believe gave me a second chance at life. He is, without question, the best counselor I could have hoped for — deeply dedicated to his work, to helping others, and to every single one of his clients. Travis has an extraordinary ability to truly see and hear his clients, to understand not just the words they say but the pain, hurt, and deep-seated emotions beneath them. He pushed me to do the uncomfortable work that was necessary for my growth, balancing firmness with compassion in exactly the way I needed. He put his heart and soul into working with me, often taking extra time between sessions to check in if I was struggling, making sure I had the strength to get through the day. That kind of care is rare, and I will never forget it. I don’t think I would have extended my stay if it weren’t for his guidance and support. He treats each client as a person, not a number, and his dedication is felt in every interaction. Through our work, he helped me begin transforming my self-hatred into acceptance, my hurt into laughter, and my hopelessness into a belief in the future. I am walking away from The Diamond with more self-awareness, resilience, and hope than I ever thought possible — and for that, I will always be grateful to him. The Diamond has given me far more than sobriety — it has given me a new beginning. I leave here feeling stronger, wiser, and ready to face life with clarity and courage. My gratitude for this place and these people is endless. Thank you all ❤️
0x30fdab08ef561fcd_0xe34272d9e56b6691.author: Laura

0x30fdab08ef561fcd_0xe34272d9e56b6691.text: 17 Oct 2024 I was feeling REALLY low – worst ever and thought I had better do something about it I have been to Thailand at Rehab before and started to google places. Luckily I found the Diamond!! My wife and I read all about it and decided this is the place I need to go. I have been suffering from Mental Health issues, mainly depression for over 25 years now. I have tried everything, hypnotism, sound treatment, courses, treatments, pills, meditation etc etc – everything I could get my hands on over the years. Over the last year we have been through some VERY trying times financially and this has led me to drink excessively and not cope as things dragged out. I got worse and worse until finally the tank was empty, physically and mentally drained beyond belief, I could barely string a sentence together, zero energy. We have built up a nice lifestyle, properties etc over the years and this was looking like me may lose a large chunk of it, not ideal at the age of 60 when you’re supposed to be enjoying your retirement you worked for! I made the decision to book for a month – talked to Craig, who is awesome, and made a plan. I got so run down I actually moved the date forward a month and off I went. Well what an experience! This place is right up there with the best in the world, and affordable! The staff are all awesome, smiling all the time, greet you and acknowledge you when they see you, even the chefs and kitchen staff. The food is prepared fresh every day and is exceptional. Accommodation you have your own Villa which again is 5 star, deck out front facing the pool to relax in the warmth. Everything you need is there and if its not they will get it for you. Grounds are kelp to a very high standard and pool serviced regularly. There is a nurse onsite 24 hours for medication dispersal, pain help, blood pressure in monitored every morning. There is a doctor on call if you need more help. They are extremely friendly and helpful and help you to feel at ease. Craig, & Travis are legends with over 20 years and more experience, they really know their stuff. There are 3 sessions each day and all very interesting and helpful. Then there are one on one sessions to personally suit you. The other counsellors are also top class and there to help and listen – absolutely nothing is a problem. During my time I unfortunately went into serious pain. Nurse examined me immediately and off to the hospital immediately. Within an hour I was under sedative, admitted, had a CT scan, X ray, MRI and surgery that night!! Unbelievable service. I got my gall bladder removed and was back at the Diamond in 2 days. During my stay Craig, his wife and a counsellor Lorraine visited every day and evening between them. Over and above the call of duty, they take personal caré and attention to us all. The programme at Diamond definitely works and is a result of Craig and Travis’s personal experiences over the years, not from a book or u tube etc. On interview I told Craig I need an oil change, I left with a complete overhaul haha! I can honestly say this has been the best 5 weeks of my life ( I extended a week). Feel fantastic more and more each day all day, something I have missed for years! It is the best thing I have done for myself ever, no question. Don’t look any further this is the place! Don’t procrastinate – JUST DO IT. I am happy for Craig to release my contact details should anyone have any further questions Mark Wikstrom - New Zealand
0x30fdab08ef561fcd_0xe34272d9e56b6691.author: Mark Wikstrom

0x30fdab08ef561fcd_0xe34272d9e56b6691.text: My 7-week stay at The Diamond Luxury Rehab in Hua Hin for a gambling addiction, a condition I've learned is a serious mental disorder, has been nothing short of transformative. While the resort and pool are clearly 5-star and provide a comfortable and serene environment, it is unequivocally the staff and counsellors who elevate this facility to a true luxury rehab. During my time here, I received a comprehensive and personalised treatment plan, which included four therapy sessions per week – two with an addiction specialist and two with a psychotherapist. Travis, my addiction specialist, has been instrumental in what I can only describe as saving not only my life but also the future of my family. His insightful approach helped me uncover critical blind spots in my behaviour that were fuelling my addiction. Without his guidance, I wouldn't have gained the understanding I now have of my actions and their consequences. Caroline, my psychotherapist, was equally brilliant. Her kind, caring, and compassionate nature created a calming and trusting space where I felt comfortable enough to delve deep into my actions and the underlying reasons for them. Her support was a crucial element of my healing process. Beyond Travis and Caroline, every single member of the team at The Diamond is extraordinary. From the dedicated cleaners who maintain the immaculate environment to the incredibly supportive staff (extra credit to Chai, Judi, Pink and Noey) everyone greets you with a genuine smile. Their collective positivity significantly contributes to the creation of a calming atmosphere. Adding to the recovery experience, weekend excursions provided unforgettable opportunities to explore the beauty of Thailand, offering a welcome balance to the intensive therapeutic work. I cannot recommend The Diamond Luxury Rehab highly enough. They have genuinely changed my life for the better, equipping me with the tools and understanding to move forward. I will forever be grateful to the entire team for their dedication, professionalism, and unwavering support. This place is a beacon of hope.
0x30fdab08ef561fcd_0xe34272d9e56b6691.author: Chris Nottage

0x30fdab08ef561fcd_0xe34272d9e56b6691.text: The Diamond Rehab truly changed my life, and I am forever grateful for the incredible team there—especially their Clinical Director, Craig Bilton. This was my second attempt at recovery from substance use disorder, and the difference in my experience at The Diamond compared to my first treatment program was nothing short of transformative. Unlike the rigid, one-size-fits-all 12-step-based program I had previously attended, The Diamond Rehab took a holistic, individualized approach that catered specifically to my needs. Not only did the program address my substance use, but it also supported me in managing co-occurring mental health conditions, including long-standing depression and ADHD—an undiagnosed condition that had been overlooked for years. Craig Bilton was pivotal in this breakthrough. Within just 20 minutes of our first counseling session, Craig identified signs of ADHD, a suspicion that was quickly confirmed by a clinical diagnosis. This moment was life-changing. Despite seeing numerous doctors, therapists, and psychologists over the years, ADHD had never been considered, let alone diagnosed. Craig’s keen insight, coupled with his compassionate and solution-focused approach, was instrumental in helping me understand and manage this underlying challenge. The entire team at The Diamond Rehab was exceptional. Travis and Jessica also played key roles in my recovery journey, offering unwavering support and guidance throughout my program. Their dedication, empathy, and expertise made all the difference. Thanks to The Diamond Luxury Rehab, I am genuinely excited about life again. For the first time in years, I feel hopeful, empowered, and equipped to face the future. I cannot thank Craig, Travis, Jessica, and the entire team enough for giving me my life back. If you’re looking for a program that goes beyond just treating symptoms to truly transform lives, I cannot recommend The Diamond Rehab highly enough.
0x30fdab08ef561fcd_0xe34272d9e56b6691.author: Cody Parrish

0x30fdab08ef561fcd_0xe34272d9e56b6691.text: I would like to express my heartfelt gratitude to the entire team at Diamond who supported me throughout this journey – the therapeutic staff, psychologists, nurses, support staff, kitchen staff, housekeepers, and security guards. At first, I came for just one month, but following the advice of those around me – and realizing for myself that I needed more time – I decided to extend my stay. What was meant to be one month eventually turned into three months. There were difficult moments, times when I wanted to give up and leave early, but there was always a listening ear, a caring and supportive team, people who knew when to offer a hug, and when to tell me the hard truths – always with compassion and a genuine desire to help. Over time, the moments of doubt gave way to feelings of safety, love, and family. This place gave me immense support, real tools to face life’s challenges, and a true sense of home. I arrived here in a very difficult state – a broken person, physically, emotionally, and struggling with addictions – and I found myself again in a warm, open, and accepting environment that genuinely listens to its patients and allows them to grow, both as part of a group and in their own individual ways and perspectives. If you expect only “sunshine and butterflies,” you might be surprised – because real work is done here. Sometimes there is pain and tears, but this work is rewarding, empowering, and leads to real change. I am leaving here as a new person – filled with hope, strength, and faith in the journey ahead. I wholeheartedly recommend Diamond to anyone who is looking for true change and is ready to invest in themselves. A huge thank you to each and every one of you! ❤️

0x31029594415020b3_0x230f6ecd54dad63.text: I mustered up and got the test done. Quite frankly, I think it was one of the best things I could’ve done during my visit to Pattaya. I’m 57 and my T level was off the chart (1247 ). For those that are familiar, the normal levels of a 21 - 49 year old falls in between 300 to 1200 nanograms per deciliter (Ng/DL). My prostate checked out good along with pretty much everything else except Cholesterol border high and barely low on Red Blood Cells. So with Dr. Cham’s advice, I am correcting those and should be good to go. The obvious question was why I felt my T level was under performing and he explained a medicine I was taking (Finasteride), was blocking my T level performance. He recommended lowering in half my daily finasteride pill. So, enough about me. Dr Cham was so easy to talk to. Explained very well the results - takes about 40’ to 60’ min explaining. Price is 100% worth it regardless of what I consider are excellent results. His establishment is well run. Staff extremely polite and attentive. I could go on with the compliments. I guess I can sum it up with saying this: This could’ve easily been explained to me in the US twenty years ago. Always thought I was low on T. Paying ~ $875 a month for insurance and my doctor in US knew very well I was complaining about low performance to the extent I was prescribed sildenafil. If things could’ve just been explained to me, it would’ve saved relationships and grief. Do yourself a favor and find out about your body and health overall. The list of things addressed through this exam is extensive and informative. Now it’s up to me to carry on and address any low results. 5 STARS! Thank you Dr Cham and thank you to all your staff!

0x310293066061a7d3_0x95fa63862129f169.text: November 2025 I cannot express enough gratitude to Paul and his team at Hope House. They are truly dedicated to helping people overcome their addictions. When Daniel experienced a relapse, they didn’t judge him, they welcomed him back with open arms and unwavering support. Daniel is now back in treatment, and this time he is genuinely learning to take responsibility for his actions, including addressing some of the challenging behaviours he struggled with previously. Choosing Hope House in Thailand has been a game changer for Daniel’s recovery. It offers incredible value compared to the UK, three months of excellent care in Thailand costs only slightly more than one month in England. Being away from triggers and able to focus fully on his recovery has brought my son back. December 2023 What can I say but I've got my son back. When my son went to Hope 6 months ago he was in a very bad place with Cocaine and Cannabis, being an active addict for around 15 years. He has tried getting clean previously by going to meetings and previous rehabs but always came unstuck. I have much more hope this time as Paul and the team have spent alot of time challenging my son's behaviour and working with him to overcome and address his issues. I can't sing Paul and the team's praises enough, Paul has always been available for me to speak to him. The dedication of the team for recovery addicts and alcoholics is amazing. Brilliant, thank you.
0x310293066061a7d3_0x95fa63862129f169.author: Debbie Mcgettrick

0x310293066061a7d3_0x95fa63862129f169.text: As someone who has been through numerous treatment centers and sober houses etc, I can honestly say Hope House is one of the best places. Other places have treated me poorly, kicked me out at night and left me homeless, and essentially robbed my family of their money. That doesn't happen at hope house. Paul is the only person who has let me come in without an immediate down payment. He is flexible when necessary and really cares about his clients, as well as the rest of the staff. When they say they will help you achieve a goal they actually follow through with it. For example they helped me become an english teacher. (which other places said they would do but actually didn't) They have tons of activities to do there. Meditation, exercise, muay thai, step work, counseling, fishing, teaching english, and taking classes are some of the many many possibilities available. And theres plenty of relaxing too! It's a great place for those who already have some clean time but are weary of stepping back fully into the real world. Many good supportive friends can be made here as well which is an essential part of recovery. No program is perfect. But as someone who's had some awful experiences with other programs, I can definitely say hope was a great experience for me.
0x310293066061a7d3_0x95fa63862129f169.author: 125 guy

0x310293066061a7d3_0x95fa63862129f169.text: Had a wonderful experience at Hope House! Grateful for Paul taking me in and everyone else there for helping me come out feeling stronger. Everyone there was so helpful and went out their way to make me feel welcome and comfortable for my 2 months stay there. They had a pool, gym, sauna, ice bath, bikes, meditation room and a huge dining area where you can all hang out! The rooms were perfect and the bed was to die for! If you had any problems they’d fix it for you asap! The sessions, classes and excursions were the perfect opportunity to help me get out of my shell. We had the Orphans come to visit and that really made me feel good to give back to the community. I would definitely recommend Hope House to anyone who needs help because the people there were so friendly and welcoming. Missing Hope House already and the team and of course Jerry and Sushi 🐈‍⬛ Jasmine
0x310293066061a7d3_0x95fa63862129f169.author: Jasmine Lindsay

0x310293066061a7d3_0x95fa63862129f169.text: Hope House literally saved my life. I arrived struggling with heavy alcohol dependence and anxiety. Over the course of three months, they guided me through initial detox and helped me build a foundation for recovery. The daily AA activities, meditation sessions, and weekly onsite psychologist meetings were helpful in addressing both my drinking and anxiety. They also incorporated Smart Recovery techniques, which really complemented the program. The staff were compassionate and professional. The monthly pricing was very reasonable (maybe a quarter of the price of other rehab centers in the area). The smaller size of operations really helped with my anxiety. I initially planned to stay one month but ended up staying three. I highly recommend Hope House to anyone.

0x310293066061a7d3_0x95fa63862129f169.text: Hi I'd like to say thanks to Paul and Simon, I've just recently returned home and I'm forever grateful for there help, I've been to rehab before but this time it suited me with it been slightly more relaxed my head can only process so much a day, you will never be short of work though between classes you can go for a swim or gym ,and then there's coursework to fill your evenings ,hope house Is a great place to have a good think about your future with very helpful staff Paul and micheal will help you with anything that comes up ,all you need to do is concentrate on recovery ,I was in a rough place and still have a lifetime journey but for anybody that can't afford big rehab prices I recommend Paul's Hope house as the perfect place , good luck.

From my very first contact with V Smile Dental Clinic, I was deeply impressed by the friendliness and professionalism of the staff. In particular, Dr. Tanny was always kind, patient, and thorough in explaining the treatment procedures, progress, expected results, and estimated treatment timeline. She was also incredibly attentive to all of my detailed questions during each monthly visit, which made me feel comfortable and confident throughout the entire treatment process. I especially appreciated how responsible and thoughtful the staff members were. They consistently reminded me of my appointments one day in advance, which was extremely helpful for someone like me who often struggles to keep track of dates and times amidst a busy daily schedule. Overall, choosing V Smile Dental Clinic was one of the best decisions I made, and I have never regretted it for a moment. I will always remember the kindness, friendliness, professionalism, and responsible care provided by Dr. Tanny and the entire staff. 0x30502d728b0a18c1_0xf0a28e39c2fd5fd0.text: This place is truly amazing and for anyone in need of rehabilitation please come here. I am an alcoholic and have been to many rehab centres in the UK and Turkey without any success but truly for the first time I have hope of a new life without alcohol which I never had previously. They collect you from the airport and you are looked after the moment you enter the rehab. There are many more rehabs out there which are more expensive but in this case more expensive does not mean better:) The rooms are really nice and I stayed in an ocean view room with a relaxing terrace next door to have my morning coffee. The food is fantastic with a real variety in choice from authentic curries to fish and so much more made by chef Ramen.. Coffee machine is available with multiple choices . You get 3 meals a day so no need to worry about food . A special shout goes to John my therapist with whom I had three one to one sessions a week with. He really understands you and has a very calming persona which allows you to open up. You have many group sessions with the lovely Toni & Gift (also John) which teach you new life skills and how to cope with triggers and craving and I have learnt things I never knew to help me in my recovery. There is many activities you can participate in (It is your choice) such as Yoga, Singing bowl Muay thai massages and art classes. You also have weekend excursions to beaches ,night markets and temples (optional again) and many more. It sometimes feels like you are on holiday :) Another special mention to the lovely Dawie who takes the yoga classes(also she is a support worker)s she is a breath of fresh air and has such an infectious bubbly personality and is good to be around. With regards to all other staff I cannot fault anyone as this truly is a great place which I would recommend to anyone in need of addiction treatment. I honestly never write reviews but felt I had to this time as I reached rock bottom but this place has made me believe I can enjoy live away from alcohol and has given me many tools to put in place to deal with my issues. I actually turned up really drunk(shock for an alcoholic ha) but was given a diazapem program and got through the withdrawal which as anyone with an addiction is aware withdrawal is the hardest part and makes you still use but I came through it . I will continue online therapy sessions with John online . These people really care about you so do yourself a favour , If you have lost all hope get in touch with Kevin and get yourself booked in. Kevin is a great guy also and makes the process so easy with excellent communication . I called one day and was there 5 days later . The support staff Ye ,,Khao Alex and Dawie who take you on excursions are all really nice people and always ready to help with anything you nee Take what you want from this review but it is all true and I hope everyone who is active addiction there is hope and this place can 100% get you felling so much better at a fraction of the costs of over rehabs. So thank you to everyone at Phuket Island Rehab for giving me hope again. Over & Out Matthew(Recovering alcoholic)
0x30502d728b0a18c1_0xf0a28e39c2fd5fd0.author: Matthew Barry

0x30502d728b0a18c1_0xf0a28e39c2fd5fd0.text: I really want to thank Phuket Island Rehab for all they did for me. At first I was a little worried because of the one negative review of the place but I’m so happy I trusted my gut as it was the BEST thing I could have done for myself. From the moment I arrived, I felt safe, supported, and genuinely cared for. The facilities are absolutely beautiful. The environment is peaceful and clean, and everything is designed to help you feel calm and grounded. The rooms were spacious and extremely comfortable. I never once felt like I was missing anything. Every level of care was provided without me even needing to ask. The food was incredible. Every meal was fresh, healthy, and full of flavor. You could tell the staff put thought and effort into making sure we were nourished and well-fed. Eating well every day played a big part in helping me feel stronger, both physically and emotionally. The therapy I received was on a completely different level. Toni and John have an incredible ability to truly understand addiction and the underlying pain that comes with it. They helped me dig deep and process things I had avoided for years. Their honesty, empathy, and insight made such a difference. I will never forget what they taught me. The support workers were absolutely amazing. Daiwe, Gao, Ye, and Alex were always there when we needed something. Whether it was helping with day-to-day tasks, checking in with us, or just having a kind word ready when the days were tough, they always made us feel comfortable. Their presence created such a calm and safe atmosphere, and it meant a lot knowing they were always close by. The outings I had were also so beautiful and gave a sense of freedom. Phuket Island Rehab gave me a second chance. I arrived unsure of myself and uncertain about my future. I left with clarity, strength, and a deep sense of gratitude. I will carry this experience with me for the rest of my life. If you are thinking about getting help, this is the place. They do not just help you get clean. They help you heal. All my love to the staff and other clients 💕
0x30502d728b0a18c1_0xf0a28e39c2fd5fd0.author: Connor

0x30502d728b0a18c1_0xf0a28e39c2fd5fd0.text: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ I cannot thank this rehab center enough for the role it has played in my recovery journey. What was initially supposed to be a short stay turned into a full 3-month program — and that decision truly changed my life. I came in struggling with major depressive disorder which led to excessive alcohol use, feeling completely lost and hopeless. From day one, the environment here felt safe, welcoming, and judgment-free. The staff went above and beyond to make me feel comfortable and supported. Everyone — from the support staffs, cooks, nurses to the counselors — treated me with kindness, compassion, and patience. One of the things I appreciated most was that the center doesn’t enforce recovery through pressure or control. Instead, they guide you with empathy and give you the space to heal at your own pace. They empower you to take accountability for your actions, which helped me feel more in control of my recovery rather than being forced through it. That sense of trust and personal responsibility made a huge difference in my growth. A special thank you to my therapists, John and Gift. Their approach to therapy was not only professional but deeply human. I was able to open up about past traumas and finally begin to work through layers of pain I had buried for years. With their guidance, I learned practical coping skills, gained emotional insight, and started believing in recovery again. This place became more than just a treatment center — it became a turning point in my life. I’m walking away stronger, clearer, and finally hopeful. If you or a loved one is struggling, I cannot recommend this place enough.
0x30502d728b0a18c1_0xf0a28e39c2fd5fd0.author: Shan 99

0x30e29e553294ea33_0xf7ebe332f7b3d967.text: Exceptional Dental Care Experience in Bangkok As an Austrian traveler who encountered an unexpected dental mishap, I found myself in a situation that could have easily derailed my journey. While brushing my teeth, my front tooth crown just fell off at 3 am in the morning. What a nightmare! At least i could recover the crown and i had 2 options - fly home and get the work done at my dentist or try it here. I was very fortunate to find outstanding care at the Dental Hospital. The next morning, thanks to the prompt and professional service at this clinic, my worries were swiftly put to rest. Upon contacting the clinic, they demonstrated understanding the urgency of my situation, scheduling an appointment within the next hour. Arriving at the clinic, I was friendly greeted by the ladies at the reception who had my information already available from previous visits (in the past I went there twice for routine dental cleaning). This was eliminating any unnecessary paperwork. During my consultation, the dentist thoroughly assessed the situation, taking the time to listen to my concerns and explaining the treatment options available to me. His expertise and reassurance really gave me confidence that I was in capable hands and every aspect of my dental health was examined, including X-rays. The dentist not only addressed the immediate issue of the fallen crown but also took the time to discuss preventive measures and options for ongoing care. The clinic itself is also very impressive, with modern facilities spread across multiple levels, each dedicated to different aspects of dentistry. This setup gives me the confidence that whatever dental concern one might have, it could be addressed under one roof. During my visit, I received not only the necessary treatment but also a complete dental cleaning. The professionalism by the dentist and the assisting personnel, was truly commendable. What stood out the most was the genuine care and attention given to me as a foreigner in a foreign land. Despite the language barrier, the staff ensured clear communication, making me feel comfortable and well taken care of throughout the process. The entire experience, from the initial consultation to the final result was exceptional. And to top it off, the pricing was fair and transparent, offering great value for the high-quality service received. Also worth mentioning: Not only did they provide me with all the necessary X-rays via email for my records, but they also offered a complimentary shuttle service to and from the nearest BTS station, making transportation hassle-free, if necessary. Of course I was lucky because my case was not the worst case scenario. As someone with a long history of dental problems, i know that there are many cases where you will need more extensive treatments. And a dentist is not a magician who can fix all your dental problems in 3 hours. But if you ever find yourself in need of dental care in Bangkok, I wholeheartedly recommend this clinic. Whether for emergencies or routine check-ups, you can trust that you'll be in the hands of skilled professionals .
0x30e29e553294ea33_0xf7ebe332f7b3d967.author: Silvia Franz

0x30e29e553294ea33_0xf7ebe332f7b3d967.text: I have nothing but the highest praise for this Dental Hospital. Everything is state of the art (all their dental equipment is Swiss made) and most importantly: superb cleanliness (I even saw a cleaning team disinfecting the handrails on the staircase). The receptionists on the various floors are so friendly, I never had to wait longer then 10 minutes for my appointments (I made 7 consecutive trips to the hospital as I came over from Europe for ceramic veneers, root canal treatments, to fit a few crowns, have a few fillings and a molar extraction). The total cost was 1/3 of what I would have paid in Europe. I left with a complete new set of teeth (ceramic veneers) and the overall health of all my teeth was very well cared for. Dr Sumana truly transformed my mouth. I saw various doctors, and their assistant, they were all highly skilled and they'd trained either in USA or in the UK. The patient care, the incredible high standard of hygiene, combined with fantastic doctors truly impressed me. After returning to Europe my family members simply could not believe how natural and amazing my veneers looked. I am confident recommending this hospital for any dental treatment.

0x30e29edcffea5a69_0xf3a936a932d5af4c.text: If you’re traveling to Bangkok anytime soon and looking for a proper aesthetic clinic for any such needs then this is one of the better options to look into and that too in an ideal locality of Bangkok that is easily accessible and hard to miss with it’s multiple boards and signs. Finding a good clinic in Bangkok may be a task since there are so many options all across the city so it takes some research to find the best one for your needs and a place that can safely and effectively help you achieve whatever you want to get done. Dr Pear was so helpful during my visit and completely understood whatever I had in mind and suggested many different options to me during the initial consultation. It is hard to find doctors in the city which can mold a plan around your exact needs when it comes to aesthetic care, wellness and health so I really appreciate such experiences whenever I have them. You can speak in English and explain all your concerns/requirements and they’ll definitely be able to devise a plan that is the most appropriate! I opted for their Meso Chanel injections for the cheeks, a vitamin treatment for the face and also the fat burning Nano Lipofat injections for the face as well. All of the treatments were relatively painless and if you apply the numbing cream well in advance you won’t feel a thing. The doctor made sure that I was never experiencing any pain and constantly kept checking on me in between as well. The procedures were quick and simple and I was in and out of the clinic in an hour and a half which is great if you’re a tourist and just want small aesthetic adjustments to enhance or correct any issues you may have. I was also informed that the best results can be seen within 1.5-2 weeks and I really liked how the clinic is clean, well equipped with the latest machines and spread out across 2 floors. You can clearly tell that it is a place of high standards and will provide quality care which is a relief whenever you are going for treatments that are physically evident. Overall, I’d definitely recommend the clinic for their seamless service and great prices and if you’re coming from the Middle East or Europe, you’ll definitely appreciate their services and way of dealing with patients and that also at very economical prices!

0x30502e3764660359_0x748e5764d00e322e.text: I saw Dr. Akhin today for a filling replacement. It's a huge filling in one of my molars and the last dentist who replaced it in the U.S. said I would likely need a crown if it broke again. So, "holding my breath," I went to see Dr. Akhin (hoping it could be filled just one more time) and he was able to do it! Yay!!! Not only that, he also did it entirely without the need to give me a shot. That's a first for me! Anytime in the past I was told that I wouldn't need a shot, there was always that twinge of pain...and then they had to end up giving me the dreaded shot. But not so this time! I'm not sure how he managed it, but I never felt any pain in the tooth the whole time he was drilling. (Great job, Dr. Akhin!) I also really appreciated his "bedside manner" as he is very conscious of the comfort of his patient. He let me take breaks to rest my jaw and neck whenever I needed them. (And I needed several...) It takes a lot to impress me, but this dentist has impressed me more than any dentist I've ever had in the states (USA.) (Yes! By that I mean my entire life!) Not only that! It was also less than a third of the cost of the last time I had the same exact filling done a little over a year ago back home. You just can't beat that! 😀
