0x3054f644cdfc6899_0xbe0ded7f59ad53cf.text: I had a medical emergency for an existing health condition while on holiday. Visited on a Sunday. Very impressed with the service and professionalism. Once I registered and they took my pressure and recognized it was an emergency, they rushed me straight into the Emergency ward and the doctor and nurses were with me in literally a minute. After treating me, they also kept me for observation for 2 hours to monitor my condition. Adequate English spoken by both medical staff and administrative staff. Nurses were kind and patient. Doctor took care to explain. The bill was extremely fair for the quality, extensiveness and speed of medical attention. I read mixed reviews before coming here and was initially hesitant to come to this government hospital (instead of one of the private hospitals on the island that cater more to tourists and insurance, with exorbitant price tags to match). I wanted to leave this review because my experience at Ko Samui Hospital was very positive and the price was very reasonable. If you are a visitor who needs medical attention while in Samui, don't hesitate to come to this hospital. Although the building and infrastructure may look a bit "old" and in need of some maintenance at the entrance, the service, medcial equipment, facilities (at least at the Emergency ward) and medical attention provided are as good and modern as any international hospital.
0x3054f644cdfc6899_0xbe0ded7f59ad53cf.author: Lynn Tan

0x3054f644cdfc6899_0xbe0ded7f59ad53cf.text: The Koh Samui hospital dealt with my acute gastro- enteritis (I remember their diagnosis from march 1988 even now) SO very well. I thought I was a gonna as I had deteriorated over two or more weeks living in a (then) isolated Chaweng beach with no idea of what was wrong then, but I DID know I needed help very much. A week and a half later I was cured and strong enough to leave the hospital. But I still think of the time they saved my life, with great care and efficiency, and I thank God they were there for me, 38 years ago. Beautiful people, in a beautiful hospital, on an island which I gradually saw was heaven. (I was utterly delirious when I was brought in, with no idea of where I was, or what was wrong) The doctors and nurses were so very patient, and the nurses fed me to allow me to recover. It was only after this I learned that dysentery and acute gastro- enteritis is the greatest cause of death across the world. I say a prayer of gratitude whenever I now think of that time. Should any of the hospital nurses or doctors read this, I thank you from the bottom of my heart. Sawadee cap. 🙏🏻
0x3054f644cdfc6899_0xbe0ded7f59ad53cf.author: Paul McNicholas

0x3054f644cdfc6899_0xbe0ded7f59ad53cf.text: Good for Thai government hospital....inexpensive compared to private hospitals. Most doctors and nurses speak reasonable good English.... Start at booth 1 and fill out your data, you'll be directed to get blood pressure and other basic info... then proceed to the area (by number you are directed too) Many hospital services provided here....including a good Physio therapy unit. If non emergency treatment is required avoid Mondays and Friday mornings, if possible....although afternoons generally less busy. Closed for lunch between 12 noon and 1 pm. Although the doctors work with great efficiency of getting patients seen too. Emergency Dept open 24 hours... In case of snake bite (rare) this is the only hospital on Samui that has Antivenom. Pharmacy is very well stocked, however you must have a prescription from a doctor. They accept credit cards, with a 3% extra charge. In case of having to be admitted, there are General wards, semi private rooms (6 beds) or spacious private rooms with 1 bed, fridge, couch and TV... (additional charge of course). Great sea view too!

0x3054f644cdfc6899_0xbe0ded7f59ad53cf.text: I was really pleased to be able to do a walk-in and get a Pfizer booster free of charge. What they told me by email is - "We provide Pfizer, AstraZeneca and sinovac vaccination at a hospital. Please prepare 1 copies passport and vaccine certificate. - Room9 during Mon, Thu and Fri Service hours 13.00 - 15.00. - Room 25 during Tue and Wen. Service hours: 9.00 - 11.00, 13.00 - 15.00. Close public holiday." However on arrival it was Pfizer only. I didn't need passport or vaccine certificate copies, I just showed them my pink card and Mor Prom app and it was good enough. Also, don't go straight to the rooms mentioned above. You need to start at reception and fill in a form, otherwise they will send you back again. It's now close to a week later and my Mor Prom app hasn't updated with the details of this booster, but since my purpose was mainly protection I'm not too bothered about that. EDIT: My Mor Prom app was updated around 3 weeks after the event. So all good in the end and I’m bumping this review up to five stars

0x30e299097e3d1353_0x1fb72e37217acd6a.text: Since turning 40, I've experienced hair loss and thinning, leading to a lack of confidence and a anguish spent countless hours cutting and styling my hair. I tried many solutions, but the results were unsatisfactory. Finally, I decided to consider hair transplantation and researched several clinics. Pavicon Hair Clinic was one of the options I considered, and I wasn't disappointed. After the consultation, I was impressed with the doctor and staff who provided insightful advice directly addressing my specific needs. I decided to have the procedure done at Pavicon on my first day. A week later, I had my transplant appointment. I have to admit, I was very nervous and afraid of the pain, but after witnessing the doctor's professionalism, skill, and procedures, I felt relieved, even though the procedure took a long time due to its precision. (I secretly thought to myself, I'm just lying there, but the doctor and team have to stand for much longer; if they can endure it, so can I!) After six hours, everything went well. Before leaving, the doctor gave me post-operative care instructions. The first night was slightly sore, and I had follow-up appointments for wound cleaning and light therapy. We'll have to wait and see what the results are, as the doctor is scheduling follow-up appointments throughout the year. If you're looking for a hair transplant clinic, I highly recommend Pavicon Hair Clinic as a top choice.

0x3054f1c9d6d16fe3_0x3b3819db2375d770.text: I applied to the clinic for the removal of my lower wisdom tooth. The staff is very friendly and speaks English. They took an X-ray and provided an approximate cost. Since there was no available time when I arrived, they suggested I come back later so the doctor could assess the situation and give me the exact cost of the removal. The doctor turned out to be a pleasant man; he examined me and asked when I was ready to have the tooth removed—now or later. Since the doctor was free, he began the extraction immediately. The entire process lasted about an hour; it was incredibly scary, and at times I was shaking, but there was no pain. I have a fear of dentists and the sound of the drill =))) After the appointment, they gave me a lot of medication and instructed me to return in 10 days to have the stitches removed. Today is the second day, and the wound hardly hurts. I am taking painkillers and believe everything will heal quickly. Thanks to the staff for handling everything neatly and relatively quickly. Lower wisdom teeth are dreadful. The procedure is certainly not cheap, but I decided to have the tooth removed because it started to break and hurt. All together, including X-rays, injections, and medications, the total cost came to over 6,000 baht, which is quite expensive, but they saved me from a problem that had been bothering me for more than a month. Thank you!

0x30da3bfd3b64eddb_0x4b130d50158fa1df.text: We initially came here just to check the prices, as we had already compared several clinics in Chiang Mai, including those located in shopping malls. From the very first moment, the experience was completely different. Two ladies immediately came out to welcome me and my wife, greeted us warmly, and took the time to talk with us instead of trying to sell anything. The atmosphere was calm, friendly, and very comfortable — no crowds, no noise, no pressure, and no people pushing flyers into your hands like in shopping malls. The clinic itself is very modern, clean, and clearly well maintained, with a professional and sterile environment, but still warm and pleasant inside. Although the prices listed online were promotional, the staff kindly honored the holiday promotional prices for us without any hesitation. Thanks to this, we were able to get a treatment package for nearly half the price compared to similar clinics in shopping malls, where prices were literally twice as high. Everything was clearly explained and calculated in advance, so there were no surprises at all. We were taken in immediately, without waiting, and the laser hair removal treatment was completely painless. Every step of the procedure was explained carefully, and the staff made sure we felt comfortable throughout the entire process. Communication in English was very good — everything was easy to understand and there were no issues at all. During our visit, we also learned that the clinic offers Botox treatments not only for the jaw and forehead, but also for other areas of the body. They also provide facial fillers to reduce wrinkles and restore volume where needed, as well as CO₂ skin boosters and vitamin IV drips. We are definitely interested in trying more treatments here in the future. Since these procedures usually require follow-up sessions, we are certain we will be coming back. In terms of price, quality of service, professionalism, friendly staff, and central location, this is by far the best clinic we have found in Chiang Mai. We highly recommend this place to anyone traveling or living here.

0x305031311322fc3d_0x969f45f715726e87.text: We couldn’t recommend SAFE Fertility Clinic (Phuket) enough. My husband and I travelled from the UK to pursue IVF here, and the experience exceeded our expectations in every way. Originally, we planned to do IVF at home in the UK, but we decided that going through the process in Phuket — a place we’ve always loved — might make the journey feel more positive and less stressful. After finding Dr. Manop Pinyopummintr and communicating with him over WhatsApp and Zoom before traveling, we immediately felt comfortable and confident moving forward. From the very beginning, Dr. Manop and his entire team were outstanding. Communication was always clear and prompt, and they were incredibly patient and supportive with every question or concern we had. IVF can feel overwhelming, but the staff at SAFE made the whole process feel smooth, professional, and genuinely caring. The clinic itself is modern, well organized, and the level of care we received was exceptional. What stood out most was how warm and attentive everyone was. After only two months of treatment, I’m now heading back home pregnant, and we are beyond grateful. Choosing SAFE and Dr. Manop was one of the best decisions we could have made. Thank you to the entire team for giving us such an incredible experience and helping make our dream come true!

0x3102960b88a71a1f_0x58e069f6b8ed430f.text: On January 21, 2025, I visited this clinic under my insurance policy. I must say right away that my visit was pleasant and the service was professional! They offered me two options: I chose tooth extraction, removal of the pus, and wound healing, with a subsequent decision on implantation. The second option was root canal treatment with a success rate of up to 60%, but that wasn't my option. The entire procedure was conducted with the help of a translator, with the doctor, a relatively young specialist, displaying information on a large screen and on the screen in front of me. The doctor answered many of my questions, prescribed treatment after the extraction, and provided me with all the necessary medications. They also sent me a link on WhatsApp with instructions on measures to take after the tooth extraction. From there, it's up to me to strictly take the prescribed medications. Thank you very much to the staff at Your Dentist Pattaya Dental Clinic for your timely and high-quality assistance!

0x311d6777a1017b51_0x45ab5340488a147c.text: The clinic is on the third floor, and the actual PCR testing area is located after exiting Exit 7 on the first floor and walking to the left (towards Exit 8). Near Exit 3 on the first floor is the antigen test. It's inexpensive at 550 baht, but it's only a qualitative antigen test, so it can't be used when entering Japan. First, tell the staff where you're traveling to (step ①), then hand over your passport and 1,200 baht. Next, fill out a medical questionnaire and hand it to the staff. The staff will create a form based on the questionnaire. If the documents you're given are correct, hand them over (step ③), open the door, enter, and have a swab inserted into both your nostrils. You can go home when you're done. You'll receive your test results later via email. If the email address on the questionnaire is incorrect, you won't receive the email, so be sure to write it correctly. Apparently, test results won't be sent that same day unless you register by 11:00. Please note that if you plan to take a late-night flight on the same day, if you register by 11:00, the test results will be sent to you around 16:00.
0x311d6777a1017b51_0x45ab5340488a147c.author: ダーロン

0x311d6777a1017b51_0x45ab5340488a147c.text: It's located between Gates 7 and 8 on the first floor. Gate 3 is for antigen tests, so it cannot be used when returning to your home country. At the reception, inform them that you're returning to Japan and submit your passport. Fill out the reception form with your physical condition, email address, etc., and hand over 1,200 baht. The information is confirmed on the paper with your email address and other details written on it. You enter a small room and a sample is taken from your nose. Both nostrils are taken. I took the test at around 9:00 AM, and the results arrived by email around 4:00 PM.

Thank you to the doctor for taking the time to explain everything in detail, providing knowledge, advice, and making me feel that there are always people ready to care for and help me. Thank you to all the nurses who cared for me with gentleness and patience, whether it was the smallest steps or things that needed to be repeated, they still cared for me willingly. Everyone contributed to making this treatment visit go better and felt warmer than I expected. Sometimes, people working in the medical field may not realize that... What everyone does each day is invaluable to the patients. But for us, we want everyone to know that I remember and am truly grateful for every word, every act of kindness, and every help I received. Thank you for not only caring for the illness but also for caring for the patients' feelings. Thank you for making me feel reassured on days when I was worried. May all the doctors, nurses, and staff receive abundant blessings in return, just as the goodwill you have given to the patients. May you all have good health, happiness in your work, and the strength to continue caring for people every day. Thank you from the bottom of my heart. For all the kindness, attention, and care. 0x30da304634610d43_0x58f188f1dfd74579.text: The counselling staff are among the best I've ever been in contact with. I've seen many psychologists and counsellors and the Cabins are by far the best. I found a lot of use from the art therapy with Yuliya. She has a way of getting information and emotions out with just a few scribbles on a page. I learnt about "box breathing" during meditation sessions with Nim. It came in handy for many situations, from solo meditation to controlling my anxiety in so many circumstances. Nim is a wealth of knowledge when it comes to engaging with life's trials and tribulations. The support staff are great. And a barrel of laughs too. The nurses are very caring. Don't forget to meet Prem and Mickey in the restaurant area. They're great for a chat and always have a smile on their face. I definitely recommend learning some basic Thai so you can chat with the lovely cleaning staff, gardener's and security. Be prepared to get fit with Aon and Nay in the gym too. Yoga in the morning with Nock and Siri is a great way to stretch after a good night's sleep. The Cabins new addition Prijanka who does meditation and mindfulness sessions, is out of this world. Prijanka helped me to see myself in a different light. I suffer from severe self esteem issues which go way back to childhood trauma. And these sessions have helped me immensely.
0x30da304634610d43_0x58f188f1dfd74579.author: Tim C

0x30da304634610d43_0x58f188f1dfd74579.text: I cannot not express how incredible this program is. Substance. One word to describe The Cabin. The staff, the program, the food, the way they individualize care . THE VALUE. I’ve never felt such a return on an investment in my life. They have world class counselors that are able to unlock the individual enigma that each addict presents. I’m brought to tears of gratitude just writing this bc of the love and energy that they chose to put into their clients. From the nurses, cooks, support staff, yoga/reiki, art teachers to counselors. They all are there bc they want to help those that are suffering. 14 of last 18 years I spent on a combination of Heroin/fentanyl or methadone. I felt no rehab could handle a situation as complex as mine. I left after 8.5 weeks with my happiness back, my emotional stability back, my life back... If you want to be pampered and have your every desire for instant gratification met this may not be the place for you. If you want to do the real work that leads to recovery, to be held accountable, while being provided every opportunity to heal then this is the place for you. Thank you all for your commitment and unwavering dedication to my recovery. I’ll never forget you.
0x30da304634610d43_0x58f188f1dfd74579.author: Bin Met

0x30da304634610d43_0x58f188f1dfd74579.text: I really don’t have the words to fully explain how much this place helped me. It’s just something you feel when you’re there. The program has real depth, nothing fake, nothing rushed. They actually take time to understand you and your situation. Every person I met here truly cared. The counselors, nurses, kitchen staff, support team, everyone. You can tell they are not just doing a job. They want to help people who are hurting. I came in thinking my case was too complicated and that no rehab could really help me. I was wrong. After a little over two months, I left feeling more stable, clearer in my mind, and honestly happier than I’ve been in years. I got my life back. This place doesn’t give you shortcuts or quick comfort. You are expected to do the work, but you are never alone while doing it. If you want real healing and not just to be “treated,” this is the place. I’m very thankful for everything they did for me. I won’t forget it.
0x30da304634610d43_0x58f188f1dfd74579.author: Jacques Luong

0x30da304634610d43_0x58f188f1dfd74579.text: This is THE place to go to when you are struggling with addiction and/or mental health issues. All the people at the CABIN have one purpose and that is to meet you where you are in your process (mentally, physically, emotionally) and help you move forward. Very experienced, state of the art, caring professionals who work from a holistic approach that really creates change if you are willing to do the work. The family program that they offer for loved ones is an amazing support system where education on what addiction is and how to deal with it, and how to navigate yourself when someone around you is suffering from addiction, is so helpful. Dont doubt, sign up today. Get the help you need. All you have to do is send an email or call. You got this.
0x30da304634610d43_0x58f188f1dfd74579.author: Anke van kempen

0x30da304634610d43_0x58f188f1dfd74579.text: One of my best friends went to The Cabin for help with a cocaine addiction, and honestly, the change has been amazing. The support he got there was exactly what he needed. It’s been so good to have my friend back; clear-headed, focused, and actually happy again. Super grateful to The Cabin for giving him that reset. 0x30e29fd222121501_0x66d0aaa76d0dee95.text: I have suffered from back pain for around about 15 years, at times it has been bad but overall it was generally well managed with pain relief and physio. In September of 2018 this all changed when the back pain suddenly became unbearable and I was unable to walk unaided or even sit in a comfortable position. My sciatic nerve had been compromised due to a severely herniated disc and the pain was something I can’t describe. I had heard about Spine Connection through a friend that had recently travelled to Germany for surgery on her neck. I decided to make contact with them to see if there was something that they could do for me. I am so glad that I did, Jake Lemon was amazing. He asked me to provide him with x-rays and MRIs and came back to me within days advising that they were going to be able to help me. In fact, I was asked to be in Germany within 3 days as they were able to fit me in for an artificial disc replacement in my L5/S1. This was a great relief for me as I had been told by NZ Drs that I would have to have a fusion. Once I organised flights, Jake had taken care of everything else. My support person and I were collected by a taxi at the airport and taken to the hospital for some tests before being taken to our Accommodation. The fact that everything is taken care of was a great relief to both me and my support person. The whole process was seamless. Doctor Illerhaus met with me the day before my surgery to explain the process to me. He spoke excellent English and was able to explain things to me in a way that was both calming and reassuring. All the nurses were very caring and most of them spoke very good English. The hospital was clean and the staff were friendly. The only thing I struggled with a bit was the food but this was largely down to the fact that I was on a liquid diet, something I am not a big fan of. Post-surgery I remained in hospital for a week before being transferred to Medicos Rehab Centre. What an amazing facility! There is literally everything you need under one roof to get well on the road to recovery. This is attached to a hotel where we stayed. Once again all our meals were provided. Dr V and his team are amazing. He had me in fits of laughter during our appointments and immediately put me at ease. Recovery is not easy but having such an amazing treatment team around certainly helps. I formed some really great bonds with my team and could not speak highly enough of them all. Spine Connection have given me back my life. Without them I would still be waiting for treatment in NZ and it is unlikely that I would have the same mobility that I have now. I have even been told I can go back to riding my horse. I would not hesitate to recommend them to anyone who is suffering with pain in their back or neck. Every step is meticulously planned and goes off without a hitch. The team are professional, the hospital and rehab centre are amazing and the results are outstanding.
0x30e29fd222121501_0x66d0aaa76d0dee95.author: Jacqui Cleaver

0x30e29fd222121501_0x66d0aaa76d0dee95.text: Words can not describe how grateful I am to have meet Jake from Spine Connection. After years of suffering with neck pain that started to radiate down my arm and causing numbness, weakness and massive headaches everyday I knew I had to get this looked into. I spoke to my Father who recommended I look into Artificial Disc Replacement, however no-one here in Australia seemed to do it, and the Surgeon I had meet with here (not affiliated with SC) told me it was not possible and the only hope I had was to have a fusion done as it was my ONLY option. Sadly enough I was in desperate need to get rid of the pain and with boarder restrictions I thought fusion was my destiny, I'm lucky that due to a hospital glitch they refused my surgery here in Australia. I went back to Jake and sent through everything I needed for the Surgeons to look at my case, as I was not wanting to live through another winter with the pain, headaches and numbness for another winter. Within 5 days I had my answers from Jake and the Surgeons. I rang my parents who live in New Zealand at 10:45pm at night to tell them I had a date, my surgery was scheduled for in a months time. Jake answered all my questions I remember emailing him and within a few hours I had either a phone call or an email back. Once we where in Germany I kept in contact with Jake and he would email/message me to see how I was doing and ensuring I was doing well and if I had any issues I could contact him. The hospital staff were incredible and Susanne the liaison at the hospital was so lovely and made me feel very calm, and any issues or questions I could contact her when I needed. My surgeon Dr Illerhaus, he's an absolute crack up and a wonderful Surgeon, he answered any questions and concerns I had. After the surgery was completed I remember he came up to meet with my parents and I to see how I was feeling after the surgery, he explained to us that healing will take time (even though I was already excited that I could swing my head left to right in full motion which is something I have not done in MANY years) and that the surgery went according to plan C4-C5 C5-C6 Artificial Disc Replacement. Rehabilitation was next level at Medicos, you are treated so well by all the staff there.. My parents are excited that they have their daughter back after 22.5 years "the day you hit the bottom of the pool all the light went out of you, and here you are today 22.5 years on and your back with the light", my father told me this the day after my surgery, 2 months on I feel like a brand new woman, and I'm excited to see the next chapter of my life as healed woman. Jake, thank you again and your team you guys don't really understand how much of my life you have given me back.
0x30e29fd222121501_0x66d0aaa76d0dee95.author: Catherine Ross

0x30e29fd222121501_0x66d0aaa76d0dee95.text: I had three discs replaced in Germany in October 2018, two in the lumbar area and one in my neck. Jake did an outstanding job of facilitating the whole process. He responded to every question promptly; sometimes within minutes. When I had questions regarding the surgery, he ensured the German clinic answered them promptly and thoroughly. He also put in touch with former patients who had similar procedures in Germany, which really helped me make the decision to proceed with the surgery. He was in constant contact during my time in Germany, and when there was an issue with the airport transfer, he ensured we were fully compensated. I can’t speak highly enough of the service Spine Connection provides. Jake’s customer service is second to none. It is now five and half years since I had the disc replacements and I have nothing but issues with the lumbar discs since. Within twelve months of the original surgery an osteophyte formed. Jake did try to organise a trip back to Germany, but the borders closed. I recently learnt that the bone has grown over both disc replacements and they are effectively fused. I paid a lot of money to avoid a fusion and ended up with two anyway. Few people are candidates for ADR make sure you are suitable. I was told I was but I wasn't. The disc above the discs that were replaced has now herniated as a result of taking the load from the failed disc replacements. If you have been told you are not a candidate for a ADR by your local doctors, you probably aren't. Ensure you speak to the neurosurgeon and triple check that your joints are healthy enough to be suitable for an ADR.
0x30e29fd222121501_0x66d0aaa76d0dee95.author: Bob Thomas

0x30e29fd222121501_0x66d0aaa76d0dee95.text: As an American working overseas, I was inclined to simply return home and have surgery on my cervical spine because I was somewhat reluctant, and a little afraid, to have such a serious operation overseas. That said, however, after researching the Spine Connection and seeing the state of the art facilities and equipment, coupled with the cutting edge technological advances they are making, the decision to have the surgery in their Germany clinic became very easy for me. They provided an artificial disc replacement at C2-3, above my previous fusion and disc compression at C4-6, along with a disc decompression, fusion and artificial bone replacement at C6-7. Unlike my first surgery in the US, I was out and about the day after surgery, walking throughout the hospital and into town for lunch. The post-op guidance has been great and in six to eight weeks I will begin weight training again, albeit lightly as I work back to full strength. The staff were amazing, the facilities top notch, and perhaps the biggest selling point for me personally - the information provided through honest and ultra-responsive communications when attempting to make my final decision and to schedule the procedure. Through and through the Spinal Connection exceeded my expectations and I am so extremely happy I made the decision to select their clinic for my surgery. Dr. Illerhaus was my surgeon and was the absolute best!
0x30e29fd222121501_0x66d0aaa76d0dee95.author: Keith Marsland

0x30e29fd222121501_0x66d0aaa76d0dee95.text: After Jake organised a meeting in Sydney with myself and Dr Bierstedt, I walked out of that meeting knowing that he was the surgeon for me. All the way through my journey to surgery I found Jake to be a very supportive, professional and Jakes confidence in the process and surgical team alleviated any of my concerns about this major life changing surgery. All the milestones Jake said came true, even though to me at the time seemed too unbelievable. Milestones such as- that I will be able to walk on day 2 after the surgery, day 3-4 I will be able to walk up and down stairs and that after 2 weeks i will be able to get on a flight and fly back to Australia. All this seemed so surreal to me at the time, however it was all came to fruition. I also was impressed by how Jake and the team handled the whole Covid situation which certainly made the process a bit more complicated. I am thankful to Jake and all his support along my journey. He has always been very positive and never ever had any problem with me contacting him with my concerns however trivial they may have been.I am now 8 months post surgery and well on my way to living a fully active lifestyle which had been hindered for so long. I would highly recommend Jake to guide you back to your journey to better health.

0x30e29fd222121501_0x66d0aaa76d0dee95.text: As one of the first New Zealand patients to travel off shore for a double M6 motion preserving surgical procedure, Jake was instrumental in gathering all the data and communicating between Surgeons and myself, also linking me up with past patients to talk to. He was there prior to the trip over for guidance and highly supportive post surgery helping out with any queries. Prior to making the decision to travel to Germany, I actually flew from New Zealand to the Gold Coast, Australia to meet Jake at their office for myself - we discussed the process, past clients, the surgeons, their experience levels/history etc. I personally found Jake approachable and professional, accurate and understanding, and he gave me all the tools I needed to make an informative decision. I have already given a review of my excellent experience at the ONZ in Germany, and would recommend anyone contemplating a ‘fuse’ of the spine, to look seriously at the option of Motion Preserving surgery by surgeons who perform hundreds and not dozens a year.

0x30e2990813867e45_0xa76412effc5eb6f7.text: I had a snowboarding accident more than 10 years ago, which resulted in a T8/T9 spinal cord injury. In March 2026, I came to Verita Neuro in Bangkok for epidural stimulation surgery and spent 5 weeks at the clinic. From the very first online meeting, I felt supported, heard, and cared for. Making a decision like this is not easy, especially when it involves traveling to another country for treatment, but the team made the whole process feel much less overwhelming. Their communication was always professional, clear, and reassuring. What stood out to me the most was the people. Everyone at the clinic was incredibly kind, warm, and welcoming. It never felt like I was just another patient. The doctor, therapists, nurses, and clinic staff all treated me with genuine care and attention, and that made a huge difference during my stay. The 5 weeks I spent there were not only about the surgery and therapy, but also about feeling encouraged every day. The team created a positive and supportive environment that helped me stay motivated through the process. I’m very grateful for my experience at Verita Neuro. From the first call to the very end of my visit, I felt that I was in good hands. It was a professional, friendly, and truly heartwarming experience, and I will always appreciate the care I received there.
0x30e2990813867e45_0xa76412effc5eb6f7.author: Oleg Vorobiov

0x30e2990813867e45_0xa76412effc5eb6f7.text: I'm Marin and 3 and a half years ago I have cavernoma on my spinal cord that broke and leak on my spinal cord. It makes me more then 10 cm of presure on a spinal cord. After the surgury I can't move anything but my head. After 5 months I made my first step but without any fealings in my legs. After 2 years of that I was in Nerita Neuro for the first time Stem Cell treatmant. 10 hours after first treatmant of Stem Cell I put my leg on leg and finaly feal them touching....2 years after surgery. Now I'm finishing my 3 Stem Cell treatmant and I really belive it will get me back a lot more feal in my body. I have more power,stamina and endurance. This kind of therapy is the only thing that can help people to get back some normal life and to try their best. But without you work like crazy on your rehabilitation don't expect miracles. Team here in hospital is really nice and they know what they are doing. People with the spinal cord injury this is probably your last and only chance.
0x30e2990813867e45_0xa76412effc5eb6f7.author: Marin Ivezic

0x30e2990813867e45_0xa76412effc5eb6f7.text: My procedure (EES implants and Stem Cell Treatment) went well. Being SCI T6 paraplegic, Asia A I expected increased trunk control and being able to stand up for a certain time. My expectations were fully met and beyond I was able to walk with assistance. The surgery went very well and the consecutive hospital stay was pleasant. My quest to increased mobility just started and continuation of permanent exercise is needed to further improve. The staff of Verita Neuro is highly professional, forthcoming and super friendly. Their facilities were very good and I always felt well taken care of. I am looking forward to my re-mapping visit in Thailand in 6-8 months, depending on my further progress. Finally, I recommend this procedure and Verita Neuro to everybody who is willing to put in time and effort into their recovery as well to increase their mobility.
0x30e2990813867e45_0xa76412effc5eb6f7.author: Joachim Enenkel

0x30e2990813867e45_0xa76412effc5eb6f7.text: Big things often begin with small steps. This treatment may not be a complete solution, but it is an important and promising first step in the recovery process, and it gives us real optimism moving forward. It helps keep the legs and body in good condition and prepares the patient for future, more advanced treatments as medical options for spinal cord injuries continue to evolve. We are very grateful to the entire team for their excellent care, professionalism, and dedication to helping people in this condition.

0x30e29c0d015f3dad_0x6204451a2c016722.text: Excellent in all aspects. Regarding the MRI procedure, the problem is that during the procedure in the tunnel, patients can be frightened because they are unaware of the scary sounds. This is especially concerning given that patients are already anxious and afraid of serious illnesses. Having to repeatedly listen to the machine instruct them to breathe in and out and hold their breath is particularly distressing. Consider how frightening it would be for patients who don't understand and follow the instructions. Therefore, I offer the following suggestions: 1. Have staff explain to patients what will happen in the tunnel, including the noises and the instructions they need to follow. 2. Provide a document or guide for patients to read two to three minutes before entering the tunnel to reduce their fear and panic, so they can understand and follow instructions correctly. I respectfully submit these suggestions with good intentions.

0x305194866763e8cd_0x83cad44735f49997.text: After a scooter accident, I was taken by ambulance to Hospital Krabi. The doctors and nurses responded and treated me as best they could, taking into account the other patients. They did an X-ray, ultrasound and MRI. I was hospitalized for 4 days with suspicion of internal bleeding. The nurses and doctors took excellent care of me, I was bedridden. My boyfriend took care of me at the bedside the whole time and there was no problem with that. We had all the conversations through a translator, because we don't speak English or Thai. The only thing that was tiring for me was the heat and only fans, a large room with about 30 beds and a lot of relatives of the patients who are here 24/7. The staff was incredibly nice, smiling, dedicated. The longest part was waiting to complete the formalities with the insurance companies for payment of the hospitalization.
0x305194866763e8cd_0x83cad44735f49997.author: Martina Sveykovska

0x305194866763e8cd_0x83cad44735f49997.text: As a French couple visiting Krabi for a holiday, we needed to see a doctor for a respiratory infection. We were taken care of immediately upon arrival at this Krabi hospital, and despite the significant language barrier, the staff did everything they could to help us, tested us for COVID-19, and directed us to the emergency room to be seen by a doctor. The wait was very short, and the doctor's explanations were clear thanks to our willingness to use Google Translate. We were directed to the nurses, received our medication at the hospital very quickly, and settled the bill for our treatment (2420 baht / 66 euros for both of us). The staff were helpful, friendly, and attentive to our needs via Google Translate. They didn't hesitate to advise us to return to the hospital if any complications arose within two days. We highly recommend this hospital.
0x305194866763e8cd_0x83cad44735f49997.author: Denis ARIS BROSOU

0x305194866763e8cd_0x83cad44735f49997.text: The staff and nurses provide excellent service. The waiting area is at examination room 9 in the 65-year-old building. The air-conditioned ward on the ground floor is cool and comfortable. The nurses are diligent, especially in the mornings, helping patients' relatives change linens and bathe them. They work until late in the day; I feel tired just watching them. The private rooms on the 6th and 7th floors also have diligent nurses who provide good care and offer various recommendations. Plus, the view is probably one of the most beautiful in Krabi, better than most hotel views. The rooms are clean, and the housekeeping staff are hardworking. Another place that impressed me is the X-ray room (located in front of the shrine). The staff are lovely and very polite.
0x305194866763e8cd_0x83cad44735f49997.author: kenshin Himora

0x305194866763e8cd_0x83cad44735f49997.text: As a foreigner, I was greatly impressed by this public hospital. Yes, the building is old and some of the workers there can be a little rude, but they work hard all day, so it’s understandable that they might be tired. I went there because I was feeling pressure in my chest, and my doctor advised me to go to the hospital. They did a blood pressure test, a chest X-ray, and a heart test. After that, a doctor examined me and gave her diagnosis and medication. For all that, I paid 750 baht and stayed for around 1 hour and 30 minutes. Great service and an unbelievable price compared to a private hospital, where I would have paid around 30–40k for the same thing.
0x305194866763e8cd_0x83cad44735f49997.author: Mael Pitart

0x305194866763e8cd_0x83cad44735f49997.text: I have to come here regularly because it's the hospital near my home. 0x305194866763e8cd_0x83cad44735f49997.text: Visited Krabi Provincial Hospital when my wife was severely dehydrated, pale, and unable to keep fluids down. 0x30e29c1c288d6cbf_0xe7133e271b296c5d.text: From the outside, the building looks unremarkable, but once you step inside, you'll be impressed. It's clean, the air conditioning is just right (not too cold), there are ample restrooms, and the common areas are excellent. The bank area is separate, located in the office building, while the plaza has a McDonald's, a Watsons, and an air-conditioned night market. The first floor has a wide variety of shops, including beautiful clothes at reasonable prices, and a monthly showcase of stylish handmade genuine leather bags. There are also gift shops and cosmetics stalls rotating from Monday to Friday, along with Thai desserts and trendy food vendors. For those who want to eat, there's a food court on the 3rd floor. It's a one-stop shop for everything. The space is very well-organized.

0x30da3b1e647a28d1_0xa860ab4829c19e61.text: I stayed for 6 weeks at The Treehouse Retreat — and yes, it was truly life-changing for me. Coming from a phase where professional and personal responsibilities had completely defined my identity, I was battling anxiety, chronic depression and an overall low phase in life. This retreat gave me the calmness and space I desperately needed, while also helping me build a routine — with daily workouts and simple brain exercises. More than that, I learned to practice the basics: empathy, kindness, and love — which made me more mindful and humble each day. The weekly Thursday excursions felt like moments of freedom within the structure, thoughtfully designed within time slots. I highly recommend this place to anyone prepared to put in the work to become a better version of themselves. But let me clarify — this is not a place of instant magic. The team equips you with the right tools, but it is entirely up to you to practice, apply, and build positivity from them. The food, while simple and sometimes monotonous, is part of the process — and as the team rightly says, “trust the process.” I personally committed to a digital detox during my time here and brought along a few long-awaited books — which turned out to be the perfect companion for my downtime. One of my most significant realizations during this journey was: acceptance of your weaknesses can make life much easier. It’s essential to accelerate your strengths, but equally important to develop coping mechanisms for your weaknesses. Brain mapping was another eye-opener for me. I completed 20 sessions of neurofeedback in 6 weeks. However, the experts did mention that meaningful results usually show after 60 sessions — so I would suggest opting for these only if truly necessary and committed for 60 sessions. The staff here is incredibly friendly and supportive. I’m especially grateful for the sessions I had with Tony and John — both of whom guided me through invaluable reflections and personal revelations. Overall, my experience was transformative — but like everything in life, you’ll only get as much as you’re willing to put in.
0x30da3b1e647a28d1_0xa860ab4829c19e61.author: Suvidha Shetty

0x30da3b1e647a28d1_0xa860ab4829c19e61.text: When I first got here I thought I just needed like, a break from weed you know? Figured it was about cutting back or whatever, maybe learning some tricks to deal with stuff. But what actually went down was way deeper than I expected. I've been dealing with depression and anxiety pretty much my whole life. Weed became my go-to for numbing all that out, but it never actually fixed anything - just made things... quieter I guess. At The Treehouse they really pushed me to dig into the stuff underneath. All the old wounds and self-doubt and fear. God it was painful. There were definitely times I wanted to just bail, but I started realizing the real fight wasn't even with cannabis. It was with all these parts of myself I'd been running from for years. Writing my story down... man that nearly destroyed me. Had to look at all these moments I've been trying so hard to forget, left me feeling completely raw and exposed. But slowly - and I mean slowly - I began seeing these patterns. How the depression would just drag me down into this hole, how anxiety kept me totally paralyzed, and how weed was basically just this band-aid I slapped on everything. The Treehouse didn't like, magically cure me or anything. That's not how recovery works I guess. But it gave me tools and honesty and just... space to finally stop running from myself. I'm leaving here knowing the real work happens at home, and honestly? For the first time in forever I actually think I can handle it.
0x30da3b1e647a28d1_0xa860ab4829c19e61.author: Frank Wright

0x30da3b1e647a28d1_0xa860ab4829c19e61.text: It was a relief to find The Treehouse in Thailand. The location strikes a perfect balance – close enough to city conveniences and attractions for outings, yet wonderfully peaceful by the river with beautifully maintained grounds. The amenities, including the pool, gym, and yoga, are a definite plus, and the rooms are as comfortable as a good city hotel. However, the staff truly set The Treehouse apart. The nurses are incredibly understanding and patient. What struck me was that many of the support staff have personal experience with addiction, which allows them to connect with clients on a deeper level. I had the pleasure of meeting with the clinical manager, John, who was fantastic. He provided honest and clear updates on progress and consistently sent helpful email updates to my family. From my initial inquiry, Grace was exceptional, dedicating a significant amount of time over several calls to answer all my questions. Overall, I am very happy with the care and support provided by The Treehouse and wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone considering a stay for themselves or a loved one. It's reassuring to know such a dedicated facility exists here in Thailand.

0x30da3b1e647a28d1_0xa860ab4829c19e61.text: Review for Treehouse Treatment Centre I recently had the pleasure of staying at the Treehouse rehab Centre, and I must say, it was an exceptional experience. From the moment I arrived, I was greeted with warmth and professionalism by the staff, who made me feel right at home. I’d like to give special thanks to Emmy the nurse and Wine who works in the restaurant. Though I cannot forget Dr Tony, John, Jamie, Conan, Gigi, Pia, Tyler, Bryan, Note, Gabriel, Yamin, Bhum, Mate, Nigh, in fact the whole Team (I hope I haven’t forgotten anyone!) The facilities are top-notch, with beautifully appointed treehouses that offer a unique blend of comfort and nature. Each treehouse is equipped with everything you could possibly need, and the attention to detail is evident in every corner. The serene setting provides the perfect backdrop for relaxation and healing. One of the highlights of my stay was the variety of treatments available. The therapists are highly skilled and attentive, ensuring that each session is tailored to your specific needs. The holistic wellness program, at the Treehouse Treatment Centre has it all. 5 stars!!!
0x30da3b1e647a28d1_0xa860ab4829c19e61.author: Tim Hill

0x30da3b1e647a28d1_0xa860ab4829c19e61.text: My daughter was at the treehouse a few months ago and I just want to share how much it meant to us. As her mom I had watched her struggle for years, which was so hard and nothing ever seemed to help. When she went to the treehouse it was the first time I felt like she was truly safe and being understood. The counselor’s there were patient and caring through all her ups and downs. They didn’t give up on her, even when she felt like giving up on herself. I could see little by little she was starting to find hope again, and that’s something I hadn’t seen in her for a llong time. What really made a difference for me was that I was updated about her treatment every week and I could ask questions or ask about anything I was worried about to the clinical manager. A few days before she left the treehouse we even had a family zoom meeting with all of the treehouse team and we were able to plan for when she came home. Looking back now, I’m so grateful for the support she got at the treehouse. It gave her the chance to heal and gave me comfort and hope knowing she was finally in good hands.
0x30da3b1e647a28d1_0xa860ab4829c19e61.author: Casey Quinn

0x30da3b1e647a28d1_0xa860ab4829c19e61.text: Spent 6 weeks at Treehouse and it was lifechanging. I arrived burnt-out, fearful and anxious and left super fit, healthy and empowered. The location is amazing, on the River Ping with stunning gardens, mountain views and an icy refreshing pool. The rooms are amazing traditional teak huts with incredibly comfy fluffy four poster beds. The trauma based treatment covers education, group and individual sessions and is applicable to a broad range of issues. I'm not going to say it was easy. There were some days I didn't want to run up the temple stairs, do crunches or face my demons and be brave and vulnerable but you get out what you put in. The first week can be a little scary as you get used to the place but if you commit to the program and trust the process you will find your happy place again. I went specifically for EMDR and felt healed of trauma memories that had plagued me for years. Happy to be contacted if you want more detail but highly recommend this place.
0x30da3b1e647a28d1_0xa860ab4829c19e61.author: Epicphannys - with a silent C

0x30da3b1e647a28d1_0xa860ab4829c19e61.text: Fantastic service. Our youngest son has just completed 2 months at the Tree House and we have nothing but good things to say. The journey or recovery is a long and difficult one but John and the staff at the treehouse assign the right levels of tough love and counselling to guide each client to achieve their best version of themselves. 0x30da3f88bc8c6209_0xa04a1a288e25582.text: I have been to psychiatric units and rehabs over the world and my praise isn't easily earned. I can say with warm sincerity this sets the standard when it comes to rehabs. Especially as the price comparison with the UK and US I choose very wisely these days and was extremely hesitant to stray from Engalnd after a horrifying experience ce with a well know outfit in South Africa. The Hills was personally recommended and I phoned Peter directly. He gave me all the reassurance I needed with his honesty and candour, and I gor to talk to the psychiatrist about a potentially difficult prescription med taper. Luxury, food and shouldnt be the impetus to go to a rehab. Yet it helps. As for the money it's utterly ridiculous how such a beautiful place, sublime amenities, and all that can exist. More imlortantly the one on one therapy sessions were very good. I am complicated but was given great help and perspective by my therapist. What was new to me and something i have repeatedly shunned was the holistic aspect of recovery. Craig, a therapist, recommended a book “ the body keeps score” and thats where massage, tension release exercise, personal training, kickboxing, reiki sound healing, chats with monks and walks, excursions in nature as varied as white water rafting to waterfall hikes to thai cooking all have a part to play. Obviously they also have classes on the evidence based psychological techniques. I would have prefered these to be less lecture type though. I was happy to be in a group that was diverse but shared the common goal of wanting to get better, a given prerequisite one would think. And the community supportive and the surrounding, acres of apace, pools, open air Indeed it is not high security, so it also requires personal accountability and one wanting to get better. Although providing a safe, secure place to do so. If one wants to self sabotage and cause issues a more secure unit may be for yiu. And when I say safe, I also include the fact for such a facility it also has 24 hour trained nursing Staff, Physican and psychiatrist there daily and a hospital nearby. Which isn't always the standard. Overall, what i found stood out the most, was how they treated people with humanity and respect. Often not the case in rehabs

0x30e29ea792016663_0xc5fc704e9339d74f.text: Last Thursday, I had the opportunity to use their services. I hadn't read any reviews beforehand, but I knew about them from a friend who had previously undergone radiation therapy there. I was an emergency case; I'd been let down by a private hospital, but I was already preparing for radioactive iodine treatment, so I needed to find a new place urgently. When I called, the staff were incredibly helpful and provided excellent information. They checked for available beds and even spoke with the doctor on my behalf, as they had actually stopped accepting new patients that day (but the doctor was happy to take my case, so I got the last appointment of the day). Everything fit perfectly with my original treatment plan, which was surprisingly good and made me feel very lucky. Finally, after the phone call, I went straight to the center to see the doctor. I have to admit, the registration process, waiting for a queue number, and waiting to be called took quite a while compared to private hospitals (though from what I've read from others, mine was relatively quick). However, I understand that even though it's a private hospital, it's not the typical expensive one. They probably mostly accept cases from social security or government hospitals. The cost of radioactive iodine treatment here was more than half the price of the private hospital I initially spoke with, as was the consultation fee with the doctor. This place is almost four times cheaper than the private hospital we went to, so it's no surprise the service is different. Overall, of course, only one staff member we encountered had a slightly harsh tone, but not to the point of being aggressive. They provided normal advice and assistance, and didn't make us feel bad at all. I'll add more reviews after I've had my radioactive iodine treatment here. I couldn't find many reviews about this place.
0x30e29ea792016663_0xc5fc704e9339d74f.author: Pat Pat

0x30e29ea792016663_0xc5fc704e9339d74f.text: Before coming to use the service, we read the reviews. At first, we were worried because there were only negative aspects... Let me share my real experience when bringing my mother for treatment. The first day will be a bit slow, doing many programs, seeing the doctor, the doctor asked for a history and examined in detail. After that, the nurse took her to simulate radiation therapy, totaling about 3 hours. After that, they will make an appointment for radiation therapy, but the first day has not been radiation yet. The nurse will take her to simulate radiation therapy again, inform the schedule and make an appointment because it has to be done for 5 consecutive days, rest for 2 days, there are no holidays here. Today is not long, about 3 hours, and an appointment for radiation therapy is made for the next day. From arriving, putting down the appointment card, weighing, measuring blood pressure, waiting to be called, radiation therapy takes about 1-1.5 hours, not more than this (arrive at the appointed time, wait about this much, not an exaggeration). And most importantly, the staff and nurses take very good care of all the patients. This is my mother's 8th radiation therapy, and each time it has been good every time... Confirm that the review is from real experience as of October 5, 2025.
0x30e29ea792016663_0xc5fc704e9339d74f.author: Oranee Luangpimol

0x30e29ea792016663_0xc5fc704e9339d74f.text: Throughout April 2023, I had the opportunity (an opportunity I never wanted) to receive radiation therapy for stage 0 breast cancer at a small hospital, true to its name. On the first day, I went with a referral letter from my home hospital. It took a very long time (you could say I practically waited at the hospital). I got my turn, but didn't receive radiation therapy. Seven days later, I went again with another referral letter (requesting referral letters is very wasteful). I finally received radiation therapy on my second visit. There were so many patients, especially in the afternoons, many with patients in wheelchairs. The hospital always prioritizes patients who can walk normally over those who are not. There are few staff members, so be prepared for long waits. After the first treatment, subsequent treatments were much faster. The staff in radiation therapy room 1 were lovely and kind, mostly young people. I often bought snacks for them. I deducted one star because I think the hospital requested too many referral letters from the home hospital. Even after completing radiation therapy, you had to bring a referral letter to every follow-up appointment. This can be problematic for some patients who have to constantly run back and forth requesting documents.
0x30e29ea792016663_0xc5fc704e9339d74f.author: Sirinda Yothasiri

0x30e29ea792016663_0xc5fc704e9339d74f.text: I just finished my treatment and still have follow-up appointments. The hospital staff, nurses, and doctors here are all excellent and meet general standards. However, the management of time and patient queues is poor. I arrived in the afternoon to get a queue number for radiation therapy at 2 PM, but actually received treatment almost at 6 PM every day I used the service. There are so many patients! The hospital feels small compared to the number of patients it serves. They should limit the number of patients because there are far too many and it's very crowded. There aren't enough seats. Overall, the service is okay, the only thing I dislike is the excessive waiting time. 0x30e29facb7e28c31_0xbcb78e5cd1454ce2.text: To anyone who is afraid of painful dentist experience and do not have anywhere familiar to visit, I strongly recommend this place for your oral health care. Finally under a close friend's recommendation I decided to give this Dr a visit while visiting Bangkok for a short vacation. I arrived her place without appointment together with my girlfriend slightly close to noon and thankfully she has no appointment that day. She did a full scan of me and my girlfriend and seen that we have much to do, she urged us to go for quick lunch. After lunch she wasted no time and started working with my girlfriend's teeth as mine requires more time. She girlfriend's work took slightly over an hour and she experience obvious skill superiority compared to the dentist back in her own country. As for myself, she took the balance of the time which is around 2 hours to polish, fill up a more critical fillings and surgically removal of 2 molars and 1 wisdom. The only discomfort I felt throughout the procedure was during the polishing and I have felt nothing about those extraction process. After the extraction and under her recommendation, I took a pain killer pill and that was it until I visit another dentist back in home country 10 days later to remove the thread for the stitches.

0x30e29ee76f70e957_0xc3ffbb26a87e7ddf.text: I've actually wanted veneers for a long time because my teeth are yellow, and whitening only makes them yellow again quickly. From seeing many of the doctor's cases, their analysis and solutions were the most effective. When I met the doctor in person, she addressed my long-standing concerns about my crooked teeth and my incomplete smile. She analyzed my situation without me having to say much, and it was exactly as I thought. The results are beautiful and seamless, just like my natural teeth. No one around me knows I have veneers unless I tell them, because they look so natural. The doctor even taught me how to smile to complement my new teeth. I feel much happier with my new smile and am more confident smiling now. Another thing I appreciated was that the doctor didn't just focus on aesthetics but also prioritized dental health, such as bite alignment. She checked and adjusted my bite multiple times to ensure it was perfectly aligned and taught me how to use dental floss more effectively. If you're considering veneers, I highly recommend this clinic.

0x30e29f0045dd0ccd_0x83a6a03842ec8336.text: Adding to my review after getting filler dissolution here over 10 days ago. Previously, I had 10 filler injections (at another clinic), but I still had lumps under my eyes and on my cheeks. Here, the doctor tried to perform a very detailed and patient ultrasound examination. There were many spots they couldn't find, but I asked the doctor to fill them in anyway. The doctor was so kind and didn't want the patient to waste money. She was honest about where there was no filler left. But because I wanted to try it since after Ulthera and Oligiotherapy, there were areas where my face didn't lift or shrink, I asked the doctor to inject some fillers to make sure I had some relief. The doctor obliged. After more than 10 days, my face looks smaller. My left cheek that was sagging is now the same size as my right cheek, my sagging temples have sagged and lifted, and my under-eyes have improved. I'm very impressed with the doctor. She's so lovely, honest, and doesn't try to sell me courses or push unnecessary treatments. Please come to this clinic; the doctor is amazing! I hope this clinic becomes very popular soon. If you've been to other clinics and the doctors, assistants, and sales staff were pushy about selling courses, come here. You'll feel comfortable and at ease. The doctor explains everything in detail and gives incredibly thorough advice. She's so lovely! And the price is amazing—the best I've found, and it really works. Most importantly, she has a very gentle touch! The doctor was lovely, asking questions and showing concern, afraid I might be in pain the whole time. She explained everything in detail, was very gentle, and didn't push any treatments. She was straightforward about what should and shouldn't be done. So lovely! 0x30da3103e0dd4ddf_0x1ae4560ed2843f0e.text: I’d got myself into a bit of a rut after severely breaking my leg 4 years ago , my pain was intense to say the least and I was finding myself taking a lot of painkillers to try and manage my daily pain , opiates are great for pain but unfortunately they are extremely addictive and appear to cause pretty bad lethargy and tend to make one quite uninspired , unfortunately I’d become extremely lazy and was just plotting through life , having been quite fit in the past I’d managed to gain a lot of weight and was not happy with my appearance and lack of interest in anything, I needed a kick start big time . After speaking to Darren and telling him I needed to be reinvigorated and get off these painkillers him and I devised a plan , Darren is a good guy and he will give you a straight up answer . I knew what the jig was as ive danced this dance before . You will arrive at Jintara and they will have your roadmap ready , if you need to be detoxed from a certain substance they’ll do it for you slowly and safely depending on your poison , you will attend classes for 2 hours each week day morning , now these classes will guide you through why you do what you do , they will give you the tools you need to heal yourself and indeed there are sprinkles of gold dust among them ,the rest of the time you are exercising on your own terms at your own pace , with a plethora of extras including massage , Reiki , meditation, swimming , pickleball , Muay Thai and possibly most importantly your 121 councillor appointment twice weekly, it’s all there for you , you just have to give the program a chance . The food is fantastic, 3 professionally served nutritious meals daily and my fav , fresh fruit with every meal and if you wanna buy some junk food, you can as there are 7/11 visits and Rimping Supermarket on Saturday after the excursion, which is always pretty great . The Staff are fantastic and actually do care , the nurses Max and Oh are serious professionals who will take care of all your needs , the support staff are fantastic always smiling and happy to help , Tong , Tang , Nook and rest are great people , you’re Client Liaison will be June , she will take care of pretty much anything you need , June is a fantastic person and seriously great at her job always happy and Smiling and there to lent a hand , Infact they all are absolutely great and if you wanna get fit Lek is your man , I can honestly say I really liked all the staff members . Denise and Hannan and Rebecca are the therapists and they are all highly respected and skilled at their jobs , Denise most definitely helped me a lot with finding myself again . It took be a while to get motivated but once I did I found myself back in the zone again , I’ve been swimming and going to gym constantly for the past month and I can feel myself getting stronger and back to where I need to be , yeah ive got a long way to go but I’ve started , I’ve had the kick start which is 100% why I came . If you have any fears or reservations about coming to Jintara Rehab , don’t , it’s only 10 people max at any one time so you’re not just another number , you matter , they will get you on the the main road again , of course you will need to put in the work as well , im over a week out and honestly feeling the best I have in a long time
0x30da3103e0dd4ddf_0x1ae4560ed2843f0e.author: Dave Foxmill

0x30da3103e0dd4ddf_0x1ae4560ed2843f0e.text: Jintara review I came to Jintara and left feeling like I could beat addiction forever and learned to love and respect myself like never before. I really wish you reading this comment the best of luck as I partly feel I know what it’s like where you are now. I was so anxious and terrified about making the wrong choice going to rehab after hearing countless horror stories. I can truly say with so much confidence that Jintara was the best choice I could have made. Initially speaking to Darren I was very paranoid about going to rehab for the first time and being treated like a number, falling back to relapse and simply not getting what I needed, the healing and direction to start a better life. Of all the places I called, Darren was the only one who spent an hour with me listening to what state I’d gotten myself in and connected with me on exactly why his team could ensure my success. I probably think most people are salesy and Darren was no different but I was so wrong and have nothing but admiration for what he’s trying to do for people like you and I. I hated myself, I was lost and had thoughts of giving up. I’d resigned myself to never getting out of the hole I was in and was so confused about why I didn’t operate like a ‘normal’ person in life. One day I turned around in Jintara and realised all the work I was putting in, listening/contributing in group, forcing myself out of my room to socialise, participating in anything and everything, that I had begun loving myself, gaining confidence and felt there was a path forward. Jintara focused on providing a calm environment that offered me the chance to become physically, mentally and spiritually fit. I lost 9 kg, became very convinced of mindfulness and its ability to help regulate emotions and learned everything about addiction, why I fell into it and how to beat it going forward. They really do put the therapy first, and somehow make it extremely cost effective with the yummy meals, PT, yoga, Muay Thai, reiki, meditation and an environment with others looking to support each other constantly being prioritised so you are as comfy as you can be to focus on yourself. As of writing this I’m 90 days sober and not a thought of ever going back to substances. I really feel if you’ve suffered trauma in your life that this place is the perfect path for your recovery and if I could I’d jump on a call and tell you exactly why! I can’t so instead I hope this review gives you some peace that though there’s relatively few of them, the reviews say a lot about this place and how focused Darren and his team are on your recovery. I miss them all dearly and some really felt like family and friends by the end but I was excited to go home knowing I had a new life waiting to burst into. I wish you all the best and please make a choice you know will get you to a better place, Jintara was that for me x
0x30da3103e0dd4ddf_0x1ae4560ed2843f0e.author: James Bamford

0x30da3103e0dd4ddf_0x1ae4560ed2843f0e.text: Just over one year ago, my son was at a low point in his life. He was drinking to excess, was not concentrating on his university studies and was generally unhappy. He said to me that when he walked down the street, he hoped that a car would knock him over and kill him. One of his hobbies is golf and I had booked a tee time at a course that he was very keen to play but when the time came, he was unable to get out of bed. He came to us that evening and said that he really needed help and was ready to go into rehab. We sent him to Jintara and he stayed for two months. During that time, he participated in all counselling sessions and other activities, including exercising, playing badminton and going to the driving range. He came out a totally changed person. He set goals for himself, which he was keen to achieve. He wanted to stay clean and joined Alcoholics Anonymous to get a support structure. We said that he could go to a week´s refresher course at Jintara if he stayed clean for a year and this was a big incentive. He wanted to improve his golf game and get a lower handicap than his father (me). And he wanted to be successful in his degree studies. He has achieved all of his first-year objectives. He has been clean for over a year and continues to enjoy a clean life. His golf game has improved by probably 10 strokes (he is now better than his father) and he is taking his schoolwork seriously and is getting good grades. He is also a much nicer and friendlier person and he is physically fitter. It has not been an easy year. His old friends did not fully appreciate what he was doing and most of those are no longer in his circle but he has made a lot of new friends. We went to Jintara with him when he returned for his refresher course and met Darren and the staff and we were very impressed with their approach. They are very caring and have a system which works for those clients who put in an effort. They certainly laid the groundwork for Billy to successfully learn how to live with and control his addiction.
0x30da3103e0dd4ddf_0x1ae4560ed2843f0e.author: Frank Buck

0x30da3103e0dd4ddf_0x1ae4560ed2843f0e.text: I HAVE MY SON BACK THANKS TO JINTARA.... A little over a year ago, our son came to his father and me and said that the time had come, that he couldn’t go on the way he was going and that he needed to be in rehab. At that point, alcohol was winning – my beautiful baby had become a 33 year old alcoholic and it was destroying his life. School, relationships – even with me – were suffering. He was depressed and his life was out of control, and there was nothing I could do about it. Thankfully he asked for help – and we found Jintara. Less than a week later, he was on a plane to Chiangmai. For the next two months, he met with counselors, started exercising, and learned that he could have fun and enjoy life without drinking. There was no shame involved. The wonderful people at Jintara taught him how to be himself again, without alcohol. The change in him was nothing short of profound. Each time he called us (and the calls & WhatsApp chats were frequent), I saw a change in him. It started small and just kept growing. He was actually enjoying getting rid of poisons in his life. Somehow Jintara made it seem easy to us. Of couse, we know it wasn’t – but it did seem that way. He came home a changed person. He was able to focus on his studies, stick to a schedule so that he could get his work done, go to the gym, attend AA meetings, and make new friends who are happy to support him. Our son hasn’t had a drink in more than a year, and he went back to Jintara for a one week refresher to help him stay on track to continue leading a clean and sober life. I can see how proud he is of himself, I know how proud I am of him, and especially how thankful I am to Jintara for giving my son back to me. No matter how old your child is, they are still your child – and if your child needs help to fight an addiction, I urge you to talk to Darren and the people at Jintara. You and your child won’t regret it.
0x30da3103e0dd4ddf_0x1ae4560ed2843f0e.author: Jane Buck

I've had teeth cleaning many times before and never experienced sensitivity. After the procedure, I had sensitivity for several weeks. During the procedure, they don't have you get up to rinse your mouth; they use a suction tube to remove debris and water. 0x3102960c1bbe9a75_0x51049f5679f8113d.text: That day, we planned to take my boyfriend to get forehead injections first, rather than doing it ourselves. We thought we'd sit and support him during the procedure. The doctor said the procedure wasn't too scary, and we were so excited to be doing something like this together. When we entered the clinic, I sat next to my boyfriend, watching him with such a gentle hand and chatting with me the whole time. It put me at ease, and I was even more excited to see the results. After my boyfriend finished, he said it felt amazing. There was no redness or swelling, just a little tightness. I thought to myself, "Wow, this is better than I thought. Plus, my face looks brighter." When it was my turn, the doctor asked if I wanted to try it. My hands were shaking a little. I was both excited and a little shy, but I immediately agreed. When the first injection hit, I thought it would hurt a lot, but it was actually very mild. It only hurt a little. After the injection, I looked at myself in the mirror and loved it. My forehead looked much more defined and younger than I had imagined. In the end, I felt like the forehead injections had boosted my confidence. My face was smooth and natural-looking. No one asked what I had done because it turned out so perfectly. My boyfriend and I left the clinic with big smiles on our faces because it was such a fun experience we never thought we'd have together. 0x311d7b94bf69f80d_0xc8891142698d1093.text: I've taken my child to Baan Mor Clinic twice now, and this is my first review. The first time, my child had COVID-19. The counter staff were very polite and courteous; my child loved them because they were so friendly and played with my child. The doctor provided excellent advice. The second time, my child had RSV (Respiratory Syncytial Virus) affecting the lungs. The clinic tested for all kinds of illnesses, including COVID-19, RSV, and influenza. In the end, my child had RSV affecting the lungs, along with long-standing allergies. The doctor gave excellent advice, including how to manage the child at home during treatment, how to observe symptoms, and what to do if symptoms worsen. They also provided information on using and cleaning the equipment and supplies for treatment. This was something we had never received before, neither in private nor public hospitals. It allowed us to follow the 1234 procedures (referring to the standard 1-2-3-4 procedure) and care for our child thoroughly at home. For first-time mothers, this is the answer. This isn't a paid review; I'm a real mother who took my child to this clinic. As a first-time mother, I didn't know what to ask, but the doctor understood my feelings. The advice given was excellent, covering every step of childcare from the first to the end of the process. If we had any further questions, the doctor answered them clearly, making it very easy for us to understand. I was very impressed with the service from both the staff and the doctor. They provided exceptional care, truly attentive to the feelings of both mother and child. Compared to private hospitals, the cost was significantly lower. I was very happy to pay, especially considering the exceptional service from the staff and doctors, which was even better than some private hospitals. The price wasn't as exorbitant as I initially thought.

I was a little nervous about getting sth done outside of my home country but I’m not afraid of dental work in general. The stuff there was exceptionally friendly and calm, they had disinfected almost everything I touched because they cared about Covid. For my personal taste they overdid it with hygiene - but they were so nice about it it actually made me smile. The doctor was extremely nice and spoke English very well. He informed me about every step & also spoke in calm words even though my procedure wasn’t hurtful at all. But it showed me how much they respect their patients and I’m pretty sure even people who are afraid of dental work would have no problem being under their care. They filled out the form for my insurance and told me I could always come back anytime if there would be an issue. Also they were much cheaper than the same procedure would be in Germany and they‘ve honestly done a better job. If you’re having any tooth problems while staying in Phuket —> come here. 0x30502fc6982c85f5_0x6e170244b522173c.text: Good service, I was pleased with the results, even though the task wasn't simple. I had clicking sounds in the steering wheel when turning it back and forth in a certain position, even with a few centimeters of amplitude. I'd been to two other repair shops and an authorized Mitsubishi dealership with this problem. At the first, they said the steering rack needed replacing. I had my doubts; I could clearly hear clicking sounds in the steering wheel. At the second, I asked for a steering system diagnostic, and they said the steering rack was fine, but I needed to inspect the steering wheel. They couldn't do it themselves, so they recommended I take it to a dealership. So I went to an authorized Mitsubishi dealership for a precise diagnostic. They checked the steering wheel, lubricated it with silica spray, and said it was ready. I paid for the work and drove away happily. Ten minutes later, the clicking returned. I went back, they looked, then started telling me it was normal and that other cars had the same problem. Then they said if I wanted to eliminate the clicking, I needed to replace the steering rack, along with a list of 5-6 parts. I declined and found a nearby repair shop called CARVIA GARAGE online. Everything was professional and pleasant to deal with. They figured out the problem, ran diagnostics, and had to replace the steering column, the mechanism under the steering wheel. The steering rack is fine! Everything works as it should now! They didn't have to randomly replace parts that would still work, as other repair shops suggested, at my expense. I highly recommend them! I'll definitely be back if I need any repairs on my car.
