0x30e298de1103c6c1_0x84f6d07b169b5a01.text: This is a small hospital, not very large or spacious, mostly a public hospital under the Bangkok Metropolitan Administration in the Khlong San district of Bangkok's Thonburi side. The entrance features a statue of King Taksin and the hospital's patron deity. The area around the patient examination rooms and payment counters for medication and fees is busy. There's a single-story building inside with a 7-Eleven convenience store and a COVID-19 screening unit (visitors must arrive before 8:00 AM). It's located near the Khlong San intersection and the Khlong San station of the Gold Line BTS Skytrain. The ICONSIAM shopping mall is also a short walk from the hospital. During my recent visit, I saw the hospital's new building, constructed almost four years ago, now open. This four-story building houses the clinics: Gynecology, Pregnancy Checkup, Dentistry, Surgery, and General Medicine departments.

0x30e29475d4b91737_0xee46d1b5083c117b.text: If you book an appointment in advance, you'll likely have a long wait. If you want to proceed immediately, we recommend walking in before 7 am to get a queue number at the medical records counter on the 3rd floor. This will allow you to see a doctor that morning. Doctors start seeing patients at 9 am. If you get a queue number later in the morning (possibly after 9 am), you will see the doctor in the afternoon. There are no appointments available for new patients on Wednesday afternoons and Saturdays. We recommend walking in on Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, or Friday. 1. Go up to the 3rd floor to get a queue number. - New patients: Fill out a patient history form. - Existing patients: Just present your ID card. The staff will guide you through the next steps. 2. After receiving your VN slip from the 3rd floor, go down to the glass-enclosed room on the 2nd floor to have your blood pressure measured and wait to be called for screening.

0x30da3be0d7daaedb_0x93cd3f13f053086e.text: My husband and I are Americans from Miami, and we stumbled upon Sris through a mutual friend while honeymooning in Thailand. We had no idea we were about to have one of the best medical aesthetic experiences of our lives. Dr. Mook is simply exceptional. She’s knowledgeable, refreshingly transparent, and most importantly… she’s not trying to sell you anything you don’t need. I came in asking for Botox, and she looked me over and told me honestly that I wasn’t ready for it yet. That kind of integrity is rare anywhere, let alone at this price point. Between the two of us, I had the Doublo treatment and absolutely loved the results. My husband’s Botox came out flawlessly natural, exactly what you hope for. The clinic itself is spotless and modern, and the overall experience felt elevated in every sense. For context: I’ve had work done at high-end practices across Miami and have tried most of what’s trendy in the US. This surpassed all of it. If your aesthetic is “effortlessly natural” the kind where no one can tell” this is your place. We will absolutely be scheduling a visit on our next trip to Thailand. Worth coming to Chiang Mai for alone.

Most importantly, there are no salespeople around to sell you anything. None at all. No one bothers you at all, before, after, or during your treatment. If you want to know the price, they'll provide the information so you can make your own decision. The doctor is lovely, gentle, and offers excellent and thorough advice. In such a premium place, the prices are friendly, accessible, and very reasonable. Some treatments are even cheaper than at other clinics. I highly recommend making an appointment and trying this service. Evian mineral water is served, and you'll receive a welcome card with your name on it. It's so lovely. I highly recommend it from the bottom of my heart.

0x3102970053b8ba0f_0x68e2f9a09911ab4d.text: I visited the clinic complaining of tonsillitis. The doctor listened to me, examined me, and prescribed treatment. In addition to medications, he prescribed antibiotic injections every day. I paid for the medications and for the appointment with a truly professional and attentive doctor. The clinic is new, clean, and comfortable! When I arrived the next day to get the prescribed injection, I was told to see a general practitioner. They didn't tell me it would be a full appointment and would cost extra. The conversation went something like this: -What's hurting you? -You have it all on your computer, nothing has changed, but I'm already feeling better. I came to get my prescribed injection. -Okay, you can go get the injection; the door is over there. If I'd known it was a paid appointment, I wouldn't have spent two minutes there in this pointless conversation; I would have asked questions about my health. I have some related issues, but I planned to see the doctor myself after finishing the prescribed antibiotic treatment and then return for a follow-up examination once the acute infection had cleared up. I'd also like to thank the doctor and leave a good review, but unfortunately, they only gave me a receipt that didn't include his name and no information about diagnosis. I also liked the staff and nurses; they were very responsive and attentive. In conclusion, it would be much easier for me to buy the exact same medication with the same dosage in tablet form at the pharmacy than to pay for a pointless consultation every day when I'm already prescribed injections. Perhaps this was a system error, as the clinic is new and the workflow processes may not be in place. I hope management sees my review. In any case, I'll give them 5 stars, but be careful if you go here: ask about the cost of all services before they do anything, otherwise you might get a completely different bill at the checkout.

0x30503bcf5cd50e31_0x97ded78604f7995e.text: I had a fantastic experience at Alpha Patong Clinic. The staff is incredibly friendly and professional, and what really sets them apart is that they don’t try to sell you treatments. Instead, they focus on what could be done, explaining your options clearly without pressure. Unlike many places, they don’t push you into making a decision on the spot. After discussing possible treatments, they simply hand you a price list so you can think it over and do your own research before committing—something I really appreciated. I did a Botox treatment here and have done it for many years in Sweden, so I know how it should be done and what to expect. The doctor was very professional, and her staff made sure I was comfortable throughout. Another big plus is that a follow-up appointment is included in the price. When I missed mine, they immediately rescheduled it without hesitation or complaints. At my follow-up, I mentioned that I was happy with the results but wondered if more could be done. They carefully examined me and, to my surprise, offered an additional touch-up free of charge to ensure everything looked perfect. There are a lot of tourist traps in Phuket, unfortunately, but this clinic is the real deal. If you want professional, ethical, and high-quality aesthetic treatments in Phuket, I strongly recommend Alpha Patong Clinic!

0x30da3b0aa0a8fd97_0xb165e7500eb0439b.text: Today, I took my mother to the doctor and observed a patient with low blood pressure. The patient's blood pressure eventually dropped to around 80/40 before the patient was finally picked up. What impressed me most was her coordination in contacting the stretcher bearer. Her enthusiasm, attention to detail, and unwavering dedication to helping the patient demonstrated the spirit of a nurse who prioritizes patient safety. I would like to express my sincere gratitude to Nurse Sasikarn Rojchanaratnangkoon for her dedication, sacrifice, and heartfelt service. It was a truly impressive experience.

0x30e29e7f222a175f_0x82dc3d1151077c02.text: I wanted to review my dental visit, hoping it will be helpful for first-time visitors. First of all, the dental staff were all lovely and provided excellent service. I highly commend them! 1. For those who want free dental treatment, you can use your National Health Insurance (NHI) card. People from outside Bangkok can easily transfer their NHI to Bangkok themselves. Just search on Google. Once transferred to Bangkok, you can use your NHI anywhere. 2. The dental clinic has two sessions: morning and afternoon. They accept 5 patients per session, so expect a long wait. - For the morning session, you can book an online appointment (I can't attach a picture, so try checking at the center) or walk-ins before 8:30 AM. I recommend arriving by 6:00 AM. - For the afternoon session, I recommend walk-ins only. Staff will set up a queue system at 3:45 PM. I recommend arriving before 3:45 PM because people will already be waiting. If you arrive late, they won't accept more patients. —————— Additional information: For general illnesses, there's an evening session opening at 4:00 PM. You can arrive by 3:30 PM. There are staff available to provide guidance.

0x3050256546909393_0xf514ba707638407.text: Dr Sarawut is a great dentist who cares about what is best for you and not what make him the most money. Prior to a trip to Phuket I went to a dentist in Brisbane and was told I needed a root canal and that the tooth could not be saved so I would need to implant/crown. I decided to wait and see what it would cost in Thailand. I made the rounds of several dentists and chose Dr Sarawut even though he was not the cheapest. When he examined my tooth he confirmed that a root canal was necessary but that he would be able to save the tooth, "you do not get rid of your own teeth unless there is no alternative" he said. I was impressed. On my last visit I had a cavity on the side of a wisdom tooth that was right at the gum line so could not be filled. Dr Sarawut told that the tooth would need to come out but told me wait and do it back in Australia, he said "you are on holiday so you do not want to ruin that with getting a wisdom tooth extracted." Again, more concerned with what was best for me than making money. When I did get it removed back in Brisbane I understood what he meant and was thankful for his advise. I am going back next month to have my amalgam fillings replaced. By the time I included the cost of airfare and accommodation I will probably be paying close to the same as I would in Brisbane but Dr Sarawut is worth it. If you are visiting Phuket and want/need to get dental work done then do yourself a favour book an appointment with Dr Sarawut.
0x3050256546909393_0xf514ba707638407.author: Don Ostapov

0x3050256546909393_0xf514ba707638407.text: FYI - I am Kenans wife I had an excellent experience with Dr Sarawut and team. From the moment I walked in, the lovely reception was warm and welcoming and made us feel so comfortable I initially visited for a consultation about replacing missing teeth Dr. Sarawut took the time to thoroughly evaluate my situation and offer honest advice. I originally went in expecting to get dental bridges to address some missing teeth — something I was ready to move forward with. But after carefully examining my situation, Dr. Sarawut gave me honest, thoughtful advice: he recommended doing Invisalign first to correct my bite and alignment. It was clear that this recommendation was made in my best long-term interest, even though it meant losing immediate business for the clinic. He also did a few fillings during my visit, and the work was done incredibly smoothly and professionally—no discomfort, no stress, just efficient, kind and careful treatment. My husband also received treatment at the clinic earlier in the year and had a similarly positive experience. He had several crowns done, and the results were excellent. He was very satisfied with the quality of care and the outcome. It’s refreshing to meet a dentist who prioritizes patient care and integrity over profit. I’ll definitely be returning for future treatment and would highly recommend Dr. Sarawut to anyone looking for trustworthy, high-quality and ethical dental care.

0x30e29915e608d13d_0x53d22a6507eaf063.text: The doctor is very kind, polite, and friendly. The prices are excellent. I highly recommend this place! More information: Pisit Clinic, located in Soi Ban Dok Mai (near Worachak and Khlong Thom), is considered a legendary clinic, especially among older generations and people in inner Bangkok. Here's some history and interesting facts about the clinic: The Beginning and Reputation The Era: This clinic has been operating for many decades (probably more than 40-50 years), since a time when access to specialist dermatologists wasn't as widespread as it is today. Expertise: It's widely known for its "treatment of skin diseases," including acne, melasma, freckles, rashes, and various chronic skin conditions. Unique Feature: Pisit Clinic's defining characteristic is its own "medications," especially its acne treatment solution and moisturizing creams, which many people recommend as "effective" at affordable prices compared to modern beauty clinics. Atmosphere and Charm of the Clinic Classic: The clinic is located in an old shophouse in Soi Ban Dok Mai. The interior retains the simple atmosphere of an old-fashioned clinic, without luxurious decorations. But the focus is on friendly and personalized treatment. Waiting lines: In the past (and even today), it's known for its very long queues. Some people have to wait from early morning to get a chance to see a doctor. Even ordering medication by mail for customers from other provinces is very popular. Why has it survived? Even though there are many beauty clinics in shopping malls nowadays, Pisit Clinic still maintains a loyal customer base for several main reasons: Treatment results: Targeted treatments and uniquely formulated medications. Affordable prices: The cost of treatment and medication is not high, making it accessible to all groups. Word of mouth: From generation to generation, children are often brought to see the doctor here, following in their parents' footsteps. Additional note: Soi Ban Dok Mai itself has a long history. It's an old community famous for making fireworks and firecrackers in the past. Going to see a doctor here is like stepping back in time to experience the atmosphere of old Bangkok. I'll take pictures and share them later.
0x30e29915e608d13d_0x53d22a6507eaf063.author: Boywatchara

0x30502f1004b40d8b_0x745fb6643f65d2e.text: I’m in Thailand and needed to get a Thai driver’s license. For that, I needed a medical certificate, so I went to the nearest place for me: Thiti Clinic. I’d read some negative reviews saying the staff were impolite or rude, but I reminded myself that I’m in Thailand and the official language isn’t English—so it would be unreasonable to expect literary, eloquent English from everyone. As a tourist and guest, it’s my job to make communication easier. Since I don’t speak Thai yet, I asked GPT to help me write a polite message explaining what I needed: that I’m a tourist, I need a driver’s license, and I require the medical papers—could they please help and what should I do? At reception, a staff member named Fatima (wearing a hijab) and her colleague Kimberly were very nice. For context, I’m a pretty intense customer—I have some temper issues and I’m not always the most pleasant person—but they stayed polite and helpful. When I said I don’t speak Thai (I know about four words), they even helped me learn a few. The procedure was very fast—no more than five minutes—smooth, and Fatima was smiling. I don’t want to point fingers, but sometimes our experience depends on how we treat people. Maybe we should first ask ourselves how we’re treating others; they might just respond accordingly. My experience here was really good and even a bit fun. Thank you! I received my medical certificate after a proper check.
0x30502f1004b40d8b_0x745fb6643f65d2e.author: Taras

0x30502f1004b40d8b_0x745fb6643f65d2e.text: I came to get my ears cleaned. The whole process took less than an hour, including the wait. It cost 780 baht for both ears. I'm not sure if you could pay by card, but you can definitely use a QR code. The doctor is a pleasant man and speaks English well enough to understand each other, so I gather he's a jack of all trades. Other comments said the woman at the reception desk was rude. I can't say she was rude to me, but this isn't a Bangkok hospital. When she was putting a blanket on my shoulders, she painfully caught my hair with a clothespin and left. But the doctor, at my request, adjusted everything and apologized. Perhaps she wasn't being mean, but just tired from the sheer volume of work. Basically, if you're not rude to her, she won't be rude to you either. For some basic cases, it's definitely an okay place in terms of price and quality. Also, the opening hours at the time of my visit are slightly different from those on Google Maps. They have a sign on the door that they're open until 12, and then from 5:00 PM, not 5:30 PM. So you can show up right at 5:00 PM and there won't be much of a line. UPDATE: I got an ear infection there and had to treat it for the next three weeks.

0x3050310056e23503_0x758bae233a4339a8.text: Dr Kitisak and his team seamlessly continued my treatment as I moved to Phuket following a complex break and subsequent long term treatment. They immediately understood the extent of the damage, reviewed my treatment up to that point, and from the start each and every session has been tailored to my rehabilitation as well as my needs that day, including treating other unrelated injuries or issues that ever crop up. The physical massage is expertly reactive to both what I feel and what they can feel in the moment. They seem to have a wide range of equipment, including the ultrasound and electric therapy that I need; facilities and amenities are on par with those I experienced at the private hospital in the city where I moved from. I love the fact I can buy sessions in batches which further help save money on the already reasonable prices, as well as the fact that you don't have to make an appointment and can turn up to suit your schedule. And with long opening hours throughout the week, it is easy to get treatment to fit in with all your daily commitments. Location is easy to find with plenty of parking in the car park behind - you can get a pass from the physio to cover the parking. With excellent English, communication is also very easy. Highly recommended.

0x30e29f295233ef5d_0xfb6062ce4f50e68d.text: Definitely a top clinic managed by incredible staff who went above and beyond to ensure my recovery was smooth. 0x30e29f295233ef5d_0xfb6062ce4f50e68d.text: Had a tummy tuck and another minor procedure on June 3rd, 2024 with Dr. Theerapong. Eight months later, and... While I'm still waiting on the scars to fade, I have my body back, and feel so much more confident now. It is hard to accurately convey just how profoundly talented Dr. Thee is as a surgeon. I live in Florida, one of the most popular places in the world for plastic surgery - and multiple local doctors have independently commented that the work Dr. Theerapong did is superior to anything I could have gotten done locally. Any discussion of Interplast is incomplete without mentioning the post-op care and attention provided by Lan. She's one of the kindest, sweetest, and most attentive people you'll ever meet. I still cherish those memories and am thankful to have met her. Something you should know - this is not Dr. Thee's fault and there does not appear to be anything to be done about this, apparently the nicer hospitals significantly infringe upon a surgeon's freedom - but my experience with hospital staff was a bit rougher than I had bargained for. Fortunately - Lan and Dr. Thee got me out of there as soon as possible!

0x30e29f295233ef5d_0xfb6062ce4f50e68d.text: I had a procedure with Dr. Theerapong. I had a wonderful experience. Support staff was attentive, friendly, and helpful in walking me through the whole process. They corrected a physical insecurity that had been bothering me for years. Happy with the clinic, I would go back.

0x30e2996d52061a81_0x53a4da543fc6426a.text: We were recommended this clinic by our hotel. My partner and I both had road rash from a motorbike accident, I wasn't too bad but he had quite severe wounds. The nurses are very professional and friendly! They speak quite a bit of English and they spend a lot of time on each wound to make sure they are clean and are gentle unlike a lot of clinics (who rip off bandages that are stuck to open wounds, tearing off healing skin). Some clinics are known to give medicines that aren't needed to get extra money from you but this clinic didn't. They had to scrub our wounds, which sounds awful and was at other clinics, but they made this experience so much easier and comfortable. This clinic isn't too expensive, but more than average. BUT you get what you pay for. I felt our wounds after a week were not healing but the first day after we went to this clinic our wounds were so much better and we could see they were healing and they felt much better. We came from Phuket (where the accident happened) which we went to a couple of different clinics and they were rough, expensive and didn't clean or dress the woulds correctly. We highly recommend this clinic! They accept travelers insurance also and are open 24 hours! We sometimes see one of the nurses around and she always says hello!

0x30da30780b28da6d_0x41d0f60fb7e80194.text: On November 5th, 2019 (today), I brought a relative from Phitsanulok to see a doctor. We traveled since 4 AM. Upon entering the hospital, I was very impressed with all the staff. - First, the security guard politely helped us find parking. Once we found a parking spot, two people quickly came to help direct us, and another person in civilian clothes (probably a member of the public) also helped. They were all very cheerful and provided excellent service. I even felt guilty for not buying them coffee because I was busy checking on my patient. 1. The first point, the man in the yellow uniform at the registration point, was very helpful and attentive. 2. The point where we filled out the medical history information, was also very helpful. He urged us to fill it out quickly because he was worried we wouldn't make it in time for the morning queue. He did his best, and we managed to get in on time for the afternoon queue (very impressed, worth the wait). 3. The new patient registration point was good. 4. The screening point, queue B, number 2, was very polite to everyone. 5. The man (or woman) at the social welfare office provided excellent service, was very helpful and polite. 6. The doctor at the social welfare office was very polite and gave excellent advice. 7. Dr. Wachana, who examined me in room 4, gave excellent advice. I forgot my medical certificate after the examination and went back to request it, but he was still very helpful and not annoyed at all. 8. The finance department provided good service and the staff were polite. 9. The pharmacy counter (front counter 8, male staff member) provided excellent service and advice. After receiving my medication, I forgot something and went back to have the medication description written down. He wrote it for me and gave helpful advice with a smile. 10. The referral room for patients returning to their place of residence provided excellent advice and service. Everything was completed with a smile on everyone's faces. The service was incredibly impressive. Everyone was chatting amongst themselves. It would be wonderful if all hospital staff were like this. Everyone was tired, but they had a great spirit and excellent ethics. Usually, you only see this in luxurious, expensive hospitals in Bangkok, but even those aren't always good in every department. The only places with excellent service in every department are 5-star hotels. But this hospital made me and my companion feel better than we would at a luxury hotel. There was more than just smiles and service; there was genuine sincerity and a feeling of genuine kindness from within. Thank you to everyone, and thank you to the director for selecting such good staff to serve the public. I will remember this day and continue to support everyone. Oh... and thank you to the relative of the patient I was with as well, while I was looking for the restroom. They were also very helpful, even walking me to the restroom. Driving there and back was tiring, but I was incredibly impressed. It's beyond words. Somkiat Chainbarameetham
0x30da30780b28da6d_0x41d0f60fb7e80194.author: somkiat chaiyabarrameetham

0x30da30780b28da6d_0x41d0f60fb7e80194.text: I was admitted to this hospital as emergency three years ago as I was Full of emotions due to very horrible experiences could not control myself and known myself at Thai Burmese border near Mae Hong Son while I was in Thailand. I am agree that the standard or normal service that you will have to stay and sleep with more than 20 patients in one large room and the staff are very strict so the standard or normal service of this hospital is a little bit touch for as foreigners to hand on but cheaper, I stayed 10 days including upgrade service costed me only 20,000 Baths. Therefore if you or your family member want the treatment from this hospital, I am strongly suggest that use the upgrade services which is only available upon the request. 0x30da3d13ad38fb1f_0x744c2a28a197b0ed.text: ☺️ If anyone is thinking about trying acupuncture, I highly recommend it. I've tried many treatments for 15 years – medication, injections, massage, traction, physical therapy – but nothing improved my lower back, neck, and stomach pain. I didn't try acupuncture until now because I was afraid of needles. But I didn't want to take medication anymore because it constantly irritated my stomach. People who were cured recommended acupuncture, so I decided to try it. It turned out not to be as painful as I thought, and not as dangerous as I imagined. I felt better from the first session. Since my condition was severe, I bought a 10-session course – it was amazing!😃 Even an ant bite hurts more, I'm telling you!😁 I've recommended acupuncture to everyone I know (people with pain, stress, insomnia, difficulty conceiving, those who want to look good and control their weight). I've recommended many friends and family members to see the doctor for 3-4 years now. The staff and the doctor are all wonderful. There's relaxing music. The prices aren't expensive here. Don't suffer any longer; try it, and you'll overcome your fear of needles forever.

0x30e287291c67c955_0xf68b2c7d14b8a5c3.text: I once had Chikungunya. After recovering for two weeks, I had severe joint pain in every joint and couldn't sleep. The pain was even worse in the mornings; I couldn't get out of bed and needed my children and husband to help me get dressed because my arms and shoulders ached so much. I went to two hospitals, received injections and medication, but the pain returned after 1-2 days. I cried myself to sleep for two months. My husband, recommended by a friend, took me to see this doctor. I received acupuncture, injections, and medication. The next morning, the pain was almost gone; I could even shower and get dressed myself. My husband, who brought me here, couldn't believe it! I also had an allergic reaction to the doctor – a rash of small, itchy blisters that were painful, sometimes bleeding, and peeling, almost completely obscuring my fingerprints. Now, two years later, I'm finally recovered and have no more appointments. I am so grateful to the doctor; he is incredibly skilled and compassionate. My husband's back sprain healed completely after just one acupuncture session. A friend from abroad also recommended the doctor, and their frozen shoulder cleared up in one session without surgery. Unbelievable, right? If you're experiencing something similar, come and see this doctor; you'll see I'm not exaggerating.

0x30503aa248747279_0xe0ff9b6f01619ceb.text: Super clean, the staff are very kind and very efficient. Everything is clearly labelled in Thai and English, often also in Chinese and Russian. I find the prices really cheap. If you don't have an appointment, you get a number on your form when you take your vitals (automatic blood pressure/ heart rate/etc test machine) and register. The nurses will call you by number and name. They will make sure to call in a way you understand if you aren't Thai, so don't worry about language barriers. The doctors and nurses speak perfectly understandable English. The doctor even filled out my care recommendation in English. In the winter, a kind man from Switzerland is at the information desk to help you find your way around. Do note that the nurses have a lunch break ending at about 13:00, with the doctors' break ending at about 13:30, so for non- emergency cases I recommend you come in the morning. There is a very cute garden smoking area with some animals and a stone table with a chess board on it. If you stand facing the blue atm (pictured) and look to the right you'll see it just next to the ramp. I hope I don't get injured again (I walked into a low concrete structure lol), but if I do I'll feel safe and happy coming here! Lastly, please consider putting whatever you can in the donation boxes in the two large halls on either side of the hospital this is a state hospital with not much funding and they are doing an amazing job!
0x30503aa248747279_0xe0ff9b6f01619ceb.author: Alice S

0x30503aa248747279_0xe0ff9b6f01619ceb.text: I would like to explain how patient care is prioritized at this government hospital, especially for foreign patients. All patients are first assessed by medical staff and classified as clinically stable or unstable, based on basic evaluations such as vital signs. • If your vital signs are stable, you will be directed to the Outpatient Department (OPD). • If your vital signs are unstable, you will be managed in the Emergency Department (ED). As this is a government hospital, medical resources and staff are limited. Therefore, priority is given to severe and life-threatening cases, such as patients who are unconscious, require intubation, have severe trauma, or conditions that may result in organ loss. For this reason, long waiting times—especially at night—are normal, particularly if your condition is stable, such as having cough, fever, or mild symptoms that have already been evaluated by medical staff. If you prefer faster service, you may choose to visit a private clinic or private hospital. However, please be aware that the cost will be significantly higher compared to government hospitals, which provide more affordable care. Thank you for your understanding. Please take good care of yourself—and always wear a helmet when riding a motorcycle.

0x311d6fe104b8c3c7_0x6f1f99bafd352154.text: She's a beautiful woman, after all. No matter where I sit, I have to cross my legs. It wouldn't be a problem for a moment, but out of habit, I had to cross my legs as soon as I sat down. This time, it wasn't just for a moment. I was sitting cross-legged. While I was sitting at my desk, I suddenly felt pain in my left leg, and it was tingling in my knee. When I tried to stand up, it hurt so much that I had to straighten my leg out. It was like the universe knew. This led me to see the doctor at Sala Prapak Thai Traditional Medicine Clinic... Well... the name alone should make me feel relaxed and comfortable... When I arrived... I was relaxed. I didn't have to circle around ten times looking for parking, like you usually do at other clinics. And when I arrived at the clinic and saw the doctor, oh my... my leg must be so sore. She's like an angel... beautiful, with a sweet smile, gentle, and kind. They even offered me snacks. We talked and took my medical history in a gentle, warm manner. Ahhh... time to get into bed! The angelic doctor chose a Thai massage treatment... but I was confused. Thai massage involves using two pieces of wood to pound the body. But why doesn't it hurt? And the rhythmic sound of the pounding is beautiful. I was about to fall asleep, but the doctor kept asking about my symptoms and examining me constantly, asking where and how it hurt. He also used massage and stretching techniques, which helped me stay awake. In the blink of an eye, the treatment was over... Whoa... My knee pain from climbing the stairs was gone. Stretching my leg relieved the pain... I could walk like a baby... There it is... the angel doctor... One treatment and I'm so comfortable. Her clinic is called... Sala Phloen Phlu. Thank you, angel doctor, for helping my knees and legs function normally again... and remember to follow your advice: don't sit in the wrong position again, or it will come back... Yes, doctor... but if I'm not sick, can I just come and talk to you? Angel doctor...

0x30da300ed597ac63_0xd4e939804144f7a8.text: I came to Chiang Mai memorial hospital on a Sunday after having had a red body rash, all over and feeling so very sick for 4 days. I was treated excellently from start to finish by all hospital personal, but especially by Dr Chainarin. He gave lots of test, importantly, an early blood test to confirm I had contacted Dengue Fever!( I had previously seen a doctor at another hospital who said it was an allergic reaction and gave me antihistamines and cream, which did not help!) After the dengue diagnosis which included a chest X-ray, it was suggested that I could stay overnight if that was helpful. I was very dehydrated and potassium deficient as well as super teary. I was processed quickly and given an intravenous drip full of redyradtion medicine and given a number of options to ease my extremely itchy skin. This morning, I feel almost normal after feeling dreadful for a few days. Dr chainarin was also kind and warm- his English is good and when we were at a word impasse. Google translate was perfect. I highly recommend Chiang Mai memorial hospital and particularly Dr Chianarin. They were also transparent with all the fees each time a new procedure was initiated. Thankyou for my health back- it means soooo much!

0x310295fd3d409c75_0xc6ca5c6bf34ef81.text: I rarely leave reviews for anything. Frankly I usually cannot be arsed. Unless I feel really compelled to do so. In this case, having seen some of the reviews here, which are mostly positive, but a few horribly and unnecessarily negative reviews I thought I would make an exception and offer my input. I am the clinics longest running patient, I was 50/51 when I first walked in when they opened up 9 or 10 years ago and I have been on a monthly program ever since. I am now 59. And I am doing great. Thats largely thanks to Dr Tim and his great team. I pay my money every month and I get ongoing monitoring and adjustments to treatment as and when needed. The first step was to fix the problems and then its ongoing maintenance from then on. I am not a body builder - that was not my reason or purpose in seeking help. I came to see Dr Tim because I have multiple chronic immune system disorders caused by heavy and prolonged chemical exposure at age +/- 20 which basically screwed up my hormones (among other things). Since age 27 I have been on TRT therapy plus Cortisol (for Addisons disease) and Thyroid hormones (hypo). I have had dedicated endocrinologists in the UK, in Hong Kong, Spain, and Bangkok (Bumrungrad hospital) - basically anywhere I have lived long term I have needed professional monitoring and support - literally if I don’t take my meds correctly I die. It’s that simple. Let alone being able to have an active sex life or have a great body. Staying alive and well is my first priority. I have had to educate myself along the way - even my previous endocrinologists and other doctors have acknowledged that I am a very rare case. No less than 6 autoimmune disorders. Ergo at this point I know more about the totality of my condition than any single doctor I have ever met. And yet I live a normal, VERY active life (wink wink, if you know what I mean). I look better, I feel better and life is good! Thanks to Dr Tim and his team. Because of my past experiences (my medical files in hospitals around the word are probably thousands of pages by now) I have learned to question everything - especially advice and treatments offered by various so called medical professionals (albeit seemingly highly qualified). I was told, at age 27, by my then consultant at Derriford hospital in the UK, that I would be in a wheelchair within 2 years because of my disorders, He gave me antidepressants and that was it. Of course I ignored his advice and never went back. I realised there and then that the mainstream medical profession wasn’t there to help me and I learned to question EVERYTHING. What I have especially appreciated with Dr Tim is that he actually LISTENS. And he really doesn’t mind when I question something (as I often do). That’s a key part in understanding any problem and then being open minded about the solution. It’s like teamwork. He works with you to find the best way forward. In my case the solution was fundamentally about changing to a healthy diet (avoid anything that is processed basically) and tweak and maintain the hormones to optimum levels. The diet part is easy, I didn’t need the clinics help for that. The hormone part is very very complex obviously and that’s where I really needed help. In my experience Dr Tim is always totally professional and methodical in his approach. At the same time he is not afraid to think ‘outside of the box’ - which is just what I needed. I see a few silly complaints on here about price - which seems like nonsense to me - the reality is they are neither expensive nor cheap - fairly priced I would say. To my mind the price is irrelevant anyway. What price can you put on your health and quality of life? My case is extremely complex to say the least. If Dr Tim and his team can handle me and fix my problems, which they have, then I think any relatively normal person should have no doubts whatsoever about the service here. Happy to confirm anythign if any one has doubts - ask the staff for my cell phone.
0x310295fd3d409c75_0xc6ca5c6bf34ef81.author: Martin B

0x310295fd3d409c75_0xc6ca5c6bf34ef81.text: First, a little background. I'm an American, but I have a condo in Thailand. Almost 20 years ago, I was diagnosed with a massive tumor in my optical chiasm, the area in the brain where the optical nerves criss-cross from one hemisphere to the other. It was causing me to lose my eyesight, and immediate surgery was required. The upshot is that my pituitary gland was destroyed when the tumor was removed, meaning I'd need to be on testosterone replacement therapy for the rest of my life. In the U.S., getting a prescription for testosterone can be difficult, even when you have a well-documented medical need for it, as I do. Then there's the insurance issue. I've often had to do battle with my insurance company over getting testosterone treatments, and any time I changed insurers, the problems started all over again. Moving from one state to another made matters even worse. The people at my (very expensive) insurance were useless. Anyway... I came to Thailand three years ago, and with my supply of testosterone dwindling I went into the Maximum Performance Center in Pattaya to see if they could help me. My life got so much better that day! Getting on a regular schedule of injections was easy, and the cost includes regular blood testing and monitoring of not only my testosterone levels, but other critical blood components, too. I was able to start immediately. I didn't have to wait six weeks for a consultation with a doctor, then wait another month for a referral to a specialist, and then spend another two months arguing with my insurance company over whether the treatments were even warranted (that routine seemed to be the norm for me in the U.S.). Fortunately, quality health care is much more accessible here in Thailand. I've been going to Maximum Performance for over two years now, except for brief periods when I was visiting other countries, or when I've had to travel back to the United States. My doctor at Maximum Performance is always available if I have questions (either in person or on the Line app), and the staff have always been friendly and very efficient. The monthly price of the treatments sounds high when quoted in Thai Baht, but when you convert it to U.S. dollars it's actually an incredible value. For me, it's less than half of my old co-pay. I happily pay "out of pocket" because the cost is so reasonable. I also don't have to book separate appointments with a diagnostic lab (like Quest - yuck!) and then wait to hear from my endocrinologist to go over the test results. Everything is handled in one location, and those test results are ready the very next day. In summary, Maximum Performance has been a game-changer for me. Something that was a major headache for almost 20 years has been reduced to the simple task of stopping in twice a week for a quick shot. Easy peasy! FIVE STARS from me.

0x305031b8a0acc7e5_0x704321a56a24f7ab.text: I recently underwent multiple procedures at PPSI with Dr. Piyapas Pichaichanarong, and I cannot recommend him or the entire team highly enough. From the moment I met Dr. Piyapas, I felt completely at ease. He was warm, honest, and incredibly thorough. He answered all my questions without sugar-coating anything, which I really appreciated — especially travelling alone for major surgery. What truly blew me away was the extra care he showed — knowing I'd had gastric sleeve surgery and needed extra protein for healing, he personally brought me a banana protein shake every day. That simple gesture meant so much and showed how genuinely he cares for his patients. I had quite an extensive list of procedures done: ✔️ Breast Reduction with Implants ✔️ Vaser Liposuction (Upper & Lower Abdomen, Love Handles, Lower Back) ✔️ Extended Tummy Tuck & Flankplasty (Belt Lipectomy) ✔️ Vaser Liposuction of the Circumferential Thighs (Inner, Outer, and Front Thighs) ✔️ Extended Thigh Lift They were big surgeries, and I couldn’t be happier with the results. Even my GP back home was seriously impressed with Dr. Piyapas' work — so much so that he asked for his contact details to refer future patients. Emotionally, the days after surgery were tough — I was extremely emotional and couldn't stop crying, even though I didn't fully understand why. But the nurses and hospital staff were absolutely incredible. Despite the language barrier, I felt cared for, supported, and safe. They showed me so much kindness and respect, and always empowered me to believe I was improving, even on the tough days. Every time I went for my check-ups, the staff were genuinely happy to see my progress and mobility improving. It made me feel seen and celebrated. I also have to give a huge thank you to Restored Beauty Getaways, who organised this for me. From the initial booking to the daily check-ins while I was recovering, they made the entire process so smooth and stress-free. Travelling alone for such a big surgery was daunting, but with their support, I never felt alone. I wouldn’t have had the confidence to do this without them. If you're considering surgery in Thailand, I honestly couldn’t recommend PPSI, Dr. Piyapas, and Restored Beauty Getaways more. Their care, professionalism, and kindness exceeded all expectations. 10/10 — I wouldn’t trust anyone else.
0x305031b8a0acc7e5_0x704321a56a24f7ab.author: Zoe

0x305031b8a0acc7e5_0x704321a56a24f7ab.text: I have just returned to Perth after having an Endoscopic Brow Lift with Dr Piyapas Pichaichanarong, who is an incredible surgeon. I cannot rate Phuket Plastic Surgery Institute (PPSI) high enough! The team of doctors, nurses and staff members are absolutely incredible, from first point of contact via email in Australia to my last follow up appointment in Phuket two weeks after surgery. Dr Piyapas was very informative, honest and kind, I was a bit nervous about the surgery, but Dr Piyapas, and his Anaesthetist both put me at ease, and they both did a fantastic job before and after surgery. My Anaesthetist was there to wake me up, and managed my pain level straight away back in my private room, along with the lovely nurses who cared for me and checked on me hourly. The level of service at this hospital it unbelievable, the breakfast, lunch and dinners were divine, the food and drinks did not stop coming. Straight after surgery I didn’t look great, my eyes were a bit puffy but I expected worse, and the very next day I looked and felt perfectly fine, to be honest less than a week later you couldn’t even tell. Dr Piyapas, has done an incredible job, I would highly recommend him and his colleagues at PPSI. Also, Phuket is the best place for recovery, not only did I return home looking great with my new brow lift, I had a lovely sun tan, and I also felt mentally calm and relaxed. Thank you to everyone at PPSI.
0x305031b8a0acc7e5_0x704321a56a24f7ab.author: Tara Thomson

0x305031b8a0acc7e5_0x704321a56a24f7ab.text: I'm not usually one to leave reviews, but choosing a place for a procedure is a big decision, so hopefully I can help someone undecided to choose this amazing hospital. 2 weeks ago I flew to Thailand from Australia for a rhinoplasty at PPSI. Absolutely incredible standards, on par with Sydney hospitals. Amazing service from nurses during my stay, my surgeon; Dr. Piyapas Pichaichanarong was very professional and kind. The recovery was very quick and painless, making the surgery feel a lot less invasive than it was. Absolutely every question I had was answered during my consultation, leaving me with no doubts or worries. Be aware when getting a nose job that the results take around 6 months to fully develop, so don't get discouraged if it is very swollen when the cast first comes off! My only minor criticism would be the initial difficulty communicating via email. Sometimes it would take a few days to get a reply and have my questions answered. If this was fixed, it would be a lot easier for foreigners looking for cosmetic surgery to be equipped with all the information they need. Kind, professional, attentive nurses and doctors and amazing results so far, for a quarter of the Australian price. I am surprised there are not more reviews for PPSI (part of Bangkok hospital), so if anyone has any questions, I can only answer from my personal experience. feel free to reach out! My instagram is saskiafinnan
0x305031b8a0acc7e5_0x704321a56a24f7ab.author: Saskia Finnan

0x305031b8a0acc7e5_0x704321a56a24f7ab.text: Came here the first time for consultation after doing some google research. Book an online appointment (consultation or surgery) or make a call to the PPSI (Phuket Plastic Surgery Institute). They’ll tell you what to do, when to come, and approximation of the fees. Go here as scheduled. Though the PPSI personnel are able to speak English fluently the other staff here don’t. Go straight to 4th floor (PPSI floor) and do what you need to do here. If you don’t know how to get here in the first place, take Local Bus Line 1 from Bus Terminal 1 (Pink bus with number 1 on it) 15 TB/person and asked for Big C as destination, PPSI just next to it. 0x30e29fc7a36f7349_0x5c09b1443fff6609.text: I came for filler injections, but the doctor wouldn't let me because other treatments would give me even better results! For genuine care, only Jairak Clinic! Now that I'm in my 30s, my face is aging, so I needed Jairak's help. Last time I had filler injections with Dr. Ning, the results were amazing, but because I was in a hurry and wanted it done right then and there, I had Dr. Phuwan take care of me. I initially planned to only get filler injections to lift my face, but Dr. Phuwan analyzed my situation in detail. I have sunken temples, hollow cheeks, sagging skin, and uneven facial bone structure, making my face look asymmetrical. He said too much filler would make my face look bigger. So, he recommended Sculptra to address these issues, focusing on plumping the skin and providing an overall solution for a more youthful appearance. It also addresses the sunken areas with a biostimulator that stimulates collagen production, tightening loose and sagging skin. Improved skin structure + improved external appearance = a younger look. They always go all out with numbing cream here; they apply a generous amount of numbing mask. If you're afraid of pain, don't worry! He waits until the anesthetic takes full effect before starting the procedure, and he also injects local anesthetic at specific points. Therefore, the Sculptra injection was completely painless. The doctor was kind, gave excellent advice, explained every detail, provided full knowledge, and had a very gentle touch. Before the injection, the doctor mixed the medication in front of you, and you could scan a QR code to check the product information. You don't have to worry about getting counterfeit, smuggled, or expired medication; it's definitely the real thing. Now, let's talk about the location. It's a new branch, still easy to get to, and the atmosphere is fantastic. It feels like a spa, very modern, with private waiting rooms for those who need to have meetings or quick work discussions while waiting. The treatment rooms are clean and not intimidating. The immediate immediate effect was an improved skin appearance, like someone who had just finished a face mask. After 3 days, my face felt firmer and less saggy. I think the results will be more noticeable within 1-3 months. If you want to take care of your skin, choose Jairak Clinic; you won't be disappointed!

0x30e29fead08def43_0x2fa835476be33f41.text: I was so impressed! It was the most fun Ulthera treatment I've ever had. The doctor explained the equipment, how to identify authentic products, how to check skin layers, and the number of lines – it was like a pre-medical course! It helped me understand how the machine works and what I was getting into my body, how deep it penetrated, and how I could see my skin condition. It was so fun I wanted to get up and take notes! Throughout the procedure, there were 3-4 nurses massaging and using a massage machine to distract me from the pain. Actually, it wasn't painful at all and added to the comfort. Another thing that impressed me was the pillowcase! They changed the sheet for each person, so it was incredibly clean. Sometimes they don't invest in things like that. Imagine, so many heads sharing the same pillow! During the procedure, the doctor had the nurses adjust the neck angle left and right, tilting it up and down using techniques that didn't strain the client's neck at all. And the doctor sang a happy birthday song throughout the procedure! I can honestly say it was a very fun and memorable procedure. Importantly, the price was reasonable. Having flown to Korea for treatments for the past 3 years, I didn't have any plans to fly this year, so I looked for a trustworthy clinic with a good price, and I wasn't disappointed. I came with a promotion from James: 400+400. The doctor was very meticulous and the procedure took over an hour. It was totally worth the price because the doctor's time is money, but they were so thorough and careful. They didn't rush or try to accommodate too many clients. I highly recommend it. There's parking available. The clinic is near Chidlom BTS station, close to a suit shop. If you go up to the second floor, you'll see the suit shop first, with a beautiful view of Louis Vuitton as a backdrop. The clinic entrance is a little hard to find, but once you get inside, it's amazing! I was impressed with everything.🤙🏻

0x305031e80228b915_0x720d29d806ced6b.text: I want to help all the girls who were looking for information about abortion in Phuket and ended up at this clinic. At the time of this review, the clinic is open Thursdays from 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM. You should arrive early and get in line if you don't want to wait all day or not see the doctor at all. We arrived around 10:30 AM and didn't see the doctor until 3:30 PM. It was really crowded (but there's a Central shopping center nearby, so you can wait there). So, you enter the clinic barefoot (put on socks if you're worried about that), approach the very nice girl in the lobby, and she gives you a ticket with a number. Then you wait while she processes everyone who arrived before you. Once you're in line, you'll be called and given a time when the doctor will be ready to see you. After that, you can go about your business. I recommend arriving half an hour before your scheduled appointment, as the doctor may see you earlier (this happened to me; they saw me about 15-20 minutes early). Next, you'll be called in by a doctor with whom you'll discuss your concerns. The doctor is very professional, performs the ultrasound very gently (she doesn't press hard on your abdomen, as is often the case) and listens fully to you. She offers solutions and clearly describes the entire procedure. If your English is poor, the doctor will speak to you through a translator. Then you'll receive instructions and medications to address your concerns. Or, if, for example, the ultrasound doesn't show a fetus, you won't receive them. I saw the doctor rushing between the reception and her office, trying to see as many women as possible during her workday. Yet, the quality of the consultation doesn't suffer. This inspires respect; it's rare to find such a doctor. The doctor will also provide her WhatsApp number so you can receive information about the abortion procedure and contact you if you have any problems. Personally, I was extremely pleased with my visit to this hospital. Everything was handled very clearly and correctly, from the registration process to the administration and dispensing of pills. Thank you.

0x30e29cf6b9467a95_0x66586477d57b4b32.text: A Truly World-Class Healing Journey with Verita Life and Dr. Hossami My wife Daniella and I first came to Verita Life in 2017 after she was diagnosed with breast cancer. After researching several alternative cancer clinics, we spoke with Dr. Hossami over the phone. His calm reassurance, deep expertise, and compassionate approach gave us hope at a time when we were overwhelmed. Just five days later, we flew from the Middle East to begin our journey with Verita Life—and that decision changed everything. Thanks to Dr. Hossami’s personal attention and the clinic’s integrative approach, Daniella’s breast cancer was successfully treated during our first visit. From then on, we returned only for annual health checks. We’re also glad to share that her cancer markers have been steadily reducing —a testament to the effectiveness of the treatments and the ongoing care. In 2025, Daniella’s health declined again, and we returned to Verita Life. A PET scan revealed a fractured hip due to a recurrence of cancer. Once again, under Dr. Hossami’s guidance, Daniella regained her strength through a tailored program of treatments and therapies. After a few months, we were able to enjoy our summer vacation. What makes Verita Life truly exceptional is the complete experience: • Advanced Wellness Treatments: Hyperthermia, red light therapy, oxygen therapy, and many other integrative treatments are part of the standard offering. Each therapy is delivered with precision and care. • Seamless Arrival Experience: From the moment you land, Verita Life’s first-class meet-and-greet service at the airport ensures a smooth transition to your hotel. It’s one less thing to worry about during a stressful time. • Luxury Limousine Transfers: Daily transport from the hotel to the clinic and back is provided in comfort, allowing us to take in the vibrant sights of Thai life along the way. • Exceptional Nutrition Plans: The health food options are outstanding—nutritionally balanced, delicious, and tailored to support recovery and wellness. • State-of-the-Art Facilities: The brand-new clinic on the 32nd floor offers breathtaking views and a serene, healing environment. The facilities are exactly what you’d expect from a 5-star medical center—modern, spotless, and thoughtfully designed. • Unmatched Care and Attention: While you're here, you truly don’t have to think. Every detail is taken care of by the incredible team, whose loving care and attention lift the burden from your shoulders. • Comprehensive Departure Support: When it’s time to leave, Dr. Hossami and his team prepare all your medications and travel documents, and continue to follow up with calls to check in and answer any questions. It’s also worth noting that Dr. Hossami is constantly researching new methods for treating cancer. His commitment to staying updated with the latest protocols and innovations in wellness is truly astonishing. Knowing that he is always seeking better ways to help his patients puts our minds at ease and reinforces our faith in Verita Life. Words cannot fully express our gratitude. Daniella and I feel truly blessed for everything Dr. Hossami and his team have done—and continue to do—with such dedication, compassion, and excellence Oliver Harper

0x30e29cf6b9467a95_0x66586477d57b4b32.text: I would like to share my personal experience with my mother. I was literally in a state of confusion and extreme fear after she was diagnosed with stage 2 breast cancer. I started searching for clinics or places that offer complementary medicine treatments and came across Dr. Abdullah Hossami through an online interview with Alia Al-Moayed. I researched the clinic further, but since personal experiences were not widely available online, I was very anxious and hesitant. To be honest, I was also worried about some of the comments I read, which made me hesitant about visiting the clinic. However, my manager recommended the place after hearing about it from a Bahraini patient who had been treated there. I contacted her, and she provided me with all the details I needed. I kept praying and hesitated a lot, especially since my mother’s body couldn’t tolerate the first strong chemotherapy dose in our country, and her health deteriorated. I reached out to the marketing manager, Tareq, who was extremely responsive. He clearly explained all the required procedures and documents, guiding me through the online submission process. He also scheduled a free consultation with Dr. Abdullah. The doctor was very transparent and explained the treatment details thoroughly. That’s why I encourage anyone who is unsure about whether this treatment is suitable for them to book a consultation with the doctor. When we arrived at Virta Life Clinic, everything was smooth, quick, and comfortable—from airport reception to the treatment procedures during our four-month stay (as my mother underwent surgery in Bangkok). The way they treat cancer patients is incredibly kind and compassionate. We truly felt their care from every single member of the medical team. My mother felt both physically and emotionally reassured, unlike her experience with some doctors in our country. Now, we have returned home, and my mother is continuing her treatment with follow-ups from Dr. Abdullah. They remain attentive to our inquiries, responding to all our questions. Dr. Abdullah personally asked me to keep him updated on all my mother’s current symptoms and side effects after completing her treatment. To be completely honest in my review, my mother has improved, and the tumor has been removed. She is now undergoing additional treatments for three more months. However, we can only confirm whether her body is completely cancer-free after an MRI in three months. I made a promise to myself to help anyone who wants to ask about my experience because I remember how scared and lost I felt at the beginning. My mother is happy with her progress and always thanks me for choosing a comfortable place that offers gentle complementary cancer treatments and milder chemotherapy doses instead of the strong ones. I will write an update later 👍🏼

0x30e29cf6b9467a95_0x66586477d57b4b32.text: Dr. Hossami, Julie Palmer, a patient at Veritalife Thailand, died on April 4th, 2024, after returning home with promising actionable scan results provided by your clinic to her metastatic breast cancer. However, Australian oncologists found severe discrepancies, indicating her cancer had exponentially and significantly progressed. Additionally and despite assurances from you, that Julie was on the road to recovery. Julie's health deteriorated rapidly upon returning to Australia causing admission to the ICU THE VERY NEXT DAY OF HER RETURN to Australia, eventually leading to her death. We both attempted to reach out for clarification, from Veritalife and you in particular for direction and assurance, but we received no response at all and this was all promised to Julie leaving you and your facility. This tragic outcome occurred after 19 weeks of intensive treatment at your facility when we were told that 6 weeks would be adequate. And raises severe medical concerns and question to your actual treatment regime. It also raises alarm bells to serious concerns about the care Veritalife and you provided Julie and towards the accuracy of the scan results you assured Julie were encouraging as she left your facility. Julie was aged 63, came home at 41 kg and her lungs were filled with fluid on return home but leaving AUSTRALIA she was approximately 65kg. She returned home in severe respiratory distress with 4 Ltr of fluid in one lung and one ltr of fluid in the other lung but so devastatingly sick, and you declared her fit to fly home and without oxygen , really Dr Hossami? When Julie was given the news here by the oncologist in AUSTRALIA , It completely broke her heart and shattered us all especially as she and I were expecting correlation to your scan results. She was told straight out that her cancer had progressed seriously and she would not survive and that they recommend palliative care immediately from this point on? Julie and I trusted Veritalife and you, only to be let down so Severely and devastatingly it is hard for us to comprehend . Ultimately we buried Julie on April 26th, 2024. This unethical behaviour has devastated our family not just to losing my dear wife but has broken my daughter on losing her mother, physically and spiritually. We are suffering financially now as a result as a family and this abomination demands accountability from you and Veritalife." Anthony Donnellan
0x30e29cf6b9467a95_0x66586477d57b4b32.author: Anthony Donnellan

0x30e29cf6b9467a95_0x66586477d57b4b32.text: I was diagnosed with breast cancer in 2024. Before starting any treatment in my home country of Saudi Arabia, I researched the most effective and efficient methods to completely eradicate the tumor without any residual effects or side effects. I heard from a friend that her relative had been treated in Thailand in a record time of three months. I contacted her and learned all about her experience and how she returned home completely cancer-free, so I decided to try it myself. I traveled to Thailand, which proved to be a suitable option. I met Dr. Abdullah Husami, whose approach was very reassuring, and I immediately began treatment. It was a comprehensive treatment plan that focused on the type of food and vitamins the body needed, detoxifying the body, and using natural cancer-fighting agents, with the addition of a low-dose chemotherapy with minimal side effects if necessary to eliminate the disease. The approach was comfortable and the treatment was excellent. My treatment continued for three months, after which I returned home and continued treatment with a special diet and immune-boosting supplements, antioxidants to combat inflammation, and low-dose chemotherapy pills. I remained in contact with Dr. Husami, and we are still in close contact and monitoring my condition. …Thanks to Professor Tariq, the clinic supervisor…Thanks to Dr. Hossami for his excellent treatment…I ask God to grant complete healing to me and every patient.

0x30e29cf6b9467a95_0x66586477d57b4b32.text: I purchased the "Cancer coach program" for a family member who was diagnosed with cancer last year. I had one session with the doctor and couldn't get a session with the nutritionist since sessions were booked for a whole month! A few days after the first session with the doctor, my family member passed away. I contacted Verita life and asked for a partial refund since I only got one session from the eight offered in the program. They dragged the matter for months before finally informing me that their policy doesn't have a refund option in my case. I checked and couldn't find such policy anywhere! Hence, my rating is for the administrative aspect and not the medical one, unfortunately we did not have a chance to fully take advantage of it! In the end my advice is to have hope and knock all doors for treatment, but even though no one goes into this expecting the worst, but know your rights from the start. UPDATE: Dr. Hossami saw my review and contacted me directly. He explained that they didn't know anything about this! The employee whom I contacted -who is no longer with them - didn't follow up on the matter nor inform them about it! They immediately refund the whole amount and apologized for what happened. This gave me faith that I am dealing with an honest establishment who took action once they knew that something was wrong. Many thanks to Dr. Hossami!

0x30e284f272fb914b_0xf3d3e03a6cfbd5c4.text: Based on your review, Im kira: As I was the doctor who examined you today, Im kira, you were a new patient who hadn't made a prior appointment. The fact that you have periodontitis necessitates treatment from a specialist because the treatment procedure requires local anesthesia to prevent pain, as all tartar needs to be removed both above and below the gums. 0x30e29fdf7cede86d_0x273357fda523ff01.text: I am a patient in the neurology department. I underwent my first surgery in August 2024 for a ruptured cerebral artery and a second surgery in March 2025 to prevent another rupture. Before that, I received treatment at the physical therapy department for a frozen left shoulder. I would like to express my sincere gratitude to the three physical therapists who took such excellent care of me. With brain surgery, my biggest fear was the side effects, which can range from muscle weakness to paralysis. Besides the expert brain surgery team, I cannot help but write a heartfelt thank you to the three physical therapists who provided me with physical and emotional support, giving me the strength to do physical therapy every day until I became almost completely normal (even though during that time I wasn't confident I would ever fully recover). The physical therapists enabled me to have a healthy body and fulfill my dream: to study Thai classical dance. 🥰🥰 Memorizing dance movements, maintaining balance—head, arms, legs, torso—everything must move in coordination and with perfect rhythm. This comes from consistent and sometimes intense practice. Thanks to the skills of these three physiotherapists. I would like to take this opportunity to express my gratitude to the following three individuals: 1. Mr. Prasit Suwanmanirat. I would like to call him a Super Coach. He was incredibly patient with my mood swings and trained me rigorously and consistently. Most importantly, he changed my perspective on what it means to be a good physiotherapist. He taught me that it's not just about training the patient's body, but also training their heart to be patient, persistent, and to reach their goals without giving up. 2. Ms. Manasavee Uraiphan. She was the first physiotherapist who trained me for my frozen shoulder. She was sincere in her training, making it fun, and she constantly encouraged me even before my stroke. 3. Ms. Kanjana Chulaphan. She was a physiotherapist who, when I was fussy and sleepy from taking anti-seizure medication, comforted me in countless ways. I felt so grateful and motivated to do my arm physiotherapy, even though it was very painful. These three individuals are physiotherapists of the highest quality I've ever met. I am so incredibly happy that during my year and a half at Bangkok Hospital, I met all three of them. Christmas is almost here! I may not have any gifts to give to the three of you, so I would like to take this opportunity to say "Thank you very much" for helping me, a brain patient, to return to studying performing arts, as I have always dreamed. Thank you so much. And I would also like to thank Bangkok Hospital for screening out highly qualified physical therapists to work at Bangkok Hospital, so that patients like us have the opportunity to receive such excellent treatment for life.
0x30e29fdf7cede86d_0x273357fda523ff01.author: Worapan Hoontrakool

I had lost a significant amount of weight, and had quite loose skin on my lower stomach. I had been planning this surgery for about 18months. My biggest fear was replacing something I hated (my loose skin) with something I hated even more (a horrific scar). Dr Weerachai specialises in his stitch work and I could not be more happy with my lines. His attention to detail, his constant checking in. I seen Dr Weerachai every single day I was in the hospital. I felt very cared for and not just another number. He listened to what I was hoping to achieve and went above my expectations. The nursing staff at the hospital were brilliant as well! I travelled over solo and was slightly worried how I would go without a support person. However, with the nurses, there really isn't a need for a support person as they are right there helping you with everything. I would 100% recommend Destination Beauty and Dr Weerachai to anybody that's looking at contouring their body. The professionalism and attention to detail are unmatched.
0x30e29be3a7ba320f_0x3a49662e1ab22a62.author: Sarah McHenry

0x30e29be3a7ba320f_0x3a49662e1ab22a62.text: I had a really lovely experience with Destination Beauty! From start to finish, .The care, professionalism, and support I received throughout my journey were outstanding. My husband came along as my support and was truly amazing,I could not have gone through this without him by my side. My 2 surgeons Dr Ring and Dr Weerachai did an outstanding job with my surgeries, and I absolutely love my results. The sweet nurses at the hospital were so kind and caring, and the Destination Beauty team consistently checked in on me—both in person and via text—to make sure I was recovering well and had everything I needed. I felt truly cared for every step of the way. I highly recommend them to anyone considering surgery abroad, honestly far better than anything I've experienced here in Australia. I'm now 1 year post-op,and I couldn't be happier with my results. Dr Weerachai performed my breast lift with implants, and Dr Ring performed my arm lift, back bra line lift, and liposuction. Thank you DB for making my experience such a positive one! Just be sure to follow all the pre- and post-op care instructions, and you’ll be in great hands

0x30e29be3a7ba320f_0x3a49662e1ab22a62.text: Absolutely outstanding service, support and care! I had skin removal surgery with Destination Beauty 7 months ago and my experience was second to none. My entire journey - planning and guidance from my rep, pre surgery consults, 24/7 care by the nursing staff before, during and after surgery and recovery care in a hotel - was a dream come true. After a 70kg weight loss, I desperately needed skin removal surgery. I researched extensively before deciding Destination Beauty was the right fit for me. It was 1/3 of the price I was quoted in Australia, which not only included the surgery by an excellent surgeon whose work was impeccable, it included all airport, hotel and hospital transfers, recovery care in a beautiful hotel with free buffet breakfasts each morning, complimentary outings, mini afternoon 'high teas' , regular nurse visits and do you believe it included taking along a support person! I have never received the level of care that I received with Destination Beauty. I would and do recommend them to anyone wanting surgery of any kind!!

0x3102969a5132a507_0xf71a1fbf0176757d.text: Front incisor root pin broke (after previous repair at local hospital) and now an implant was the only viable course of action. After visiting several places, I settle on Dr. Nan (his nickname). Besides being license here, he attended a year of implant training at UCLA (California USA) and has good mastery of the English language. He was prepared to explain everything in writing and was most willing to answer questions without pressure or rushing you. During the many visits, he took great care to reduce discomfort and to verify his work. Because this was a very visible area of the mouth he made a temporary bridge from flow-able resin. No one could tell I was having work done. Please understand he certainly isn't the cheapest place around, but as with most things, you get what you pay for. What impressed me also was "no surprises" of up-charging for extras. Dr. Nan has training from several of the major implant makers. In my case we decided on a mid range implant made by Anyridge. This was after much web investigation and consultation. I won't know for sure until years down the road if I made the correct decisions of doctor and device; but I am pretty sure I did.

0x30e29f60c122f74d_0xe5bf56df4a5d3635.text: Review of filler injection with Dr. Ploy Atmosphere/Location: The clinic is clean and not too difficult to get to. It's located in a small alley within another alley, about a 10-minute walk from the BTS station. The clinic has two floors, with one room upstairs. Service: The staff are lovely, polite, and friendly. They offered sweet drinks and blankets/pillows when I seemed afraid of needles. They followed up after the injection and explained the medication in an easy-to-understand way. Doctor: I had my injection with Dr. Ploy because I was mainly concerned about the area around my eyes. The admin informed me that Dr. Ploy is an ophthalmologist, so I chose her. She has a gentle touch; there was the normal pain from a deep needle insertion. She gave excellent advice, distributing the filler evenly across my face from the 3cc package I purchased. She didn't try to sell me more, only recommending specific areas I wanted to address. She offered suggestions for future appointments and didn't pressure me. Initially, I didn't plan on getting filler, but she also added filler to my chin, making my face look softer. She was very patient and took breaks to allow me to prepare. I will definitely come back for more injections with her. Results: About two days later, I love how I look. I feel like I've had enough sleep, and my face looks slimmer. Shallow under-eye grooves, slightly flat cheeks, a little eye lift, a subtle chin enhancement – ​​very natural-looking. Price: We used the 14,999 baht promotion and got 3cc of Elasty, which works out to about 5,000 baht per cc. It was okay, I was satisfied. I paid the same price upon leaving the clinic; there were no additional purchases. Overall, it was good. This was my first time getting filler injections, and I think I'll come back for more services.

There are other cosmetic and medical services offered in the same medical facility on different floors as well. Payment is accepted after each treatment and since Bangkok never sleeps you'll never miss out on anything. The only major difference I noticed between this facility and the facility I used in the states is that the use of saline (salt) it's used more conservatively in Thailand so bring mustard or salt tablets if you're the type who cramps.
